jobs.title: Operations Manager, ZCAM
jobs.description:
Are you a motivated and innovative person, interested in working on strategic projects for one of the largest global insurers? Then this job is definitely something for you.

As Operations Manager, you will be part of an agile delivery unit to power data-driven decisions and advancing the data and analytics capabilities of the Zurich organization. By leveraging new technology, the ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) unit ensures that all stakeholders in the organization can efficiently access leverage data and use modern technologies to enable the business to be truly customer centric. As an Operations Manager you own the production operations of existing setups leading a wider cross-functional team of internal resources and external partners.
Within our chapter-based delivery model, you are the single point of accountability for production operations ensuring that all live solutions meet agreed service levels, that the RUN team is effectively resourced and managed, and that operational excellence is continuously advanced. You drive the adoption of Agentic AI and automation to enhance production resilience, reduce manual intervention, and future-proof our operations.

You act as the connective tissue between chapter leads, product teams, vendors, and senior leadership on all matters relating to production stability, operations resourcing and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

- Production Operations Ownership: Own end-to-end accountability for production operations across all live Claims and Automation solutions. Ensure service stability, SLA/OLA adherence, availability targets, and operational health across the production landscape

- Own the resource model for the wider RUN team. Plan, allocate, and manage capacity across internal staff and external partners to ensure adequate coverage for BAU operations, incident response, peak periods, and planned maintenance windows

- Lead incident response and resolution processes; ensure root cause analysis and problem management drive sustainable fixes and reduce repeat incidents. Maintain escalation paths and on-call structures

- Define, monitor, and report on SLAs, OLAs, and KPIs for production services. Drive accountability for service performance and initiate corrective actions where targets are at risk.

- Systematically identify and eliminate operational inefficiencies, recurring issues, and manual toil. Drive measurable improvements in availability, mean time to resolve (MTTR), and operational cost

- Champion the adoption of Agentic AI and intelligent automation within production operations including self-healing mechanisms, automated monitoring and alerting, intelligent incident triage, and predictive maintenance

- Own the RUN operational budget, drive cost transparency, and identify opportunities to optimize spend though automation, vendor consolidation

- Ensure RUN operations comply with Zurich's IT governance, change management, security, and regulatory standards. Maintain audit readiness and operational documentation

- Engaging with various business and customer stakeholders as well as technology teams Lead incident response and resolution processes; ensure root cause analysis and problem management drive sustainable fixes and reduce repeat incidents. Maintain escalation paths and on-call structures

- Lead, coach, and develop the wider RUN team. Foster a culture of ownership, reliability, and continuous learning. Manage performance, onboarding, and skill development for production operations roles.

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven track record in production/RUN operations management, service management, or IT operations leadership

- Strong experience managing wider, cross-functional teams (internal and external) in a 24/7 or business-critical production environment

- Deep expertise in ITIL service management frameworks: incident, problem, change, and service level management

- Demonstrated experience in RUN resource planning, capacity management, and workforce scheduling across multiple products or platforms

- Track record of driving continuous service improvement with measurable outcomes (availability, MTTR, cost per transaction, automation rate)

- Familiarity with AI/ML technologies and enthusiasm for leveraging Agentic AI to automate and enhance production operations

- Strong analytical skills; comfort with data-driven decision-making, KPI dashboards, and operational reporting

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to translate operational complexity into clear executive-level updates

- Experience with operations and monitoring tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, Azure Monitor, PagerDuty, Jira)

- Knowledge of insurance industry operations, particularly claims processing, is an advantage

- Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or related field; advanced degree is an advantage

- Fluent in Slovenian and English; any additional language is an advantage

- Acts with integrity, accountability, and sound business ethics; champions operational reliability and continuous improvement

- Acts with integrity, confidence, accountability and demonstrates sound business ethics and consistently adheres to, and promotes these throughout the project lifecycle

Additional information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich supports flexible working arrangements and recognizes that talent comes in many forms. Please feel free to discuss any flexibility needs during the interview process.

At Zurich, we challenge the status quo and focus on what can go right. We are an equal opportunity employer that values diversity, individuality and collaboration.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Location(s): SI - Ljubljana

- Remote working: Hybrid

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Vesna Pivk

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei una persona motivata e innovativa, interessata a lavorare a progetti strategici per uno dei più grandi assicuratori globali? Allora questo lavoro e' sicuramente qualcosa per te.

In qualità di Operations Manager, sarai parte di un'unità di consegna agile per alimentare le decisioni basate sui dati e migliorare le funzionalità di dati e analisi dell'organizzazione di Zurigo. Grazie alla nuova tecnologia, l'unità ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) assicura che tutti gli stakeholder dell'organizzazione possano accedere efficacemente ai dati di leva e utilizzare le moderne tecnologie per consentire all'azienda di essere veramente centrici per i clienti. Come Operations Manager possiedi le operazioni di produzione di configurazioni esistenti che portano un team multifunzionale di risorse interne e partner esterni.
All'interno del nostro modello di consegna a base di capitolo, sei il singolo punto di responsabilità per le operazioni di produzione, assicurando che tutte le soluzioni dal vivo soddisfino i livelli di servizio concordati, che il team RUN sia effettivamente dotato e gestito, e che l'eccellenza operativa sia continuamente avanzata. Si guida l'adozione di AI Agentic e l'automazione per migliorare la resilienza di produzione, ridurre l'intervento manuale e future-proof le nostre operazioni.

Si agisce come il tessuto connettivo tra i capi di capitolo, i team di prodotto, i fornitori e la leadership senior su tutte le questioni relative alla stabilità di produzione, alle operazioni di risonanza e alle prestazioni operative.

Principali responsabilità

- ProprietÃ delle operazioni di produzione: Responsabilità end-to-end per le operazioni di produzione in tutte le soluzioni Live Claims e Automation. Assicurare stabilità del servizio, aderenza SLA/OLA, obiettivi di disponibilità e salute operativa attraverso il paesaggio di produzione

- Proprio il modello di risorsa per il team RUN più ampio. Pianificare, assegnare e gestire la capacità tra personale interno e partner esterni per garantire una copertura adeguata per le operazioni di BAU, risposta agli incidenti, periodi di picco e finestre di manutenzione pianificate

- Guidare i processi di risposta e risoluzione degli incidenti; garantire l'analisi causa radice e la gestione dei problemi guidare correzioni sostenibili e ridurre gli incidenti ripetuti. Mantenere percorsi di escalation e strutture on-call

- Definire, monitorare e segnalare SLA, OLA e KPI per i servizi di produzione. Guidare la responsabilità per le prestazioni del servizio e avviare azioni correttive in cui gli obiettivi sono a rischio.

- Identificare ed eliminare sistematicamente le inefficienze operative, i problemi ricorrenti e il toil manuale. Guidare miglioramenti misurabili nella disponibilità, significa tempo per risolvere (MTTR), e costi operativi

- Campione l'adozione di AI Agentic e l'automazione intelligente all'interno delle operazioni di produzione, compresi i meccanismi di autoguarigione, il monitoraggio automatizzato e l'avviso, il triage degli incidenti intelligenti e la manutenzione predittiva

- Proprio il bilancio operativo RUN, la trasparenza dei costi di trasmissione e identificare le opportunità per ottimizzare la spesa anche se l'automazione, consolidamento del fornitore

- Assicurarsi che le operazioni RUN siano conformi alla governance IT di Zurigo, alla gestione dei cambiamenti, alla sicurezza e agli standard normativi. Mantenere la disponibilità di audit e la documentazione operativa

- Impegnarsi con diversi stakeholder aziendali e clienti, così come i team tecnologici portano i processi di risposta e risoluzione degli incidenti; assicurano l'analisi delle cause principali e la gestione dei problemi guidare correzioni sostenibili e ridurre gli incidenti ripetuti. Mantenere percorsi di escalation e strutture on-call

- Guidare, allenare e sviluppare la squadra RUN più ampia. Promuovere una cultura di proprietà, affidabilità e apprendimento continuo. Gestisci prestazioni, onboarding e sviluppo di abilità per ruoli di produzione.

Qualificazioni predestinate

- Provato record di traccia nella gestione delle operazioni di produzione/RUN, gestione dei servizi o leadership delle operazioni IT

- Forte esperienza nella gestione di team più ampi e interfunzionali (interni ed esterni) in un ambiente di produzione 24/7 o business-critical

- Competenze approfondite nei quadri di gestione dei servizi ITIL: gestione degli incidenti, dei problemi, dei cambiamenti e dei livelli di servizio

- Esperienza dimostrata nella pianificazione delle risorse RUN, nella gestione delle capacità e nella pianificazione della forza lavoro su più prodotti o piattaforme

- Registrazione di guida continuo miglioramento del servizio con risultati misurabili (disponibilità, MTTR, costo per transazione, tasso di automazione)

- Familiarità con le tecnologie AI/ML e l'entusiasmo per sfruttare l'intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare e migliorare le operazioni di produzione

- Forte capacità analitiche; comfort con il processo decisionale, cruscotti KPI e report operativi

- Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder; capacità di tradurre complessità operativa in chiari aggiornamenti di livello executive

- Esperienza con operazioni e strumenti di monitoraggio (ad esempio, ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, Azure Monitor, PagerDuty, Jira)

- La conoscenza delle operazioni del settore assicurativo, in particolare il trattamento dei crediti, è un vantaggio

- Laurea in economia, ingegneria, informatica, o campo correlato; grado avanzato è un vantaggio

- Fluente in sloveno e inglese; qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un vantaggio

- Atti con integrità, responsabilità ed etica aziendale sonora; campioni di affidabilità operativa e miglioramento continuo

- Atti con integrità, fiducia, responsabilità e dimostra la sana etica aziendale e aderisce costantemente e li promuove in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto

Ulteriori informazioni

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online.

Zurigo sostiene le modalità di lavoro flessibili e riconosce che il talento viene in molte forme. Si prega di sentirsi liberi di discutere qualsiasi esigenza di flessibilità durante il processo di intervista.

A Zurigo, sfidiamo lo status quo e ci concentriamo su ciò che può andare bene. Siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che valorizza la diversità, l'individualità e la collaborazione.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che sa che ogni dipendente è unico - questo è ciò che rende la nostra squadra così grande!
Unisciti a noi come esploriamo costantemente nuovi modi per proteggere i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

- Posizione(i): SI - Lubiana

- Funzionamento remoto: ibrido

- Orari: Tempo pieno

- Nome del reclutatore: Vesna Pivk
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie eine motivierte und innovative Person, die an strategischen Projekten für einen der größten globalen Versicherer interessiert ist? Dann ist dieser Job definitiv etwas für dich.

Als Operations Manager sind Sie Teil einer agilen Delivery Unit, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungen zu treffen und die Daten- und Analysefähigkeiten der Zürcher Organisation voranzutreiben. Durch die Nutzung neuer Technologien stellt die ZCAM-Einheit (Zürich Customer Active Management) sicher, dass alle Stakeholder in der Organisation effizient auf Daten zugreifen und moderne Technologien nutzen können, um das Unternehmen wirklich kundenorientiert zu machen. Als Operations Manager besitzen Sie den Produktionsbetrieb bestehender Setups und führen ein breiteres funktionsübergreifendes Team aus internen Ressourcen und externen Partnern.
Innerhalb unseres kapitelbasierten Liefermodells sind Sie der einzige Verantwortlichkeitspunkt für den Produktionsbetrieb, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Live-Lösungen die vereinbarten Serviceniveaus erfüllen, dass das RUN-Team effektiv mit Ressourcen ausgestattet und verwaltet wird und dass die operative Exzellenz kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt wird. Sie treiben die Einführung von Agentic AI und Automatisierung voran, um die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Produktion zu verbessern, manuelle Eingriffe zu reduzieren und unseren Betrieb zukunftssicher zu machen.

Sie fungieren als Bindegewebe zwischen Chapter Leads, Produktteams, Anbietern und Führungskräften in allen Fragen der Produktionsstabilität, der Betriebsmittelbeschaffung und der operativen Leistung.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

- Production Operations Ownership: Eigene End-to-End-Verantwortlichkeit für den Produktionsbetrieb in allen Live-Claims und Automatisierungslösungen. Gewährleistung der Servicestabilität, der Einhaltung von SLA/OLA, der Verfügbarkeitsziele und des Betriebszustands in der gesamten Produktionslandschaft

- Besitze das Ressourcenmodell für das breitere RUN-Team. Planen, Allokieren und Verwalten von Kapazitäten zwischen internen Mitarbeitern und externen Partnern, um eine angemessene Abdeckung des BAU-Betriebs, der Reaktion auf Vorfälle, der Spitzenzeiten und der geplanten Wartungsfenster zu gewährleisten

- Führen Sie Incident Response- und Lösungsprozesse; Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ursachenanalyse und das Problemmanagement nachhaltige Korrekturen vorantreiben und Wiederholungsvorfälle reduzieren. Eskalationspfade und Bereitschaftsstrukturen beibehalten

- Definieren, überwachen und berichten Sie über SLAs, OLAs und KPIs für Produktionsdienste. Führen Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht für die Serviceleistung und initiieren Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen, wenn Ziele gefährdet sind.

- Systematisch identifizieren und beseitigen operative Ineffizienzen, wiederkehrende Probleme und manuelle Arbeit. Steigerung der Verfügbarkeit, der mittleren Lösungszeit (MTTR) und der Betriebskosten

- Verfechten Sie die Einführung von Agentic AI und intelligenter Automatisierung in den Produktionsbetrieben, einschließlich Selbstheilungsmechanismen, automatisierter Überwachung und Alarmierung, intelligenter Incident Triage und vorausschauender Wartung

- Besitzen Sie das RUN-Betriebsbudget, fördern Sie Kostentransparenz und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung der Ausgaben durch Automatisierung, Lieferantenkonsolidierung

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass der RUN-Betrieb den Zürcher IT-Governance-, Change-Management-, Sicherheits- und Regulierungsstandards entspricht. Pflege der Prüfungsbereitschaft und der Betriebsunterlagen

- Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Geschäfts- und Kundenstakeholdern sowie Technologieteams Führen Sie Incident Response- und Lösungsprozesse; Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ursachenanalyse und das Problemmanagement nachhaltige Korrekturen vorantreiben und Wiederholungsvorfälle reduzieren. Eskalationspfade und Bereitschaftsstrukturen beibehalten

- Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie das breitere RUN-Team. Fördern Sie eine Kultur des Eigentums, der Zuverlässigkeit und des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Verwalten Sie Leistung, Onboarding und Kompetenzentwicklung für Rollen im Produktionsbetrieb.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in den Bereichen Produktions-/RUN-Betriebsmanagement, Servicemanagement oder IT-Betriebsführung

- Starke Erfahrung im Management breiterer, funktionsübergreifender Teams (intern und extern) in einer 24/7 oder geschäftskritischen Produktionsumgebung

- Tiefe Expertise in ITIL Service Management Frameworks: Incident, Problem, Change und Service Level Management

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der RUN-Ressourcenplanung, dem Kapazitätsmanagement und der Mitarbeiterplanung über mehrere Produkte oder Plattformen hinweg

- Erfolgsbilanz der kontinuierlichen Serviceverbesserung mit messbaren Ergebnissen (Verfügbarkeit, MTTR, Kosten pro Transaktion, Automatisierungsrate)

- Vertrautheit mit AI / ML-Technologien und Begeisterung für die Nutzung von Agentic AI zur Automatisierung und Verbesserung des Produktionsbetriebs

- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten; Komfort mit datengesteuerter Entscheidungsfindung, KPI-Dashboards und operativer Berichterstattung

- Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; Fähigkeit, operative Komplexität in klare Updates auf Führungsebene zu übersetzen

- Erfahrung mit Betriebs- und Überwachungstools (z. B. ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, Azure Monitor, PagerDuty, Jira)

- Kenntnisse der Versicherungsbranche, insbesondere der Schadenbearbeitung, sind von Vorteil

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Engineering, Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen; fortgeschrittener Abschluss ist ein Vorteil

- Fließend in Slowenisch und Englisch; jede zusätzliche Sprache ist von Vorteil

- Handeln mit Integrität, Rechenschaftspflicht und solider Geschäftsethik; Verfechter der Betriebszuverlässigkeit und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung

- Handeln Sie mit Integrität, Vertrauen und Rechenschaftspflicht und zeigen Sie eine solide Geschäftsethik und halten Sie sich konsequent daran und fördern Sie diese während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus

Zusätzliche Angaben

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung.

Zurich unterstützt flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen und erkennt an, dass Talente in vielen Formen vorkommen. Bitte fühlen sie sich frei, alle flexibilitätsbedürfnisse während des interviewprozesses zu besprechen.

Bei Zurich stellen wir den Status Quo in Frage und konzentrieren uns darauf, was richtig gehen kann. Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Wert auf Vielfalt, Individualität und Zusammenarbeit legt.

Warum Zürich

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der weiß, dass jeder Mitarbeiter einzigartig ist - das macht unser Team so großartig!
Begleiten Sie uns, während wir ständig neue Wege erkunden, um unsere Kunden und den Planeten zu schützen.

- Ort(e): SI - Ljubljana

- Fernarbeit: Hybrid

- Zeitplan: Vollzeit

- Name des Personalvermittlers: Vesna Pivk

Êtes-vous une personne motivée et innovante, intéressée à travailler sur des projets stratégiques pour l'un des plus grands assureurs mondiaux? Alors ce boulot est définitivement quelque chose pour vous.

En tant que gestionnaire des opérations, vous ferez partie d'une unité de livraison agile pour alimenter les décisions basées sur les données et faire progresser les capacités de données et d'analyse de l'organisation de Zurich. En tirant parti des nouvelles technologies, l'unité ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) veille à ce que toutes les parties prenantes de l'organisation puissent accéder efficacement aux données de levier et utiliser les technologies modernes pour permettre à l'entreprise d'être véritablement centrée sur le client. En tant que gestionnaire des opérations, vous possédez les opérations de production des configurations existantes et dirigez une équipe interfonctionnelle élargie de ressources internes et de partenaires externes.
Dans notre modèle de prestation par chapitre, vous êtes le seul point de responsabilisation pour les opérations de production en veillant à ce que toutes les solutions réelles répondent aux niveaux de service convenus, à ce que l'équipe RUN soit efficacement dotée de ressources et gérée, et à ce que l'excellence opérationnelle soit constamment avancée. Vous conduisez l'adoption de l'IA Agentic et de l'automatisation pour améliorer la résilience de la production, réduire l'intervention manuelle et protéger nos opérations.

Vous agissez comme le tissu conjonctif entre les chefs de chapitre, les équipes de produits, les fournisseurs et les cadres supérieurs sur toutes les questions liées à la stabilité de la production, au ressourcement des opérations et au rendement opérationnel.

Principales responsabilités

- Exploitations de production Propriété : Responsabilité de bout en bout pour les opérations de production dans toutes les solutions de réclamations et d'automatisation en direct. Assurer la stabilité des services, le respect de l'ALS/ALA, les objectifs de disponibilité et la santé opérationnelle dans l'ensemble du paysage de production

- Posséder le modèle de ressources pour l'équipe RUN élargie. Planifier, répartir et gérer les capacités de l'ensemble du personnel interne et des partenaires externes pour assurer une couverture adéquate des opérations de l'UAB, des interventions en cas d'incident, des périodes de pointe et des fenêtres d'entretien prévues

- Diriger les processus d'intervention et de résolution des incidents; veiller à ce que l'analyse des causes profondes et la gestion des problèmes entraînent des correctifs durables et réduisent les incidents répétés. Maintenir les voies d'escalade et les structures d'appel

- Définir, surveiller et rendre compte des ALS, des ALO et des ICR pour les services de production. Diriger la reddition de comptes sur le rendement du service et prendre des mesures correctives lorsque les cibles sont à risque.

- Identifier et éliminer systématiquement les inefficacités opérationnelles, les problèmes récurrents et le travail manuel. Conduire des améliorations mesurables dans la disponibilité, le temps moyen pour résoudre (MTTR) et les coûts opérationnels

- Championne de l'adoption de l'IA Agentic et de l'automatisation intelligente dans les opérations de production, y compris les mécanismes d'auto-guérison, la surveillance et l'alerte automatisées, le tri intelligent des incidents et la maintenance prédictive

- Posséder le budget opérationnel RUN, favoriser la transparence des coûts et identifier les possibilités d'optimiser les dépenses par l'automatisation, la consolidation des fournisseurs

- Veiller à ce que les opérations RUN respectent les normes de gouvernance informatique, de gestion du changement, de sécurité et de réglementation de Zurich. Maintenir l'état de préparation de la vérification et la documentation opérationnelle

- Faire appel à divers intervenants commerciaux et clients ainsi qu'à des équipes technologiques Diriger les processus d'intervention et de résolution des incidents; veiller à ce que l'analyse des causes profondes et la gestion des problèmes entraînent des solutions durables et réduisent les incidents répétés. jobs.title: Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter Umbrella Excess Casualty
jobs.description:
Zurich is seeking an Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter, Umbrella Excess Casualty for our National Accounts Large Property Underwriting team in our Dallas office. While this position will be based out of a Zurich office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers and be in the office/market three days per week.

As an Umbrella Excess Casualty Underwriter at Zurich you will have the opportunity to grow and develop your career as a member of seasoned and dynamic team. You will be underwriting new and renewal business, under limited direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority levels on highly complex accounts. We focus strongly on our customers and are seeking someone with the ability to develop exceptional relationships and a strong market facing presence. Experience with underwriting P&C lines is preferred.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Our Umbrella Excess Casualty Underwriters are responsible for:

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make agent/broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiate Terms & Conditions and close deals.

- Cross-Sell other lines of business to increase product density with the account.

- Participate in Sales Team meeting as related to assigned brokers and / or territory.

- Proactively engage in the target account process, managing a qualified list of opportunities 90 to 120 days prior to effective date.

- Update required systems with details of broker / client visits and account status within specified time frame.

- Serve as key contact for assigned target accounts.

- Develop strong broker and client networks as related to industries underwritten by Business Unit.

- Calculate Target Price accurately by utilizing underwriting tools appropriately.

Basic Qualifications: Underwriting Specialist:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Basic Qualifications - Executive Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in commercial underwriting or brokerage or market facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the claims or underwriting support area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- CPCU

- Advanced knowledge of Umbrella/Excess Casualty product lines

- Knowledge of Primary Casualty and loss sensitive accounts

- Strong broker/customer relationships

- Excellent communication skills

- Excellent skills in relationship building

- Strong presentation skills

- Results oriented

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $79,600.00 - $172,300.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $79,600.00 - $130,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $105,200.00 - $172,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.+

Within the TDC, we are the DDP AI Solutions team within Zurich's TDC Barcelona — senior team delivering end-to-end AI applications for Group Functions. Current live products include an agentic control testing platform, a regulatory monitoring tool across multiple jurisdictions, an AI assistant for multinational insurance data, and financial crime alerting solutions.

Our stack: Python, FastAPI, React, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MongoDB, REST APIs, Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked – I asked myself the same question at the time.

As an AI Developer Intern you will have the opportunity to:

- Build and maintain Python/FastAPI backend services and REST APIs

- Integrate LLM capabilities into application workflows

- Create AI Agents and integrate them in key insurance processes.

- Connect internal and external data sources via APIs

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- Available at least 6 months, up to 30h/week. Preferred if the candidate can stay 12 months.

- Solid python — you can build a backend service and call an API independently

- Knows how REST APIs work, comfortable with GIT

- Fluent in English

- Curious - you figure things out before asking

- Bonus: React, Docker, SQL, cloud basics, or any hands-on AI/LLM experience

We are not looking for data scientists or ML engineers. Our AI is assembled from existing models — your job is to build the software around them.

And… What Makes Us Special?

- Paid Internship, up to 30 hours weekly with a flexible schedule.

- LinkedIn and internal training opportunities.

- Special discounts on various brands and products, plus great banking and insurance conditions.

- A welcome pack filled with amazing gadgets.

- A dynamic workspace with tasty coffee and fruit and featuring gaming, gym, and other fun areas!

- Summer and Christmas events and different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more

jobs.title: Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter, Umbrella Excess Casualty
jobs.description:
Zurich is seeking an Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter, Umbrella Excess Casualty for our National Accounts Large Property Underwriting team in our Chicago office. While this position will be based out of a Zurich office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers and be in the office/market three days per week.

As an Umbrella Excess Casualty Underwriter at Zurich you will have the opportunity to grow and develop your career as a member of seasoned and dynamic team. You will be underwriting new and renewal business, under limited direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority levels on highly complex accounts. We focus strongly on our customers and are seeking someone with the ability to develop exceptional relationships and a strong market facing presence. Experience with underwriting P&C lines is preferred.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Our Umbrella Excess Casualty Underwriters are responsible for:

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make agent/broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiate Terms & Conditions and close deals.

- Cross-Sell other lines of business to increase product density with the account.

- Participate in Sales Team meeting as related to assigned brokers and / or territory.

- Proactively engage in the target account process, managing a qualified list of opportunities 90 to 120 days prior to effective date.

- Update required systems with details of broker / client visits and account status within specified time frame.

- Serve as key contact for assigned target accounts.

- Develop strong broker and client networks as related to industries underwritten by Business Unit.

- Calculate Target Price accurately by utilizing underwriting tools appropriately.

Basic Qualifications: Underwriting Specialist

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Basic Qualifications - Executive Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in commercial underwriting or brokerage or market facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the claims or underwriting support area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- CPCU

- Advanced knowledge of Umbrella/Excess Casualty product lines

- Knowledge of Primary Casualty and loss sensitive accounts

- Strong broker/customer relationships

- Excellent communication skills

- Excellent skills in relationship building

- Strong presentation skills

- Results oriented

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $83,400.00 - $180,500.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $83,400.00 - $136,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $110,200.00 - $180,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Zurich is seeking an Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter, Umbrella Excess Casualty for our National Accounts Large Property Underwriting team in our Chicago office. While this position will be based out of a Zurich office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers and be in the office/market three days per week.

As an Umbrella Excess Casualty Underwriter at Zurich you will have the opportunity to grow and develop your career as a member of seasoned and dynamic team. You will be underwriting new and renewal business, under limited direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority levels on highly complex accounts. We focus strongly on our customers and are seeking someone with the ability to develop exceptional relationships and a strong market facing presence. Experience with underwriting P&C lines is preferred.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Our Umbrella Excess Casualty Underwriters are responsible for:

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make agent/broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiate Terms & Conditions and close deals.

- Cross-Sell other lines of business to increase product density with the account.

- Participate in Sales Team meeting as related to assigned brokers and / or territory.

- Proactively engage in the target account process, managing a qualified list of opportunities 90 to 120 days prior to effective date.

- Update required systems with details of broker / client visits and account status within specified time frame.

- Serve as key contact for assigned target accounts.

- Develop strong broker and client networks as related to industries underwritten by Business Unit.

- Calculate Target Price accurately by utilizing underwriting tools appropriately.

Basic Qualifications: Underwriting Specialist

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Basic Qualifications - Executive Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in commercial underwriting or brokerage or market facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the claims or underwriting support area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- CPCU

- Advanced knowledge of Umbrella/Excess Casualty product lines

- Knowledge of Primary Casualty and loss sensitive accounts

- Strong broker/customer relationships

- Excellent communication skills

- Excellent skills in relationship building

- Strong presentation skills

- Results oriented

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $83,400.00 - $180,500.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $83,400.00 - $136,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $110,200.00 - $180,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
#ZCC is currently hiring a:

DATA ENGINEER SR / DATABRICKS

• Design and build scalable solutions to ingest, store and process very large amounts of data (structured, semi-structured and unstructured), including streaming and real time into the cloud-based Lakehouse.

• Build enterprise grade, highly reusable data assets for analytics consumption.

• Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data architecture blueprints and systems specifications to develop single source of truth for the enterprise.

• Partner with analytics experts, data scientists, and Business Unit analysts to build self-service experiences in our data democratization platform.

• Take ownership of operationalization of Agentic AI & ML Models while designing solutions to optimize data pipelines, model deployment, and model monitoring

Technical skills:

• Experience with Azure or AWS Cloud

• Experience in building enterprise grade Data & AI solutions

• Experience with various Microsoft Azure services (including Fabric, Databricks, Data factory, Cosmos DB, Document Intelligence, Cognitive Services, AI Foundry, Power Platform, Co-pilot studio, Azure ML, Power Automate, Power BI etc.).

• Experience with vector stores like Elastic, Pinecone, Mongo Atlas, or Redis

• Experience with cloud data warehouse solutions like Snowflake, Fabric, or Redshift

• Exposure to ML frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn

• Exposure to deployments for LLMs including end to end unstructured data pipeline build, design of vector stores, embeddings, and prompt engineering.

We offer:

Attractive compensation scheme.

Food vouchers

Restaurant vouchers

Benefits above the law.

Life insurance

Major medical expenses insurance

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.

DATENMOTOR SR/DATENGRÖSSEN

• Entwerfen und erstellen Sie skalierbare Lösungen zur Aufnahme, Speicherung und Verarbeitung sehr großer Datenmengen (strukturiert, semistrukturiert und unstrukturiert), einschließlich Streaming und Echtzeit in das Cloud-basierte Lakehouse.

• Erstellen Sie hochgradige, hoch wiederverwendbare Datenbestände für den Analyseverbrauch.

• Entwickeln Sie konzeptionelle, logische und physische Datenarchitektur-Blueprints und Systemspezifikationen, um Single Source of Truth für das Unternehmen zu entwickeln.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Analyseexperten, Data Scientists und Business Unit Analysten zusammen, um Self-Service-Erfahrungen in unserer Datendemokratisierungsplattform aufzubauen.

• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Operationalisierung von Agentic AI & ML-Modellen und entwerfen Sie Lösungen zur Optimierung von Datenpipelines, Modellbereitstellung und Modellüberwachung

jobs.title: IT Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

Zurich Insurance Benelux is one of the most specialized insurance companies within non-life insurance for local and international businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxemburg. Our ambition is to become one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. We are currently looking for an Office Coordinator for our IT department. Our IT department is unique, as they focus on IT solutions for the Benelux, France, and Nordic Business Units in Zurich Insurance’s Commercial Insurance business.

This is a fulltime on-site role where you will be working from our office in Diegem, Belgium.

Role Overview

As IT Office Coordinator, you keep the office running like a well-oiled machine. From coordinating facilities and helping colleagues with first-line workplace support, to guiding smooth onboarding and offboarding. You’ve got it covered. And of course, you keep everything neatly documented and audit-ready along the way.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate day-to-day office operations (facilities, vendors, maintenance, supplies) & IT support

- Provide first-line IT support and manage onboarding/offboarding, including setups, troubleshooting, access, and asset tracking

- Support health & safety and compliance through inspections, documentation, and ensuring emergency readiness

- Maintain accurate records and audit-ready processes by managing inventory, documentation, and deadlines

- Oversee office governance and ensuring clear communication and follow-up

- Welcome visitors and support management with administrative tasks such as meeting prep, scheduling, and travel arrangements

- Manage office supplies and purchasing, invoices, and support budget tracking and cost efficiency

Skills & Qualifications

- English fluency as well as an excellent command of Dutch or French (speaking, writing, reading).

- Proven experience in office and facilities coordination or a similar operational role.

- Able to work independently, works well under pressure, good at prioritizing, and able to juggle multiple requests at once

- O365 literate; knowledge of Word, Excel, Powerpoint, PowerApps, PowerBI

- You are comfortable with basic IT/workplace tools and asset tracking; able to fix common user issues

- Strong attention to detail when it comes to documentation, processes, and confidentiality.

What you can expect from us:

At Zurich Benelux, we recognize the value that experienced professionals bring to our organization. We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment where your expertise will be valued and your career aspirations supported. Join us and take advantage of:

- Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

- Opportunities for professional growth and development.

- A collaborative and inclusive corporate culture.

- The chance to make a significant impact within a leading global insurance provider.

Join Zurich Benelux and take the next step in your career. You can apply by submitting your CV; we would very much appreciate if you could provide a brief motivation alongside your application or upload a separate motivation once you have submitted your application. We can create a brighter future together!

jobs.title: Internship at Underwriting Service Credit Lines (suitable for university students)
jobs.description:
Our opportunity

Internship at Underwriting Service Credit Lines (suitable for university students)

Ready to gain hands-on experience in a global insurance company? Join our team as a Student Trainee and support our Underwriting Service Credit Lines!

Your role

As Intern in at Underwriting Service Credit Lines, your main responsibilities will involve:

- Enter and manage data in our policy systems (credit reports, surety bond applications, notifications, and more)

- Manually transfer information from customer documents into our internal systems

- Coordinate and process cases that require personal attention beyond automation

- Support with billing, document uploads, and follow-ups with customers

- Help with ongoing administrative tasks as our processes evolve

Your skills & experience

Your skills and experience will ideally include:

- You’re studying Economics or Business Administration, or have relevant business admin experience

- You work independently, think in solutions, and pick things up quickly

- You have a strong service mindset and enjoy helping customers

- Fluent in English and with at least basic knowledge of German

Why Zurich?

- Flexible student job in a supportive, international team

- Learn, grow, and opportunity to make a real impact

- Gain hands-on experience in insurance and business operations

Additional Information

- Wage: 8 EUR/hour gross

- Location: Bratislava, Mýtna 48 (possibility of occasional home office)

- Schedule : Part-time (20 hours/week on average)

- Type of contract: Agreement on Student Work

- Duration: 1 year with possibility to prolong for another year

We are looking forward to welcoming you to Zurich Insurance Slovakia!

jobs.title: UNDERWRITER IV
jobs.description:
Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Underwriter IV #ZAM”

Objetivo:

Contribuir a la rentabilidad y crecimiento sostenible del negocio de Affinities y P&C mediante la suscripción técnica de riesgos, el diseño de soluciones aseguradoras para programas masivos (afinidades, colectivos, partnerships) y la correcta administración del portafolio, alineado con las directrices de Zurich en materia de riesgo, cumplimiento, servicio al cliente y sostenibilidad.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Actuaría, Economía, Ingeniería, Administración, Finanzas.

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo 5 años en suscripción P&C, Affinities o líneas personales (hogar, auto, PyMe, accidentes personales). Deseable participación en programas de afinidad (banca, retail, plataformas digitales).

- Conocimientos técnicos: Principios de suscripción y gestión de portafolio, evaluación de riesgos masivos y colectivos (segmentación, límites, exclusiones). Conocimiento de productos estándar P&C (accidentes personales, hogar, auto, garantía extendida). Nociones de tarificación técnica. Regulación aplicable a P&C.

Responsabilidades:

- Analizar y evaluar riesgos P&C y de programas de afinitty, garantizando equilibrio entre competitivad comercial y rentabilidad técnica.

- Definir y aprobar términos y condiciones dentro de su nivel de autoridad de suscripción.

- Revisar y ajustar tarifas, límites, deducibles y exclusiones de acuerdo con la estrategia de suscripción y guías internas.

- Apoyar en el diseño y actualización de productos y soluciones específicas para partners de afinidad (banca, retail, telcos, etc.).

- Participar en la estructuración de propuestas técnicas para nuevos convenios y renovaciones.

- Colaborar con Distribución/Ventas en la preparación de ofertas, presentaciones y argumentación técnica frente a socios.

- Monitorear indicadores de desempeño técnico (primas, siniestralidad, ratio combinado, retención, crecimiento).

- Detectar desviaciones y proponer acciones correctivas (revisión de tarifas, ajustes de condiciones, segmentaciones).

- Contribuir a la planeación de negocio (budget, forecasts) con insumos técnicos y análisis de tendencias.

- Colaborar con el área de Siniestros para revisar casos relevantes y sugerir medidas de control de exposición.

- Apoyar en la interpretación de coberturas y condiciones de póliza en casos complejos.

- Asegurar que las soluciones suscritas cumplen con la normativa local y con las políticas internas de Zurich (incluyendo criterios de ESG y sostenibilidad cuando aplique).

Ofertamos:

- Programa de bienestar

- Esquema de trabajo flexible

- Desarrollo y Crecimiento

“Underwriter IV #ZAM”

Objetivo:

Contribuir a la rentabilidad y crecimiento sostenible del negocio de Affinities y P&C mediante la suscripción técnica de riesgos, el diseño de soluciones aseguradoras para programas masivos (afinidades, colectivos, partnerships) y la correcta administración del portafolio, alineado con las directrices de Zurich en materia de riesgo, cumplimiento, servicio al cliente y sostenibilidad.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Actuaría, Economía, Ingeniería, Administración, Finanzas.

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo 5 años en suscripción P&C, Affinities o líneas personales (hogar, auto, PyMe, accidentes personales). Deseable participación en programas de afinidad (banca, retail, plataformas digitales).

- Conocimientos técnicos: Principios de suscripción y gestión de portafolio, evaluación de riesgos masivos y colectivos (segmentación, límites, exclusiones). Conocimiento de productos estándar P&C (accidentes personales, hogar, auto, garantía extendida). Nociones de tarificación técnica. Regulación aplicable a P&C.

Responsabilidades:

- Analizar y evaluar riesgos P&C y de programas de afinitty, garantizando equilibrio entre competitivad comercial y rentabilidad técnica.

- Definir y aprobar términos y condiciones dentro de su nivel de autoridad de suscripción.

- Revisar y ajustar tarifas, límites, deducibles y exclusiones de acuerdo con la estrategia de suscripción y guías internas.

- Apoyar en el diseño y actualización de productos y soluciones específicas para partners de afinidad (banca, retail, telcos, etc.).

- Participar en la estructuración de propuestas técnicas para nuevos convenios y renovaciones.

- Colaborar con Distribución/Ventas en la preparación de ofertas, presentaciones y argumentación técnica frente a socios.

- Monitorear indicadores de desempeño técnico (primas, siniestralidad, ratio combinado, retención, crecimiento).

- Detectar desviaciones y proponer acciones correctivas (revisión de tarifas, ajustes de condiciones, segmentaciones).

- Contribuir a la planeación de negocio (budget, forecasts) con insumos técnicos y análisis de tendencias.

- Colaborar con el área de Siniestros para revisar casos relevantes y sugerir medidas de control de exposición.

- Apoyar en la interpretación de coberturas y condiciones de póliza en casos complejos.

- Asegurar que las soluciones suscritas cumplen con la normativa local y con las políticas internas de Zurich (incluyendo criterios de ESG y sostenibilidad cuando aplique).

jobs.title: Responsable d'équipe Broker Account Management West (h/f/d) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
Es-tu passionné(e) par le développement des relations avec les courtiers et la gestion d’une équipe performante ? Aimes-tu relever des défis commerciaux tout en assurant un service de qualité et en atteignant des objectifs ambitieux ?

En tant que Responsable d’équipe Broker Account Management West, tu auras l’opportunité de piloter une équipe dynamique et de jouer un rôle clé dans le développement des relations avec les courtiers de la région Ouest. Tu seras au cœur de la stratégie de Zurich, en collaborant avec différentes parties prenantes internes et externes pour garantir une prise en charge optimale des courtiers et la réalisation des objectifs commerciaux.

Si tu es une personne leader inspirante, orientée résultats, avec une forte sensibilité au service client et une capacité à gérer les priorités dans un environnement dynamique, cette opportunité est faite pour toi !

Découvre ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse fait partie du "Top 3" du prix du “Meilleur employeur” en Suisse. Deviens-en membre également et postule en tant que Responsable d’équipe Broker Account Management West.

Ce que tu fais

- Tu encadres une équipe, définis des objectifs individuels et collectifs, et accompagnes le développement professionnel de tes collaboratrices et collaborateurs, en favorisant une culture de collaboration et d’amélioration continue

- Tu développes et gères les relations avec les courtiers clés de la région Ouest, en mettant en œuvre des stratégies de croissance et en suivant les indicateurs clés de performance

- Tu coordonnes les flux entre les équipes Broker Account Management Persona Line (BAMPL) et Entry Point pour garantir un service efficace et de qualité

- Tu contribues à la planification commerciale, au suivi de la rentabilité des portefeuilles et à la promotion des solutions Zurich auprès des courtiers

- Tu participes activement à des initiatives de digitalisation et d’amélioration continue, tout en garantissant le respect des standards Zurich en matière de conformité et de protection des données

Ce que tu apportes

- Formation supérieure en économie, gestion, assurance ou équivalent, idéalement complétée par une certification dans le domaine de l’assurance

- Expérience confirmée en gestion de courtiers et en management d’équipe, avec des compétences avérées en coaching et en pilotage de la performance

- Solide compréhension des produits d’assurance, des processus d’underwriting et des outils CRM/digitaux

- Excellentes compétences en communication, une capacité à collaborer avec des parties prenantes variées et un esprit d’initiative

- Maîtrise du français et une bonne connaissance de l’allemand et/ou de l’anglais comme atout important

Ton contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant : Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Informations complémentaires

Ce poste est disponible à temps partiel ou à temps plein: 80 - 100%.

Lieu: Lausanne, Crissier

Les déplacements pour ce poste peuvent aller jusqu'à 10%

Travail hybride : jusqu’ à 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Nous attendons avec impatience de recevoir ta candidature en ligne - même sans lettre de motivation. Tu pourras nous convaincre de ta motivation lors d'un entretien personnel.

Qui nous sommes

Zurich est une marque forte – plus de 1,4 million de clientes et clients en Suisse font confiance à nos produits et services. Notre succès, nous le devons principalement à nos 53'000 employés qui, répartis dans 210 pays et territoires, aident nos clients à comprendre les risques et à s’en prémunir. Pour être le plus performant possible, nous offrons à nos collaborateurs un modèle de travail flexible et de nombreuses opportunités de formations continues. En tant qu’employé de Zurich tu profites de nombreux avantages et d’une culture d’entreprise très positive basée sur l’acceptation, la diversité et l’esprit d’équipe.

Chez Zurich, nous favorisons une culture basée sur la diversité et l’inclusion. Nos objectifs et nos valeurs sont conçus pour protéger, inspirer confiance et aider nos employés à atteindre leur potentiel. Nous valorisons et défendons ce qui est juste et mettons en avant l’équité pour tous, sans distinction de genre, handicap, identité sexuelle, race, appartenance ethnique, génération, croyances, etc. Nos processus respectent cet engagement au quotidien, aussi bien dans la recherche de talents qu’au niveau du recrutement. Fais partie de cette culture en rejoignant Zurich.

Pourquoi Zurich connaît-elle le succès depuis plus de 150 ans ? Découvre notre histoire et rejoins-la.

Information aux agences de recrutement

Zurich n'accepte aucune candidature soumise de leur propre chef par les agences de recrutement pour ce poste. Nous demandons aux agences de recrutement de ne transmettre aucun document de candidature que ce soit à nos collaborateurs/trices ou par le biais de notre portail carrière online. Nous déclinons toute responsabilité concernant des candidatures non sollicitées ainsi que d'éventuels honoraires qui en découleraient. Nous te remercions de ta compréhension.

Postuler »

jobs.description:
L’idée de garantir à chaque étape du traitement d’un sinistre que nos clients bénéficient d’un interlocuteur compétent et fiable t’inspire et te motive ? Alors tu pourrais bien être la personne que nous recherchons.

Si tu es animé(e) par l’envie d’aider, que tu possèdes des qualités de leadership affirmées et que tu t’engages activement pour que ton équipe donne le meilleur d’elle-même, cette opportunité pourrait constituer une étape importante dans ta carrière.

Au sein du département Sinistres choses / RC, nous gérons l’ensemble des sinistres liés aux assurances de choses et de responsabilité civile pour nos clients privés et professionnels. En cas d’intempéries ou de catastrophes, la Task Force Grands Sinistres coordonne l’organisation et met immédiatement en œuvre les mesures nécessaires pour soutenir nos clients.

Dans ce contexte, tu rejoindras une équipe expérimentée et bien rodée, au sein de laquelle tu prendras, de manière autonome et responsable, la direction d’une équipe dédiée aux sinistres complexes dans la région de Crissier.

Découvre ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse fait partie du "Top 3" du prix du “Meilleur employeur” en Suisse. Deviens-en membre également et postule en tant que Responsable d’équipe sinistres complexes.

Ce que tu fais

- Tu es responsable de la gestion technique et tu conduis une équipe comptant jusqu’à 9 collaborateurs chargés du traitement complet des sinistres dans les domaines des assurances choses, responsabilité civile et techniques.

- Tu veilles à une gestion efficace des sinistres conformément aux directives et contribues activement à l’amélioration continue des processus.

- Tu assures la gestion opérationnelle au quotidien et garantis le bon déroulement des activités.

- Tu encourages le développement professionnel et personnel de chaque membre de ton équipe.

- Tu accompagnes activement ton équipe dans la mise en œuvre des changements.

Ce que tu apportes

- Brevet fédéral en assurance ou diplôme d’une école supérieure spécialisée en assurance.

- Min. 1-3 ans d’expérience en gestion d’équipe souhaitée.

- Plusieurs années d’expérience dans le règlement de sinistres et solides connaissances techniques dans les domaines des assurances choses et responsabilité civile.

- Esprit vif, forte orientation client, service et solutions.

- Excellente maîtrise du français et bonnes connaissances de l’allemand.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'idea di garantire in ogni fase del trattamento di un disastro che i nostri clienti beneficiano di una persona di contatto competente e affidabile tsinspires e vi motiva? Allora potresti essere la persona che cerchiamo.

Se siete guidati dal desiderio di aiutare, avere forti qualità di leadership e sono attivamente impegnati a rendere il vostro team il meglio che si può fare, questa opportunità potrebbe essere un passo importante nella vostra carriera.

All'interno del Dipartimento di Corporate Affairs / RC, gestiamo tutte le richieste relative all'assicurazione di business e responsabilità per i nostri clienti privati e professionali. In caso di condizioni meteorologiche o di disastri, la Task Force Grands Sinisters coordina l'organizzazione e implementa immediatamente le misure necessarie per supportare i nostri clienti.

In questo contesto, ti unirai a un team esperto e ben funzionante, all'interno del quale guiderai in modo indipendente e responsabile un team dedicato a rivendicazioni complesse nella regione del Crissier.

Scopri perché Zurigo Svizzera fa parte del prezzo "Top 3" del miglior datore di lavoro in Svizzera. Diventa membro anche e si candida come capo di squadre di disastro complesse.

Che cosa fai

- Sei responsabile della gestione tecnica e conduci un team di fino a 9 dipendenti responsabili del trattamento completo dei reclami nei settori dell'assicurazione civile e tecnica.

- Assicura una gestione efficace dei disastri secondo le linee guida e contribuisce attivamente al miglioramento continuo dei processi.

- L'utente fornisce una gestione operativa quotidiana e garantisce un funzionamento regolare delle attività.

- Incoraggi lo sviluppo professionale e personale di ogni membro del tuo team.

- Accompagnate attivamente il vostro team nell'attuazione dei cambiamenti.

Cosa porti

- Brevetto federale in assicurazione o diploma da un'università specializzata in assicurazione.

- Min. 1-3 anni di esperienza nella gestione del team desiderato.

- Diversi anni di esperienza nella liquidazione dei crediti e solide conoscenze tecniche nei settori dell'assicurazione di affari e responsabilità.

- Spirito vibrante, forte orientamento del cliente, servizio e soluzioni.

- Ottima padronanza del francese e buona conoscenza del tedesco.

Il tuo contatto

Consulente per l'acquisizione di talenti senior: Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Ulteriori informazioni

Questa posizione è disponibile a tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%.

Ubicazione: Losanna, Crissier

Lavoro ibrido: fino al 40%

#LI-Hybrid #

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda online - anche senza una lettera di copertura. Potete convincerci della vostra motivazione in un colloquio personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti in Svizzera si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. Il nostro successo è dovuto principalmente ai nostri 53.000 dipendenti, che, in 210 paesi e territori, aiutano i nostri clienti a comprendere i rischi e proteggerli. Per essere il più efficiente possibile, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un modello di lavoro flessibile e molte opportunità di formazione continua. Come dipendente di Zurigo si godono molti vantaggi e una cultura aziendale molto positiva basata su accettazione, diversità e lavoro di squadra.

A Zurigo, promuoviamo una cultura basata sulla diversità e l'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere, ispirare la fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro potenziale. Valoriamo e difendiamo ciò che è giusto e promuoviamo l'equità per tutti, indipendentemente dal sesso, dalla disabilità, dall'identità di genere, dalla razza, dall'etnia, dalla generazione, dalle convinzioni, ecc. I nostri processi rispettano questo impegno ogni giorno, sia nella ricerca del talento che nel reclutamento. Partecipa a questa cultura unendo Zurigo.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Scopri la nostra storia e unisciti.

Informazioni alle agenzie di reclutamento

Zurigo non accetta alcuna domanda presentata di propria iniziativa dalle agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. descriptionByLocale.en:
The idea of guaranteeing at every stage of the processing of a disaster that our customers benefit from a competent and reliable contact person tsinspires and motivates you? Then you could be the person we're looking for.

If you are driven by the desire to help, have strong leadership qualities and are actively committed to making your team the best you can do, this opportunity could be an important step in your career.

Within the Department of Corporate Affairs / RC, we manage all claims related to business and liability insurance for our private and professional clients. In case of weather or disasters, the Task Force Grands Sinisters coordinates the organisation and immediately implements the necessary measures to support our clients.

In this context, you will join an experienced and well-functioning team, within which you will independently and responsibly lead a team dedicated to complex claims in the Crissier region.

Find out why Zurich Switzerland is part of the "Top 3" price of the best employer in Switzerland. Become a member also and apply as Head of complex disaster teams.

What You Do

- You are responsible for technical management and lead a team of up to 9 employees responsible for the complete processing of claims in the fields of business, civil and technical insurance.

- You ensure effective disaster management in accordance with the guidelines and actively contribute to continuous process improvement.

- You provide day-to-day operational management and ensure the smooth running of activities.

- You encourage the professional and personal development of every member of your team.

- You actively accompany your team in implementing the changes.

What you bring

- Federal patent in insurance or diploma from a university specializing in insurance.

- Min. 1-3 years of experience in team management desired.

- Several years of experience in claims settlement and solid technical knowledge in the fields of business and liability insurance.

- Vibrant spirit, strong customer orientation, service and solutions.

- Excellent mastery of French and good knowledge of German.

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant : Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Further information

This position is available on a part-time or full-time basis: 80 - 100%.

Location : Lausanne, Crissier

Hybrid work: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to receiving your application online - even without a cover letter. You can convince us of your motivation in a personal interview.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million customers in Switzerland trust our products and services. Our success is due mainly to our 53,000 employees, who, in 210 countries and territories, help our clients understand the risks and protect them. To be as efficient as possible, we offer our employees a flexible work model and many opportunities for continuous training. As an employee of Zurich you enjoy many advantages and a very positive corporate culture based on acceptance, diversity and teamwork.

At Zurich, we promote a culture based on diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees reach their potential. We value and defend what is right and promote equity for all, regardless of gender, disability, gender identity, race, ethnicity, generation, beliefs, etc. Our processes respect this commitment on a daily basis, both in the search for talent and in recruitment. Be part of this culture by joining Zurich.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? Discover our story and join it.

Information to recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications submitted on its own initiative by the recruitment agencies for this position. We ask recruitment agencies not to submit any application documents to our employees or through our online career portal. We disclaim any liability for unsolicited applications and any fees resulting from them. We thank you for your understanding.

Apply »

Die Idee, in jeder Phase der Abwicklung einer Katastrophe zu garantieren, dass unsere Kunden von einem kompetenten und zuverlässigen Ansprechpartner profitieren, inspiriert und motiviert Sie? Dann könntest du die Person sein, die wir suchen.

Wenn Sie vom Wunsch nach Hilfe angetrieben werden, starke Führungsqualitäten haben und sich aktiv dafür einsetzen, Ihr Team so gut wie möglich zu machen, könnte diese Gelegenheit ein wichtiger Schritt in Ihrer Karriere sein.

Innerhalb des Department of Corporate Affairs / RC verwalten wir alle Ansprüche im Zusammenhang mit Geschäfts- und Haftpflichtversicherungen für unsere privaten und professionellen Kunden. Im Falle von Wetter oder Katastrophen koordiniert die Task Force Grands Sinisters die Organisation und setzt sofort die notwendigen Maßnahmen um, um unsere Kunden zu unterstützen.

In diesem Zusammenhang treten Sie einem erfahrenen und gut funktionierenden Team bei, in dem Sie unabhängig und verantwortungsvoll ein Team führen, das sich komplexen Ansprüchen in der Region Crissier widmet.

Erfahren Sie, warum Zürich Schweiz Teil des „Top 3 Preises des besten Arbeitgebers der Schweiz ist. Werden Sie auch Mitglied und bewerben Sie sich als Leiter komplexer Katastrophenteams.

Was Sie tun

- Sie sind verantwortlich für das technische Management und führen ein Team von bis zu 9 Mitarbeitern, die für die komplette Abwicklung von Schadensfällen in den Bereichen Business, Zivil- und technische Versicherungen verantwortlich sind.

- Sie sorgen für ein effektives Katastrophenmanagement gemäß den Richtlinien und tragen aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung bei.

- Sie sorgen für die tägliche Betriebsführung und sorgen für den reibungslosen Ablauf der Aktivitäten.

- Sie fördern die berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung jedes Mitglieds Ihres Teams.

- Sie begleiten Ihr Team aktiv bei der Umsetzung der Änderungen.

Was du mitbringst

- Bundespatent in der Versicherung oder Diplom von einer Universität in der Versicherung spezialisiert.

- Min. 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Teammanagement gewünscht.

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Schadensregulierung und fundiertes technisches Wissen in den Bereichen Geschäfts- und Haftpflichtversicherung.

- Lebendiger Geist, starke Kundenorientierung, Service und Lösungen.

- Hervorragende Beherrschung des Französischen und gute Deutschkenntnisse.

Ihr Kontakt

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Weitere Informationen

Diese Position ist auf Teilzeit- oder Vollzeitbasis verfügbar: 80 - 100%.

Standort: Lausanne, Crissier

Hybridarbeit: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung online – auch ohne Anschreiben. Sie können uns in einem persönlichen Interview von Ihrer Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zürich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Kunden in der Schweiz vertrauen unseren Produkten und Dienstleistungen. Unser Erfolg ist vor allem unseren 53.000 Mitarbeitern zu verdanken, die in 210 Ländern und Territorien unseren Kunden helfen, die Risiken zu verstehen und sie zu schützen. Um so effizient wie möglich zu sein, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitern ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell und viele Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung. Als Mitarbeiter von Zurich genießen Sie viele Vorteile und eine sehr positive Unternehmenskultur, die auf Akzeptanz, Vielfalt und Teamwork basiert.

Bei Zurich fördern wir eine Kultur, die auf Vielfalt und Inklusion basiert. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind darauf ausgerichtet, zu schützen, Vertrauen zu schaffen und unseren Mitarbeitern zu helfen, ihr Potenzial zu erreichen. Wir schätzen und verteidigen, was richtig ist und fördern Gerechtigkeit für alle, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Behinderung, Geschlechtsidentität, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Generation, Überzeugungen usw. Unsere Prozesse respektieren dieses Engagement täglich, sowohl bei der Suche nach Talenten als auch bei der Rekrutierung. Werden Sie Teil dieser Kultur, indem Sie Zürich beitreten.

Warum ist Zürich seit mehr als 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Entdecken Sie unsere Geschichte und schließen Sie sich ihr an.

Zurich nimmt von sich aus keine Bewerbungen der Personalvermittlungsagenturen für diese Stelle entgegen.
