jobs.description:
Möchtest du Underwriting-Qualität, Governance, Assurance und Lerninitiativen prägen und so einen zentralen Beitrag zur Zukunft unseres P&C-Geschäfts leisten?

Als Head Technical Underwriting & Academy Schweiz übernimmst du die Schlüsselrolle für Underwriting-Qualität, Assurance und Governance in P&C Underwriting und Commercial Insurance Schweiz. Du führst ein spezialisiertes Team, positionierst die Funktion als zentrale Anlaufstelle für rund 300 Underwriter und Senior Stakeholder und entwickelst unser First Line Risk & Internal Control Framework sowie zentrale Governance- und Regulatorikprojekte weiter. Mit der Underwriting Academy stärkst du technische Exzellenz, organisationsweites Lernen und die internationale Underwriting-Community.

Klingt das nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Head Technical Underwriting & Academy Schweiz.

Was du tust

- Du führst, entwickelst und coachst das Technical Underwriting & Academy Team und verantwortest die Umsetzung von Underwriting-Qualitäts-, Assurance- und Governance-Konzepten für alle P&C Lines of Business und Kundensegmente mit rund 300 Underwritern

- Du steuerst und entwickelst das First Line Risk & Internal Control Framework und stellst ein aussagekräftiges Reporting an Management, Risk Management, Compliance und die Gruppe sicher

- Du agierst als strategischer Sparringspartner für Senior Stakeholder (Geschäftsleitung, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Group Underwriting) und koordinierst bereichsübergreifende Initiativen mit hoher geschäftlicher und regulatorischer Relevanz

- Du verantwortest die Underwriting Academy als Kompetenzplattform für LoB-übergreifende Trainings, förderst technische Exzellenz und entwickelst Lernformate wie Onboarding-Programme sowie Initiativen zur Stärkung der internationalen Underwriting-Community

- Du positionierst die Funktion als zentrale Expertenstelle für Qualitäts-, Assurance- und Governance-Themen für das multinationale Programmgeschäft

Was du mitbringst

- Hochschulabschluss oder fundierte Versicherungsausbildung mit relevanter Weiterbildung - idealerweise mehrjährige Erfahrung im Underwriting, Governance, Assurance, Risk & Controls oder Commercial Insurance

- Ausgeprägte Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management auf C-Level sowie nachweisliche Leitung von Governance-, regulatorischen oder bereichsübergreifenden Transformationsprojekten; Führungserfahrung ist von Vorteil

- Sehr gutes Verständnis von Underwriting-Governance, First Line Risk & Internal Control Frameworks, Compliance-Anforderungen

- Starke konzeptionelle, analytische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten; komplexe Themen werden rasch erfasst, managementgerecht aufbereitet und in klare, umsetzbare Massnahmen übersetzt

- Freude daran, technische Exzellenz, Lernen und Community-Building zu fördern und die Underwriting Academy als wirksame Kompetenzplattform weiterzuentwickeln; stilsichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Dein Kontakt

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Philippe Frutiger (+41 44 628 32 20)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 70 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

jobs.description:
Motiviert dich die Idee, dank deiner qualitativen und kompetenten Dienstleistungen das Aushängeschild der Zurich für hervorragenden Brokerservice zu sein? Hast du Freude daran, Verantwortung in der administrativen Unterstützung unserer Broker zu übernehmen und ihnen bei Versicherungsfragen im Nichtleben-Privatkundengeschäft als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Seite zu stehen? Dann könnte diese Rolle genau dein nächster Schritt sein.

Der Bereich Brokers steht für starke Partnerschaften, persönliche Betreuung und den direkten Draht zu unseren unabhängigen Brokerpartnern. Wir begleiten unsere Broker im Alltag, unterstützen sie mit Fachwissen, schnellen Lösungen und einem klaren Ziel: Zurich im Privatkundengeschäft Nichtleben als verlässliche, kompetente und unkomplizierte Partnerin erlebbar zu machen.

Dafür suchen wir dich: eine zuverlässige, proaktive Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt, Broker bei Fragen und administrativen Anliegen smart und lösungsorientiert unterstützt und dabei ein echter Teamplayer ist.

Als Backoffice Mitarbeiter im Broker Account Management Privatkundengeschäft übernimmst du alle anfallenden Tätigkeiten im Rahmen der Neu- und Bestandskundenverwaltung und bist Anpsrechperson für unsere Broker für Service-Anliegen rund um Nichtleben-Produkte.

Auf dich wartet ein ausserordentlich angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld in einem jungen und dynamischen Team mit fixem Salär und attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Wenn du ein Teamplayer bist und leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, einen herausragende Brokerbetreuung zu bieten, dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Backoffice Mitarbeiter im Broker Account Management Privatkundengeschäft .

Was du tust

- Du bearbeitest alle administrativen Aufgaben im Rahmen der Neu- und Bestandskundenverwaltung im Sachversicherungsgeschäft für Privatkunden

- Du verarbeitest Neuabschlüsse, Vertragsänderungen, Kündigungen sowie In- und Ausserverkehrsetzungen

- Du gibst kompetente Auskünfte bei telefonischen und schriftlichen Brokeranfragen

- Du hast die Möglichkeit verschiedene Sonderrollen oder –aufgaben im Team zu übernehmen

- Du arbeitest aktiv daran mit, die Backoffice-Prozesse zu optimieren und neue digitale Lösungen einzuführen

Was du mitbringst

- Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder gleichwertige Ausbildung

- Erfahrung in der Versicherungs- oder Finanzbranche von Vorteil

- Erfahrung im der Bearbeitung von administrativen Kundenanliegen

- Selbstständige, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einer hohen Kundenorientierung und hohem Qualitätsanspruch

- Stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil

Dein Kontakt

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Victor Sale (+41 44 628 20 48)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Arbeitsort: Zurich, Oerlikon

jobs.description:
Fasziniert dich die Steuerung des Software Asset Lifecycles und die Optimierung von Lizenz- und Vertragsmanagement in einem dynamischen Unternehmensumfeld? Möchtest du Verantwortung übernehmen, um Transparenz über Softwarekosten zu schaffen und Einsparpotenziale zu heben?

In dieser Rolle bist du eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Herstellern, und du hast die Möglichkeit, strategische Empfehlungen zu entwickeln und als Trusted Advisor zu agieren. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Zusammenarbeit fördert und dir die Möglichkeit gibt, deine Expertise in Software Asset Management und IT Financial Management einzubringen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Wenn du eine Ownership-Mentalität mit strategischem und wirtschaftlichem Denken mitbringst und gerne bereichsübergreifend arbeitest, dann ist dies deine nächste Karriereschritt!

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als IT Software & License Management Specialist.

Was du tust

- Du steuerst den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Software-Assets und sorgst für eine belastbare Lizenz- und Vertragsdatenbasis inkl. Audit- und Compliance-Fähigkeit. Dabei kümmerst du dich um Beschaffung, Nutzung, Optimierung, Renewals und Ausserbetriebnahme

- Du schaffst Transparenz über Softwarekosten, entwickelst belastbare Forecasts und erstellst Business Cases. Zudem identifizierst du konkrete Optimierungs- und Einsparmöglichkeiten

- Du steuerst softwarebezogene Vertrags- und Lizenzthemen und unterstützt komplexe Verhandlungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Procurement, Finance, Legal, Group SAM und Herstellern zusammen

- Du bewertest regelmässig den Gesundheitszustand des SAM-Frameworks und berichtest strukturiert ans Management. Dies umfasst Compliance, Renewals, Audit Readiness sowie Vertrags- und Vendor-Risiken

- Du verfolgst Entwicklungen bei Hersteller-Lizenzmodellen, SaaS/Cloud, AI-/Copilot-Lizenzierung und FinOps. Daraus leitest du Empfehlungen ab und berätst Digital Product Manager und Führungskräfte als Trusted Advisor

Was du mitbringst

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Lizenz- und Software-Vertragsmanagement, idealerweise in einem komplexen Unternehmensumfeld. Referenzen aus der Industrie oder dem Finanzbereich sind von Vorteil

- Expertenwissen in Software Asset Management, Software Licensing, Contract Management, IT Financial Management, Cost Optimization und Vendor Management. Du bist sattelfest in Microsoft-Lizenzierung und hast Erfahrung mit AI Tools, Flexera und ServiceNow

- Nachweisbare Erfolge bei Kosteneinsparungen und Optimierungsinitiativen sowie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Governance & Compliance, Risk Management, Business Case Development und Data Analytics

- Ausgeprägtes Stakeholder- und Vendor-Management. Du baust Beziehungen auf, schaffst Alignment und kommunizierst faktenbasiert und überzeugend, auch auf Management-Ebene und in bereichsübergreifenden Gremien

- Ownership-Mentalität mit strategischem und wirtschaftlichem Denken. Du treibst Themen aktiv voran, erkennst Risiken und Trends frühzeitig, hinterfragst Kosten und entwickelst zukunftsgerichtete Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung des Software-Portfolios

Dein Kontakt

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Hybride s Arbeiten : bis zu 40%

In dieser Rolle bist du eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Herstellern, und du hast die Möglichkeit, strategische Empfehlungen zu entwickeln und als Trusted Advisor zu agieren. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Zusammenarbeit fördert und dir die Möglichkeit gibt, deine Expertise in Software Asset Management und IT Financial Management einzubringen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Wenn du eine Ownership-Mentalität mit strategischem und wirtschaftlichem Denken mitbringst und gerne bereichsübergreifend arbeitest, dann ist dies deine nächste Karriereschritt!

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als IT Software & License Management Specialist.

Was du tust

- Du steuerst den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Software-Assets und sorgst für eine belastbare Lizenz- und Vertragsdatenbasis inkl. Audit- und Compliance-Fähigkeit. Dabei kümmerst du dich um Beschaffung, Nutzung, Optimierung, Renewals und Ausserbetriebnahme

- Du schaffst Transparenz über Softwarekosten, entwickelst belastbare Forecasts und erstellst Business Cases. Zudem identifizierst du konkrete Optimierungs- und Einsparmöglichkeiten

- Du steuerst softwarebezogene Vertrags- und Lizenzthemen und unterstützt komplexe Verhandlungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Procurement, Finance, Legal, Group SAM und Herstellern zusammen

- Du bewertest regelmässig den Gesundheitszustand des SAM-Frameworks und berichtest strukturiert ans Management. Dies umfasst Compliance, Renewals, Audit Readiness sowie Vertrags- und Vendor-Risiken

- Du verfolgst Entwicklungen bei Hersteller-Lizenzmodellen, SaaS/Cloud, AI-/Copilot-Lizenzierung und FinOps. Daraus leitest du Empfehlungen ab und berätst Digital Product Manager und Führungskräfte als Trusted Advisor

Was du mitbringst

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Lizenz- und Software-Vertragsmanagement, idealerweise in einem komplexen Unternehmensumfeld. Referenzen aus der Industrie oder dem Finanzbereich sind von Vorteil

- Expertenwissen in Software Asset Management, Software Licensing, Contract Management, IT Financial Management, Cost Optimization und Vendor Management. Du bist sattelfest in Microsoft-Lizenzierung und hast Erfahrung mit AI Tools, Flexera und ServiceNow

- Nachweisbare Erfolge bei Kosteneinsparungen und Optimierungsinitiativen sowie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Governance & Compliance, Risk Management, Business Case Development und Data Analytics

- Ausgeprägtes Stakeholder- und Vendor-Management. Du baust Beziehungen auf, schaffst Alignment und kommunizierst faktenbasiert und überzeugend, auch auf Management-Ebene und in bereichsübergreifenden Gremien

- Ownership-Mentalität mit strategischem und wirtschaftlichem Denken. Du treibst Themen aktiv voran, erkennst Risiken und Trends frühzeitig, hinterfragst Kosten und entwickelst zukunftsgerichtete Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung des Software-Portfolios

Dein Kontakt

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Hybride s Arbeiten : bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Information für Personalvermittler

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

jobs.title: UNDERWRITER IV
jobs.description:
Job Title: Underwriter IV oficina Monterrey

Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Underwriter IV oficina Monterrey #ZAM”

Objetivo del puesto

Gestionar y suscribir riesgos de mediana y alta complejidad, asegurando rentabilidad técnica y alineamiento con el apetito de riesgo de Zurich. Además, liderar y coordinar un equipo de suscriptores, impulsando buenas prácticas técnicas, colaboración con ventas y excelencia en servicio al cliente..

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Administración, Finanzas, Economía, Actuaría, Ingeniería o carrera afín

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo 5 años en análisis o suscripción de riesgos, preferentemente de Motor.

- Competencias y habilidades: Orientación técnica y analítica. Toma de decisiones. Liderazgo y coaching. Orientación al cliente y negociación. Comunicación efectiva y colaboración

Responsabilidades principales

- Analizar y evaluar solicitudes de seguros y renovaciones.

- Determinar términos, condiciones y precios adecuados para cada riesgo.

- Elaborar y revisar documentos contractuales, cotizaciones y propuestas de seguros.

- Mantener la comunicación con áreas comerciales, e intermediarios para aclarar dudas o requerimientos.

- Garantizar el cumplimiento normativo y operativo en el proceso de suscripción.

- Apoyar en la identificación de oportunidades para mejorar procesos y maximizar la rentabilidad del portafolio.

- Colaborar con otras áreas para asegurar una gestión de riesgos alineada a los objetivos de Zurich.

Ofertamos:

- Atractivo esquema de compensación.

- Prestaciones superiores a la ley

- Grandes oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.title: Executive Underwriter- Professional Liability & Cyber
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is looking for a Cyber and Technology E&O Underwriter for our Middle Market segment. This position reports to the Head of Middle Markets within the Professional Liability & Cyber Business Unit.

You will be responsible for achieving key performance metrics to drive profitability, shifting portfolio mix, identifying paths for operational efficiency, and developing and executing our go-to-market strategy to drive new business and renewal retention. The Middle Market Professional Liability & Cyber Business Unit manages the growth and placement of the following lines of coverage for customers with up to $750M in revenue: Cyber, Technology E&O, Miscellaneous Professional Liability, Manufacturers E&O, and Employed Lawyers.

While this position is based out of the Philadelphia office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role requires visibility in the marketplace, with the expectation of being in the office or market three days per week.

The Cyber and Technology E&O Underwriter is responsible for:

- Underwrite and manage a portfolio of Cyber, Technology E&O, Miscellaneous Professional Liability, Manufacturers E&O, and Employed Lawyers policies.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

- Contribute to the development and implementation of underwriting strategies and initiatives.

- Actively pursue new business opportunities and work to expand Zurich’s portfolio.

- Comply with underwriting rules and guidelines, insurance laws and regulations and rating manual rules

- Continuously monitor and assess emerging Cyber and Technology E&O trends—including threat vectors, claims patterns, legal/regulatory developments, and coverage evolution—and translate those insights into disciplined risk selection, pricing, and portfolio strategy.

- Manage and optimize portfolio performance, balancing growth, profitability, and risk selection in alignment with underwriting strategy.

- Develop deep expertise in Zurich’s Cyber and Professional Liability products and policy forms, and confidently communicate coverage positions, changes, and underwriting appetite to brokers to support deal execution and relationship development.

- Understand client needs and priorities and work collaboratively with brokers to develop solutions that create value for customers while maintaining underwriting discipline.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Basic Qualifications:

Underwriting Specialist:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Executive Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

jobs.title: Sr. Liability Trial Attorney - Colorado
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for an experienced Trial Attorney to join our Staff Legal Team working fully remote in Colorado. This litigator will be responsible for representing the insureds of a prestigious and financially stable commercial insurance carrier, by preparing and trying moderate to high exposure General Liability and Commercial Auto cases from a challenging and varied caseload.

If you are ready for a career move, consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers terrific benefits including an incentive plan, 401K match and a second 401K company contribution, flexible work options and a great culture.

This is an exciting opportunity to work for a well-respected Company and represent its insureds in all phases of litigation, while being part of a high-performing law office. The ideal candidate will engage in the practice of law at all times in compliance with the ethical standards established by the Federal Courts and Colorado State Bar.

Duties of this position encompass all aspects of insurance defense, including initial investigation, legal analysis and advice, evaluating damages, preparing and filing legal pleadings and documents, performing legal research, preparing for and conducting pre-trial discovery, preparing for and aggressively handling hearings and trials, and conducting post-trial activities where appropriate.

The candidate will demonstrate strong case analysis ability and have a track record of effective settlement and trial skills, as well as the ability to work independently without substantial supervision. In addition, they will be expected to mentor less experienced attorneys and provide leadership and training across the organization.

Basic Qualifications for the Sr. Liability Trial Attorney:

- Juris Doctor and 7 or more years of experience in the Litigation area
AND

- Member in good standing of the Colorado State Bar

- Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe

- Experience working with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience handling insurance industry claims and general commercial litigation, including but not limited to wrongful death, commercial motor vehicle torts, products and premises liability, and personal injury, from inception through trial.

- Must be well organized with good analytical skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, proactive approach to file handling and caseloads, and able to work independently as well as within a team environment.

- Relevant first chair jury trial experience

- Ability to budget costs and calculate exposure for clients.

- Efficient work habits, knowledge of billables and diary review with substantive and procedural legal knowledge.

- Understands the staff counsel function and role in overall business.

- A functional and extensive knowledge of the law and procedure

- Prior experience in an insurance defense environment

- Strong negotiation skills

- Effective problem solving skills

- Experience working in a team-based environment

- Strong collaboration skills

- PC literate

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $160,000.00 - $180,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

jobs.title: Internal Controls Testing Specialist-Fixed term
jobs.description:
Internal Controls Testing Specialist (ZICTT Specialist) - (6-month contract)

Location: Krakow

About the role:

We are looking for an Internal Controls Testing Specialist to join our team on a 6-month fixed-term contract . As an Internal Controls Testing Specialist, you will provide independent and objective assessment of the design and operating effectiveness of the control environment, in accordance with the Zurich Internal Controls Integrated Framework (ICIF) Policy. You will actively contribute to the development of the internal controls environment across the organization by ensuring compliance with Zurich methodology and guidelines.

In this role, you will leverage the team's Agentic AI solution to support internal controls testing activities and contribute to the continuous enhancement of this innovative tool. You will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple locations, supporting a robust and efficient controls framework while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities:

- Perform internal controls testing activities for assigned Reporting Units (RUs), using the ZICTT Agentic AI solution as the primary testing workspace

- Support Senior Specialists and Testing Partners in analyzing financial reporting risks, completeness, and appropriateness of controls

- Test sensitive controls involving highly confidential evidence and information

- Collaborate with Internal Controls Managers and Control Owners, providing timely support and addressing questions and concerns

- Complete deliverables in a timely and accurate manner, ensuring compliance with agreed deadlines and quality standards

- Ensure all testing documentation and deliverables meet Zurich methodology requirements and undergo appropriate reviews

- Support testing-related projects and transformation initiatives within the Zurich Internal Controls Testing Team (ZICTT)

- Contribute to the continuous development and enhancement of the ZICTT Agentic AI solution

- Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency and expand the use of AI within the testing environment

- Ensure compliance with Zurich ICIF methodology, policies, and guidelines

- Work effectively with geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders across multiple business units

- Demonstrate a proactive, customer-oriented approach and contribute positively to team collaboration

Candidate’s profile:

- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Accounting, Finance, Economics, IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

- At least 1 year of postgraduate experience in Internal Controls, Compliance, Audit, Risk Management, or a related area

- English C1

- Spanish, Italian and/or German B2 is nice to have

- Knowledge of Finance & Accounting processes, Information Security, IT Audit/IT Governance, Risk & Compliance is an advantage

- Previous experience in internal controls, audit, or SOX-related environments is desirable

- Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal control frameworks

- Experience working within global organizations, shared service environments, or multi-location teams is an asset

- Experience working with AI tools or digital solutions is an advantage

- Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA (or willingness to pursue) are considered an asset

- Security certifications such as Security+, SSCP, CSX, CISSP, CRISC, CISA or CISM (or willingness to pursue) are considered an asset

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Proactive, customer-oriented, and highly motivated mindset

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality results within tight deadlines

- Resilient and comfortable working in a dynamic environment

We offer:

- real life opportunities to develop and grow with us and contribute to the world around us

- competitive salaries, language allowance and an employee benefits package that includes among others medical insurance, life insurance and sport-card

- annual bonus depending on company annual results and individual performance

- wide range of learning programs and personal development opportunities including also possibility to apply for up to 80% of educational trainings reimbursement

- referral awards

- online fitness trainings

- possibility to work from home

- nice and friendly atmosphere

Who we are:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading multi-line insurer serving people and businesses in more than 200 countries and territories. Founded 150 years ago, Zurich is transforming insurance. In addition to providing insurance protection, Zurich is increasingly offering prevention services such as those that promote wellbeing and enhance climate resilience. Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together’, Zurich aspires to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. It is targeting net-zero emissions by 2050 and has the highest-possible ESG rating from MSCI. In 2020, Zurich launched the Zurich Forest project to support reforestation and biodiversity restoration in Brazil. The Group has about 60,000 employees and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and has a level I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) program, which is traded over-the-counter on OTCQX. Further information is available at www.zurich.com.

In March 2016 we established a Shared Service Centre in Kraków, in Poland to support our global strategy. It is from this location that we have created a global shared service platform, focusing on advanced business functions such as financial accounting and reporting, planning and performance management, ICFR testing, financial systems management as well as HR integrated talent management operations.

This role is related to the key area of Zurich’s activity in Kraków. We are committed to complete the recruitment process as soon as possible, however in some occasions it may take up to 6 months and the requirements for the position may be subject to some clarification or modification during the recruitment process.

Location: Krakow

About the role:

We are looking for an Internal Controls Testing Specialist to join our team on a 6-month fixed-term contract . As an Internal Controls Testing Specialist, you will provide independent and objective assessment of the design and operating effectiveness of the control environment, in accordance with the Zurich Internal Controls Integrated Framework (ICIF) Policy. You will actively contribute to the development of the internal controls environment across the organization by ensuring compliance with Zurich methodology and guidelines.

In this role, you will leverage the team's Agentic AI solution to support internal controls testing activities and contribute to the continuous enhancement of this innovative tool. You will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple locations, supporting a robust and efficient controls framework while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities:

- Perform internal controls testing activities for assigned Reporting Units (RUs), using the ZICTT Agentic AI solution as the primary testing workspace

- Support Senior Specialists and Testing Partners in analyzing financial reporting risks, completeness, and appropriateness of controls

- Test sensitive controls involving highly confidential evidence and information

- Collaborate with Internal Controls Managers and Control Owners, providing timely support and addressing questions and concerns

- Complete deliverables in a timely and accurate manner, ensuring compliance with agreed deadlines and quality standards

- Ensure all testing documentation and deliverables meet Zurich methodology requirements and undergo appropriate reviews

- Support testing-related projects and transformation initiatives within the Zurich Internal Controls Testing Team (ZICTT)

- Contribute to the continuous development and enhancement of the ZICTT Agentic AI solution

- Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency and expand the use of AI within the testing environment

- Ensure compliance with Zurich ICIF methodology, policies, and guidelines

- Work effectively with geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders across multiple business units

- Demonstrate a proactive, customer-oriented approach and contribute positively to team collaboration

- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Accounting, Finance, Economics, IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

- At least 1 year of postgraduate experience in Internal Controls, Compliance, Audit, Risk Management, or a related area

- English C1

- Knowledge of Finance & Accounting processes, Information Security, IT Audit/IT Governance, Risk & Compliance is an advantage

- Previous experience in internal controls, audit, or SOX-related environments is desirable

- Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal control frameworks

- Experience working within global organizations, shared service environments, or multi-location teams is an asset

- Experience working with AI tools or digital solutions is an advantage

jobs.title: UNDERWRITER II
jobs.description:
Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Underwriter II (Mérida) #ZAM”

Objetivo:

Contribuir a la rentabilidad y crecimiento sostenible del negocio mediante la suscripción técnica de riesgos y la correcta administración del portafolio, alineado con las directrices de Zurich en materia de riesgo, cumplimiento, servicio al cliente y sostenibilidad.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Actuaría, Ingeniería Industrial o afín.

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo 6 mesesen suscripción.

- Conocimientos técnicos: Principios de suscripción y gestión de portafolio, evaluación de riesgos (segmentación, límites, exclusiones). Conocimiento de productos estándar de Seguros. Nociones de tarificación técnica.

Responsabilidades:

- Análisis de suscripción, negociación, market face.

- Cotizar y priorizar las solicitudes de cotización de acuerdo con el apetito de riesgo definido.

- Realizar el análisis para asegurar la suficiencia de prima de negocio para renovaciones y negocio nuevo.

- Conocer el proceso de envío de solicitudes fuera de su autoridad.

- Aplicar las mejores prácticas y metodologías de suscripción correspondientes en cada cotización.

- Conocer y aplicar los manuales de suscripción que correspondan.

Ofertamos:

- Pr ograma de bienestar

- Esquema de trabajo flexible

- Desarrollo y Crecimiento

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el status quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is hiring a Corporate Counsel to join our Corporate Law team! We are open to hiring talent in Schaumburg, IL Headquarters.

Purpose:

The role holder is responsible for identifying, managing and mitigating legal, regulatory and corporate governance risks, to enable business to achieve strategic and commercial goals in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and to protect and preserve Zurich’s tangible and intangible assets.

Key Accountabilities:

With close legal supervision and oversight:

Corporate Legal - Regulatory and Governance

• Promote the practice of the organizational values, ethic and responsible business conduct.

• Contribute towards the support of the Procurement and Claims Vendor Management functions.

• Provide legal advice to address and manage local legal issues and regulatory requirements in relation to a proposed corporate transaction.

• Address potential conflicts between management and legal entity view by either aligning the two views or by actively identifying and managing the divergence.

Commercial Legal – Insurance:

• In conjunction with Procurement and Vendor Management, advise the business on laws and regulation related to the full range of non-insurance related commercial activities, from sourcing, procurement, vendor management, and data protection, and facilitate establishing and support executing the related activities.

- Business Travel, as required

- Extended Hours during Peak Periods, as required

- Regular Predictable Attendance

- Visibility in the Office, as required

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 6 or more years of experience in the Legal area
AND

- Member of the Bar

- Knowledge of NILS, Lexis or Westlaw

Preferred Qualifications:
Insurance Industry experience

- Strong organizational and analytical skills

- Excellent communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $115,200.00 - $155,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Remote Working: Hybrid
Schedule: Full Time
Employment Sponsorship Offered: No

jobs.description:
Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis.

Location: Glasgow (hybrid working after training period)

Salary: £25,000 - £29,000

Closing date for applications: 9th September 2026

The opportunity

Are you customer obsessed and looking for your next move? We’re looking for talented, driven people like you to join our Claims Team. You don’t need to have worked as a Claims Handler before, what you do need is the ability to deliver exceptional customer service through strong communication, relationship management and effective negotiation skills.

We currently have opportunities across both Motor and Casualty claims, offering a varied and engaging environment where no two days are the same.

Our Claims function is the largest department in our UK General Insurance business, and it plays a critical role in ensuring customers receive an efficient, professional, and empathetic service. Joining such a big team means there is always opportunities to learn, grow and develop your career, such as fully funded insurance qualification programmes and allotted development days each month.

To help you become the best you can be, we provide comprehensive training that includes 5 weeks in a classroom environment and 4 weeks buddy support. Once our formal training is complete, we’ll provide a supportive learning environment so you can confidently continue with your career as a Claims Handler.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

What will you be doing?

Working as a Claims Handler, you will be an integral part of our business, supporting brokers, solicitors and suppliers. This role is not about getting through calls quickly – it is about understanding the caller’s needs and delivering a great outcome. We also want you to have the ability be able to play an active role in shaping our business, suggesting, and getting involved in how we can improve!

Other key responsibilities include:

- Responsible for handling and negotiating claims

- Compliance to statutory regulations

- Develop and maintain relationships with internal and external customers

- To proactively handle third party claims aiming to settle cases within optimum time scales

- Investigation and evaluation of liability and quantum to achieve the desired resolution for all claims handled

Our full-time working hours are 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday between the hours of 8am – 6pm. No weekends, late nights, or bank holiday working, we also offer a hybrid working model so once you’re up to speed you can work from home if you prefer, up to 50% of the time.

What are we looking for?

You don’t need to have worked in insurance or as a Claims Handler before, what you will need is excellent communication skills. Additionally, you will require good case management and workload management skills.

The ideal candidate will be able to:

- Always demonstrate outstanding customer engagement skills

- Demonstrate a positive can-do attitude, always acting with integrity

- Provide accurate information to brokers, solicitors and other third parties

- Apply common sense and pragmatism to achieve appropriate outcomes

- Support a culture of continuous improvement

We are looking for people who want a career and not just a job. Whilst previous experience is great, equally important is having a passion for customer service coupled with great verbal and written skills.

You will also:

- Be customer focused with excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Have strong attention to detail

- Be a great team player

- With an inquisitive nature, you will enjoy problem solving and building relationships

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich; we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK

What happens next?

Once the closing date has passed all applicants will be invited to complete an online assessment

Successful candidates will be invited to a face-to-face interview in our Glasgow office; interviews will be scheduled to take place from the week commencing 3rd August

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our culture:

At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected.

Over a quarter of our employees are members of at least one of our inclusion communities (Employee Resource Groups), with groups focused on areas such as social mobility and cultural awareness. We’re proud to have received numerous industry awards recognising our diversity and inclusion policies and initiatives.

We’ve created an environment that places real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide practical advice and access to a wide range of lifestyle support, alongside opportunities to learn, grow and develop the skills needed for the future.

We actively support our employees to give back to their communities through volunteering and charitable activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest‑established corporate trusts in the UK. Together, we’ve supported causes across the UK through grants and volunteering, contributing over £100 million in funding and volunteered time.

Your application:

We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

Time away

- You can also request to swap UK bank holidays for days off that have cultural or religious significance to you.

- The option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

- Up to 16 weeks' full pay for maternity, paternity and adoption leave.

Your health is important to us

- Access to Private medical insurance.

- Virtual GP appointments.

- Discounted gym membership.

- Access to a wealth of support from our wellbeing partners.

Location: Glasgow (hybrid working after training period)

Salary: £25,000 - £29,000

Closing date for applications: 9th September 2026

The opportunity

Are you customer obsessed and looking for your next move? We’re looking for talented, driven people like you to join our Claims Team. You don’t need to have worked as a Claims Handler before, what you do need is the ability to deliver exceptional customer service through strong communication, relationship management and effective negotiation skills.

We currently have opportunities across both Motor and Casualty claims, offering a varied and engaging environment where no two days are the same.

Our Claims function is the largest department in our UK General Insurance business, and it plays a critical role in ensuring customers receive an efficient, professional, and empathetic service. Joining such a big team means there is always opportunities to learn, grow and develop your career, such as fully funded insurance qualification programmes and allotted development days each month.

To help you become the best you can be, we provide comprehensive training that includes 5 weeks in a classroom environment and 4 weeks buddy support. Once our formal training is complete, we’ll provide a supportive learning environment so you can confidently continue with your career as a Claims Handler.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

What will you be doing?

Working as a Claims Handler, you will be an integral part of our business, supporting brokers, solicitors and suppliers. This role is not about getting through calls quickly – it is about understanding the caller’s needs and delivering a great outcome. We also want you to have the ability be able to play an active role in shaping our business, suggesting, and getting involved in how we can improve!

Other key responsibilities include:

- Responsible for handling and negotiating claims

- Compliance to statutory regulations

- Develop and maintain relationships with internal and external customers

- To proactively handle third party claims aiming to settle cases within optimum time scales

- Investigation and evaluation of liability and quantum to achieve the desired resolution for all claims handled

Our full-time working hours are 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday between the hours of 8am – 6pm. No weekends, late nights, or bank holiday working, we also offer a hybrid working model so once you’re up to speed you can work from home if you prefer, up to 50% of the time.

What are we looking for?

You don’t need to have worked in insurance or as a Claims Handler before, what you will need is excellent communication skills. Additionally, you will require good case management and workload management skills.

The ideal candidate will be able to:

- Always demonstrate outstanding customer engagement skills

- Demonstrate a positive can-do attitude, always acting with integrity

- Provide accurate information to brokers, solicitors and other third parties

- Apply common sense and pragmatism to achieve appropriate outcomes

- Support a culture of continuous improvement

We are looking for people who want a career and not just a job. Whilst previous experience is great, equally important is having a passion for customer service coupled with great verbal and written skills.

You will also:

- Be customer focused with excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Have strong attention to detail

- Be a great team player

- With an inquisitive nature, you will enjoy problem solving and building relationships

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich; we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Claims Handler
jobs.description:
At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into [one of] the following North American Claims office[s]: remote United States.

Zurich North America is currently hiring a Senior Legal Claims Handler, and this person will report to a Commercial Surety Claims Manager. We are open to hiring talent who is located within the U.S. This is a fully remote position so you will have a home-based office.

In this role, you will manage a caseload of high complexity single and multi-party commercial surety claims from start through settlement and resolution, and within specific authority limits. You will ensure that claims are handled in the most efficient and effective manner to deliver on Zurich’s claims best practices and customer-led commitment. You will have an opportunity to develop strong partnerships that include extensive communications and interactions with principals, brokers, and other internal business unit contacts.

Using your strategic mindset, you will:

- Manage commercial surety claims from start to finish with a focus on quality, efficiency, and service excellence-

- Analyze liability, exposure, bond obligations, and damages by gathering and analyzing relevant facts and utilizing applicable law

- Build claim strategies to drive timely, high-quality claim resolutions

- Set and monitor reserves throughout the claim lifecycle using analytical judgment

- Negotiate settlements by establishing appropriate negotiation strategy and utilizing available tools and resources within authority limits

- Deliver clear, timely communication to stakeholders throughout the claim process

- Manage vendors and expenses through approved networks

- Ensure compliance, confidentiality, and ethical claim handling

- Identify potential subrogation and fraud, and escalate appropriately

- Share claim trends and insights to support business growth and risk management

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies

- Coach and provide technical advice within and outside operating unit

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 5 or more years of experience in the Legal area AND

- JD and 5 or more years of legal practice experience in the insurance area

- Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s)

- Experience in insurance claims and the insurance legal and regulatory environment

- Negotiation experience

- Customer service experience

- Microsoft Office experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technology and efficiency tools, with a mindset for applying them to improve claim management

- Foundational knowledge of bankruptcy-related issues and proceedings. Prior experience in commercial surety is not required

- Experience coaching junior team members

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem solving skills

- Solid time management, prioritization and multi-tasking skills

- Experience collaborating in a team environment and building cross functional working relationships

- Demonstrates understanding of the reserving process for indemnity and expense in analyzing the potential exposure of complex claims

- Ability to develop and execute a negotiation strategy and plan for resolution

- Ability to identify subtleties in customer/client and/or business partner interactions

- Ability to present information necessary to propose a claim resolution to stakeholders

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $100,200 - $164,100, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Remote Working: Yes

- Build claim strategies to drive timely, high-quality claim resolutions

- Set and monitor reserves throughout the claim lifecycle using analytical judgment

- Negotiate settlements by establishing appropriate negotiation strategy and utilizing available tools and resources within authority limits

- Deliver clear, timely communication to stakeholders throughout the claim process

- Manage vendors and expenses through approved networks

- Ensure compliance, confidentiality, and ethical claim handling

- Identify potential subrogation and fraud, and escalate appropriately

- Share claim trends and insights to support business growth and risk management

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies

- Coach and provide technical advice within and outside operating unit

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 5 or more years of experience in the Legal area AND

- JD and 5 or more years of legal practice experience in the insurance area

- Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s)

- Experience in insurance claims and the insurance legal and regulatory environment

- Negotiation experience

- Customer service experience

- Microsoft Office experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technology and efficiency tools, with a mindset for applying them to improve claim management

- Foundational knowledge of bankruptcy-related issues and proceedings. Prior experience in commercial surety is not required

- Experience coaching junior team members

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem solving skills

- Solid time management, prioritization and multi-tasking skills

- Experience collaborating in a team environment and building cross functional working relationships

- Demonstrates understanding of the reserving process for indemnity and expense in analyzing the potential exposure of complex claims

- Ability to develop and execute a negotiation strategy and plan for resolution

- Ability to identify subtleties in customer/client and/or business partner interactions

- Ability to present information necessary to propose a claim resolution to stakeholders

jobs.description:
Our opportunity

Junior Credit Analyst - WKV & WKV Banking / Long Term Underwriting

As a Junior Credit Analyst, you will play a key role in assessing and managing credit risks for the German market within an international environment.

Your role

As a Junior Credit Analyst, your main responsibilities will involve:

- Analyze financial statements and key financial indicators of domestic and international corporate clients with guidance from experienced colleagues

- Support the assessment of transaction, counterparty, and group risks

- Prepare credit assessments and recommendations for review and approval

- Monitor existing exposures and support risk mitigation activities

- Collaborate closely with Credit Analysis teams in Germany and Bratislava

- Participate in discussions with brokers, policyholders, and internal stakeholders

- Ensure compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements

- Contribute to process improvement initiatives and team projects

- Continuously develop expertise in corporate credit risk analysis and underwriting

Your Skills and Experience

As a Junior Credit Analyst, your skills and experience will ideally include:

- University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

- 1+ years of experience in finance, banking, risk management, accounting, audit, or a related area

- Strong interest in corporate credit risk and financial analysis

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills

- Basic understanding of financial statements and financial ratios

- Eagerness to learn and develop within an international environment

- Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel

- Very good command of English

- German language skills are an advantage, but not required

What sets you apart

- Strong analytical mindset combined with sound judgement

- Structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working

- Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities

- Ability to take ownership and make decisions in a dynamic environment

- Team player with the confidence to challenge and discuss risk topics constructively

-

La nostra opportunità

Analizzatore di credito

WKV & WKV Banking / Sottoscrizione a lungo termine

In qualità di Credit Analys, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella valutazione e nella gestione dei rischi di credito per il mercato tedesco in un ambiente internazionale.

Il tuo ruolo

Come analista di credito, le vostre principali responsabilità coinvolgeranno:

- Valutare il merito creditizio dei rischi di transazione, controparte e di gruppo sia a livello nazionale che internazionale

- All'interno della tua autorità, prendi decisioni di credito indipendenti e basate sul rischio e prepari casi per approvazioni di livello superiore

- Monitorare le esposizioni esistenti e contribuire attivamente alle strategie di mitigazione del rischio

- Agite come interfaccia tra Bratislava e la Germania, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Analisi del Credito Tedesco

- Conducete e partecipate alle discussioni sui rischi con i broker, gli assicurati e gli stakeholder interni

- Garantisci la conformità agli standard interni e ai requisiti normativi

- Comunichi e difendi chiaramente le tue decisioni di credito in un ambiente di stakeholder professionale

- Contribuisci a elaborare iniziative di ottimizzazione e sostenere progetti internazionali

Le tue abilità ed esperienza

Come analista di credito, le tue competenze e l'esperienza includono idealmente:

- Laurea in economia, finanza, o in un campo relativo (idealmente con un focus sui prestiti aziendali), o una qualifica commerciale comparabile

- Forte esperienza professionale nella valutazione del credito, assicurazione sul credito commerciale, o business di sicurezza

- Competenze solide nell'analisi del bilancio finanziario, nella valutazione del credito e nella classificazione dei rischi

- Buona comprensione delle dinamiche dell'industria e del mercato

- Gestione sicura di MS Office e sistemi correlati al credito

- Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese

Che cosa ti distingue

- Forte mentalità analitica combinata con il giudizio sonoro

- Modo di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione

- Capacità di comunicazione eccellenti e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder

- Capacità di prendere la proprietà e prendere decisioni in un ambiente dinamico

- Team player con la fiducia di sfidare e discutere temi di rischio costruttivamente

Offriamo

La compensazione per i ruoli a Zurigo dipende da una vasta gamma di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, il ruolo specifico, il set di competenze, il livello di esperienza e soggetto alla legge applicabile. Zurigo fornisce così una gamma di compensazioni allineate all'architettura interna del lavoro e ai benchmark di mercato per garantire una paga equa e coerente per ruoli comparabili.

La gamma di stipendio base di partenza per questa posizione è 2300 EUR / Gross.

Benefici del tempo di lavoro
Giorni liberi personali, settimana di lavoro concentrata, Vacanza aggiuntiva, Ufficio domestico, Giorni extra in occasione di parto, congedo sabatico, Workcation

Benefici monetari
Assicurazione sulla vita da Zurigo Austria, Compensazione per la perdita di stipendio durante il congedo di malattia, 3° contributo pilastro pensione, Risk Life Insurance, Contributo in cima al minimo legale richiesto, Anni di bonus di servizio, Bonus di nozze, Baby bonus

Altri vantaggi
Caffetteria elettronica edenred, Contributo di trasporto pubblico, Prestazioni di congedo di maternità, Massaggi in ufficio

Apprendimento/Sviluppo
Certificazioni professionali, Portali di formazione online, programma di onboarding esteso, cultura basata sui punti di forza (GALLUP)

Informazioni su di noi

Nella nostra azienda, riconosciamo l'importanza di promuovere un ambiente aperto, sicuro e inclusivo per tutti. Siamo con la diversità e rispetto diversi sfondi e stili di vita. Ecco perché abbiamo implementato numerose iniziative per garantire che i nostri dipendenti si sentano a proprio agio, accettati e rispettati in ogni momento.

Unsere Chance

Kreditanalytiker

WKV & WKV Banking / Long Term Underwriting

Als Credit Analyse spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bewertung und dem Management von Kreditrisiken für den deutschen Markt im internationalen Umfeld.

Deine Rolle

Als Credit Analyst werden Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

- Sie bewerten die Kreditwürdigkeit von Transaktions-, Gegenpartei- und Gruppenrisiken sowohl auf nationaler als auch auf internationaler Ebene

- Innerhalb Ihrer Zuständigkeit treffen Sie unabhängige, risikobasierte Kreditentscheidungen und bereiten Fälle für Genehmigungen auf höherer Ebene vor

- Sie überwachen bestehende Expositionen und tragen aktiv zu Risikominderungsstrategien bei

- Sie agieren als Schnittstelle zwischen Bratislava und Deutschland und arbeiten eng mit den deutschen Credit Analysis Teams zusammen

- Sie führen und beteiligen sich an Risikodiskussionen mit Brokern, Versicherungsnehmern und internen Stakeholdern

- Sie gewährleisten die Einhaltung interner Standards und regulatorischer Anforderungen

- Sie kommunizieren und verteidigen Ihre Kreditentscheidungen in einem professionellen Stakeholder-Umfeld

- Sie tragen zu Prozessoptimierungsinitiativen bei und unterstützen internationale Projekte

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Als Credit Analyst umfassen Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen idealerweise:

- Abschluss in Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich (idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Unternehmenskrediten) oder einer vergleichbaren kommerziellen Qualifikation

- Starke Berufserfahrung in Bonitätsbeurteilung, Handelskreditversicherung oder Bürgschaftsgeschäft

- Solide Expertise in der Bilanzanalyse, Bonitätsbeurteilung und Risikoklassifizierung

- Gutes Verständnis von Industrie und Marktdynamik

- Vertrauensvoller Umgang mit MS Office und kreditbezogenen Systemen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was dich auszeichnet

- Starke analytische Denkweise kombiniert mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen

- Strukturierte, unabhängige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten

- Fähigkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Entscheidungen in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu treffen

- Teamplayer mit dem Selbstvertrauen, Risikothemen konstruktiv herauszufordern und zu diskutieren

Wir bieten

Die Vergütung für Rollen in Zürich hängt von einer Vielzahl von Faktoren ab, darunter, aber nicht beschränkt auf die spezifische Rolle, die Fähigkeiten, den Erfahrungsstand und das geltende Recht. Persönliche freie Tage, konzentrierte Arbeitswoche, zusätzlicher Urlaub, Home Office, zusätzliche freie Tage bei der Geburt, Sabbaturlaub, Workcation

En tant qu'analyste du crédit, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Vous évaluez la solvabilité des risques de transaction, de contrepartie et de groupe aux niveaux national et international

- Au sein de votre autorité, vous prenez des décisions de crédit indépendantes fondées sur le risque et préparez des cas pour des approbations de niveau supérieur

- Vous surveillez les expositions existantes et contribuez activement aux stratégies d'atténuation des risques

- Vous agissez comme une interface entre Bratislava et l'Allemagne, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes allemandes d'analyse du crédit

- Vous dirigez et participez aux discussions sur les risques avec les courtiers, les souscripteurs et les intervenants internes

- Vous assurez la conformité aux normes internes et aux exigences réglementaires

- Vous communiquez et défendez clairement vos décisions de crédit dans un environnement professionnel

- Vous contribuez aux initiatives d'optimisation des processus et soutiennez des projets internationaux

Vos compétences et votre expérience

En tant qu'analyste de crédit, vos compétences et votre expérience comprendront idéalement :

- Degré dans les affaires, les finances ou un domaine connexe (idéalement axé sur les prêts aux entreprises), ou une qualification commerciale comparable

- Forte expérience professionnelle dans l'évaluation du crédit, l'assurance-crédit professionnel ou l'entreprise de caution

- Une solide expertise en analyse des états financiers, évaluation du crédit et classification des risques

- Bonne compréhension de l'industrie et de la dynamique du marché

- Traitement confidentiel des systèmes MS Office et de crédit

- Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais

Ce qui vous sépare

- Forte mentalité analytique associée à un jugement sain

- Mode de travail structuré, indépendant et axé sur la solution

- Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes

- Capacité de prendre des décisions dans un environnement dynamique

- Joueur d'équipe avec la confiance pour défier et discuter de sujets de risque de manière constructive

Nous offrons

La rémunération pour les rôles à Zurich dépend d'un large éventail de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le rôle spécifique, les compétences, le niveau d'expérience et le droit applicable. Zurich offre ainsi une gamme de rémunérations alignée sur l'architecture interne de l'emploi et les repères du marché pour assurer une rémunération équitable et cohérente pour des rôles comparables.

L'échelle salariale de base de départ pour ce poste est de 2300 EUR / brut.

Prestations de temps de travail
Jours de congé personnels, Semaine de travail concentrée, Vacances supplémentaires, Bureau à domicile, Jours de congé supplémentaires à l'occasion de l'accouchement, Congé sabbatique, Travail

Avantages monétaires
Assurance vie de Zurich Autriche, Indemnisation pour perte de salaire en congé de maladie, 3ème cotisation au pilier de pension, Assurance vie à risque, Cotisations repas en plus du minimum légal, Prime d'années de service, Prime de mariage, Prime pour bébé

Autres prestations
Cafétéria électronique Edenred, Contribution Transports publics, Prestations de congé de maternité, Massages au bureau

Apprentissage/Développement
Certifications professionnelles, portails d'éducation en ligne, vaste programme d'embarquement, culture basée sur les forces (GALLUP)

Sur nous

Chez nous, nous reconnaissons l'importance de favoriser un environnement ouvert, sécuritaire et inclusif pour tous. Nous nous tenons avec diversité et respectons différents milieux et styles de vie. C'est pourquoi nous avons mis en oeuvre de nombreuses initiatives pour que nos employés se sentent à l'aise, acceptés et respectés en tout temps.

jobs.title: Actuary - Life Reporting & Analytics 80-100%, Temporary until Sept. 2027
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the prospect of deepening insight and promoting sustainable growth for key life KPIs? In this role within Group Actuarial you'll help shape the future of actuarial reporting and analytics by supporting the design and implementation of future-state processes and capabilities across the Group. Through a blend of actuarial expertise, process innovation, requirements definition, and stakeholder coordination, you'll contribute to the delivery of standardised, efficient, and scalable solutions. By working collaboratively across functions, you'll help enhance reporting insights, strengthen analytical capabilities, and support better decision-making for the business.

What you will do

- Drive the future of Life reporting and analytics across the Group by reviewing current approaches and identifying opportunities for simplification, standardisation and greater efficiency.

- Partner with colleagues across Business Units, Group Actuarial and Group Risk Management to define the target operating model and future-state processes, helping to deliver solutions built on more consistent and granular data.

- Translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions, developing documentation, governance frameworks and implementation specifications that support successful delivery.

- Drive stakeholder engagement throughout the transformation journey, coordinating testing, transition and adoption activities to embed new capabilities and ways of working across actuarial, risk and finance teams.

- Help unlock the value of data by defining and supporting the development of enhanced analytical capabilities, enabling deeper insights, more effective sensitivity analysis and improved self-service reporting for stakeholders across the Group.

What you bring

- Experienced qualified actuary with at least 5 years of post-qualification experience as a Life actuary, with a substantial portion spent working in actuarial reserving, reporting or modelling.

- Strong ability to communicate with a range of stakeholders, including across different geographies, and to build working relationships while also managing to see topics through to a final conclusion.

- Proven experience transforming business processes into business and technical requirements with a clear vision of integration into the IT systems landscape.

- Experience and skillset in data analytics, data management and data visualization techniques.

- Familiarity with modern data and analytics platforms such as Databricks and cloud-based data environments would be a big advantage.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!
