jobs.title: Data Governance Business Analyst
jobs.description:
#ZCC is looking for a Data Governance Business Analyst

Data Governance Business Analyst Profile

Purpose: Builds the business and data context needed to support data governance, stewardship, data quality, and master data management initiatives by documenting processes, data flows, and ownership across the enterprise.

Key Accountabilities

- Partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, and SMEs to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, processes, and data needs.

- Facilitate workshops and working sessions to understand business processes, data usage, reporting requirements, and system interactions.

- Create and maintain process maps, data flows, and business requirements artifacts that clearly document current-state and future-state operations.

- Translate business processes into business data lineage and trace critical data from source to consumption across systems and reports.

- Identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities related to data flows, ownership, governance, controls, and operational processes.

- Support metadata management by documenting business definitions, data relationships, ownership, and governance requirements within data catalog tools (e.g., Collibra).

- Partner with Data Governance and Stewardship teams to identify Critical Data Elements (CDEs) , define data quality requirements, and support accountability frameworks.

- Support data issue management by documenting, analyzing, and tracking data-related issues, risks, and dependencies to enable effective resolution.

- Conduct impact assessments to evaluate the business, process, and data implications of changes to systems, policies, or operating models.

- Develop and maintain governance, process, and data documentation that enables knowledge sharing, audit readiness, traceability, and regulatory compliance.

- Build strong cross-functional relationships and facilitate alignment among business, technology, and governance teams to drive data-informed decision making.

Ideal Candidate

A highly analytical and collaborative professional who combines strong business analysis, process modeling, and data governance capabilities to improve data quality, strengthen governance practices, and enable trusted business decision-making across the enterprise.

Who we are
Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world.
You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most.
It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.
So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.
At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

However, there is still more to do to ensure customer perspectives consistently shape decisions across the organisation and become embedded in our everyday mindset and culture. We believe better customer understanding leads to better business decisions.

The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.

Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.

As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

What you will do

As Senior Insight Manager you will:

- Champion the voice of the customer, helping embed customer thinking into decision-making across Zurich.

- Generate compelling customer and brand insights that influence to drive business impact

- Oversee Zurich's global retail Brand and Relationship NPS programmes and lead our Commercial Broker study, ensuring high-quality delivery, governance and business value.

- Evolve our insight programmes and measurement approaches to ensure they remain relevant to changing customer and business needs.

- Transform complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives that drive action.

- Partner with the insights team, markets, agencies and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business challenges and accelerate customer-centred change.

- Connect customer, brand and business data to strengthen understanding of performance drivers and commercial impact.

- Facilitate discussions and workshops that turn insight into tangible business outcomes.

- Work closely with the Tracking Insight Manager and TNPS Expert to maximise the impact, adoption and activation of insights across the organisation.

- Bring external best practice, innovation and emerging AI capabilities into Zurich's insight ecosystem to continuously enhance how we generate and apply insight.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

What you bring

As Senior Insight Manager, you will bring:

- A passion for understanding customers and translating customer, market and brand data into meaningful business opportunities and actions.

- Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to distil complex information into clear, compelling narratives that influence decision-making.

- Proven experience activating insights within organisations, driving awareness, engagement and action across diverse stakeholder groups.

- Expertise in leading continuous and ad hoc qualitative and quantitative research programmes, either within an in-house insights function or consultancy environment.

- Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer insights with business performance, growth and loyalty outcomes.

- Experience managing complex global programmes and building effective relationships across markets, functions and cultures.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and workshops that drive alignment and action.

- Curiosity and practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies to enhance insight generation, synthesis and activation.

- Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets and statistical tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS), turning data into actionable recommendations.

- Experience bringing together multiple data sources to identify performance drivers and generate deeper business understanding.

- A degree (e.g. in business studies, marketing, research, psychology, behavioural science, customer or change management or a related field), alongside significant experience in customer, market or brand insights.

- Knowledge of the insurance sector is beneficial but not essential; curiosity, commercial thinking and a customer-first mindset are critical.

- Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire en prévoyance professionnelle (LPP) (h/f/d) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
La prévoyance professionnelle t’intéresse et tu souhaites te développer dans ce domaine ? Tu aimes travailler en équipe et offrir un excellent conseil client, orienté vers les solutions ?

En tant que Gestionnaire en prévoyance professionnelle (LPP), tu es la personne de référence pour nos clients et nos partenaires externes. Tu les conseilles et les accompagnes dans toutes les questions relatives à la prévoyance professionnelle. Grâce à tes excellentes compétences en communication, ton sens du service et ton engagement, tu contribues de manière déterminante à offrir une expérience client de qualité.

Découvre ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse fait partie du "Top 3" du prix du “Meilleur employeur” en Suisse. Deviens-en membre également et postule en tant que Gestionnaire en prévoyance professionnelle (LPP).

Ce que tu fais

- Gérer avec soin, professionnalisme et autonomie un portefeuille de clients qui est attribué, et assurer la coordination avec les autres services concernés.

- Assurer la mise en place des nouvelles affiliations, de reprises de contrats et de changements de plans de prévoyance ainsi que la réalisation de changements de portefeuille (entrées, sorties, changements de salaire).

- Entretenir au quotidien des relations de confiance avec les assurés, les entreprises et les partenaires commerciaux.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de vente et de distribution.

Ce que tu apportes

- Formation dans le secteur de l’assurance ou des services financiers. Un brevet en assurances sociales ou le brevet fédéral de spécialiste de la prévoyance en faveur du personnel constitue un atout.

- Au moins deux ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la prévoyance professionnelle ainsi que dans le soutien d'entreprises et partenaires.

- Forte orientation client, avec une méthode de travail autonome, structurée et rigoureuse.

- Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques courants, notamment Excel, Word et Outlook.

- Excellente maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. La connaissance de l’allemand et/ou de l’anglais constitue un atout.

Contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant : Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Informations complémentaires

Ce poste est disponible à temps partiel ou à temps plein : 80 - 100%.

Lieu : Lausanne, Crissier

Travail hybride : jusqu’ à 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Nous attendons avec impatience de recevoir ta candidature en ligne - même sans lettre de motivation. Tu pourras nous convaincre de ta motivation lors d'un entretien personnel.

Qui nous sommes

Zurich est une marque forte – plus de 1,4 million de clientes et clients en Suisse font confiance à nos produits et services. Notre succès, nous le devons principalement à nos 53'000 employés qui, répartis dans 210 pays et territoires, aident nos clients à comprendre les risques et à s’en prémunir. Pour être le plus performant possible, nous offrons à nos collaborateurs un modèle de travail flexible et de nombreuses opportunités de formations continues. En tant qu’employé de Zurich tu profites de nombreux avantages et d’une culture d’entreprise très positive basée sur l’acceptation, la diversité et l’esprit d’équipe.

Chez Zurich, nous favorisons une culture basée sur la diversité et l’inclusion. Nos objectifs et nos valeurs sont conçus pour protéger, inspirer confiance et aider nos employés à atteindre leur potentiel. Nous valorisons et défendons ce qui est juste et mettons en avant l’équité pour tous, sans distinction de genre, handicap, identité sexuelle, race, appartenance ethnique, génération, croyances, etc. Nos processus respectent cet engagement au quotidien, aussi bien dans la recherche de talents qu’au niveau du recrutement. jobs.title: Staff Legal Secretary
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is currently hiring a Staff Legal Secretary to join our team in Maitland, FL office. The Staff Legal Secretary performs a broad range of administrative and secretarial support for three insurance defense attorneys, specializing in Workers’ Compensation and General Liability. This position is a hybrid of remote work and in office activity designed to meet the needs of the selected candidate and Zurich North America.

At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into the following North American Claims office: Maitland or Fort Lauderdale office. For the right candidate we are open to a remote Florida candidate.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Applying knowledge of legal document formats to prepare and type contracts, briefs, summonses, complaints, and motions.

- Providing administrative support to 2-3 attorneys such as answering the phone, scheduling, and maintaining calendars, etc.

- Responding to inquiries from and interacts with customers, clients, counsel, and witnesses.

- Drafting legal pleadings, correspondence, and other documents as directed.

- Maintaining accurate litigation management system for assigned attorneys' cases.

- Organizing and maintaining electronic files related to legal and administrative matters.

- Contributing to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Legal Secretary area within the Insurance industry

OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Legal Secretary area within the Insurance industry

AND

- Experience drafting legal documents and correspondence

- Experience providing administrative support to one or more attorneys

Preferred Qualifications:

- Associate Degree or Bachelor’s degree

- Ability to effectively draft complex legal documents, correspondence, and pleadings

- Strong Microsoft Office skills

- Familiarity with litigation management software systems

- Organization and prioritization skills

- Experience with Florida jurisdiction & laws

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Defense litigation experience

- Experience handling both Workers’ Compensation and Litigation matters

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed hourly range for this position is $24.66-$33.89, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Location(s): AM - Maitland, AM - Ft. Lauderdale
Remote Working: Hybrid
Schedule: Full Time
Employment Sponsorship Offered: No

Nearest Major Market: Orlando

jobs.title: Strategic Relationship Leader, Commercial Insurance, Southeast Region
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is seeking a highly influential Strategic Relationship Leader to join our Customer Relationship Management team in the Southeast Region. The position offers the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders, strategic customers, and broker partners across Zurich's important growth markets.

In this high-visibility role, you will partner with senior executives, brokers, and key stakeholders to strengthen customer partnerships, identify growth opportunities, and deliver innovative risk solutions that create long-term value. You will work across Zurich's underwriting, claims, risk engineering, and service teams to help shape customer strategy, drive retention, and accelerate profitable growth.

We are looking for a leader who enjoys building executive-level relationships, influencing outcomes, and bringing people together to solve complex challenges.

This position reports to the Head of Customer Relationship Management and supports strategic customers throughout the Southeast Region. Preferred locations include Atlanta, South Carolina or North Carolina though candidates located elsewhere within the Southeast Region may be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

- Serve as the primary relationship strategist for a portfolio of large, high-value customers and prospects.

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite executives, risk managers, brokers, and key decision-makers.

- Develop and execute customer engagement strategies that drive retention, profitability, and long-term growth.

- Identify opportunities to expand Zurich's solutions and capabilities across domestic and global operations.

- Lead executive business reviews, stewardship meetings, and strategic planning sessions for key customers.

- Partner with underwriting, claims, risk engineering, service, and distribution teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

- Create compelling value propositions that align Zurich's capabilities with customer business objectives.

- Leverage market insights, customer intelligence, and analytics to identify opportunities and strengthen account strategies.

- Coordinate internal resources and leadership engagement to ensure seamless execution and delivery.

- Travel as needed to support customer relationships and business objectives.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Relationship Management area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Relationship Management area
AND

- Experience managing and growing profitable external customer relationships

- Demonstrated success developing and executing strategic business plans

- Strong communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills

- Significant Commercial Insurance experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Commercial Property & Casualty insurance experience

- Underwriting, brokerage, risk management, or client management background

- Proven success managing large, complex customer relationships and driving profitable growth

- Existing broker, agent, and customer relationships throughout broader Southeast region

- Advanced knowledge of Salesforce and underwriting platforms such as Guidewire, PolicyCenter, Power BI, and the ability to self-serve reporting needs while partnering with underwriting and data science teams to holistically represent the customer relationship.

- Strong capabilities in running executive‑level meetings and stewardship conversations that integrate Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering, and senior leadership for large accounts.

- Deep customer and relationship management experience with strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.

- Demonstrated expertise in managing key customers and driving profitable business performance.

- Ability to engage and influence C‑suite leaders with strong negotiation skills and thought leadership.

- Knowledge of risk assessments and the ability to deliver clear, actionable risk insights.

- Exceptional presentation, communication, time‑management, and multitasking skills.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem‑solving abilities.

At Zurich, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts, leverage a global network of resources, and help shape risk solutions for some of the world's most respected organizations. You'll join a company known for its strong culture, collaborative environment, customer focus, and commitment to helping employees grow and succeed.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $152,400.00 - $249,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 25%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

descriptionByLocale.it:
Zurigo Nord America sta cercando un leader di relazioni strategiche altamente influente per unirsi al nostro team di Customer Relationship Management nella regione sud-orientale. La posizione offre l'opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con i leader senior, i clienti strategici e i partner broker nei principali mercati di crescita di Zurigo.

In questo ruolo di alta visibilità, si partnerrà con dirigenti senior, broker e stakeholder chiave per rafforzare le partnership con i clienti, identificare le opportunità di crescita e fornire soluzioni di rischio innovative che creano valore a lungo termine. Potrai lavorare attraverso la sottoscrizione, i reclami, l'ingegneria del rischio e i team di assistenza di Zurigo per contribuire a modellare la strategia del cliente, la ritenzione del motore e accelerare la crescita redditizia.

Stiamo cercando un leader che si diverte a costruire relazioni esecutive, influenzare i risultati, e riunire le persone per risolvere sfide complesse.

Questa posizione riporta al responsabile della gestione delle relazioni con i clienti e supporta clienti strategici in tutta la regione del sud-est. Le posizioni predeterminate includono Atlanta, Carolina del Sud o Carolina del Nord, anche se i candidati situati altrove all'interno della regione del Sud-Est possono essere considerati.

Responsabilità chiave:

- Servire come il rapporto principale stratega per un portafoglio di clienti e prospettive di alto valore.

- Costruire e mantenere relazioni di fiducia con dirigenti C-suite, manager di rischio, broker e decisori chiave.

- Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di coinvolgimento del cliente che guidano la ritenzione, la redditività e la crescita a lungo termine.

- Identificare le opportunità per ampliare le soluzioni e le capacità di Zurigo in tutte le operazioni nazionali e globali.

- Lead executive business recensioni, riunioni di stewardship e sessioni di pianificazione strategica per i clienti chiave.

- Partner con team di sottoscrizione, reclami, ingegneria dei rischi, assistenza e distribuzione per offrire un'esperienza clienti eccezionale.

- Creare proposte di valore convincenti che allineano le capacità di Zurigo con gli obiettivi aziendali dei clienti.

- Leva le intuizioni del mercato, l'intelligenza dei clienti e l'analisi per identificare le opportunità e rafforzare le strategie di account.

- Coordinare risorse interne e impegno di leadership per garantire l'esecuzione e la consegna senza soluzione di continuità.

- Viaggiare come necessario per sostenere le relazioni con i clienti e gli obiettivi aziendali.

Qualifiche di base:

- Corso di laurea e 8 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Gestione relazioni
O

- Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 10 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di gestione delle relazioni
E

- Esperienza di gestione e crescita redditizia relazioni esterne dei clienti

- Dimostrativo successo sviluppo ed esecuzione di piani strategici di business

- Forte comunicazione, influenza e capacità di costruzione di relazioni

- Esperienza di assicurazione commerciale significativa

Qualificazioni predestinate

- Proprietà commerciale & esperienza di assicurazione casuale

- Sottoscrittura, intermediazione, gestione del rischio o background di gestione del cliente

- Evidente successo gestione di grandi e complessi rapporti con i clienti e la crescita redditizia

- broker esistente, agente e relazioni con i clienti in tutta la più ampia regione del sud-est

- Conoscenza avanzata delle piattaforme di Salesforce e di sottoscrittura come Guidewire, PolicyCenter, Power BI, e la capacità di auto-servare le esigenze di reporting, mentre la collaborazione con i team di sottoscrizione e di scienza dei dati per rappresentare oliticamente il rapporto con il cliente.

- Forte capacità nell'esecuzione di incontri esecutivi e conversazioni di stewardship che integrano Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering e leadership senior per grandi account.

- Esperienza di gestione dei clienti e dei rapporti profonda con una forte pianificazione strategica e capacità di esecuzione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zurich North America sucht einen einflussreichen Strategic Relationship Leader, der sich unserem Customer Relationship Management Team in der Region Southeast anschließt. Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, eng mit Führungskräften, strategischen Kunden und Brokerpartnern in den wichtigen Wachstumsmärkten von Zürich zusammenzuarbeiten.

In dieser Rolle mit hoher Sichtbarkeit arbeiten Sie mit Führungskräften, Brokern und wichtigen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Kundenpartnerschaften zu stärken, Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren und innovative Risikolösungen zu liefern, die langfristigen Wert schaffen. Sie werden in den Zurich Underwriting-, Claims-, Risk Engineering- und Serviceteams zusammenarbeiten, um die Kundenstrategie zu gestalten, die Bindung voranzutreiben und das profitable Wachstum zu beschleunigen.

Wir suchen eine Führungskraft, die gerne Beziehungen auf Führungsebene aufbaut, Ergebnisse beeinflusst und Menschen zusammenbringt, um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen.

Diese Position berichtet an den Leiter Customer Relationship Management und unterstützt strategische Kunden in der gesamten Region Südosten. Bevorzugte Standorte sind Atlanta, South Carolina oder North Carolina, obwohl Kandidaten an anderer Stelle in der Südostregion in Betracht gezogen werden können.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

- Dienen Sie als primärer Beziehungsstratege für ein Portfolio von großen, hochwertigen Kunden und Interessenten.

- Aufbau und Pflege vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu Führungskräften der C-Suite, Risikomanagern, Brokern und wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern.

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien zur Kundenbindung, die die Bindung, Rentabilität und langfristiges Wachstum fördern.

- Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, um die Lösungen und Fähigkeiten von Zurich in nationalen und globalen Geschäftsbereichen zu erweitern.

- Führen Sie Executive Business Reviews, Stewardship-Meetings und strategische Planungssitzungen für wichtige Kunden.

- Partnerschaft mit Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering, Service und Distributionsteams, um ein außergewöhnliches Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.

- Schaffen Sie überzeugende Wertversprechen, die die Fähigkeiten von Zurich an den Geschäftszielen der Kunden ausrichten.

- Nutzen Sie Marktinformationen, Customer Intelligence und Analysen, um Chancen zu identifizieren und Kontostrategien zu stärken.

- Koordinieren Sie interne Ressourcen und Führungseinsätze, um eine nahtlose Ausführung und Lieferung zu gewährleisten.

- Reisen Sie nach Bedarf, um Kundenbeziehungen und Geschäftsziele zu unterstützen.

Grundqualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Relationship Management
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Relationship Management
UND

- Erfahrung in der Verwaltung und dem Wachstum profitabler externer Kundenbeziehungen

- Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Geschäftspläne

- Starke Kommunikation, Einfluss und Beziehungsaufbau Fähigkeiten

- Bedeutende gewerbliche Versicherungserfahrung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

- Commercial Property & Casual Insurance Erfahrung

- Underwriting, Brokerage, Risikomanagement oder Client Management Hintergrund

- Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Verwaltung großer, komplexer Kundenbeziehungen und der Förderung profitablen Wachstums

- Bestehende Makler-, Agenten- und Kundenbeziehungen in der gesamten Region Südosten

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von Salesforce- und Underwriting-Plattformen wie Guidewire, PolicyCenter, Power BI und die Fähigkeit, Berichtsanforderungen selbst zu bedienen und gleichzeitig mit Underwriting- und Data-Science-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um die Kundenbeziehung ganzheitlich darzustellen.

- Starke Fähigkeiten bei der Durchführung von Meetings auf Führungsebene und Stewardship-Gesprächen, die Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering und Senior Leadership für große Konten integrieren.

- Tiefe Erfahrung im Kunden- und Beziehungsmanagement mit starken strategischen Planungs- und Ausführungsmöglichkeiten.

- Demonstrierte Expertise in der Verwaltung von Schlüsselkunden und der Steigerung der profitablen Geschäftsleistung.

- Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte der C-Suite mit starkem Verhandlungsgeschick und Vordenkerrolle einzubinden und zu beeinflussen.

- Kenntnis der Risikobewertungen und die Fähigkeit, klare, umsetzbare Risikoinformationen zu liefern.

- Außergewöhnliche Präsentation, Kommunikation, Zeitmanagement und Multitasking-Fähigkeiten.

- Starke organisatorische, analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

Bei Zurich haben Sie die Möglichkeit, mit Branchenexperten zusammenzuarbeiten, ein globales Netzwerk von Ressourcen zu nutzen und Risikolösungen für einige der weltweit angesehensten Organisationen zu gestalten. Sie treten einem Unternehmen bei, das für seine starke Kultur, sein kollaboratives Umfeld, seine Kundenorientierung und sein Engagement dafür bekannt ist, Mitarbeitern zu helfen, zu wachsen und erfolgreich zu sein.

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig.

Die gezeigte Lohnspanne ist ein nationaler Durchschnitt und kann je nach Standort variieren. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt 152.400.00 $ - 249.500.00 $, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung auf 25% festgelegt ist.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist führend im Risikomanagement und verfügt über mehr als 150 Jahre Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

Zürich in Nordamerika diskriminiert nicht aufgrund von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsausdruck, Geschlechtsidentität, genetischer Information, Alter, Behinderung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Schwangerschaft oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est à la recherche d'un leader de la relation stratégique hautement influent pour rejoindre notre équipe de gestion de la relation client dans la région du Sud-Est. Ce poste offre l'occasion de travailler en étroite collaboration avec des dirigeants, des clients stratégiques et des partenaires de courtage sur les marchés de croissance importants de Zurich.

Dans ce rôle de grande visibilité, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des cadres supérieurs, des courtiers et des intervenants clés afin de renforcer les partenariats avec les clients, d'identifier les possibilités de croissance et de proposer des solutions de risque novatrices qui créent une valeur à long terme. Vous travaillerez à travers les équipes de souscription, de réclamation, d'ingénierie des risques et de service de Zurich pour aider à façonner la stratégie client, conduire la rétention, et accélérer la croissance rentable.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader qui aime établir des relations au niveau de la direction, influencer les résultats et rassembler les gens pour résoudre des défis complexes.

Ce poste relève du chef de la gestion des relations avec la clientèle et soutient les clients stratégiques dans toute la région du Sud-Est. Les endroits préférés comprennent Atlanta, la Caroline du Sud ou la Caroline du Nord, mais les candidats situés ailleurs dans la région du Sud-Est peuvent être considérés.

Principales responsabilités :

- Servir de principal stratège relationnel pour un portefeuille de grands clients et de perspectives de grande valeur.

- Établir et maintenir des relations de confiance avec les cadres de C-suite, les gestionnaires de risques, les courtiers et les décideurs clés.

- Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies d'engagement des clients qui favorisent la rétention, la rentabilité et la croissance à long terme.

- Identifier les possibilités d'étendre les solutions et les capacités de Zurich à toutes les opérations nationales et mondiales.

- Diriger les examens des activités des cadres supérieurs, les réunions d'intendance et les séances de planification stratégique pour les principaux clients.

- Partenaire avec des équipes de souscription, de réclamation, d'ingénierie des risques, de service et de distribution pour offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle.

- Créer des propositions de valeur convaincantes qui harmonisent les capacités de Zurich avec les objectifs commerciaux des clients.

- Tirer parti des perspectives du marché, de l'intelligence client et de l'analyse pour identifier les possibilités et renforcer les stratégies de compte.

- Coordonner les ressources internes et l'engagement du leadership afin d'assurer une exécution et une prestation harmonieuses.

- Voyage au besoin pour soutenir les relations avec la clientèle et les objectifs commerciaux.

Qualifications de base :

- Baccalauréat Diplôme et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la gestion des relations
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 10 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la gestion des relations
PAYS

- Expérience de gestion et de croissance de relations clients externes rentables

- Réalisation démontrée de plans d'affaires stratégiques

- Compétences solides en communication, influence et établissement de relations

- Expérience importante en assurance commerciale

Qualifications privilégiées

- Expérience d'assurance de la propriété commerciale et des pertes

- La souscription, le courtage, la gestion des risques ou la gestion des clients

- Succès prouvé en gérant de grandes relations client complexes et en favorisant une croissance rentable

- Relations actuelles entre courtiers, mandataires et clients dans toute la région du Sud-Est

- Connaissance avancée des plateformes Salesforce et de souscription telles que Guidewire, PolicyCenter, Power BI, et la capacité de se servir des besoins de rapport tout en s'associant avec des équipes de souscription et de science des données pour représenter globalement la relation client.

- De solides capacités pour organiser des réunions de direction et des conversations d'intendance qui intègrent la souscription, les réclamations, le génie des risques et le leadership supérieur pour les grands comptes.

- Expérience approfondie de gestion client et relationnelle avec de solides capacités de planification stratégique et d'exécution.

- Expertise démontrée dans la gestion des clients clés et la conduite de performances commerciales rentables.

- Capacité d'engager et d'influencer les chefs de C‐suite avec de solides compétences en négociation et un leadership réfléchi.

- Connaissance des évaluations des risques et de la capacité de fournir des renseignements clairs et concrets sur les risques.

- Compétences exceptionnelles en présentation, communication, gestion du temps et multitâche.

- De solides capacités organisationnelles, analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.

À Zurich, vous aurez l'occasion de travailler aux côtés d'experts de l'industrie, de tirer parti d'un réseau mondial de ressources et d'aider à définir des solutions de risque pour certaines des organisations les plus respectées au monde. Vous rejoindrez une entreprise connue pour sa culture forte, son environnement collaboratif, son orientation client et son engagement à aider les employés à croître et à réussir.

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et à des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont au-dessus de la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous.

L'échelle de rémunération indiquée est une moyenne nationale et peut varier selon l'endroit. L'échelle salariale proposée pour ce poste est de 152 400,00 $ - 249 500,00 $, l'admissibilité à la prime incitative à court terme étant fixée à 25 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est un chef de file en gestion des risques, avec plus de 150 ans d'expertise et de couverture dans plus de 25 industries, dont 90 % du Fortune 500®.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for an AVP Underwriting Manager – Middle Market to support our West region production underwriting team in Seattle! While this position will be based out of our Seattle office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role requires visibility in the marketplace, with the expectation of being in the office and/or market three days per week.

Middle Market is a key business segment within Zurich, and we are focused on attracting top customer advocates who possess a sales mindset, strong technical underwriting skills and solution focused problem-solving abilities. Our industry focus includes (not limited to) Financial Institutions, General Industries, Manufacturing, Technology, Professional Services and Real Estate. Zurich Middle Market offers end to end solutions for our customers inclusive of international programs.

In this role you will manage a team of skilled Property & Casualty production Underwriters. You will be expected to travel as necessary to support the needs of the team and to cultivate key broker relationships. This is a critical role in driving an engaging team culture. This role requires a strong technical, staff development and sales execution mindset.

AVP, Underwriting Manager Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the claims or Under Support area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
AND

- 2 or more years of management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- CPCU

- Advance knowledge of product lines and insurance industry

- Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills

- Excellent skills in relationship building

- Strong presentation skills

- Results oriented

- Strategic planning and execution experience

- Strong negotiation skills

- Experience managing complex portfolios

- Technical knowledge of insurance industry operations and processes

- Knowledge in risk selection and strategical components of anticipating the market environment

The proposed Salary range for this position is $182,900.00 - $299,400.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

jobs.title: Strategic Relationship Leader, Commercial Insurance, South Region
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is seeking a highly influential Strategic Relationship Leader to join our Customer Relationship Management team in the South Region. The position offers the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders, strategic customers, and broker partners across Zurich's important growth markets.

In this high-visibility role, you will partner with senior executives, brokers, and key stakeholders to strengthen customer partnerships, identify growth opportunities, and deliver innovative risk solutions that create long-term value. You will work across Zurich's underwriting, claims, risk engineering, and service teams to help shape customer strategy, drive retention, and accelerate profitable growth.

We are looking for a leader who enjoys building executive-level relationships, influencing outcomes, and bringing people together to solve complex challenges.

This position reports to the Head of Customer Relationship Management and supports strategic customers throughout the South Region. Preferred locations include Houston or Dallas, though candidates located elsewhere within the South Region may be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

- Serve as the primary relationship strategist for a portfolio of large, high-value customers and prospects.

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite executives, risk managers, brokers, and key decision-makers.

- Develop and execute customer engagement strategies that drive retention, profitability, and long-term growth.

- Identify opportunities to expand Zurich's solutions and capabilities across domestic and global operations.

- Lead executive business reviews, stewardship meetings, and strategic planning sessions for key customers.

- Partner with underwriting, claims, risk engineering, service, and distribution teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

- Create compelling value propositions that align Zurich's capabilities with customer business objectives.

- Leverage market insights, customer intelligence, and analytics to identify opportunities and strengthen account strategies.

- Coordinate internal resources and leadership engagement to ensure seamless execution and delivery.

- Travel as needed to support customer relationships and business objectives.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Relationship Management area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Relationship Management area
AND

- Experience managing and growing profitable external customer relationships

- Demonstrated success developing and executing strategic business plans

- Strong communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills

- Significant Commercial Insurance experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Commercial Property & Casualty insurance experience

- Underwriting, brokerage, risk management, or client management background

- Proven success managing large, complex customer relationships and driving profitable growth

- Existing broker, agent, and customer relationships throughout Texas and the broader South Region

- Advanced knowledge of Salesforce and underwriting platforms such as Guidewire, PolicyCenter, Power BI, and the ability to self-serve reporting needs while partnering with underwriting and data science teams to holistically represent the customer relationship.

- Strong capabilities in running executive‑level meetings and stewardship conversations that integrate Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering, and senior leadership for large accounts.

- Deep customer and relationship management experience with strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.

- Demonstrated expertise in managing key customers and driving profitable business performance.

- Ability to engage and influence C‑suite leaders with strong negotiation skills and thought leadership.

- Knowledge of risk assessments and the ability to deliver clear, actionable risk insights.

- Exceptional presentation, communication, time‑management, and multitasking skills.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem‑solving abilities.

At Zurich, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts, leverage a global network of resources, and help shape risk solutions for some of the world's most respected organizations. You'll join a company known for its strong culture, collaborative environment, customer focus, and commitment to helping employees grow and succeed.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $152,400.00 - $249,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 25%.

- Strong capabilities in running executive‑level meetings and stewardship conversations that integrate Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering, and senior leadership for large accounts.

- Deep customer and relationship management experience with strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.

- Demonstrated expertise in managing key customers and driving profitable business performance.

- Ability to engage and influence C‑suite leaders with strong negotiation skills and thought leadership.

- Knowledge of risk assessments and the ability to deliver clear, actionable risk insights.

- Exceptional presentation, communication, time‑management, and multitasking skills.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem‑solving abilities.

At Zurich, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts, leverage a global network of resources, and help shape risk solutions for some of the world's most respected organizations. You'll join a company known for its strong culture, collaborative environment, customer focus, and commitment to helping employees grow and succeed.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $152,400.00 - $249,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 25%.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Assurance Expert (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Does the thought of shaping Zurich’s global internal control framework and influencing key risk decisions across the Group appeal to you? As a Senior Risk Assurance Expert, you will work at the heart of Group Risk Management, providing high impact assurance and partnering with business units and Group functions worldwide.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to strengthen the reliability of our Internal Control Integrated Framework (ICIF), drive improvements based on best practice, and support policy owners in designing robust control objectives that truly make a difference. Joining an experienced, international team, you will contribute to a culture of togetherness and forward thinking, helping Zurich build resilient, future ready risk and control capabilities while continuing to grow your own expertise and influence.

What you will do

- Provide assurance over the quality of the internal controls within the Internal Control Integrated Framework (ICIF).

- Assess and discuss internal control issues which are significant to the Group.

- Perform assurance reviews within business units and Group functions, working closely with the local Internal Control, Risk and first line teams.

- In co-operation with control testing teams, be responsible for performing assurance procedures to ensure that internal control testing activities are performed in compliance with the ICIF methodology.

- Provide enhancements based on learnings across the Group and from industry external best practices.

- Supporting policy owners in designing, developing and implementing control objectives.

What you bring

- 10+ years of experience.

- Solid knowledge of Insurance processes is required.

- Previous experience gained working within a global audit team (such as a Big 4 firm) or internal control engagements is preferred.

- Prior experience within a business unit in Risk Management, Finance or within Group Finance (within the insurance industry) would be an asset.

- Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills are required.

- Excellent communication skills in both written and verbal format

- Fluent written and spoken English skills.

- Additional company languages (e.g. German or Spanish) would be a distinct advantage

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

jobs.title: Broker Relationship Manager: South East Region
jobs.description:
Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis

Location: South East region, regular travel across your assigned broker panel and attendance at our Croydon office

Closing date for applications: 8th September 2026

The opportunity:

Are you looking for an exciting new opportunity where you’ll get to develop and grow relationships with brokers? Our Broker Relationship Manager role could be just the one for you!

At Zurich, we put our customer and broker panel needs at the heart of everything we do through our range of products and services. We are committed to helping you grow for the future, building on your existing sales, product, and market knowledge.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and developing new and growing broker relationships. This role requires a strategic thinker with exceptional interpersonal skills and a deep understanding of the insurance industry.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

Key responsibilities:

- Management and development of new and growing broker relationships.

- Development responsibility for broker panel. These accounts will vary in size, complexity or how technical they are in nature.

- With support from the outset if required, working with minimal supervision you will be responsible for delivery of own sales and business performance targets.

- Work with all brokers on panel to educate and implement new initiatives and drive pipeline, as well as other sales campaigns and appropriate marketing.

- Identifying actual and potential customers or intermediary needs and meet those from the various products and propositions that exist within the business.

- Complete a granular evaluation of your broker panel to drive maximum share of wallet.

- Always represent Zurich in a professional manner.

- Achieve minimum required standard for completion of all essential business tools.

- Implement the Zurich distribution strategy and objectives through all allocated brokers.

- Gaining and feeding back market intelligence/activity.

- Carry out presentations and sales training for new product launches.

- Working alongside Underwriters and the wider business to provide brokers with a market leading service proposition.

Your skills and experience:

- DIP CII qualification or working towards it (preferred).

- In-depth knowledge of market dynamics, product details, and technical aspects, with a strong drive to continuously improve.

- Adherence to industry standards and best practices.

- Well-versed in the unique characteristics and trends of the UK General Insurance market.

- Proven ability to forge strong connections with brokers.

- Effective collaborator with a strong ability to work within a team environment.

- Excellent verbal and written communication abilities to articulate ideas clearly and confidently.

- Skilled in managing your schedule and prioritising tasks based on urgency and business needs.

- Ability to oversee and drive successful outcomes in these areas.

- Exceptional planning skills to manage your diary effectively and prioritise tasks critical to business success.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday, alongside a range of other flexible benefits

You can find out more about our wide range of employee benefits on our website .

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our culture:

At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected.

Over a quarter of our employees are members of at least one of our inclusion communities (Employee Resource Groups), with groups focused on areas such as social mobility and cultural awareness. We’re proud to have received numerous industry awards recognising our diversity and inclusion policies and initiatives.

We’ve created an environment that places real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide practical advice and access to a wide range of lifestyle support, alongside opportunities to learn, grow and develop the skills needed for the future.

We actively support our employees to give back to their communities through volunteering and charitable activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest‑established corporate trusts in the UK. Together, we’ve supported causes across the UK through grants and volunteering, contributing over £100 million in funding and volunteered time.

Your application:

We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

- 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme.

- Annual company bonus.

- Income Protection.

- Life cover - four times your salary.

Time away

- 28 days holiday a year plus bank holidays.

- You can also request to swap UK bank holidays for days off that have cultural or religious significance to you.

- The option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

- Three days paid volunteering.

- Up to 16 weeks' full pay for maternity, paternity and adoption leave.

Your health is important to us

- Access to Private medical insurance.

- Virtual GP appointments.

- Discounted gym membership.

- Free flu jab.

- Access to a wealth of support from our wellbeing partners.

We're making a difference

- Creating a brighter, more sustainable future underpins all that we do here in Zurich. We were the first insurer to sign the ‘UN Business Ambition for 1.5˚C’ pledge.

- Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, has awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: IT Service Desk Administrator
jobs.description:
Location: Douglas, Isle of Man

Closing date for applications: 8th September 2026

The opportunity:

Are you passionate about technology and delivering excellent customer service? We're looking for an IT Service Desk Administrator to join our team on a permanent basis and play a vital role in supporting Zurich colleagues and partners.

As the first point of contact for IT support, you'll help users resolve technical issues, answer service requests, and ensure a seamless technology experience across the business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys problem solving, thrives in a customer-focused environment, and is looking to develop their career within a supportive and collaborative team.

At Zurich, you'll be encouraged to grow your skills, expand your technical knowledge, and contribute to a team that keeps our business running smoothly through exceptional service and support.

Key responsibilities:

As an IT Service Desk Administrator, you will:

- Be the first point of contact for IT incidents, problems and service requests, providing a professional, responsive and customer-focused support experience.

- Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve technical issues at first contact wherever possible, ensuring minimal disruption to users.

- Triage and prioritise incidents using agreed processes, escalating complex issues to the appropriate support teams when required.

- Manage incidents and service requests through to resolution using approved service management tools, ensuring service level targets are met or exceeded.

- Accurately record incident details, updates and resolutions to support effective communication and knowledge sharing across support teams.

- Communicate technical information clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical users.

- Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers and colleagues, delivering a consistently high standard of service.

- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and supporting the development of support documentation and knowledge resources.

- Keep up to date with relevant technologies, systems, processes and policies to ensure accurate and effective support is provided.

About you:

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping people, has a positive attitude, and is keen to develop their IT career.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

- Experience providing excellent customer service, ideally within an IT support, service desk or customer-focused environment.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.

- Strong general PC and system skills, with the confidence to learn new technologies and applications.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and professionally.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to resolving issues.

- The ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks effectively.

- Confidence working independently while also contributing positively as part of a team.

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

- Sound judgement and the ability to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Our culture:

At Zurich on the Isle of Man, our sense of community is strong and we’re particularly passionate about diversity and inclusion. We want our people to bring their whole selves to the workplace and ensure everybody is made to feel welcome, regardless of their background, race, gender or sexual identity, beliefs, or culture. We are committed to treating all our applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

We have an environment that places a real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide the best advice and access to a wealth of lifestyle support. We’re also committed to continuous improvement, and we offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We’re passionate about supporting employees to help others by getting involved in volunteering, charitable and community activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest-established corporate trusts in the UK. In that time, we’ve awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

L'opportunità:

Sei appassionato di tecnologia e di fornire un servizio clienti eccellente? Stiamo cercando un amministratore IT Service Desk per unire il nostro team in modo permanente e svolgere un ruolo vitale nel sostenere colleghi e partner di Zurigo.

Come primo punto di contatto per il supporto IT, aiuterai gli utenti a risolvere problemi tecnici, rispondere alle richieste di servizi e garantire un'esperienza tecnologica senza soluzione di continuità in tutto il business. Questa è un'ottima opportunità per qualcuno che gode di problem solving, prospera in un ambiente focalizzato sul cliente, e sta cercando di sviluppare la loro carriera all'interno di un team di supporto e collaborativo.

A Zurigo, sarete incoraggiati a crescere le vostre competenze, ampliare le vostre conoscenze tecniche, e contribuire a un team che mantiene la nostra attività senza problemi attraverso un servizio e un supporto eccezionali.

Responsabilità chiave:

In qualità di amministratore IT Service Desk,:

- Siate il primo punto di contatto per incidenti IT, problemi e richieste di assistenza, fornendo un'esperienza di supporto professionale, reattiva e orientata al cliente.

- Indagare, risolvere i problemi tecnici e risolvere i problemi al primo contatto, ovunque possibile, garantendo un minimo disordine agli utenti.

- Triage e priorità incidenti utilizzando processi concordati, aumentando problemi complessi ai team di supporto appropriati quando necessario.

- Gestire gli incidenti e le richieste di assistenza attraverso la risoluzione utilizzando strumenti di gestione dei servizi approvati, assicurando che gli obiettivi del livello di servizio siano soddisfatti o superati.

- Accuratamente registrare dettagli degli incidenti, aggiornamenti e risoluzioni per supportare la comunicazione efficace e la condivisione delle conoscenze tra i team di supporto.

- Comunicare informazioni tecniche in modo chiaro e fiducioso sia per gli utenti tecnici che non tecnici.

- Costruire e mantenere rapporti di lavoro positivi con clienti e colleghi, offrendo un livello di servizio costantemente elevato.

- Contribuire al miglioramento continuo identificando i problemi ricorrenti e sostenendo lo sviluppo della documentazione di supporto e delle risorse di conoscenza.

- Tenere aggiornato con le tecnologie, i sistemi, i processi e le politiche pertinenti per garantire un supporto accurato ed efficace.

Su di te:

Stiamo cercando qualcuno che si diverte ad aiutare le persone, ha un atteggiamento positivo, ed è desideroso di sviluppare la loro carriera IT.

Ci piacerebbe sentire da voi se avete:

- Esperienza che offre un servizio clienti eccellente, idealmente all'interno di un supporto IT, di un service desk o di un ambiente focalizzato sul cliente.

- Buona conoscenza di lavoro di Microsoft Word, Excel e Outlook.

- Forte PC generale e competenze di sistema, con la fiducia di imparare nuove tecnologie e applicazioni.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, con la capacità di spiegare le informazioni in modo chiaro e professionale.

- Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving, con un approccio proattivo per risolvere i problemi.

- La capacità di priorizzare i carichi di lavoro e gestire più attività in modo efficace.

- La fiducia che funziona in modo indipendente e contribuisce anche positivamente come parte di una squadra.

- Forte attenzione ai dettagli e impegno a fornire un lavoro di alta qualità.

- Giudizio sonoro e la capacità di prendere decisioni informate in un ambiente frenetico.

La nostra cultura:

A Zurigo sull’Isola dell’Uomo, il nostro senso di comunità è forte e siamo particolarmente appassionati di diversità e inclusione. Vogliamo che la nostra gente porti il proprio sé sul posto di lavoro e assicuri che tutti siano fatti per sentirsi benvenuti, indipendentemente dal loro background, razza, genere o identità sessuale, credenze o cultura. Ci impegniamo a trattare tutti i nostri candidati in modo equo e rispettoso, indipendentemente dal loro reale o presunto background, disabilità, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta.

Abbiamo un ambiente che pone una reale importanza sul benessere della nostra gente da una prospettiva fisica, mentale, sociale e finanziaria. Lavoriamo con i nostri partner di benessere e gli esperti del settore per fornire i migliori consigli e l'accesso a una ricchezza di supporto allo stile di vita. Siamo anche impegnati a un miglioramento continuo, e offriamo l'accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.

Siamo appassionati di sostenere i dipendenti per aiutare gli altri, coinvolgendoci nell’attività di volontariato, caritativa e comunitaria. Il nostro braccio caritativo, Zurich Community Trust, è uno dei più consolidati trust aziendali nel Regno Unito. In quel periodo, abbiamo concesso borse di studio e tempo di volontariato per meritare cause nel Regno Unito valutato a oltre 90 milioni di sterline.

Quindi, fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora per noi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Aktivitäten in der Nähe von Douglas, Isle of Man

Bewerbungsschluss: 8. September 2026

Die Gelegenheit:

Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für Technologie und einen exzellenten Kundenservice? Wir suchen einen IT Service Desk Administrator, der sich unserem Team permanent anschließt und eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung der Zürcher Kollegen und Partner spielt.

Als erster Ansprechpartner für den IT-Support helfen Sie Benutzern, technische Probleme zu lösen, Serviceanfragen zu beantworten und ein nahtloses Technologieerlebnis im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten. Dies ist eine ausgezeichnete Gelegenheit für jemanden, der gerne Probleme löst, in einer kundenorientierten Umgebung lebt und seine Karriere in einem unterstützenden und kollaborativen Team entwickeln möchte.

Bei Zurich werden Sie ermutigt, Ihre Fähigkeiten zu erweitern, Ihr technisches Wissen zu erweitern und zu einem Team beizutragen, das unser Geschäft durch außergewöhnlichen Service und Support reibungslos am Laufen hält.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

Als IT Service Desk Administrator werden Sie:

- Seien Sie der erste Ansprechpartner für IT-Vorfälle, Probleme und Serviceanfragen und bieten Sie eine professionelle, reaktionsschnelle und kundenorientierte Support-Erfahrung.

- Untersuchen, Beheben und Beheben von technischen Problemen beim ersten Kontakt, wo immer möglich, um eine minimale Störung der Benutzer zu gewährleisten.

- Triggern und priorisieren Sie Vorfälle mithilfe vereinbarter Prozesse, wobei komplexe Probleme bei Bedarf an die entsprechenden Supportteams weitergeleitet werden.

- Verwalten Sie Incidents und Service Requests bis hin zur Lösung mit genehmigten Service Management Tools, um sicherzustellen, dass die Service Level Ziele erreicht oder übertroffen werden.

- Aktualisieren Sie Details, Updates und Auflösungen von Vorfällen genau, um eine effektive Kommunikation und den Wissensaustausch zwischen den Supportteams zu unterstützen.

- Kommunizieren Sie technische Informationen klar und sicher sowohl für technische als auch für nichttechnische Benutzer.

- Aufbau und Pflege positiver Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Kunden und Kollegen, die einen konstant hohen Servicestandard bieten.

- Tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bei, indem Sie wiederkehrende Probleme identifizieren und die Entwicklung von Unterstützungsdokumentationen und Wissensressourcen unterstützen.

- Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit relevanten Technologien, Systemen, Prozessen und Richtlinien, um eine genaue und effektive Unterstützung zu gewährleisten.

Über dich:

Wir suchen jemanden, der gerne Menschen hilft, eine positive Einstellung hat und daran interessiert ist, ihre IT-Karriere zu entwickeln.

Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören, wenn Sie:

- Erleben Sie einen hervorragenden Kundenservice, idealerweise in einem IT-Support, Service Desk oder einer kundenorientierten Umgebung.

- Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Word, Excel und Outlook.

- Starke allgemeine PC- und Systemkenntnisse, mit dem Vertrauen, neue Technologien und Anwendungen zu erlernen.

- Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Informationen klar und professionell zu erklären.

- Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Lösung von Problemen.

- Die Fähigkeit, Workloads zu priorisieren und mehrere Aufgaben effektiv zu verwalten.

- Selbstvertrauen arbeitet unabhängig und trägt gleichzeitig positiv als Teil eines Teams bei.

- Starke Liebe zum Detail und eine Verpflichtung, qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit zu liefern.

- Ein fundiertes Urteilsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, fundierte Entscheidungen in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu treffen.

Unsere Kultur:

Bei Zurich on the Isle of Man ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl stark und wir sind besonders leidenschaftlich für Vielfalt und Inklusion. Wir möchten, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihr ganzes Selbst an den Arbeitsplatz bringen und sicherstellen, dass sich jeder willkommen fühlt, unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund, seiner Rasse, seinem Geschlecht oder seiner sexuellen Identität, seinem Glauben oder seiner Kultur. Wir verpflichten uns, alle unsere Bewerber fair und mit Respekt zu behandeln, unabhängig von ihrem tatsächlichen oder angenommenen Hintergrund, Behinderung oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen.

Wir haben ein Umfeld, das dem Wohlergehen unserer Menschen aus körperlicher, geistiger, sozialer und finanzieller Sicht eine echte Bedeutung beimisst. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Wohlfühlpartnern und Branchenexperten zusammen, um die beste Beratung und den Zugang zu einer Fülle von Lifestyle-Unterstützung zu bieten. Wir sind auch der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung verpflichtet und bieten Zugang zu einer umfassenden Palette von Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Mitarbeiter dabei zu unterstützen, anderen zu helfen, indem wir uns in Freiwilligenarbeit, gemeinnützigen und gemeinschaftlichen Aktivitäten engagieren. Unser gemeinnütziger Arm, Zurich Community Trust, ist einer der am längsten etablierten Corporate Trusts in Großbritannien. In dieser Zeit haben wir Zuschüsse und freiwillige Zeit für verdienstvolle Zwecke in Großbritannien im Wert von über 90 Millionen Pfund vergeben.

Also, machen Sie einen Unterschied. Werden Sie herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Unterstützt werden. Liebe, was du tust. Arbeitet für uns.
