L'occasion :

Êtes-vous passionné par la technologie et la prestation d'un excellent service à la clientèle? Nous sommes à la recherche d'un administrateur de service informatique pour rejoindre notre équipe de façon permanente et jouer un rôle essentiel dans le soutien des collègues et partenaires de Zurich.

En tant que premier point de contact pour le support informatique, vous aiderez les utilisateurs à résoudre les problèmes techniques, à répondre aux demandes de service et à assurer une expérience technologique transparente dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. C'est une excellente occasion pour quelqu'un qui aime résoudre des problèmes, prospère dans un environnement axé sur la clientèle, et cherche à développer sa carrière au sein d'une équipe de soutien et de collaboration.

À Zurich, vous serez encouragé à développer vos compétences, à développer vos connaissances techniques et à contribuer à une équipe qui assure le bon fonctionnement de notre entreprise grâce à un service et un soutien exceptionnels.

Principales responsabilités :

En tant qu'administrateur du bureau de services informatiques, vous :

- Soyez le premier point de contact pour les incidents informatiques, les problèmes et les demandes de service, offrant une expérience de soutien professionnelle, réactive et axée sur le client.

- Enquêter, dépanner et résoudre les problèmes techniques dès le premier contact, dans la mesure du possible, en assurant un minimum de perturbations aux utilisateurs.

- Triage et hiérarchisation des incidents en utilisant des processus convenus, en augmentant les problèmes complexes aux équipes de soutien appropriées au besoin.

- Gérer les incidents et les demandes de services au moyen d'outils de gestion des services approuvés, en veillant à ce que les objectifs de niveau de service soient atteints ou dépassés.

- Consigner avec précision les détails de l'incident, les mises à jour et les résolutions afin de favoriser une communication efficace et un partage des connaissances entre les équipes de soutien.

- Communiquer l'information technique de façon claire et sûre aux utilisateurs techniques et non techniques.

- Établir et maintenir des relations de travail positives avec les clients et les collègues, offrant un service de qualité élevée.

- Contribuer à l'amélioration continue en identifiant les problèmes récurrents et en appuyant l'élaboration de documents d'appui et de ressources de connaissances.

- Tenez-vous au courant des technologies, des systèmes, des processus et des politiques pertinents pour assurer un soutien précis et efficace.

À propos de vous :

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime aider les gens, qui a une attitude positive et qui souhaite développer sa carrière en TI.

Nous aimerions avoir des nouvelles de vous si vous avez:

- Expérience fournissant un excellent service à la clientèle, idéalement dans un support informatique, un bureau de service ou un environnement axé sur le client.

- Bonne connaissance pratique de Microsoft Word, Excel et Outlook.

- Fortes compétences générales en PC et système, avec la confiance pour apprendre de nouvelles technologies et applications.

- Excellente capacité de communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité d'expliquer l'information clairement et professionnellement.

- Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche proactive pour résoudre les problèmes.

- La capacité de prioriser les charges de travail et de gérer efficacement plusieurs tâches.

- La confiance dans le travail indépendant tout en contribuant positivement dans une équipe.

- Une grande attention aux détails et un engagement à fournir un travail de haute qualité.

- Un bon jugement et la capacité de prendre des décisions éclairées dans un environnement rapide.

Notre culture :

À Zurich, sur l'île de Man, notre sentiment de communauté est fort et nous sommes particulièrement passionnés par la diversité et l'inclusion. Nous voulons que notre peuple apporte toute sa personne sur le lieu de travail et nous veillons à ce que tout le monde se sente accueilli, indépendamment de son origine, de sa race, de son sexe ou de son identité sexuelle, de ses croyances ou de sa culture. Nous nous engageons à traiter tous nos candidats avec équité et respect, indépendamment de leur origine réelle ou présumée, de leur handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée.

Nous avons un environnement qui accorde une réelle importance au bien-être de notre population d'un point de vue physique, mental, social et financier. Nous travaillons avec nos partenaires bien-être et des experts de l'industrie pour fournir les meilleurs conseils et l'accès à une multitude de soutien de style de vie. Nous sommes également attachés à l'amélioration continue, et nous offrons l'accès à une gamme complète de possibilités de formation et de développement.

Nous sommes passionnés de soutenir les employés pour aider les autres en nous engageant dans des activités bénévoles, caritatives et communautaires. Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, est l'une des fiducies les plus anciennes au Royaume-Uni. À cette époque, nous avons accordé des subventions et du temps bénévole à des causes méritoires au Royaume-Uni, évaluées à plus de 90 millions de livres.

Alors, faites une différence. Soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Soyez soutenu. J'adore ce que tu fais. Travaille pour nous.

jobs.title: Senior Development Underwriter - Mid-Market Retail Insurance - North West
jobs.description:
Senior Development Underwriter – Mid-Market Retail Insurance

Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis

Salary: Competitive package + company car

Location: North West based (Greater Manchester, Liverpool, Cheshire, North Lancs)

The opportunity:

Are you an accomplished underwriter with a passion for market growth and strategic leadership? Do you thrive on influencing the market, unlocking new opportunities, and shaping portfolios? At Zurich, we’re excited to announce a newly created Senior Development Underwriter position—offering the opportunity to champion our new business strategy and play a leading role in strengthening our position across the mid-market retail insurance sector.

As Senior Development Underwriter, you will drive Zurich’s growth agenda across our mid-market retail portfolios. This is a new and highly visible role, designed to accelerate business development and deliver strategic impact. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with commercial acumen, leading the origination, negotiation, and underwriting of complex risks. Your ability to develop relationships with brokers, clients, and market influencers will be key to growing Zurich’s business and reputation.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at the interview about the flexibility you may need.

What will you be doing?

- Driving strategic growth: Lead the identification, development, and conversion of high-value mid-market retail insurance opportunities, positioning Zurich as an underwriter of choice.

- Market leadership: Build and leverage senior relationships with brokers, clients, and industry stakeholders to secure new business and enhance Zurich’s presence in target markets.

- Expert underwriting: Take ownership of complex, high-value risks—providing expert analysis, bespoke solutions, and profitable decision-making.

- Insight-led strategy: Monitor, interpret, and respond to market trends, competitor activity, and regulatory change—informing the development of market-leading propositions.

- Mentoring and collaboration: Coach and support regional teams, share specialist knowledge, and foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement to drive commercial success.

What are we looking for?

- Significant experience in mid-market retail insurance underwriting, with a strong track record of business development and portfolio growth.

- Advanced technical and analytical skills—confident in assessing and structuring complex risks.

- Proven ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with senior brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

- A strategic, commercially minded approach, with a focus on innovation and business results.

- Experience mentoring others or leading team development is highly desirable.

As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world and the best global insurer. Together we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 55,000 employees in more than 170 countries , you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company who are a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee; to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you're interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment for a company that recognises and rewards your creativity, initiatives and contributions - then Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our Culture:

At Zurich, our sense of community is strong and we’re particularly passionate about diversity and inclusion, which we’ve won numerous awards for. We want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work and ensure everybody is made to feel welcome, regardless of their background, beliefs or culture. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our customers, and so are committed to treating all of our applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability or any other protected characteristic.

We’ve an environment that places a real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide the best advice and access to a wealth of lifestyle support. We’re also committed to continuous improvement, and we offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We’re passionate about supporting employees to help others by getting involved in volunteering, charitable and community activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest-established corporate trusts in the UK. In that time, we’ve awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us. #LI-Hybrid

Senior Development Underwriter – Mid-Market Retail Insurance

Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis

Salary: Competitive package + company car

Location: North West based (Greater Manchester, Liverpool, Cheshire, North Lancs)

The opportunity:

Are you an accomplished underwriter with a passion for market growth and strategic leadership? Do you thrive on influencing the market, unlocking new opportunities, and shaping portfolios? At Zurich, we’re excited to announce a newly created Senior Development Underwriter position—offering the opportunity to champion our new business strategy and play a leading role in strengthening our position across the mid-market retail insurance sector.

As Senior Development Underwriter, you will drive Zurich’s growth agenda across our mid-market retail portfolios. This is a new and highly visible role, designed to accelerate business development and deliver strategic impact. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with commercial acumen, leading the origination, negotiation, and underwriting of complex risks. Your ability to develop relationships with brokers, clients, and market influencers will be key to growing Zurich’s business and reputation.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at the interview about the flexibility you may need.

What will you be doing?

- Driving strategic growth: Lead the identification, development, and conversion of high-value mid-market retail insurance opportunities, positioning Zurich as an underwriter of choice.

- Market leadership: Build and leverage senior relationships with brokers, clients, and industry stakeholders to secure new business and enhance Zurich’s presence in target markets.

- Expert underwriting: Take ownership of complex, high-value risks—providing expert analysis, bespoke solutions, and profitable decision-making.

- Insight-led strategy: Monitor, interpret, and respond to market trends, competitor activity, and regulatory change—informing the development of market-leading propositions.

- Mentoring and collaboration: Coach and support regional teams, share specialist knowledge, and foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement to drive commercial success.

What are we looking for?

- Significant experience in mid-market retail insurance underwriting, with a strong track record of business development and portfolio growth.

- Advanced technical and analytical skills—confident in assessing and structuring complex risks.

- Proven ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with senior brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

- A strategic, commercially minded approach, with a focus on innovation and business results.

- Experience mentoring others or leading team development is highly desirable.

As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world and the best global insurer. Together we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 55,000 employees in more than 170 countries , you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company who are a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee; to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you're interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment for a company that recognises and rewards your creativity, initiatives and contributions - then Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our Culture:

At Zurich, our sense of community is strong and we’re particularly passionate about diversity and inclusion, which we’ve won numerous awards for. We want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work and ensure everybody is made to feel welcome, regardless of their background, beliefs or culture. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our customers, and so are committed to treating all of our applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability or any other protected characteristic.

We’ve an environment that places a real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide the best advice and access to a wealth of lifestyle support. We’re also committed to continuous improvement, and we offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We’re passionate about supporting employees to help others by getting involved in volunteering, charitable and community activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest-established corporate trusts in the UK. In that time, we’ve awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us. #LI-Hybrid

descriptionByLocale.it:
Senior Development Underwriter – Mid-Market Retail Insurance

Ore lavorative: Questo ruolo è disponibile a tempo parziale, a tempo pieno o a tempo pieno

Salario: Pacchetto competitivo + auto aziendale

Posizione: North West based (Greater Manchester, Liverpool, Cheshire, North Lancs)

L'opportunità:

Sei un sottoscritto compiuto con una passione per la crescita del mercato e la leadership strategica? Si prospera su influenzare il mercato, sbloccare nuove opportunità e modellare portafogli? A Zurigo, siamo entusiasti di annunciare una nuova posizione di Senior Development Underwriter, offrendo l’opportunità di sostenere la nostra nuova strategia aziendale e di svolgere un ruolo di primo piano nel rafforzare la nostra posizione nel settore delle assicurazioni al dettaglio di metà mercato.

Come Senior Development Underwriter, guiderai l’agenda di crescita di Zurigo nei nostri portafogli di vendita al dettaglio di metà mercato. Questo è un ruolo nuovo e altamente visibile, progettato per accelerare lo sviluppo aziendale e fornire un impatto strategico. Potrai combinare profonda esperienza tecnica con acume commerciale, che conduce l'origine, la negoziazione e la sottoscrizione di rischi complessi. La vostra capacità di sviluppare relazioni con i broker, i clienti e gli influencer di mercato sarà la chiave per la crescita del business e della reputazione di Zurigo.

Molti dei nostri dipendenti lavorano in modo flessibile in una varietà di modi diversi, tra cui ore part-time, orari flessibili, quote di lavoro, un elemento di lavoro da casa o ore compresse. Questo perché vogliamo le persone migliori per i nostri ruoli, e riconosciamo che a volte quelle persone non sono disponibili a tempo pieno. Si prega di parlare con noi durante l'intervista sulla flessibilità che potrebbe essere necessario.

Cosa farai?

- Guidare la crescita strategica: guidare l'identificazione, lo sviluppo e la conversione delle opportunità di assicurazione di vendita al dettaglio di alto valore, posizionando Zurigo come uno strumento di scelta.

- Leader del mercato: Costruire e sfruttare le relazioni senior con i broker, i clienti e gli stakeholder del settore per garantire nuovi business e migliorare la presenza di Zurigo nei mercati target.

- Sottoscrittura di esperti: Assumere la proprietà di rischi complessi e di alto valore—fornire analisi di esperti, soluzioni su misura e decisioni redditizie.

- Strategia insight-led: Monitorare, interpretare e rispondere alle tendenze del mercato, alle attività dei concorrenti e ai cambiamenti normativi, informando lo sviluppo delle proposte leader del mercato.

- Mentoraggio e collaborazione: Coach e sostenere team regionali, condividere conoscenze specialistiche, e promuovere una cultura di collaborazione e miglioramento continuo per guidare il successo commerciale.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

- Esperienza significativa nella sottoscrizione dell'assicurazione vendita al dettaglio di mercato medio, con un forte record di sviluppo aziendale e crescita del portafoglio.

- Competenze tecniche e analitiche avanzate - fiduciosi nella valutazione e nella strutturazione dei rischi complessi.

- comprovata capacità di coinvolgere, influenzare e negoziare con broker senior, clienti e stakeholder interni.

- Un approccio strategico, commercialmente pensato, con un focus sull'innovazione e sui risultati aziendali.

- L'esperienza di mentoring gli altri o il principale sviluppo del team è altamente auspicabile.

Come datore di lavoro inclusivo vogliamo garantire che tutti i candidati si sentano a proprio agio e siano in grado di eseguire al meglio durante l'intervista. Avrete la possibilità di farci sapere qualsiasi ragionevole adattamento o supporto pratico necessario quando si applica.

Cosa otterrai in cambio?

Ognuno è diverso. Ecco perché a Zurigo offriamo una vasta gamma di vantaggi per i nostri dipendenti in modo che i nostri clienti possano scegliere ciò che si adatta a loro e alla loro vita. I nostri vantaggi offrono una reale flessibilità in modo che le nostre persone possano fare scelte considerate e personalizzare i loro benefici durante tutto l'anno. I nostri benefici includono 12% di pensione non contributiva definita, bonus annuale dell'azienda, assicurazione medica privata e la possibilità di acquistare fino a un ulteriore 20 giorni o vendere alcuni della vostra vacanza.

Seguire il link per maggiori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi - Vantaggi del dipendente | Lavorare presso l'assicurazione di Zurigo UK

Chi siamo:

A Zurigo aspiriamo ad essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d'impatto del mondo e il migliore assicuratore globale. Insieme stiamo creando un futuro più luminoso per i nostri clienti, la nostra gente e il nostro pianeta.

Con oltre 55.000 dipendenti in più di 170 paesi, sentirete il supporto di essere parte di una società forte e stabile che sono un giocatore di lunga data nel settore assicurativo.

Abbiamo fatto una promessa l’uno all’altro e ogni dipendente; per concentrarsi sull’impatto sostenibile, per prendersi cura del benessere degli altri, per utilizzare le nostre diverse competenze per essere curiosi e ottimisti e per sviluppare le competenze necessarie per il nostro futuro.

Se sei interessato a lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante per un'azienda che riconosce e premia la tua creatività, iniziative e contributi - allora Zurigo potrebbe essere il posto giusto per te. Fai parte di qualcosa di grande.

La nostra cultura:

A Zurigo, il nostro senso di comunità è forte e siamo particolarmente appassionati di diversità e inclusione, per cui abbiamo vinto numerosi premi. Vogliamo che il nostro popolo porti tutto il loro lavoro e assicuri che tutti siano accolti, indipendentemente dal loro background, dalle loro convinzioni o dalla loro cultura. Vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti riflettano la diversità dei nostri clienti, e così si impegnano a trattare tutti i nostri candidati in modo equo e rispettoso, indipendentemente dal loro reale o presunto background, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta.

Abbiamo un ambiente che pone una reale importanza sul benessere della nostra gente da una prospettiva fisica, mentale, sociale e finanziaria. Lavoriamo con i nostri partner di benessere e gli esperti del settore per fornire i migliori consigli e l'accesso a una ricchezza di supporto allo stile di vita. Siamo anche impegnati a un miglioramento continuo, e offriamo l'accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.

Siamo appassionati di sostenere i dipendenti per aiutare gli altri, coinvolgendoci nell’attività di volontariato, caritativa e comunitaria. Il nostro braccio caritativo, Zurich Community Trust, è uno dei più consolidati trust aziendali nel Regno Unito. In quel periodo, abbiamo concesso borse di studio e tempo di volontariato per meritare cause nel Regno Unito valutato a oltre 90 milioni di sterline.

Ci piacerebbe se si poteva presentare la vostra applicazione online. Se avete bisogno di un metodo alternativo di applicazione, si prega di inviare una email a recruit@uk.zurich.com

Quindi fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Siate sostenuti, Amate quello che fate. Lavora per noi. #LI-Hybrid #

Senior Development Underwriter - Mid-Market Retail Insurance

Arbeitszeit: Diese Rolle ist auf Teilzeit-, Job-Share- oder Vollzeitbasis verfügbar

Gehalt: Wettbewerbspaket + Firmenwagen

Standort: North West (Greater Manchester, Liverpool, Cheshire, North Lancs)

Die Gelegenheit:

Sind Sie ein versierter Underwriter mit einer Leidenschaft für Marktwachstum und strategische Führung? Gedeihen Sie davon, den Markt zu beeinflussen, neue Möglichkeiten zu erschließen und Portfolios zu gestalten? In Zürich freuen wir uns, eine neu geschaffene Position als Senior Development Underwriter bekannt zu geben, die die Möglichkeit bietet, unsere neue Geschäftsstrategie zu unterstützen und eine führende Rolle bei der Stärkung unserer Position im mittelständischen Einzelhandelsversicherungssektor zu spielen.

Als Senior Development Underwriter werden Sie die Wachstumsagenda von Zurich in unseren mittelständischen Retail-Portfolios vorantreiben. Dies ist eine neue und sehr sichtbare Rolle, die die Geschäftsentwicklung beschleunigen und strategische Auswirkungen erzielen soll. Sie kombinieren fundiertes technisches Fachwissen mit kommerziellem Scharfsinn und führen die Entstehung, Verhandlung und Übernahme komplexer Risiken. Ihre Fähigkeit, Beziehungen zu Brokern, Kunden und Marktbeeinflussern aufzubauen, ist der Schlüssel zum Wachstum des Geschäfts und des Rufs von Zurich.

Viele unserer Mitarbeiter arbeiten flexibel auf verschiedene Arten, darunter Teilzeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Jobsharing, ein Element der Arbeit von zu Hause aus oder komprimierte Arbeitszeiten. Das liegt daran, dass wir die besten leute für unsere rollen wollen, und wir erkennen, dass diese leute manchmal nicht vollzeit verfügbar sind. Bitte sprechen Sie mit uns im Interview über die Flexibilität, die Sie möglicherweise benötigen.

Was werden Sie tun?

- Strategisches Wachstum vorantreiben: Führen Sie die Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Umwandlung hochwertiger mittelständischer Retail-Versicherungsmöglichkeiten und positionieren Sie Zurich als Underwriter Ihrer Wahl.

- Marktführerschaft: Aufbau und Nutzung leitender Beziehungen zu Brokern, Kunden und Branchenakteuren, um Neugeschäfte zu sichern und die Präsenz von Zurich in den Zielmärkten zu verbessern.

- Expert Underwriting: Übernahme komplexer, hochwertiger Risiken - Bereitstellung von Expertenanalysen, maßgeschneiderten Lösungen und profitablen Entscheidungen.

- Insight-geführte Strategie: Überwachung, Interpretation und Reaktion auf Markttrends, Wettbewerberaktivitäten und regulatorische Veränderungen - informiert über die Entwicklung marktführender Vorschläge.

- Mentoring und Zusammenarbeit: Coachen und unterstützen Sie regionale Teams, teilen Sie Fachwissen und fördern Sie eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um den kommerziellen Erfolg voranzutreiben.

Worauf warten wir?

- Bedeutende Erfahrung im mittelständischen Retail-Versicherungsgeschäft mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz bei der Geschäftsentwicklung und dem Portfoliowachstum.

- Fortgeschrittene technische und analytische Fähigkeiten - zuversichtlich bei der Bewertung und Strukturierung komplexer Risiken.

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, sich mit leitenden Brokern, Kunden und internen Stakeholdern zu engagieren, zu beeinflussen und zu verhandeln.

- Ein strategischer, kaufmännischer Ansatz mit Fokus auf Innovation und Geschäftsergebnisse.

- Erfahrung in der Betreuung anderer oder der Leitung der Teamentwicklung ist sehr wünschenswert.

Als inklusiver Arbeitgeber möchten wir sicherstellen, dass sich alle Kandidaten wohl fühlen und während des Interviews ihre besten Leistungen erbringen können. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, uns jede angemessene Anpassung oder praktische Unterstützung mitzuteilen, die bei Ihrer Bewerbung erforderlich ist.

Was bekommen Sie im Gegenzug?

Jeder ist anders. Deshalb bieten wir in Zürich ein breites Spektrum an Mitarbeiterleistungen, damit unsere Mitarbeiter wählen können, was zu ihnen und ihrem Leben passt. Unsere Vorteile bieten echte Flexibilität, damit unsere Mitarbeiter überlegte Entscheidungen treffen und ihre Vorteile das ganze Jahr über anpassen können. Unsere Leistungen umfassen 12% beitragsunabhängige Altersvorsorge, jährlichen Unternehmensbonus, private Krankenversicherung und die Option, bis zu 20 Tage mehr zu kaufen oder einen Teil Ihres Urlaubs zu verkaufen.

Weitere Informationen zu unseren Leistungen - Mitarbeiterleistungen | Arbeiten bei Zurich Insurance UK

Wer wir sind:

Bei Zurich streben wir danach, eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt und der beste globale Versicherer zu sein. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden, unsere Menschen und unseren Planeten.

Mit über 55.000 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 170 Ländern werden Sie die Unterstützung spüren, Teil eines starken und stabilen Unternehmens zu sein, das ein langjähriger Akteur in der Versicherungsbranche ist.

Wir haben uns gegenseitig und jedem Mitarbeiter ein Versprechen gegeben, uns auf nachhaltige Auswirkungen zu konzentrieren, uns um das Wohlergehen des anderen zu kümmern, unser vielfältiges Fachwissen zu nutzen, um neugierig und optimistisch zu sein und die Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die für unsere Zukunft erforderlich sind.

Wenn Sie daran interessiert sind, in einem dynamischen und herausfordernden Umfeld für ein Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das Ihre Kreativität, Initiativen und Beiträge anerkennt und belohnt - dann könnte Zürich genau der richtige Ort für Sie sein. Sei Teil von etwas Großem.

Unsere Kultur:

Bei Zürich ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl stark und wir sind besonders leidenschaftlich für Vielfalt und Inklusion, für die wir zahlreiche Auszeichnungen erhalten haben. Wir wollen, dass unsere Leute sich ganz an die Arbeit machen und sicherstellen, dass sich jeder willkommen fühlt, unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund, Glauben oder seiner Kultur. Wir möchten, dass unsere Mitarbeiter die Vielfalt unserer Kunden widerspiegeln, und sind daher verpflichtet, alle unsere Bewerber fair und respektvoll zu behandeln, unabhängig von ihrem tatsächlichen oder angenommenen Hintergrund, Behinderung oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen.

Wir haben ein Umfeld, das dem Wohlbefinden unserer Menschen aus körperlicher, geistiger, sozialer und finanzieller Sicht einen echten Stellenwert einräumt. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Wohlfühlpartnern und Branchenexperten zusammen, um die beste Beratung und den Zugang zu einer Fülle von Lifestyle-Unterstützung zu bieten. Wir sind auch der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung verpflichtet und bieten Zugang zu einer umfassenden Palette von Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Mitarbeiter dabei zu unterstützen, anderen zu helfen, indem wir uns in Freiwilligenarbeit, gemeinnützigen und gemeinschaftlichen Aktivitäten engagieren. Unser gemeinnütziger Arm, Zurich Community Trust, ist einer der am längsten etablierten Corporate Trusts in Großbritannien. In dieser Zeit haben wir Zuschüsse und freiwillige Zeit für verdienstvolle Zwecke in Großbritannien im Wert von über 90 Millionen Pfund vergeben.

Wir würden es lieben, wenn sie ihre bewerbung online einreichen könnten. Wenn Sie eine alternative Bewerbungsmethode benötigen, senden Sie bitte eine E-Mail an recruiting@uk.zurich.com

Machen Sie also einen Unterschied. Werden Sie herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Sei unterstützt, liebe, was du tust. Arbeitet für uns. #LI-Hybrid

Salaire: Forfait compétitif + voiture d'entreprise

Lieu: North West basé (Grand Manchester, Liverpool, Cheshire, North Lancs)

L'occasion :

Êtes-vous un souscripteur accompli avec une passion pour la croissance du marché et le leadership stratégique? Proliférez-vous en influençant le marché, en ouvrant de nouvelles possibilités et en formant des portefeuilles? À Zurich, nous sommes heureux d'annoncer un nouveau poste de Senior Development Underwriter, qui offre l'occasion de défendre notre nouvelle stratégie commerciale et de jouer un rôle de premier plan dans le renforcement de notre position dans le secteur de l'assurance de détail.

En tant que Senior Development Underwriter, vous piloterez le programme de croissance de Zurich dans nos portefeuilles de vente au détail à mi-marché. Il s'agit d'un rôle nouveau et très visible, conçu pour accélérer le développement des entreprises et produire un impact stratégique. Vous alliez une expertise technique profonde à un sens commercial, menant l'origine, la négociation et la souscription de risques complexes. Votre capacité à développer des relations avec les courtiers, les clients et les influenceurs du marché sera la clé de la croissance des affaires et de la réputation de Zurich.

Beaucoup de nos employés travaillent avec souplesse de diverses façons, y compris à temps partiel, des heures flexibles, des parts de travail, un élément de travail à domicile ou des heures comprimées. C'est parce que nous voulons les meilleures personnes pour nos rôles, et nous reconnaissons que parfois ces personnes ne sont pas disponibles à temps plein. Veuillez nous parler à l'entrevue de la flexibilité dont vous pourriez avoir besoin.

Que ferez-vous ?

- Diriger la croissance stratégique : Diriger l'identification, le développement et la conversion des opportunités d'assurance de détail de grande valeur, positionner Zurich comme un souscripteur de choix.

- Leadership du marché : Établir et exploiter des relations de haut niveau avec les courtiers, les clients et les intervenants de l'industrie afin d'assurer de nouvelles affaires et d'améliorer la présence de Zurich dans les marchés cibles.

- La souscription d'experts : prendre en charge les risques complexes et de grande valeur – fournir une analyse d'experts, des solutions sur mesure et une prise de décision rentable.

- Stratégie axée sur les connaissances : Surveiller, interpréter et réagir aux tendances du marché, à l'activité des concurrents et aux changements réglementaires, afin d'orienter l'élaboration de propositions de pointe.

- Mentoring et collaboration: Coach et soutenir les équipes régionales, partager des connaissances spécialisées, et favoriser une culture de collaboration et d'amélioration continue pour stimuler le succès commercial.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

- Expérience importante de la souscription d'assurances de détail en milieu de marché, avec une solide expérience du développement des entreprises et de la croissance du portefeuille.

- Compétences techniques et analytiques avancées — Confiance dans l'évaluation et la structuration des risques complexes.

- Capacité éprouvée d'engager, d'influencer et de négocier avec des courtiers chevronnés, des clients et des intervenants internes.

- Une approche stratégique et commerciale, axée sur l'innovation et les résultats commerciaux.

- L'expérience du mentorat d'autres personnes ou du développement d'équipes est hautement souhaitable.

En tant qu'employeur inclusif, nous voulons nous assurer que tous les candidats et candidates se sentent à l'aise et qu'ils sont en mesure de s'acquitter au mieux de leurs fonctions pendant l'entrevue. Vous aurez l'occasion de nous faire part de tout ajustement raisonnable ou soutien pratique nécessaire lorsque vous postulerez.

Qu'obtiendras-tu en retour ?

Tout le monde est différent. C'est pourquoi à Zurich, nous offrons un large éventail d'avantages sociaux afin que nos gens puissent choisir ce qui leur convient et leur vie. Nos avantages offrent une réelle flexibilité afin que nos employés puissent faire des choix réfléchis et adapter leurs avantages tout au long de l'année. Nos prestations comprennent un régime de retraite non contributif défini de 12%, une prime annuelle d'entreprise, une assurance médicale privée et l'option d'acheter jusqu'à 20 jours supplémentaires ou de vendre une partie de vos vacances.

Suivez le lien pour plus d'informations sur nos avantages sociaux - Avantages sociaux

Qui nous sommes :

À Zurich, nous souhaitons être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes au monde et le meilleur assureur mondial. Ensemble, nous créons un avenir meilleur pour nos clients, nos gens et notre planète.

Avec plus de 55 000 employés dans plus de 170 pays, vous ressentirez le soutien d'une entreprise forte et stable qui est un acteur de longue date dans le secteur de l'assurance.

Nous avons fait une promesse l'un envers l'autre et envers chaque employé; de nous concentrer sur l'impact durable, de nous soucier de notre bien-être, d'utiliser notre expertise diversifiée pour être curieux et optimiste et de développer les compétences nécessaires à notre avenir.

Si vous êtes intéressé à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant pour une entreprise qui reconnaît et récompense votre créativité, vos initiatives et vos contributions, Zurich pourrait être l'endroit idéal pour vous. Faites partie de quelque chose de génial.

Notre culture :

À Zurich, notre sens de la communauté est fort et nous sommes particulièrement passionnés par la diversité et l'inclusion, pour lesquelles nous avons remporté de nombreux prix. Nous voulons que notre peuple apporte l'ensemble d'eux-mêmes au travail et nous veillons à ce que tout le monde se sente accueilli, quels que soient son origine, ses croyances ou sa culture. Nous voulons que nos employés reflètent la diversité de nos clients, et nous nous engageons donc à traiter tous nos candidats avec équité et respect, indépendamment de leurs antécédents réels ou supposés, de leur handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée.

Nous avons un environnement qui accorde une réelle importance au bien-être de notre population dans une perspective physique, mentale, sociale et financière. Nous travaillons avec nos partenaires bien-être et des experts de l'industrie pour fournir les meilleurs conseils et l'accès à une multitude de soutien de style de vie. Nous sommes également attachés à l'amélioration continue, et nous offrons l'accès à une gamme complète de possibilités de formation et de développement.

Nous sommes passionnés de soutenir les employés pour aider les autres en nous engageant dans des activités bénévoles, caritatives et communautaires. Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, est l'une des fiducies les plus anciennes au Royaume-Uni. À cette époque, nous avons accordé des subventions et du temps bénévole à des causes méritoires au Royaume-Uni, évaluées à plus de 90 millions de livres.

Nous aimerions que vous soumettiez votre candidature en ligne. Si vous avez besoin d'une autre méthode de candidature, veuillez envoyer un courriel à recrutement@uk.zurich.com

Alors faites une différence. Soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Soyez soutenu, aimez ce que vous faites. Travaille pour nous. #LI-Hybrid

- Accès à l'assurance médicale privée.

Nous faisons une différence

- Créer un avenir plus radieux et plus durable sous-tend tout ce que nous faisons ici à Zurich. Nous avons été le premier assureur à signer l'engagement « UN Business Ambition » pour 1,5 C.

- Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, a accordé des subventions et du temps bénévole à des causes méritantes au Royaume-Uni d'une valeur de plus de 90 millions de livres.

jobs.title: Chief Trial Attorney
jobs.description:
At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location including the ability to work from a home office, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report to our Irvine CA Office once per week.

Zurich North America is hiring a Chief General Liability Attorney to join our team!

With minimal direction, The Chief Trial General Liability Attorney will represent the Company's insureds in all phases of litigation for matters of the highest technical complexity and engage in the practice of and the representation of Zurich insureds in litigation to protect their interests.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Achieving best outcomes for clients by demonstrating a high level of technical expertise in case handling, trial preparation and presentation for cases of the highest level of complexity.

- Driving positive results by correctly applying the law and legal trends, conducting legal analysis and research, preparing legal pleadings and documents, preparing for and managing pre-trial discovery, and participating in judicial or administrative hearings and trials.

- Documenting case files by accurately capturing and updating relevant information in compliance with best practices.

- Working to have a timely resolution to matters by collaborating with the claims adjuster, developing a case strategy and escalating issues as appropriate.

- Ensuring customer service to clients by proactively communicating information; responding to inquiries; and following customer protocols.

- Determining and implementing alternative dispute resolution techniques as appropriate, by using effective mediation and negotiation skills within authority limits.

- Maintaining professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies.

- Contributing to the team effort by accomplishing related results and collaborating on matters as needed.

- Serving as a technical resource by providing guidance, and/or mentoring to lower-level attorneys on legal strategies and use of tools and resources.

- Identifying and suggesting improvement to tools and resources to contribute to continuous improvements and operational efficiencies.

- Ensuring legal compliance by following state and federal laws and regulations.

- Protecting Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential.

Basic Qualifications include:

- Juris Doctor and 10 or more years of experience in the Litigation area

- Extensive experience handling complex liability litigation, including trials, arbitrations, and mediations

- Strong record of successful jury trial outcomes, preferably in insurance defense or liability matters
AND

- Member of the California Bar in good standing

- Experience with Microsoft Office suite and Adobe

- Experience with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

- Knowledge of the law and procedure

Preferred Qualifications include:

- Effective communication skills

- Effective information technology skills

- Strong negotiation skills

- Experience working in a team-based environment

- Strong collaboration skills

- Effective problem solving and analytical skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The proposed Salary range for this position is $200,000 to $225,000 , with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Zurigo North America Claims riconosciamo che l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e la flessibilità sono una priorità quando si tratta di scegliere la tua prossima mossa di carriera. Progettato con le esigenze dei nostri dipendenti, il modello di lavoro ibrido ZNA Claims sottolinea la flessibilità, consentendo ai dipendenti di rivendicare il lavoro individuale nella loro posizione preferita, compresa la capacità di lavorare da un ufficio domestico, facilitando le connessioni in-persone e le attività collaborative quando significativo e prezioso. Mentre il modello fornisce un alto livello di flessibilità e autonomia, dovrebbero essere previste circostanze occasionali che richiedono la presenza in ufficio. Il candidato selezionato per questa opportunità dovrebbe essere in grado di riferire al nostro Ufficio CA Irvine una volta alla settimana.

Zurigo Nord America sta assumendo un Procuratore Generale di Responsabilità per unirsi alla nostra squadra!

Con una direzione minima, il Chief Trial General Liability Attorney rappresenterà le assicurazioni della Società in tutte le fasi del contenzioso per questioni di massima complessità tecnica e si impegna nella pratica e nella rappresentanza delle assicurazioni di Zurigo in contenzioso per proteggere i loro interessi.

In questo ruolo sarete responsabili di:

- Ottenere i migliori risultati per i clienti dimostrando un alto livello di competenze tecniche nel caso di gestione, preparazione di prova e presentazione per i casi del più alto livello di complessità.

- Guidare risultati positivi applicando correttamente la legge e le tendenze legali, conducendo l'analisi legale e la ricerca, preparando pieghe legali e documenti, preparando e gestendo la scoperta pre-triale, e partecipando a udienze e prove giudiziarie o amministrative.

- Documentazione dei file dei casi catturando e aggiornando le informazioni pertinenti in conformità alle best practice.

- Lavorare per avere una risoluzione tempestiva per le questioni collaborando con l'adattatore dei reclami, sviluppando una strategia di caso e intensificando i problemi come appropriato.

- Garantire il servizio clienti ai clienti comunicando in modo proattivo le informazioni; rispondere alle richieste; e seguendo i protocolli del cliente.

- Determinazione e attuazione di tecniche alternative di risoluzione delle controversie, utilizzando competenze di mediazione e negoziazione efficaci entro limiti di autorità.

- Mantenere la conoscenza professionale e tecnica partecipando alle opportunità educative, mantenendo corrente con le tendenze del settore, stabilendo reti personali e partecipando alle società professionali.

- Contribuire allo sforzo di squadra realizzando risultati correlati e collaborando su questioni come necessario.

- Servire come risorsa tecnica fornendo indicazioni e/o mentoring a avvocati di livello inferiore sulle strategie legali e l'uso di strumenti e risorse.

- Identificare e suggerire il miglioramento degli strumenti e delle risorse per contribuire a miglioramenti continui ed efficienza operativa.

- Garantire la conformità legale seguendo leggi e regolamenti statali e federali.

- Proteggere la reputazione di Zurigo mantenendo le informazioni riservate.

Le qualifiche di base includono:

- Juris Doctor e 10 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di Litigation

- Ampia esperienza di gestione contenzioso di responsabilità complessa, tra cui prove, arbitrati e mediazioni

- Forte record di risultati di prova della giuria di successo, preferibilmente in materia di difesa dell'assicurazione o responsabilità
E

- Membro del California Bar in buona posizione

- Esperienza con Microsoft Office suite e Adobe

- Esperienza con Lexis o Westlaw

- Conoscenza del settore assicurativo, crediti e il contenzioso di difesa dell'assicurazione ambiente legale

- Conoscenza della legge e della procedura

Le qualifiche previste includono:

- Capacità di comunicazione efficaci

- Efficace capacità tecnologiche dell'informazione

- Forte capacità di negoziazione

- Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente basato su team

- Forte capacità di collaborazione

- Efficace problem solving e competenze analitiche

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi. La gamma Salary proposta per questa posizione è di $175,000 - $210,000, con l'ammissibilità bonus a breve termine impostata al 20%.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo in Nord America non discrimina in base a razza, etnia, colore, religione, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, identità di genere, informazioni genetiche, età, disabilità, stato veterano protetto, stato civile, orientamento sessuale, gravidanza o altre caratteristiche protette dalla legge applicabile. Pari opportunità Disabilità del datore di lavoro/vet.

Zurigo è conforme al codice 18 degli Stati Uniti § 1033.

Bei Zurich North America Claims erkennen wir an, dass Work-Life-Balance und Flexibilität eine Priorität bei der Auswahl Ihres nächsten Karriereschritts sind. Entwickelt mit Blick auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeiter betont das hybride Arbeitsmodell von ZNA Claims Flexibilität und ermöglicht es den Mitarbeitern, individuelle Arbeiten an ihrem bevorzugten Standort durchzuführen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten, während persönliche Verbindungen und kollaborative Aktivitäten erleichtert werden, wenn sie sinnvoll und wertvoll sind. Während das Modell ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität und Autonomie bietet, sollten gelegentliche Umstände erwartet werden, die eine Anwesenheit im Büro erfordern. Der für diese Gelegenheit ausgewählte Kandidat sollte sich einmal pro Woche an unser Irvine CA Office melden können.

Zurich North America stellt einen Chief General Liability Attorney ein, um sich unserem Team anzuschließen!

Mit minimaler Regie wird der Chief Trial General Liability Attorney die Versicherten des Unternehmens in allen Prozessphasen für Angelegenheiten höchster technischer Komplexität vertreten und sich in der Praxis und Vertretung der Zürcher Versicherten in Rechtsstreitigkeiten engagieren, um ihre Interessen zu schützen.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

- Das Erreichen der besten Ergebnisse für Kunden durch den Nachweis eines hohen Niveaus an technischer Expertise in der Fallbearbeitung, der Vorbereitung und Präsentation von Studien für Fälle mit höchster Komplexität.

- Förderung positiver Ergebnisse durch die korrekte Anwendung des Gesetzes und der rechtlichen Trends, die Durchführung von Rechtsanalysen und -recherchen, die Vorbereitung von Rechtsplädoyers und Dokumenten, die Vorbereitung und Verwaltung der vorgerichtlichen Entdeckung und die Teilnahme an gerichtlichen oder administrativen Anhörungen und Gerichtsverfahren.

- Dokumentation von Fallakten durch genaue Erfassung und Aktualisierung relevanter Informationen in Übereinstimmung mit bewährten Verfahren.

- Arbeiten, um eine rechtzeitige Lösung zu haben, indem Sie mit dem Schadensregulierer zusammenarbeiten, eine Fallstrategie entwickeln und Probleme gegebenenfalls eskalieren.

- Sicherstellung des Kundendienstes für Kunden durch proaktive Kommunikation von Informationen, Beantwortung von Anfragen und Befolgen von Kundenprotokollen.

- Festlegung und Umsetzung alternativer Streitbeilegungstechniken, gegebenenfalls unter Einsatz wirksamer Mediations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten innerhalb der Zuständigkeitsgrenzen.

- Pflege von fachlichem und technischem Wissen durch Teilnahme an Bildungsmöglichkeiten, Bleiben auf dem neuesten Stand der Branchentrends, Aufbau persönlicher Netzwerke und Teilnahme an Fachgesellschaften.

- Beitrag zur Teamarbeit durch Erreichung der damit verbundenen Ergebnisse und Zusammenarbeit bei Bedarf.

- Als technische Ressource dienen, indem sie Beratung und / oder Mentoring für Anwälte auf niedrigerer Ebene über rechtliche Strategien und den Einsatz von Tools und Ressourcen bietet.

- Identifizierung und Verbesserung von Tools und Ressourcen, um zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen und betrieblicher Effizienz beizutragen.

- Gewährleistung der rechtlichen einhaltung durch befolgung von bundes- und bundesgesetzen und vorschriften.

- Schutz der Reputation von Zurich durch Geheimhaltung der Schadensinformationen.

Grundqualifikationen umfassen:

- Juris Doctor und 10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Litigation

- Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Haftungsstreitigkeiten, einschließlich Gerichtsverfahren, Schiedsverfahren und Mediationen

- Starke Bilanz erfolgreicher Jury-Studienergebnisse, vorzugsweise in Versicherungsschutz- oder Haftungsfragen
UND

- Mitglied der California Bar in gutem Ansehen

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office Suite und Adobe

- Erfahrungen mit Lexis oder Westlaw

- Kenntnisse der Versicherungsbranche, Forderungen und des rechtlichen Umfelds für Versicherungsschutzstreitigkeiten

- Kenntnis des Rechts und des Verfahrens

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen umfassen:

- Wirksame Kommunikationsfähigkeit

- Effektive informationstechnische Fähigkeiten

- Starke Verhandlungsfähigkeit

- Erfahrung in einer teambasierten Umgebung

- Starke Zusammenarbeitsfähigkeit

Le candidat choisi pour cette occasion devrait pouvoir se présenter une fois par semaine à notre bureau de l'AC Irvine.

Zurich Amérique du Nord recrute un procureur général responsable pour rejoindre notre équipe!

Avec une direction minimale, le Procureur général en chef de la responsabilité représentera les assurés de la Société dans toutes les phases de litige pour les questions de la plus haute complexité technique et s'engagera dans la pratique et la représentation des assurés de Zurich dans le litige pour protéger leurs intérêts.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable:

- Réaliser les meilleurs résultats pour les clients en démontrant un haut niveau d'expertise technique dans le traitement des cas, la préparation des procès et la présentation des cas les plus complexes.

- Conduire des résultats positifs en appliquant correctement la loi et les tendances juridiques, en menant des analyses et des recherches juridiques, en préparant des plaidoiries et des documents juridiques, en préparant et en gérant la découverte avant le procès et en participant aux audiences et aux procès judiciaires ou administratifs.

- Documenter les dossiers en saisissant et en mettant à jour avec précision les renseignements pertinents conformément aux pratiques exemplaires.

- S'efforcer de régler les questions en temps opportun en collaborant avec l'expert en sinistres, en élaborant une stratégie de cas et en accroissant les problèmes au besoin.

- Assurer le service à la clientèle en communiquant de façon proactive de l'information, en répondant aux demandes de renseignements et en suivant les protocoles des clients.

- Déterminer et mettre en oeuvre d'autres techniques de règlement des différends, s'il y a lieu, en utilisant des compétences de médiation et de négociation efficaces dans les limites de l'autorité.

- Maintenir les connaissances professionnelles et techniques en participant à des activités éducatives, en suivant les tendances de l'industrie, en établissant des réseaux personnels et en participant à des sociétés professionnelles.

- Contribuer à l'effort de l'équipe en obtenant des résultats connexes et en collaborant sur des questions au besoin.

- Servir de ressource technique en fournissant aux avocats subalternes des conseils sur les stratégies juridiques et l'utilisation des outils et des ressources.

- Identifier et suggérer des améliorations aux outils et aux ressources afin de contribuer à des améliorations continues et à des gains d'efficacité opérationnelle.

- Assurer le respect de la législation en suivant les lois et règlements des États et fédéraux.

- Protéger la réputation de Zurich en maintenant les renseignements sur les réclamations confidentiels.

Les qualifications de base comprennent :

- Juris Doctor et 10 ans ou plus d'expérience en litige

- Expérience approfondie en matière de litiges complexes en matière de responsabilité, y compris les procès, les arbitrages et les médiations

- Forte expérience des résultats des procès du jury, de préférence en matière de défense ou de responsabilité en matière d'assurance
PAYS

- Membre en règle du California Bar

- Expérience avec Microsoft Office suite et Adobe

- Expérience avec Lexis ou Westlaw

- Connaissance de l'industrie de l'assurance, des réclamations et de l'environnement juridique de la défense de l'assurance

- Connaissance du droit et de la procédure

Les qualités préférées comprennent :

- Compétences de communication efficaces

- Compétences informatiques efficaces

- Compétences solides en matière de négociation

- Expérience de travail en équipe

- Compétences solides en matière de collaboration

- Compétences efficaces en résolution de problèmes et en analyse

Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. L'échelle salariale proposée pour ce poste est de 175 000 $ - 210 000 $, et l'admissibilité aux primes incitatives à court terme est fixée à 20 %.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

jobs.description:
At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location including the ability to work from a home office, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report to our Irvine CA Office once per week.

Zurich North America is seeking a successful Liability Trial Attorney.

If you are ready for a career move, consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers an excellent work/life balance, reasonable billable hours, including an incentive plan, 401K match, flexible work options, summer hours and a great culture.

The selected candidate will perform duties encompassing all aspects of insurance defense, including initial investigation and legal analysis and advice, preparing and filing legal pleadings and documents, performing legal research, preparing for and conducting pre-trial discovery, preparing for and aggressively handling hearings and trials, and conducting post-trial activities where appropriate. We are looking for demonstrated case analysis ability, a track record of proven trial and settlement skills and the ability to work independently without substantial supervision.

Additional responsibilities will include:

- Achieve best outcomes for clients by demonstrating a high level of technical excellence in case handling, trial preparation and presentation for matters of moderate to high complexity

- Drive positive outcomes by correctly applying the law and legal trends, conducting legal analysis and research, preparing legal pleadings and documents, preparing for and managing pre-trial discovery, and participating in judicial or administrative hearings and trials

- Document case files by accurately capturing and updating relevant information in compliance with best practices

- Work to have a timely resolution to matters by collaborating with the claims adjuster, developing a case strategy and escalating issues as appropriate

- Ensure customer service to clients by proactively communicating information; responding to inquiries; and following customer protocols

- Determine and implement alternative dispute resolution techniques as appropriate, by using effective mediation and negotiation skills within authority limit

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies

- Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and collaborating on matters as needed

- Serve as a technical resource by providing guidance and/or mentoring lower level attorneys on legal strategies and use of tools and resources

- Ensure legal compliance by following state and federal laws and regulations

- Protect Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 5 or more years of experience in the Litigation area
AND

- Member in good standing of the California State Bar Association

- Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe

- Experience working with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

- Knowledge of the law and procedure

Preferred Qualifications:

- Effective communication skills

- Effective negotiation skills

- Experience working in a team-based environment

- Collaboration skills

- Effective problem solving and analytical skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $150,000.00 - $190,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Bei Zurich North America Claims erkennen wir an, dass Work-Life-Balance und Flexibilität eine Priorität bei der Auswahl Ihres nächsten Karriereschritts sind. Entwickelt mit Blick auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeiter betont das hybride Arbeitsmodell von ZNA Claims Flexibilität und ermöglicht es den Mitarbeitern, individuelle Arbeiten an ihrem bevorzugten Standort durchzuführen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten, während persönliche Verbindungen und kollaborative Aktivitäten erleichtert werden, wenn sie sinnvoll und wertvoll sind. Während das Modell ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität und Autonomie bietet, sollten gelegentliche Umstände erwartet werden, die eine Anwesenheit im Büro erfordern. Der für diese Gelegenheit ausgewählte Kandidat sollte sich einmal pro Woche an unser Irvine CA Office melden können.

Zurich North America sucht einen erfolgreichen Liability Trial Attorney.

Wenn Sie bereit für einen Karrierewechsel sind, sollten Sie für ein Unternehmen mit einer globalen Präsenz arbeiten, die eine ausgezeichnete Work-Life-Balance, angemessene abrechenbare Stunden, einschließlich eines Incentive-Plans, 401K-Match, flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, Sommerstunden und eine großartige Kultur bietet.

Der ausgewählte Kandidat wird Aufgaben wahrnehmen, die alle Aspekte der Versicherungsverteidigung umfassen, einschließlich der Erstuntersuchung und der rechtlichen Analyse und Beratung, der Vorbereitung und Einreichung von Rechtsplädoyers und Dokumenten, der Durchführung von Rechtsrecherchen, der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von vorgerichtlichen Ermittlungen, der Vorbereitung und aggressiven Behandlung von Anhörungen und Gerichtsverfahren und gegebenenfalls der Durchführung von Aktivitäten nach dem Verfahren. Wir suchen nach nachgewiesenen fallanalysefähigkeiten, einer erfolgsbilanz von nachgewiesenen prozess- und siedlungsfähigkeiten und der fähigkeit, unabhängig ohne wesentliche aufsicht zu arbeiten.

Zusätzliche Verantwortlichkeiten umfassen:

- Erreichen Sie die besten Ergebnisse für Kunden, indem Sie ein hohes Maß an technischer Exzellenz in der Fallbearbeitung, Testvorbereitung und Präsentation für Angelegenheiten von mittlerer bis hoher Komplexität nachweisen

- Fördern Sie positive Ergebnisse durch die korrekte Anwendung des Gesetzes und der rechtlichen Trends, die Durchführung von Rechtsanalysen und -recherchen, die Vorbereitung von Rechtsplädoyers und Dokumenten, die Vorbereitung und Verwaltung der vorgerichtlichen Entdeckung und die Teilnahme an gerichtlichen oder administrativen Anhörungen und Gerichtsverfahren

- Fallakten dokumentieren, indem relevante Informationen in Übereinstimmung mit bewährten Verfahren genau erfasst und aktualisiert werden

- Arbeiten Sie daran, Angelegenheiten rechtzeitig zu lösen, indem Sie mit dem Schadensregulierer zusammenarbeiten, eine Fallstrategie entwickeln und Probleme nach Bedarf eskalieren

- Sicherstellen des Kundendienstes für Kunden durch proaktive Kommunikation von Informationen, Beantwortung von Anfragen und Befolgen von Kundenprotokollen

jobs.description:
Over the past five years, Zurich North America has built a world-class Middle Market operation that serves key industries across the U.S. We strive to assemble a team of dedicated Middle Market leaders and underwriters who understand this space very deeply and who grasp the unique challenges of the various industry segments and the individual customers we serve. We are looking to add to our team in Chicago, IL.

While this position is based out of the Chicago office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents.

In this role, you will serve as a customer advocate with a focus on improving customer experience by understanding their unique risks and offering the best end-to-end solution for their Property & Casualty insurance needs.

What you can expect in a Market Facing, Middle Market Underwriting position at Zurich:

- You will develop and maintain relationships with broker partners and customers across all industries in support of business objectives.

- You will leverage your Property and Casualty underwriting acumen across risk assessment, exposure evaluation and pricing to generate and maintain a profitable book of new and renewal business.

- You will work collaboratively across business units including but not limited to; claims, finance, risk engineering, actuary, and technical underwriting while gaining extensive knowledge in a growing and innovative industry.

- You will be empowered to use your technical underwriting, negotiation and interpersonal skills to grow and develop relationships with preferred distribution partners in an assigned territory.

This role will be filled at either the Executive Underwriter or AVP Underwriting Director level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Executive Underwriter Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

OR

AVP, Underwriting Director Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- Experience handling all lines of business in the Middle Market space (Auto, GL, Workers Compensation, Umbrella, Inland Marine and Property)

- Broker relationships in the Chicago Market

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Microsoft Office proficiency

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $110,200.00 - $238,700.00. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $110,200.00 - $180,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15 %. The proposed salary range for the AVP Underwriting Director is $145,800.00 - $238,700.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about helping customers become more resilient to climate risks and shaping Zurich’s global climate resilience agenda?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich’s dedicated commercial risk advisory business, working as a trusted advisor for Underwriting, insurance customers and independent advisory customers. We provide customers with services and solutions that help them understand, manage and reduce their risks – from climate and natural hazards to cyber, supply chain and other emerging risks. Climate resilience is a core pillar of our sustainability strategy and a key differentiator in our customer offering.

As Global Head of Climate Resilience, you will own ZRS’s global climate resilience advisory proposition and thought leadership. Together with the country leaders, you will drive the development of climate-related risk solutions and business development across markets. In this role, you will ensure Zurich maintains a leading position in climate resilience, working closely with colleagues across Sustainability, Underwriting, Risk Engineering and our local business units.

What you will do

- Own ZRS’s global climate resilience advisory proposition, ensuring it is relevant, differentiated and aligned with Zurich’s sustainability ambitions and customer needs.

- Lead Zurich’s thought leadership agenda on climate resilience, including external publications, customer engagements, conference participation and industry partnerships.

- Lead a team of technical Climate Resilience professionals who drive the development and enhancement of climate-related risk solutions (e.g. analytics, advisory services, tools and methodologies) that help customers understand and manage physical and transition climate risks.

- Oversee the customer-facing advisory teams that work across many of our countries and regions.

- Alongside the country leaders, drive the business development activity across markets by working with local ZRS and

- Commercial teams to embed climate resilience solutions into propositions, customer conversations and go to market strategies.

- Monitor market trends, regulatory developments and stakeholder expectations related to climate resilience, and translate insights into actionable initiatives and solution enhancements.

- Work with ZRS leaders and SMEs to develop concrete risk mitigation strategies for our customers across geographies and industries, and to develop integrated propositions that bring the best of ZRS cross-line of business capabilities to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with Sustainability, Group Risk, Underwriting, and other key stakeholders to integrate climate resilience into Zurich’s broader sustainability strategy and commercial offering.

- Explore partnership opportunities to enhance the service offering to customers.

- Provide strategic guidance and coaching to regional and local teams on climate resilience topics to build capabilities and ensure consistent delivery of our advisory proposition.

What you bring

- Several years of experience in climate risk, sustainability, risk advisory, consulting or a related field, ideally with exposure to clients from many sectors.

- Strong expertise in climate-related risks (physical and/or transition) and their implications for businesses, infrastructure and communities.

- Expertise in risk engineering and underwriting.

- Proven track record in developing and/or delivering advisory propositions, solutions or services in a complex, international environment.

- Track record of commercial success in building/growing a business.

- Ability to translate technical climate and risk concepts into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders and customers.

- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across functions and geographies.

- The ability to influence and lead in a global matrix structure.

- Strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capability – comfortable moving from concept development to practical implementation.

- Excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written); additional languages are an advantage.

- A growth-oriented, proactive and resilient mindset, with a genuine passion for sustainability and helping customers build climate resilience.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!
