jobs.title: Customer Assistance Coordinator
jobs.description:
Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.

About Travel Guard

This role is part of our Travel Guard team. Travel Guard is a leading travel insurance brand, serving millions of leisure and business travelers worldwide. Established in 1982 we offer a comprehensive portfolio of travel insurance solutions and global assistance services. Travel Guard operates service centres across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, ensuring 24/7 support to help travelers navigate unexpected circumstances that may disrupt their plans. Travel Guard became part of Zurich Cover-More in December 2024.

What you’ll be doing:

Our Medical Assistance Coordinators play a critical role in supporting travelers when they experience medical issues away from home. Whether it’s coordinating care, arranging prescriptions, or supporting medical travel, you’ll help ensure people get the right assistance at the right time. This is a fast-paced, people-focused role where calm communication, attention to detail, and empathy really matter. You’ll be trained to manage real-world medical assistance scenarios while working closely with medical professionals and global service partners.

- Take inbound calls from clients experiencing medical situations while traveling, ranging from minor concerns to urgent medical needs

- Provide calm, clear guidance and emotional reassurance to clients and their families during stressful and unfamiliar circumstances

- Coordinate medical services including doctor and facility referrals, prescription replacements, and medically related travel arrangements

- Liaise with medical professionals, hospitals, clinics, and global assistance partners to ensure appropriate care is arranged

- Apply critical thinking and sound judgement to assess situations and identify appropriate next steps within policy and operational guidelines

- Manage multiple cases at once, prioritising effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

- Accurately document case details, decisions, and client interactions in case management and policy systems

- Contribute to a consistently positive, professional and empathetic experience for every client, even in high-pressure situations

What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:

- High School Diploma or equivalent.

- Experience in customer service, call-centre, healthcare coordination, travel assistance, or another client-facing role.

- Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and compassionately.

- The ability to remain calm, empathetic, and professional when supporting people in distress.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with confidence documenting information accurately and thoroughly.

- The ability to multitask, prioritise competing demands, and follow established processes.

- Good problem-solving skills and the confidence to think through unfamiliar situations.

- A positive, flexible attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

- Medical terminology, healthcare exposure, or multilingual skills (highly regarded, but not required).

- Ability to work 6pm-4am with rotating weekends and holidays.

- Position includes a shift differential of $3/hour from 5pm-7am weeknights and all day on Saturday/Sunday and additional $3/hour Saturdays and Sundays between the hours of 7pm-7am

Why you’ll love working with us!

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travelers, at every step of their journey.

Job flexibility . We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

Career growth . This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

Take the time you need, for you and your community . We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

Investing in your health and your future. We offer a competitive high-deductible health plan, EAP programs and access to health and well-being activities along with 401(k) program with employer matching to help you plan for your future.

Diversity and inclusion . We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

Apply today and let’s go to great places together!

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers . Each year, we protect more than 20 million travelers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

Nearest Major Market: Wausau

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la tua carriera ti porterà dopo? Scopriamo insieme.

Informazioni su Travel Guard

Questo ruolo fa parte del nostro team di Travel Guard. Travel Guard è un marchio di assicurazione di viaggio leader, che serve milioni di turisti e viaggiatori d'affari in tutto il mondo. Fondata nel 1982 offriamo un portafoglio completo di soluzioni di assicurazione di viaggio e servizi di assistenza globale. Travel Guard opera centri di assistenza in Asia, Europa e America, assicurando un supporto 24/7 per aiutare i viaggiatori a navigare in circostanze inaspettate che potrebbero interrompere i loro piani. La Guardia di viaggio entrò a far parte di Zurigo Cover-More nel dicembre 2024.

Cosa farete:

I nostri Coordinatori di Assistenza Medica svolgono un ruolo fondamentale nel sostenere i viaggiatori quando si verificano problemi medici lontano da casa. Che si tratti di coordinare la cura, organizzare le prescrizioni, o sostenere i viaggi medici, vi aiuterà a garantire che le persone ottenere l'assistenza giusta al momento giusto. Questo è un ruolo veloce, focalizzato sulla gente in cui la comunicazione calma, l'attenzione ai dettagli, e l'empatia davvero la materia. Sarete addestrati a gestire scenari di assistenza medica nel mondo reale, mentre si lavora a stretto contatto con medici e partner di servizio globale.

- Prendere le chiamate in entrata dai clienti che vivono situazioni mediche durante il viaggio, che vanno dalle preoccupazioni minori alle esigenze mediche urgenti

- Fornire guida calma, chiara e rassicurazione emotiva ai clienti e alle loro famiglie durante circostanze stressanti e non familiari

- Coordinare i servizi medici, tra cui i referral medici e delle strutture, le sostituzioni delle prescrizioni e le modalità di viaggio medicalmente correlate

- Liaise con medici professionisti, ospedali, cliniche e partner di assistenza globale per garantire un'adeguata assistenza è organizzato

- Applicare il pensiero critico e il giudizio sonoro per valutare le situazioni e identificare i passi successivi appropriati all'interno di linee guida politiche e operative

- Gestisci più casi contemporaneamente, dando priorità in un ambiente dinamico e veloce

- Documentare con precisione i dettagli, le decisioni e le interazioni dei clienti nei sistemi di gestione dei casi e di policy

- Contribuisci ad un'esperienza costantemente positiva, professionale ed empatica per ogni cliente, anche in situazioni ad alta pressione

Quali competenze e esperienza porterete in questo viaggio:

- Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente.

- Esperienza nel servizio clienti, call-centre, coordinamento sanitario, assistenza di viaggio, o un altro ruolo di customer-face.

- Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale, con la capacità di spiegare le informazioni in modo chiaro e compassionevole.

- La capacità di rimanere calmo, empatico, e professionale quando sostengono le persone in difficoltà.

- Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli, con fiducia documentando le informazioni accuratamente e accuratamente.

- La capacità di multitask, priorità richieste concorrenti, e seguire processi consolidati.

- Buone capacità di problem solving e la fiducia di pensare attraverso situazioni non familiari.

- Un atteggiamento positivo e flessibile e la volontà di imparare in un ambiente frenetico.

- Terminologia medica, esposizione sanitaria, o competenze multilingue (altamente considerato, ma non richiesto).

- Possibilità di lavorare 6pm-4am con weekend e vacanze rotanti.

- La posizione include un differenziale di spostamento di $3/ora da 5pm-7am weeknights e tutto il giorno il sabato/sunday e supplementare $3/ora il sabato e la domenica tra le ore di 7pm-7am

Perché ti piace lavorare con noi!

Valoriamo l'ottimismo, la cura, l'uniformità, l'orientamento dei risultati e l'avanzamento.

Abbiamo più di 3000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo. Siamo un gruppo globale di specialisti digitali, attuaria, marketers, medici, infermieri, case manager, specialisti di rivendicazione, esperti di finanza, assistenza clienti e professionisti dei servizi aziendali. Condividiamo uno scopo globale per badare ai viaggiatori, ad ogni passo del loro viaggio.

Flessibilità del lavoro. Comprendiamo l'importanza di assicurarci che il lavoro si adatti alla tua vita, non al contrario. Il nostro approccio ibrido garantisce di mantenere l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita con la flessibilità di 3 giorni in ufficio e 2 giorni di lavoro da casa.

Crescita della carriera . Questo è un momento estremamente emozionante per noi a Zurigo Cover-More, in quanto espandiamo rapidamente il nostro business in tutto il mondo. Ci impegniamo ad aiutare le nostre persone a prosperare attraverso un'esperienza di bordo completa, uno sviluppo professionale continuo e un ambiente di lavoro di supporto che consente la crescita in ogni fase della tua carriera.

Prendetevi il tempo necessario, per voi e la vostra comunità. Vi invitiamo a prendere il tempo necessario quando ne avete bisogno. Offriamo prestazioni di congedo annuali e personali regolari insieme a congedo volontario e un sistema completo di congedo parentale pagato.

Investire nella tua salute e nel tuo futuro. Offriamo un piano sanitario altamente deducibile competitivo, programmi EAP e l'accesso alle attività di salute e benessere insieme al programma 401(k) con il datore di lavoro corrispondente per aiutarti a pianificare il tuo futuro.

Diversità e inclusione. Rispettiamo chi siete e abbracciamo profondamente la diversità. Ovunque la vita ti abbia portato, ti accogliamo per portare tutto il tuo lavoro. Basta essere voi – perché è esattamente quello che stiamo cercando.

Applicare oggi e andiamo in grandi posti insieme!

A Zurigo Cover-More, siamo orgogliosi di essere uno dei principali fornitori di assicurazione e assistenza al mondo. Ogni anno, proteggiamo più di 20 milioni di viaggiatori in tutto il mondo, assicurandoci di esserci ogni passo del loro viaggio con cura proattiva, copertura personalizzata e supporto specializzato. I partner di Zurigo Cover-More con molti dei marchi più noti al mondo – pensano alle principali compagnie aeree, ai giganti di viaggio, alle principali banche, ai fornitori di carte di credito e ai grandi rivenditori – per fornire maggiore cura, maggiore copertura, per tutti.

Lanciato nel dicembre 2024, Zurich Cover-More è il marchio di viaggi globale del Zurich Insurance Group, uno dei principali assicuratori multi-linee al mondo. La nostra famiglia di marchi di customer-facing include nomi di fiducia come Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely e Blue Insurance. Insieme, stiamo ridefinindo cosa significa viaggiare in modo sicuro e con fiducia. Che si tratti di una vacanza a lungo attesa, di un viaggio d’affari dell’ultimo minuto, o di una deviazione inaspettata, offriamo nei momenti che contano.

Mercato Maggiore più vicino: Wausau
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wohin führt dich deine Karriere als nächstes? Lasst es uns gemeinsam herausfinden.

Über Travel Guard

Diese Rolle ist Teil unseres Travel Guard Teams. Travel Guard ist eine führende Reiseversicherungsmarke, die Millionen von Urlaubs- und Geschäftsreisenden weltweit betreut. Gegründet im Jahr 1982 bieten wir ein umfassendes Portfolio an Reiseversicherungslösungen und globalen Assistenzdiensten. Travel Guard betreibt Servicezentren in Asien, Europa und Amerika und bietet 24/7-Support, um Reisenden zu helfen, unerwartete Umstände zu bewältigen, die ihre Pläne stören könnten. Travel Guard wurde im Dezember 2024 Teil von Zurich Cover-More.

Was du tun wirst:

Unsere Medical Assistance Coordinators spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Unterstützung von Reisenden, wenn sie medizinische Probleme von zu Hause aus haben. Ob es sich um die Koordination der Pflege, die Vermittlung von Rezepten oder die Unterstützung medizinischer Reisen handelt, Sie tragen dazu bei, dass die Menschen zur richtigen Zeit die richtige Hilfe erhalten. Dies ist eine schnelllebige, auf Menschen ausgerichtete Rolle, bei der ruhige Kommunikation, Liebe zum Detail und Empathie wirklich wichtig sind. Sie werden geschult, um reale medizinische Assistenzszenarien zu verwalten, während Sie eng mit medizinischen Fachkräften und globalen Servicepartnern zusammenarbeiten.

- Nehmen Sie eingehende Anrufe von Kunden entgegen, die während der Reise medizinische Situationen erleben, von kleinen Bedenken bis hin zu dringenden medizinischen Bedürfnissen

- Geben Sie ruhige, klare Führung und emotionale Beruhigung für Kunden und ihre Familien in stressigen und unbekannten Umständen

- Koordinieren Sie medizinische Dienstleistungen, einschließlich Arzt- und Einrichtungsempfehlungen, Rezeptersatz und medizinisch verwandte Reisearrangements

- Kontakt mit medizinischen Fachkräften, Krankenhäusern, Kliniken und globalen Unterstützungspartnern, um eine angemessene Versorgung zu gewährleisten

- Kritisches Denken und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen anwenden, um Situationen zu bewerten und geeignete nächste Schritte innerhalb der politischen und operativen Leitlinien zu identifizieren

- Verwalten Sie mehrere Fälle gleichzeitig und priorisieren Sie effektiv in einer dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebung

- Dokumentieren Sie Falldetails, Entscheidungen und Kundeninteraktionen in Fallmanagement- und Richtliniensystemen genau

- Beitrag zu einer durchweg positiven, professionellen und empathischen Erfahrung für jeden Kunden, auch in Hochdrucksituationen

Welche Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen Sie auf dieser Reise mitbringen werden:

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig.

- Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Call-Center, Gesundheitskoordination, Reiseunterstützung oder einer anderen Kundenrolle.

- Starke verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Informationen klar und mitfühlend zu erklären.

- Die Fähigkeit, ruhig, empathisch und professionell zu bleiben, wenn man Menschen in Not unterstützt.

- Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail, wobei das Vertrauen Informationen genau und gründlich dokumentiert.

- Die Fähigkeit, Multitasking durchzuführen, konkurrierende Anforderungen zu priorisieren und etablierten Prozessen zu folgen.

- Gute Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und das Selbstvertrauen, unbekannte Situationen zu durchdenken.

- Eine positive, flexible Einstellung und Lernbereitschaft in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld.

- Medizinische Terminologie, Gesundheitsexposition oder mehrsprachige Fähigkeiten (hoch angesehen, aber nicht erforderlich).

- Fähigkeit, 6pm-4am mit wechselnden Wochenenden und Feiertagen zu arbeiten.

- Die Position beinhaltet eine Verschiebungsdifferenz von $ 3 / Stunde von 5pm-7am wochentags und den ganzen Tag am Samstag / Sonntag und zusätzliche $ 3 / Stunde Samstags und Sonntags zwischen den Stunden von 7pm-7am.

Warum Sie es lieben werden, mit uns zu arbeiten!

Wir schätzen Optimismus, Fürsorge, Zusammengehörigkeit, Ergebnisorientierung und vorausschauendes Denken.

Wir haben weltweit mehr als 3000 Mitarbeiter. Wir sind eine globale Gruppe von digitalen Spezialisten, Versicherungsmathematikern, Vermarktern, Ärzten, Krankenschwestern, Fallmanagern, Schadenspezialisten, Finanzexperten, Kundendienst- und Unternehmensdienstleistern. Wir teilen den globalen Zweck, Reisende bei jedem Schritt ihrer Reise zu betreuen.

Arbeitsplatzflexibilität. Wir verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, sicherzustellen, dass Arbeit in Ihr Leben passt, nicht umgekehrt. Unser hybrider Ansatz stellt sicher, dass Sie die Work-Life-Balance mit der Flexibilität von 3 Tagen im Büro und 2 Tagen von zu Hause aus halten können.

Karrierewachstum. Dies ist eine äußerst aufregende Zeit für uns bei Zurich Cover-More, da wir unser Geschäft schnell auf der ganzen Welt ausbauen. Wir sind bestrebt, unseren Mitarbeitern durch eine umfassende Onboarding-Erfahrung, kontinuierliche berufliche Entwicklung und ein unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld zu helfen, das Wachstum in jeder Phase Ihrer Karriere ermöglicht.

Nimm dir die Zeit, die du brauchst, für dich und deine Gemeinschaft. Wir empfehlen Ihnen, sich die Zeit zu nehmen, die Sie brauchen, wenn Sie sie brauchen. Wir bieten regelmäßige jährliche und persönliche Urlaubsleistungen zusammen mit Freiwilligenurlaub und einem umfassenden bezahlten Elternurlaub.

Investieren in Ihre Gesundheit und Ihre Zukunft. Wir bieten einen wettbewerbsfähigen Gesundheitsplan mit hohem Selbstbehalt, EAP-Programme und Zugang zu Gesundheits- und Wohlbefindensaktivitäten zusammen mit 401 (k) -Programm mit Arbeitgeber-Matching, um Ihnen bei der Planung Ihrer Zukunft zu helfen.

Vielfalt und Inklusion. Wir respektieren, wer Sie sind und begrüßen Vielfalt. Wo auch immer das Leben dich hingebracht hat, wir heißen dich willkommen, dein ganzes Selbst zur Arbeit zu bringen. Sei einfach du - denn genau das suchen wir.

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gehen wir gemeinsam zu großartigen Orten!

Bei Zurich Cover-More sind wir stolz darauf, einer der weltweit führenden Reiseversicherungs- und Assistenzanbieter zu sein. Jedes Jahr schützen wir mehr als 20 Millionen Reisende weltweit und stellen sicher, dass wir bei jedem Schritt ihrer Reise mit proaktiver Betreuung, personalisierter Abdeckung und fachlicher Unterstützung dabei sind. Zurich Cover-More arbeitet mit vielen der bekanntesten Marken der Welt zusammen - denken Sie an große Fluggesellschaften, Reisegiganten, Top-Banken, Kreditkartenanbieter und große Einzelhändler -, um mehr Pflege, mehr Deckung für alle zu bieten.

Zurich Cover-More wurde im Dezember 2024 gegründet und ist die globale Reisemarke der Zurich Insurance Group, einem der weltweit führenden Multiline-Versicherer. Unsere Familie von kundenorientierten Marken umfasst vertrauenswürdige Namen wie Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely und Blue Insurance. Gemeinsam definieren wir neu, was es bedeutet, sicher und vertrauensvoll zu reisen. Ob es sich um einen lang erwarteten Urlaub, eine Geschäftsreise in letzter Minute oder einen unerwarteten Umweg handelt, wir liefern in den Momenten, die wichtig sind.

Nächster Hauptmarkt: Wausau
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où votre carrière vous mènera-t-elle ensuite ? Voyons ça ensemble.

À propos de la Garde des voyages

Ce rôle fait partie de notre équipe de gardes de voyage. Travel Guard est une marque d'assurance voyage leader, au service de millions de voyageurs d'affaires et de loisirs dans le monde entier. Créé en 1982, nous offrons un portefeuille complet de solutions d'assurance voyage et de services d'assistance mondiale. Travel Guard exploite des centres de services partout en Asie, en Europe et dans les Amériques, assurant un soutien 24/7 pour aider les voyageurs à naviguer dans des circonstances imprévues qui pourraient perturber leurs plans. Travel Guard fait partie de Zurich Cover-More en décembre 2024.

Ce que vous allez faire:

Nos coordonnateurs de l'aide médicale jouent un rôle crucial en aidant les voyageurs lorsqu'ils éprouvent des problèmes médicaux loin de chez eux. Qu'il s'agisse de coordonner les soins, d'organiser des ordonnances ou de soutenir les déplacements médicaux, vous allez vous assurer que les gens reçoivent la bonne assistance au bon moment. C'est un rôle rapide et axé sur les gens où la communication calme, l'attention au détail et l'empathie comptent vraiment. Vous serez formé à gérer des scénarios d'assistance médicale dans le monde réel tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les professionnels de la santé et les partenaires de services mondiaux.

- Prendre des appels entrants de clients ayant des situations médicales en voyage, allant de préoccupations mineures aux besoins médicaux urgents

- Fournir aux clients et à leur famille une orientation calme et claire et une assurance émotionnelle dans des circonstances stressantes et inconnues

- Coordonner les services médicaux, y compris l'orientation des médecins et des établissements, les remplacements d'ordonnances et les arrangements relatifs aux voyages médicaux

- Assurer la liaison avec les professionnels de la santé, les hôpitaux, les cliniques et les partenaires mondiaux de l'assistance afin d'assurer des soins appropriés

- Appliquer une pensée critique et un jugement judicieux pour évaluer les situations et déterminer les prochaines étapes appropriées dans les lignes directrices stratégiques et opérationnelles

- Gérer plusieurs cas à la fois, en priorisant efficacement dans un environnement dynamique et rapide

- Documenter avec précision les détails des cas, les décisions et les interactions avec les clients dans les systèmes de gestion des cas et de politiques

- Contribuer à une expérience toujours positive, professionnelle et empathique pour chaque client, même dans les situations à haute pression

Quelles compétences et expérience vous apporterez dans ce voyage:

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent.

- Expérience du service à la clientèle, du centre d'appels, de la coordination des soins de santé, de l'aide aux voyages ou d'un autre rôle axé sur le client.

- Forte capacité de communication verbale, avec la capacité d'expliquer l'information clairement et avec compassion.

- La capacité de rester calme, empathique et professionnel quand il soutient les personnes en détresse.

- Compétences organisationnelles solides et attention aux détails, avec confiance documentant l'information avec précision et profondeur.

- La capacité de multitâche, de prioriser les demandes concurrentes et de suivre les processus établis.

- Bonnes compétences de résolution de problèmes et la confiance de penser à travers des situations inconnues.

- Une attitude positive, flexible et la volonté d'apprendre dans un environnement rapide.

- Terminologie médicale, exposition aux soins de santé ou compétences multilingues (hautement considérées, mais non requises).

- Capacité de travailler 18h-4h avec des week-ends et des jours fériés tournants.

- Le poste comprend un différentiel de 3 $/heure de 17 h à 7 h en semaine et toute la journée le samedi/dimanche et des samedis et dimanches supplémentaires de 3 $/heure entre 19 h et 7 h

Pourquoi tu aimes travailler avec nous ?

Nous apprécions l'optimisme, l'attention, l'unité, l'orientation-résultats et l'avenir.

Nous avons plus de 3000 employés dans le monde. Nous sommes un groupe mondial de spécialistes du numérique, d'actuaires, de marketeurs, de médecins, d'infirmières, de gestionnaires de cas, de spécialistes des réclamations, d'experts financiers, de service à la clientèle et de professionnels des services corporatifs. Nous partageons un objectif mondial de prendre soin des voyageurs, à chaque étape de leur voyage.

Flexibilité de l'emploi . Nous comprenons l'importance de faire en sorte que le travail s'intègre dans votre vie, et non l'inverse. Notre approche hybride vous permet de maintenir l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée avec la flexibilité de 3 jours au bureau et de 2 jours à domicile.

Croissance des carrières . C'est une période extrêmement excitante pour nous à Zurich Cover-More, alors que nous développons rapidement nos activités à travers le monde. Nous sommes déterminés à aider nos gens à prospérer grâce à une expérience d'embarquement complète, au perfectionnement professionnel continu et à un environnement de travail qui favorise la croissance à chaque étape de votre carrière.

Prenez le temps dont vous avez besoin, pour vous et votre communauté. Nous vous encourageons à prendre le temps dont vous avez besoin quand vous en avez besoin. Nous offrons des congés annuels et personnels réguliers, ainsi que des congés volontaires et un régime de congé parental payé complet.

Investir dans votre santé et votre avenir. Nous offrons un plan de santé concurrentiel, des programmes de PAE et un accès aux activités de santé et de bien-être ainsi qu'un programme 401(k) assorti d'un employeur pour vous aider à planifier votre avenir.

Diversité et inclusion . Nous respectons qui vous êtes et nous acceptons pleinement la diversité. Partout où la vie t'a emmenée, nous te souhaitons la bienvenue pour te faire travailler. Sois juste toi – parce que c'est exactement ce que nous cherchons.

Appliquer aujourd'hui et laisser aller à de grands endroits ensemble!

À Zurich Cover-More, nous sommes fiers d'être l'un des leaders mondiaux de l'assurance voyage et de l'assistance. Chaque année, nous protégeons plus de 20 millions de voyageurs dans le monde, en nous assurant d'y être à chaque étape de leur voyage avec des soins proactifs, une couverture personnalisée et un soutien spécialisé. Zurich Cover-More partenaires avec de nombreuses marques les plus connues du monde – pensez aux grandes compagnies aériennes, géants du voyage, grandes banques, fournisseurs de cartes de crédit et grands détaillants – pour offrir plus de soins, plus de couverture, pour tous.

Lancée en décembre 2024, Zurich Cover-More est la marque mondiale de voyage de Zurich Insurance Group, l'un des principaux assureurs multilignes au monde. Notre famille de marques orientées clients comprend des noms de confiance comme Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely et Blue Insurance. Ensemble, nous redéfinissons ce que signifie voyager en toute sécurité et avec confiance. Que ce soit des vacances tant attendues, un voyage d'affaires de dernière minute ou un détour inattendu, nous livrons dans les moments qui comptent.

jobs.title: Senior .Net Developer
jobs.description:
Our opportunity
Senior .NET API Developer

We are hiring a Senior .NET API Developer to join the team building REDS - Risk Exposure Data Store . REDS is Zurich's strategic global platform for risk accumulation management. You will build robust, high-performance .NET APIs that connect REDS modules — to the shared data foundation on Databricks, Azure SQL and PostGIS. This is a hands-on senior .Net engineering role in a global, cross-functional environment, with strong exposure to business stakeholders across accumulation management, underwriting and modelling.

Your role
As Senior .NET API Developer , your main responsibilities will involve:

- Design, build and maintain .NET Core RESTful APIs that expose REDS capabilities to underwriting, modelling and reporting consumers.

- Contribute to architectural decisions for scalable, secure and cloud-native services on Azure.

- Integrate .NET services with Databricks, Azure SQL, PostGIS, message queues and internal Zurich platforms.

- Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability and secure coding practices.

- Collaborate with architects, product owners, modelers, data engineers and business stakeholders in an agile delivery model.

- Contribute to the modernization of legacy components and migration to the cloud native target architecture.

Your Skills and Experience

As Senior .NET API Developer , your skills and experience will ideally include :

- 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally in international environments and in financial services, banking or insurance.

- Demonstrated experience building applications from the ground up, not only maintaining existing systems.

- Strong experience with .NET (latest LTS, .NET 8 preferred).

- Extensive experience developing .NET Core RESTful APIs in production.

- Solid experience with Entity Framework and the Repository / Unit of Work patterns.

- Strong T-SQL / MS SQL skills, including SELECT and UPDATE statements, joins, stored procedures and triggers.

- Experience with asynchronous programming and parallelization in .NET.

- Strong knowledge of unit testing frameworks and test-driven practices.

- Hands-on experience developing Azure Web Apps, Azure Functions and other Azure PaaS services.

- Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including build, release, code quality gates and automated testing.

- Strong analytical mindset and ability to learn new technologies quickly.

- Attention to detail and a genuine passion for delivering high-quality, maintainable code.

Nice to have

- Experience with Dapper or other micro-ORMs.

- Familiarity with Databricks, Delta Lake or Spark-based data platforms.

- Experience with PostGIS or other spatial data stores.

- Experience with event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).

- Experience with API Management, App Configuration and Key Vault on Azure.

- Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes / AKS).

- Familiarity with domain-driven design and clean architecture.

- Experience with observability tooling (Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

- Experience with insurance domain concepts — exposure management, catastrophe modelling, underwriting workflows, SOV processing.

We offer

Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. The starting base salary range for this position is 2930 Eur.

Working time benefits

Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workation

Monetary benefits

Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus

Other benefits

Electronic cafeteria, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office

Learning/Development

Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP)

- Location: Bratislava

- Schedule: full-time

- Form: hybrid - occasional home office possible

About us

At our company, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted, and respected at all times.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra opportunità
Senior .NET API Sviluppatore

Stiamo assumendo un Senior .NET API Sviluppatore per aderire al team building REDS - Risk Exposure Data Store . REDS è la piattaforma strategica globale di Zurigo per la gestione dell'accumulo di rischio. Si costruirà API .NET robuste e ad alte prestazioni che collegano i moduli REDS — alla base di dati condivisa su Databricks, Azure SQL e PostGIS. Questo è un senior a portata di mano. Il ruolo dell'ingegneria netta in un ambiente globale e interfunzionale, con una forte esposizione agli stakeholder aziendali attraverso la gestione dell'accumulo, la sottoscrizione e la modellazione.

Il tuo ruolo
Come Senior .NET API Developer , le tue principali responsabilità coinvolgeranno:

- Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione .NET Core RESTful API che espongono le capacità REDS per sottoscrivere, modellare e segnalare i consumatori.

- Contribuire a decisioni architettoniche per servizi scalabili, sicuri e cloud-nativi su Azure.

- Integra i servizi .NET con Databricks, Azure SQL, PostGIS, code di messaggi e piattaforme interne di Zurigo.

- Assicurare alta qualità del codice attraverso test unità, recensioni di codice, CI/CD, osservabilità e pratiche di codifica sicure.

- Collabora con architetti, proprietari di prodotti, modellisti, ingegneri di dati e stakeholder aziendali in un modello di consegna agile.

- Contribuisci alla modernizzazione dei componenti legacy e alla migrazione all'architettura di destinazione nativa cloud.

Le tue abilità ed esperienza

Come Senior .NET API Developer , le tue competenze e l'esperienza includeranno idealmente:

- 5+ anni di esperienza di ingegneria del software pratico, idealmente in ambienti internazionali e nei servizi finanziari, bancari o assicurativi.

- Applicazioni di costruzione di esperienze dimostrate da zero, non solo mantenendo i sistemi esistenti.

- Forte esperienza con .NET (più recente LTS, .NET 8 preferito).

- Ampia esperienza di sviluppo .NET Core RESTful API in produzione.

- Esperienza solida con Entity Framework e il Repository / Unit of Work pattern.

- Forte T-SQL / MS SQL competenze, tra cui le dichiarazioni SELECT e UPDATE, si unisce, procedure memorizzate e trigger.

- Esperienza con programmazione asincrona e parallelizzazione in .NET.

- Forte conoscenza dei quadri di prova delle unità e delle pratiche di test-driven.

- Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di Azure Web Apps, Azure Funzioni e altri servizi Azure PaaS.

- Esperienza con Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, tra cui costruzione, rilascio, codici di qualità cancelli e test automatizzati.

- Forte mentalità analitica e capacità di imparare le nuove tecnologie rapidamente.

- Attenzione ai dettagli e una vera passione per la fornitura di codice manutenbile di alta qualità.

Bello da avere

- Esperienza con Dapper o altri micro-ORM.

- Familiarità con Databricks, Delta Lake o piattaforme dati basate su Spark.

- Esperienza con PostGIS o altri data store spaziali.

- Esperienza con architetture orientate agli eventi (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).

- Esperienza con Gestione API, Configurazione App e Portachiavi su Azure.

- Esperienza con containerizzazione (Docker, Kubernetes / AKS).

- Familiarità con design a dominio e architettura pulita.

- Esperienza con strumenti di osservabilità (Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

- Esperienza con i concetti di dominio di assicurazione — gestione dell'esposizione, modellazione della catastrofe, flussi di lavoro di sottoscrizione, elaborazione SOV.

Offriamo

La compensazione per i ruoli a Zurigo dipende da una vasta gamma di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, il ruolo specifico, il set di competenze, il livello di esperienza e soggetto alla legge applicabile. Zurigo fornisce così una gamma di compensazioni allineate all'architettura interna del lavoro e ai benchmark di mercato per garantire una paga equa e coerente per ruoli comparabili. La gamma di stipendio base di partenza per questa posizione è 2930 Eur.

Benefici del tempo di lavoro

Giorni liberi, settimana di lavoro concentrata, Vacanza aggiuntiva, Ufficio domestico, Giorni extra in occasione di parto, congedo sabatico, Workation

Benefici monetari

Assicurazione sulla vita da Zurigo Austria, Compensazione per la perdita di stipendio durante il congedo di malattia, 3° contributo pilastro pensione, Risk Life Insurance, Contributo di pagamento al massimo del minimo richiesto, Anni di bonus di servizio, Bonus di nozze, Baby bonus

Altri vantaggi

Caffetteria elettronica, Prestazioni di congedo di maternità, Massaggi in ufficio

Apprendimento/Sviluppo

Certificazioni professionali, Portali di formazione online, programma di onboarding esteso, cultura basata sui punti di forza (GALLUP)

- Posizione: Bratislava

- Orari: a tempo pieno

- Forma: ibrido - ufficio domestico occasionale possibile

Su di noi

Nella nostra azienda, riconosciamo l'importanza di promuovere un ambiente aperto, sicuro e inclusivo per tutti. Siamo con la diversità e rispetto diversi sfondi e stili di vita. Ecco perché abbiamo implementato numerose iniziative per garantire che i nostri dipendenti si sentano comodi, accettati e rispettati in ogni momento.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Unsere Chance
Senior .NET API Entwickler

Wir stellen einen Senior .NET API Developer ein, um dem Team beim Aufbau von REDS - Risk Exposure Data Store beizutreten. REDS ist Zürichs strategische globale Plattform für das Risikoakkumulationsmanagement. Sie erstellen robuste, leistungsstarke .NET-APIs, die REDS-Module mit der gemeinsamen Datengrundlage auf Databricks, Azure SQL und PostGIS verbinden. Dies ist ein Hands-on Senior. Netto-Engineering-Rolle in einem globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld mit starkem Engagement für Geschäftsbeteiligte in den Bereichen Akkumulationsmanagement, Underwriting und Modellierung.

Deine Rolle
Als Senior .NET API Developer umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

- Entwerfen, erstellen und pflegen Sie .NET Core RESTful APIs, die REDS-Funktionen dem Underwriting, Modellieren und Melden von Verbrauchern aussetzen.

- Tragen Sie zu architektonischen Entscheidungen für skalierbare, sichere und Cloud-native Dienste in Azure bei.

- Integrieren Sie .NET-Dienste mit Databricks, Azure SQL, PostGIS, Nachrichtenwarteschlangen und internen Zürich-Plattformen.

- Gewährleistung einer hohen Codequalität durch Unit-Tests, Code-Reviews, CI/CD, Beobachtbarkeit und sichere Codierungspraktiken.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Architekten, Product Ownern, Modellierern, Dateningenieuren und Geschäftsbeteiligten in einem agilen Liefermodell zusammen.

- Tragen Sie zur Modernisierung von Legacy-Komponenten und zur Migration auf die native Cloud-Zielarchitektur bei.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Als Senior .NET API Developer umfassen Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen idealerweise:

- 5+ Jahre praktische Software-Engineering-Erfahrung, idealerweise im internationalen Umfeld und in Finanzdienstleistungen, Banken oder Versicherungen.

- Demonstrierte Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Anwendungen von Grund auf, nicht nur bei der Wartung bestehender Systeme.

- Starke Erfahrung mit .NET (letzte LTS, .NET 8 bevorzugt).

- Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von .NET Core RESTful APIs in der Produktion.

Développeur d'API .NET senior

REDS est la plateforme mondiale stratégique de Zurich pour la gestion de l'accumulation des risques. Le rôle de l'ingénierie nette dans un environnement mondial et interfonctionnel, avec une forte exposition aux acteurs commerciaux à travers la gestion de l'accumulation, la souscription et la modélisation.

Votre rôle
En tant que Senior .NET API Developer , vos principales responsabilités comprendront:

- Concevoir, construire et entretenir des API REST de base de .NET qui exposent les capacités REDS à la souscription, à la modélisation et à la déclaration des consommateurs.

- Contribuer aux décisions architecturales pour des services évolutifs, sécurisés et cloud-native sur Azure.

- Intégrer les services .NET avec Databricks, Azure SQL, PostGIS, files d'attente de messages et plateformes internes Zurich.

- Assurer une qualité de code élevée grâce à des tests unitaires, à des examens de code, à l'IC/CD, à l'observation et à des pratiques de codage sécurisées.

- Collaborer avec les architectes, les propriétaires de produits, les modélistes, les ingénieurs de données et les intervenants commerciaux dans un modèle de livraison agile.

- Contribuer à la modernisation des composantes héritées et à la migration vers l'architecture cible native du nuage.

Vos compétences et votre expérience

En tant que Senior .NET API Developer , vos compétences et votre expérience comprendront idéalement :

- 5+ ans d'expérience pratique en ingénierie logicielle, idéalement dans les environnements internationaux et dans les services financiers, bancaires ou d'assurance.

- Expérience démontrée en matière de construction d'applications à partir de la base, non seulement la maintenance des systèmes existants.

- Forte expérience avec .NET (dernier LTS, .NET 8 préféré).

- Une vaste expérience de développement d'APIs .NET Core REST dans la production.

- Une solide expérience avec le cadre d'entité et le répertoire / l'unité de travail.

- De solides compétences T-SQL / MS SQL, y compris les instructions SELECT et UPDATE, rejoint, stocke les procédures et les déclencheurs.

- Expérience avec la programmation asynchrone et la parallélisation en .NET.

- Connaissance approfondie des cadres d'essais unitaires et des pratiques axées sur les essais.

- Expérience pratique du développement des applications Web Azure, des fonctions Azure et d'autres services Azure PaaS.

- Expérience avec Azure DevOps pipelines CI/CD, y compris la construction, la libération, les portes de qualité de code et les tests automatisés.

- Forte capacité d'analyse et d'apprentissage rapide des nouvelles technologies.

- Attention aux détails et une véritable passion pour fournir un code de haute qualité et durable.

Sympa d'avoir

- Expérience avec Dapper ou d'autres micro-ORM.

- Familiarité avec Databricks, Delta Lake ou les plateformes de données basées sur Spark.

- Expérience avec PostGIS ou d'autres magasins de données spatiales.

- Expérience des architectures animées par des événements (bus service Azure, réseau d'événements, Kafka).

- Expérience avec la gestion des API, la configuration des applications et la faille clé sur Azure.

- Expérience de la conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes / AKS).

- Familiarité avec un design de domaine et une architecture propre.

- Expérience de l'outil d'observation (Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

- Expérience des concepts de domaine de l'assurance: gestion de l'exposition, modélisation des catastrophes, gestion des flux de travail, traitement des SOV.

Nous offrons

La rémunération des rôles à Zurich dépend d'un large éventail de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le rôle spécifique, les compétences, le niveau d'expérience et le droit applicable. jobs.title: Senior Incident Response Consultant, DFIR
jobs.description:
This role joins SpearTip, the cybersecurity consulting segment within Zurich Resilience Solutions. Blending cutting-edge technologies, unique skill sets, and proven cyber counterintelligence strategies, SpearTip partners with our clients to protect shareholder value, shield corporate reputations, and enhance long-term profits. We are driven to protect our clients from the ever-changing threat actors and become the gold standard in detecting zero-day vulnerabilities. In this role you make work virtual within the U.S. and extend up to 20% travel.

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant, you will deliver expert incident response and digital forensics services to external clients experiencing cyber security incidents. Leads complex investigations, provides strategic guidance during security breaches, and drives incident containment and recovery efforts. Maintains 75% billable utilization while delivering exceptional client service and building long-term client relationships. The job's core deliverables rely on delivering expert consulting services to external clients during high-stress security incidents. Requires building trust with C-level executives, IT leaders, legal counsel, and insurance partners while managing complex multi-stakeholder relationships during crisis situations.

Key Accountabilities:

- Lead incident response engagements for external clients, conducting digital forensics investigations, malware analysis, and threat actor attribution to identify scope, impact, and root cause of security incidents.

- Provide 24/7 on-call emergency response services, rapidly deploying to client sites or remotely connecting to contain active threats, preserve evidence, and minimize business disruption.

- Conduct comprehensive forensic examinations of compromised systems, networks, and cloud environments using industry-standard tools and methodologies to support client remediation and potential legal proceedings.

- Deliver executive-level briefings and written reports to clients, translating complex technical findings into business impact assessments and actionable recommendations.

- Coordinate with client stakeholders including IT teams, legal counsel, insurance carriers, law enforcement, and executive leadership to manage incident response activities and communication strategies.

- Provide expert guidance on ransomware negotiations, business email compromise investigations, insider threat cases, and advanced persistent threat incidents.

- Develop and deliver incident response retainer services, conducting proactive readiness assessments, tabletop exercises, and security program evaluations for client organizations.

- Mentor junior consultants and analysts, providing technical guidance and quality assurance on client deliverables.

- Maintain detailed case documentation, time tracking, and engagement status reporting to ensure accurate billing and project management.

- Partner with insurance brokers, managed service providers, and law firms to provide incident response services as part of cyber insurance claims and breach response protocols.

- Stay current on emerging threats, attack techniques, and forensic methodologies through continuous research and professional development.

- Contribute to thought leadership initiatives including blog posts, conference presentations, and client education materials.

- Business Travel, as required (may be extensive during active incidents) as well as extended hours during Active Incidents/24x7 On-call Rotation, flexible scheduling to accommodate client emergencies and time-sensitive investigations, as required.

Additional Business Accountabilities:

- Develop scopes of work and cost estimates for incident response engagements, ensuring projects are appropriately resourced and profitably delivered.

- Identify opportunities for expanded client engagements based on investigation findings, security gaps, and client needs.

- Support business development activities including client presentations, capability demonstrations, and proposal development for new and existing clients.

- Ensure all client deliverables meet quality standards and are delivered within agreed timelines and budgets.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelors degree and 5 or more years experience in the Information Technology area
OR

- Zurich Cybersecurity Technician Apprentice, including Cyber Security Certification and 6 or more years experience in the Information Technology area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years experience in the Information Technology area
AND

- MS Office experience
AND

- Knowledge of Cyber Security Operations

Preferred Functional/Technical Skills Qualifications:

- Digital Forensics & Incident Response - Proficiency Level Advanced

- Threat Intelligence & Malware Analysis - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Client Communication & Stakeholder Management - Proficiency Level Advanced

- Windows/Linux System Forensics - Proficiency Level Advanced

- Network Forensics & Log Analysis - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Cloud Security (Azure/AWS/M365) - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Forensic Tool Proficiency (EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Volatility, etc.) - Proficiency Level Advanced

- Ransomware & BEC Investigations - Proficiency Level Advanced

- Report Writing & Executive Communication - Proficiency Level Advanced

- Project Management - Proficiency Level Intermediate

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $100,200.00 - $164,100.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
Accountant

Place of work: Cracow

Job purpose:

To perform specific Financial Accounting and Reporting activities relevant for Group and Local reporting to support and reinforce key business objectives. The role gives opportunity to participate in local, regional and global projects and that is why we are looking for a proactive, flexible person with
a “can do” approach.

Responsibilities:

- Calculate and perform general ledger bookings and account reconciliation (e.g. calculate deferred income tax, accruals, provisions, pre-payments)

- Provide Group and external reporting (BS, P&L, Supplementary information to financial statement – according to IFRS, Swiss/German GAAP, Swiss Solvency Test and other GAAP if needed)

- Perform Intercompany reconciliation and postings

- Asset accounting

- Perform various closing activities e.g. maintain interfaces to Sub ledger as an option: revaluation, regrouping and cost allocation cycles (depending on BU)

- Support/collaborate in various projects such as the analysis and implementation of Group Chart of Accounts changes, system changes/upgrade

- Maintain contact with various stakeholders e.g. FAR Controllers, Actuaries, Local Accountants,

- Execute controls within ICFR framework

Candidate’s profile:

- At least 1-2 years of relevant accounting experience

- Practical accounting experience in GL / financial audit or financial reporting

- Finance and Accounting, Economy or equivalent academic degree

- Good knowledge of Excel and financial system (SAP as preferred)

- Analytical skills and attention to detail

- English skills – spoken and written at fluent level

We offer:

- Real life opportunities to develop and grow with us and contribute to the world around us

- Competitive salaries, language allowance and an employee benefits package that includes among others medical insurance, life insurance and sport-card

- Annual bonus depending on company annual results and individual performance

- Wide range of learning programs and personal development opportunities including also possibility to apply for up to 80% of educational trainings reimbursement

- Referral awards

- Online fitness trainings

- Hybrid Work

- Nice and Friendly atmosphere

Who we are:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading multi-line insurer serving people and businesses in more than 200 countries and territories. Founded 150 years ago, Zurich is transforming insurance. In addition to providing insurance protection, Zurich is increasingly offering prevention services such as those that promote wellbeing and enhance climate resilience. Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ Zurich aspires to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. It is targeting net-zero emissions by 2050 and has the highest-possible ESG rating from MSCI. In 2020, Zurich launched the Zurich Forest project to support reforestation and biodiversity restoration in Brazil. The Group has about 60,000 employees and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and has a level I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) program, which is traded over-the-counter on OTCQX. Further information is available at www.zurich.com .

In March 2016 we established a Shared Service Centre in Kraków, in Poland to support our global strategy. It is from this location that we have created a global shared service platform, focusing on advanced business functions such as financial accounting and reporting, planning and performance management, ICFR testing, financial systems management as well as HR integrated talent management operations.

This role is related to the key area of Zurich’s activity in Kraków. We are committed to complete the recruitment process as soon as possible, however in some occasions it may take up to 6 months and the requirements for the position may be subject to some clarification or modification during the recruitment process.

Contabilità

Scopo del lavoro:

Per svolgere specifiche attività di contabilità finanziaria e di reporting rilevanti per il Gruppo e la reporting locale per sostenere e rafforzare gli obiettivi aziendali chiave. Il ruolo dà l'opportunità di partecipare a progetti locali, regionali e globali ed è per questo che stiamo cercando una persona proattiva e flessibile con
un approccio “può fare”.

Responsabilità:

- Calcola ed esegue prenotazioni generali di registro e la riconciliazione del conto (ad esempio, calcolare l'imposta sul reddito differita, le accruamenti, le disposizioni, i pagamenti anticipati)

- Fornire il Gruppo e la segnalazione esterna (BS, P&L, Informazioni aggiuntive al bilancio finanziario – secondo IFRS, Swiss/German GAAP, Swiss Solvency Test e altri GAAP se necessario)

- Eseguire la riconciliazione e le posting intercompany

- Assetto contabile

- Eseguire varie attività di chiusura, ad esempio mantenere interfacce a Sub ledger come opzione: rivalutazione, raggruppamento e cicli di allocazione dei costi (a seconda del BU)

- Supporto/collaborare in vari progetti, come l'analisi e l'attuazione del Quadro di Gruppo di modifiche, modifiche di sistema/upgrade

- Mantenere il contatto con varie parti interessate, ad esempio FAR Controllers, Attuari, Contabili locali,

- Eseguire i controlli all'interno del quadro ICFR

Profilo del candidato:

- Almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza contabile rilevante

- Esperienza contabile pratica in GL / audit finanziario o rendicontazione finanziaria

- Finanza e contabilità, economia o equivalente grado accademico

- Buona conoscenza di Excel e sistema finanziario (SAP come preferito)

- Competenze analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli

- Competenze inglesi – parlate e scritte a livello fluente

Offriamo:

- Real life opportunità di sviluppare e crescere con noi e contribuire al mondo intorno a noi

- Retribuzioni competitive, indennità di lingua e un pacchetto di prestazioni dei dipendenti che include tra gli altri assicurazione medica, assicurazione sulla vita e sport-card

- Bonus annuale a seconda dei risultati annuali aziendali e delle prestazioni individuali

- Ampia gamma di programmi di apprendimento e opportunità di sviluppo personale, tra cui anche la possibilità di richiedere fino all'80% di formazione di rimborso

- Premi di riferimento

- Corsi di fitness online

- Lavoro ibrido

- Atmosfera piacevole e amichevole

Chi siamo:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) è un'assicurazione multi-linea leader che serve persone e imprese in oltre 200 paesi e territori. Fondata 150 anni fa, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione. Oltre a fornire protezione assicurativa, Zurigo offre sempre più servizi di prevenzione come quelli che promuovono il benessere e migliorano la resilienza climatica. Riflettendo il suo scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, Zurigo aspira ad essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto del mondo. È mirato alle emissioni di net-zero entro il 2050 e ha il più alto grado di ESG possibile da MSCI. Nel 2020 Zurigo ha lanciato il progetto Forest di Zurigo per sostenere il rimboschimento e il ripristino della biodiversità in Brasile. Il Gruppo ha circa 60.000 dipendenti e ha sede a Zurigo, in Svizzera. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), è elencato sulla SIX Swiss Exchange e ha un programma di livello I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY), che viene scambiato sul conto su OTCQX. Ulteriori informazioni sono disponibili su www.zurich.com .

Nel marzo 2016 abbiamo istituito un Centro Servizi Condiviso a Cracovia, in Polonia, per sostenere la nostra strategia globale. È da questa posizione che abbiamo creato una piattaforma di servizio condivisa globale, concentrandosi su funzioni aziendali avanzate come contabilità finanziaria e reporting, pianificazione e gestione delle prestazioni, test ICFR, gestione dei sistemi finanziari e operazioni di gestione dei talenti integrati HR.

Questo ruolo è legato all’area chiave dell’attività di Zurigo a Cracovia. Ci impegniamo a completare il processo di reclutamento il prima possibile, tuttavia in alcune occasioni può richiedere fino a 6 mesi e i requisiti per la posizione possono essere soggetti a qualche chiarificazione o modifica durante il processo di reclutamento.

jobs.title: Audit Manager - Zurich Cover-More
jobs.description:
Hi there!

I am Alba Marin Sola the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at ServiZurich: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich !

Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First off, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to Zurich Cover-More. Zurich Cover-More is one of the world’s largest travel insurance and assistance providers and part of Zurich Insurance Group, a leading multi-line insurer. We stand for more care, more cover, for all, and we look after more than 20 million of the world’s travellers every year, making sure we are there every step of their journey.

Zurich Cover-More operates under a family of customer-facing brands including Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely and Blue Insurance. We are a connected and caring workforce of more than 2600 employees with teams in North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia Pacific.

Its global delivery platform provides a consistent multi-lingual service experience and ability to write insurance policies in more than 50 countries. Zurich Cover-More has more 200 distribution partners around the world including airlines, global travel companies, major banks and credit card providers and leading retailers.

What Can You Expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked.

This role provides a unique opportunity within a dynamic environment, as Zurich Cover-More integrates the newly acquired Travel Guard business. As an Audit Manager, you will play a key role in assessing and executing audit activities related to the global integration as well as implementing an interim and target state for audit. You may work in close collaboration with audit team members across Group Audit or take on more complex areas directly. You will also work in close collaboration for our regional technical centres of excellence, and wider regional team as relevant to bring input and insight to your audit work and delivery the best possible outcomes for the newly expanded Zurich Cover-More business.

Working with more senior members of the team, as relevant, you will undertake the risk assessment audit planning, work to develop an appropriate scope, key risks and assess the environment, including leveraging Data Analytics, Assessing IT fundamental and leveraging GenAI. You will manage day to day relationships with stakeholders, building strong working relationships. You will develop high quality audit reports, including business impact and ‘so what?’ and root causes.

As a key member of the team, you will foster a culture of quality, collaboration and continuous learning – enabling the team to deliver impactful audit outcomes. You will contribute to strategic priorities and co-create a leading audit function, utilizing innovative audit approaches, new world skills (Data Analytics, IT fundamentals and GenAI) and Agile methods.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field or professional qualification (CPA, CIA, CISA or equivalent, MBA or equivalent)

- 6+ years of relevant experience in Internal Audit, Risk Management or Compliance within the Insurance industry or +8 years of experience in Insurance business positions

- Good understanding of insurance business. Experience with Travel insurance is a plus

- Strong understanding of Internal Audit Standards and methodology and internal control frameworks. Strong report writing skills

- Extensive experience within complex, fast moving and international organizations

- Strong relationship management and influencing skills with proven ability to interact with stakeholders from all seniority levels and build business relationships

- Good experience/understanding of the power and application of new world skills (Data, IT and AI)

- Excellent project management skills, ability to organize teams, prioritize tasks, guide, and coach team members to deliver on time to high quality standards.

- Passion and enthusiasm to continue to grow yourself and others around you

- Collaborative, flexible, determined, and results-oriented mindset.

- Fluent verbal and written English. Another European language is a plus

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus , we offer:

- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.

- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.

- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.

- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.

- Life and accident insurance.

- Collective Life retirement Plan

- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.

- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts

- Functional diversity benefits

- Different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more

- Stock options and mortgage benefits.

Where Are We Located?

Via Augusta, Barcelona or Madrid Acanto

#Li-hybrid

We Are Waiting for You.

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

ServiZurich– Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): ES - Barcelona, ES - Madrid

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Alba Marin Sola

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in commercial P&C underwriting and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Senior Underwriter, Management Liability on our Financial Lines team to underwrite and grow a portfolio management liability risks while building strong relationships with our brokers and customers. This role is open to candidates based in Vancouver.

Reporting to the Underwriting Manager, Western Region (Management Liability – Middle Market Accounts), you will be responsible for developing and underwriting a profitable book of business within your delegated authority, acting as a primary point of contact for brokers, and applying Zurich’s underwriting frameworks to deliver disciplined, market-leading solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

- Underwrite new and renewal commercial Management Liability within your delegated authority, focusing on accounts with higher technical complexity.

- Assess and price risks using Zurich’s underwriting tools and methodologies, ensuring alignment with underwriting strategy and risk appetite.

- Structure coverage, terms and conditions that meet customer needs while achieving profitable growth and portfolio balance.

- Proactively build and manage a qualified pipeline of opportunities 90–120 days before they go to market.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with assigned brokers and key accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and primary contact.

- Participate in broker meetings, client meetings, marketing activities and presentations to promote Zurich’s capabilities and drive new business.

- Collaborate closely with internal partners such as claims, risk engineering and other underwriting teams to deliver integrated solutions and cross-sell additional lines of business.

- Cross-sell and coordinate on larger or more complex accounts, ensuring consistent application of underwriting standards.

- Lead or support short-term projects (typically 3–9 months) aimed at improving underwriting processes, tools or customer experience.

- Share technical expertise and provide guidance to less experienced underwriters, contributing to a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

- High School Diploma or equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

OR

- High School Diploma or equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area.

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area.

AND

- Knowledge of line(s) of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines.

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business.

- Experience with Microsoft Office.
