Treten Sie einem Team bei, in dem Ihr Fachwissen geschätzt wird, Ihre Stimme gehört wird und Ihre Karriere Raum zum Wachsen hat. Zurichs Large Contract West Region Surety Team sucht einen motivierten Contract Surety Underwriter, der uns hilft, unser Portfolio zu stärken, unsere Kundenbeziehungen zu verbessern und in den 13 westlichen Staaten nachhaltig zu wirken.

Dies ist eine hochtechnische Position und erfordert Erfahrung mit Surety-Geschäftszweigen.

Bei Zurich fördern wir eine kollaborative, zielgerichtete Kultur mit der Unterstützung einer globalen Marke. Sie haben die Möglichkeit:

- Führen Sie mit Wirkung durch die Verwaltung komplexer Großkonten

- Reisen mit Zweck, etwa 20% in der gesamten Region

- Erweitern Sie Ihr Netzwerk mit Top-Tier-Agenten und Brokern

- Treffen Sie Entscheidungen, die mit klarer Rechenschaftspflicht und breiter Autorität wichtig sind

Diese marktorientierte Rolle wird in der Westregion liegen und wir sind offen für Talente, die sich überall in den folgenden Staaten befinden: Colorado, Utah, Idaho, Washington, Montana, Oregon, Kalifornien, Nevada und Arizona. Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Verwaltung und Erweiterung eines Portfolios von nationalen und internationalen Großkonten und fördern gleichzeitig die Geschäftsentwicklung und -bindung.

- Zeichnung und Analyse von Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäften für große Vertragsbürgschaften

- Navigieren durch komplexe Aufgaben mit Vertrauen und Autonomie

- Aufbau und Pflege strategischer Broker- und Agenturbeziehungen

- Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Zeichnungsrichtlinien und regulatorischen Anforderungen

Diese Rolle wird entweder auf der Ebene des Underwriting Specialist oder des Executive Underwriter besetzt. Der Einstellungsmanager bestimmt das geeignete Niveau basierend auf der Erfahrung und den Fähigkeiten des ausgewählten Bewerbers in Bezug auf die für diese Position aufgeführten Qualifikationen.

Underwriting Specialist erforderliche Qualifikationen:

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 3 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting, Banking, Hypothek, Finanzen oder Market Facing Bereich.
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice mit einem Associate Degree und 1 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung in den Bereichen Underwriting, Banking, Mortgage, Finance oder Market Facing.
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice inklusive Associate Degree und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support.
UND

- Kenntnis des Geschäftsbereichs/der Geschäftsbereiche und der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Leitlinien

- Kenntnis der Zeitbeschränkungen für Kursofferten für Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäfte

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office

ODER

Executive Underwriter erforderliche Qualifikationen:

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 5 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting oder Market Facing Bereich, Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Banking Erfahrung
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice einschließlich eines Associate Degree und 3 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting oder Market Facing Bereich, Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Banking Erfahrung
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice inklusive Associate Degree und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support
UND

- Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office

- Erfahrung mit Zeitbeschränkungen für Angebote für Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäfte

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einer Teamumgebung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- College Degree Sehr bevorzugt

- Starker Finanz- und Buchhaltungshintergrund erforderlich

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse und Praxis von Surety Bonds

- Etablierte Brokerbeziehungen

- Fähigkeit zur Interaktion mit der C-Suite

- Fähigkeit, komplizierte Kreditbewertungen, Trends, Geschäftsstrategien und organisatorischen Charakter unter anderem Aspekte unserer Kunden zu untersuchen und zu analysieren

- Fähigkeit, diese Strategien und Finanzkonzepte kohärent zu artikulieren und faktenbasierte Schlussfolgerungen und Empfehlungen zu formulieren.

- Vorherige Erfahrung in der Verwaltung / dem Wachstum des profitablen Kundenportfolios

- Verhandlungserfahrung mit großen, internationalen und nationalen Organisationen

- Starke Teambildung und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig. Die gezeigte Lohnspanne ist ein nationaler Durchschnitt und kann je nach Standort variieren. Die kombinierte Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt $ 75.000,00 - $ 165.000.00. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für den Underwriting-Spezialisten beträgt 75.000 $ - 125.000.00 $, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung bei 10% liegt. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für den Executive Underwriter beträgt $ 100.000,00 - $ 165,000.00, wobei die Bonusfähigkeit des Global Specialty Incentive Plan auf 30% festgelegt ist.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Risikomanagement mit über 150 Jahren Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

Zürich in Nordamerika diskriminiert nicht aufgrund von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsausdruck, Geschlechtsidentität, genetischer Information, Alter, Behinderung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Schwangerschaft oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen. Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber Behinderung / Vets.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Databricks
jobs.description:
#ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is currently hiring a:

Data Engineer - Databricks

Responsibilities

As a Data Engineer, your main tasks will involve:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks and cloud-based data platforms.

- Develop, optimize, and automate ETL/ELT processes to support analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives.

- Work closely with Data Scientists, Analysts, ML Engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.

- Implement data ingestion frameworks from multiple structured and unstructured data sources.

- Build and maintain data models, data lakes, and data warehouses that support enterprise analytics needs.

- Ensure data quality, consistency, governance, and security across platforms.

- Optimize Spark workloads and Databricks environments for performance and cost efficiency.

- Support deployment and operationalization of machine learning solutions by providing production-ready datasets and feature pipelines.

- Collaborate with Azure, IT, and DevOps teams to implement CI/CD and DataOps best practices.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve data platform performance and reliability.

Your Skills and Experience

As a Data Engineer, your skills and experience will ideally include:

Required

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.

- 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments.

- Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.

- Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and distributed data processing.

- Experience designing and developing ETL/ELT data pipelines.

- Experience working with Data Lakes and modern data architectures.

- Understanding of data modeling concepts including Star Schema and Dimensional Modeling.

- Experience working with Git and version control systems.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- English level B2 or higher.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Azure Data Platform services, including:

- Azure Databricks

- Azure Data Factory

- Azure Data Lake Storage

- Azure Synapse Analytics

- Azure DevOps

- Experience working with Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture.

- Knowledge of orchestration tools such as Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or Azure Data Factory.

- Experience supporting Machine Learning use cases and MLOps practices.

- Familiarity with MLflow and model deployment processes.

- Knowledge of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DataOps practices.

- Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Event Hubs.

- Experience working in Agile environments.

- Insurance industry experience is a plus.

Nice to Have

- Experience collaborating with Data Science teams and supporting AI/ML initiatives.

- Knowledge of Generative AI, LLM data pipelines, vector databases, and embedding workflows.

- Experience with Unity Catalog, data governance, and metadata management.

- Exposure to cloud-native architectures and enterprise-scale data platforms.

-

If you are interested, please apply directly through this link or send your resume to nathalia.huerta@mx.zurich.com .

Position available only for candidates located in Mexico City, State of Mexico, or Guadalajara. Please apply only if you reside in one of these areas.

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

#ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is looking for a:

Data Science Lead

Role Overview

Leads the planning, governance, and execution oversight of the CDO portfolio across Data Science, Data Platforms and Engineering, and Data Governance.

The role is accountable for translating strategic priorities into an integrated portfolio view, driving prioritization and investment alignment, and providing executive visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.

Working in close partnership with CDO leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, this individual enables disciplined portfolio management, informed decision-making, and consistent delivery of strategic business value.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the CDO portfolio of initiatives across Data Science, Data Platforms and Engineering, and Data Governance, ensuring work is prioritized, sequenced, and aligned to strategic objectives.

• Develop and maintain portfolio roadmaps, integrated plans, milestone views, and executive reporting to provide clear visibility into delivery progress and expected outcomes.

• Govern portfolio intake, prioritization, and decision processes in partnership with CDO leaders and stakeholders, balancing business value, capacity, risk, and cross-functional dependencies.

• Partner closely with the Portfolio Planning & Delivery team to align portfolio planning, delivery oversight, reporting, and governance processes across the CDO portfolio.

• Drive cross-functional coordination to manage interdependencies, resolve delivery conflicts, and sustain execution against portfolio commitments.

• Oversee portfolio financials, including budget planning, forecasting, spend visibility, and

resource alignment, to support effective investment management.

• Support portfolio execution through disciplined vendor and contract oversight, procurement coordination, and adherence to organizational policies and timelines.

• Identify, monitor, and escalate portfolio-level risks, issues, and decisions, and drive mitigation actions to protect delivery timelines and business outcomes.

• Assess portfolio performance, delivery health, and benefit realization, and recommend

adjustments to priorities, plans, and governance mechanisms to improve results.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelors Degree and 6 or more years portfolio, program, or project management experience

OR

• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years portfolio, program, or project management experience

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of portfolio, program, or project management experience in data-centric or technology-driven environments, including accountability for multiple concurrent initiatives across functions.

• Strong knowledge of portfolio governance, intake and prioritization, resource planning, and risk management, preferably within data, analytics, or technology organizations.

• Strong executive communication, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to drive alignment across stakeholders and communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs with clarity.

• Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, forecasts, vendor engagements, and resource plans in complex, matrixed environments.

• Proficiency with portfolio and project management tools and reporting platforms, including the ability to track delivery, dependencies, risks, and investment performance.

Core Competencies

• Portfolio strategy, prioritization, and governance

• Executive stakeholder communication and influence

• Cross-functional planning and dependency management

• Financial oversight and investment alignment

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises. So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference. At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Capability Center sucht eine:

Data Science Lead

Rollenübersicht

Leitet die Planung, Governance und Ausführungsaufsicht des CDO-Portfolios in den Bereichen Data Science, Data Platforms und Engineering sowie Data Governance.

Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, strategische Prioritäten in eine integrierte Portfolioansicht zu übersetzen, die Priorisierung und Ausrichtung der Investitionen voranzutreiben und die Transparenz der Führungskräfte in Bezug auf Fortschritt, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

In enger Partnerschaft mit CDO-Führungskräften und funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern ermöglicht diese Person ein diszipliniertes Portfoliomanagement, eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung und die konsequente Bereitstellung von strategischem Geschäftswert.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie das CDO-Portfolio von Initiativen in den Bereichen Data Science, Data Platforms and Engineering und Data Governance, um sicherzustellen, dass die Arbeit priorisiert, sequenziert und auf strategische Ziele ausgerichtet ist.

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Portfolio-Roadmaps, integrierten Plänen, Meilensteinansichten und Executive Reporting, um einen klaren Überblick über den Lieferfortschritt und die erwarteten Ergebnisse zu bieten.

• Leiten Sie Portfolioaufnahme, Priorisierung und Entscheidungsprozesse in Partnerschaft mit CDO-Führungskräften und Stakeholdern und balancieren Sie Geschäftswert, Kapazität, Risiko und funktionsübergreifende Abhängigkeiten.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Portfolio Planning & Delivery-Team, um die Portfolioplanung, die Bereitstellungsaufsicht, das Reporting und die Governance-Prozesse im gesamten CDO-Portfolio aufeinander abzustimmen.

• Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Koordination zur Verwaltung von Interdependenzen, zur Lösung von Lieferkonflikten und zur Aufrechterhaltung der Ausführung von Portfolioverpflichtungen.

• Überwachen Sie die Portfoliofinanzen, einschließlich Budgetplanung, Prognose, Ausgabensichtbarkeit und

Ressourcenausrichtung, um ein effektives Anlagemanagement zu unterstützen.

• Unterstützung der Portfolioausführung durch disziplinierte Lieferanten- und Vertragsaufsicht, Beschaffungskoordination und Einhaltung organisatorischer Richtlinien und Zeitpläne.

• Identifizieren, überwachen und eskalieren Sie Risiken, Probleme und Entscheidungen auf Portfolioebene und fördern Sie Minderungsmaßnahmen, um Lieferzeiten und Geschäftsergebnisse zu schützen.

• Bewerten Sie die Performance des Portfolios, die Liefergesundheit und die Nutzenrealisierung und empfehlen Sie

Anpassungen von Prioritäten, Plänen und Governance-Mechanismen zur Verbesserung der Ergebnisse.

Grundqualifikationen

• Bachelor-Abschluss und 6 oder mehr Jahre Portfolio, Programm oder Projektmanagement-Erfahrung

ODER

• High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 8 oder mehr Jahre Portfolio, Programm oder Projektmanagement Erfahrung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• 5+ Jahre Portfolio-, Programm- oder Projektmanagement-Erfahrung in datenzentrierten oder technologiegesteuerten Umgebungen, einschließlich der Rechenschaftspflicht für mehrere gleichzeitige Initiativen in verschiedenen Funktionen.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Portfolio Governance, Intake und Priorisierung, Ressourcenplanung und Risikomanagement, vorzugsweise in Daten-, Analyse- oder Technologieorganisationen.

• Starke Führungsqualitäten in den Bereichen Kommunikation, Organisation und Führung mit der Fähigkeit, die Ausrichtung zwischen den Stakeholdern zu fördern und Status, Risiken und Kompromisse klar zu kommunizieren.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Budgets, Prognosen, Lieferanteneinsätze und Ressourcenpläne in komplexen, matrixisierten Umgebungen zu verwalten.

• Kenntnisse in Portfolio- und Projektmanagement-Tools und Berichtsplattformen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, Lieferung, Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Anlageperformance zu verfolgen.

Kernkompetenzen

• Portfoliostrategie, Priorisierung und Governance

• Executive Stakeholder Kommunikation und Einfluss

• Funktionsübergreifende Planung und Abhängigkeitsmanagement

• Finanzaufsicht und Anpassung der Investitionen

Wer wir sind

Suchen Sie nach einem herausfordernden und inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie einen Unterschied machen können? Bei Zurich vertrauen täglich Millionen von Menschen und Unternehmen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Unsere 53.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit bilden die Grundlage für unseren Erfolg und ermöglichen es Unternehmen und Gemeinschaften, sich einer Welt voller Risiken mit Zuversicht zu stellen. Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie könnten Menschen auf der ganzen Welt dabei helfen. Sie würden ihnen vertrauen und beruhigung geben, indem sie das schützen, was sie am meisten lieben. Es ist eine große Herausforderung, aber Sie werden von einem Weltklasse-Team unterstützt, das daran glaubt, Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr volles Potenzial zu erreichen und unsere Versprechen zu halten. Also sei herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Helfen Sie uns, einen Unterschied zu machen. Bei Zurich sind wir ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir ziehen und halten die besten qualifizierten personen zur verfügung, ohne rücksicht auf rasse, religion, geschlecht, sexuelle orientierung, alter oder behinderung.

#ZCC

Zurich Centre de capacités est à la recherche d'un:

Responsable de la science des données

Aperçu du rôle

Dirige la planification, la gouvernance et la supervision de l'exécution du portefeuille des OEC dans les domaines de la science des données, des plates-formes de données et de l'ingénierie et de la gouvernance des données.

Le rôle consiste à traduire les priorités stratégiques dans une vision intégrée du portefeuille, à orienter l'établissement des priorités et l'harmonisation des investissements, et à donner aux cadres une visibilité sur les progrès, les risques, les dépendances et les résultats.

En étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants de l'ODC et les intervenants interfonctionnels, cette personne permet une gestion de portefeuille disciplinée, une prise de décision éclairée et une prestation uniforme de la valeur opérationnelle stratégique.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger le portefeuille d'initiatives de l'ODC dans les domaines de la science des données, des plates-formes de données et de l'ingénierie, et de la gouvernance des données, en veillant à ce que le travail soit priorisé, séquentiel et aligné sur les objectifs stratégiques.

• Élaborer et tenir à jour des feuilles de route du portefeuille, des plans intégrés, des points de vue sur les jalons et des rapports aux cadres supérieurs afin d'assurer une visibilité claire sur les progrès réalisés et les résultats escomptés.

• Prise de portefeuille, hiérarchisation et processus décisionnels gouvernementaux en partenariat avec les dirigeants et les intervenants de l'ODC, en conciliant la valeur opérationnelle, la capacité, le risque et les dépendances interfonctionnelles.

• Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de planification et de prestation du portefeuille pour harmoniser les processus de planification, de surveillance, de rapport et de gouvernance du portefeuille des OEC.

• Encourager la coordination interfonctionnelle pour gérer les interdépendances, résoudre les conflits d'exécution et soutenir l'exécution par rapport aux engagements du portefeuille.

• Superviser les finances du portefeuille, y compris la planification budgétaire, les prévisions, la visibilité des dépenses, et

alignement des ressources, pour soutenir une gestion efficace des investissements.

• Appuyer l'exécution du portefeuille par la supervision disciplinaire des fournisseurs et des contrats, la coordination des achats et le respect des politiques et des délais organisationnels.

• Identifier, surveiller et intensifier les risques, les enjeux et les décisions au niveau du portefeuille, et orienter les mesures d'atténuation pour protéger les délais d'exécution et les résultats opérationnels.

• Évaluer le rendement du portefeuille, la santé et la réalisation des avantages, et recommander

des ajustements aux priorités, aux plans et aux mécanismes de gouvernance pour améliorer les résultats.

Qualités de base

• Baccalauréat et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience en gestion de portefeuille, de programme ou de projet

OU

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et expérience de 8 ans ou plus en gestion de portefeuille, de programme ou de projet

Qualifications privilégiées

• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de portefeuille, de programme ou de projet dans des environnements axés sur les données ou axés sur la technologie, y compris la reddition de comptes pour de multiples initiatives simultanées entre les fonctions.

• Connaissance approfondie de la gouvernance du portefeuille, de la prise en charge et de l'établissement des priorités, de la planification des ressources et de la gestion des risques, de préférence au sein des organismes de données, d'analyse ou de technologie.

• De solides compétences en communication avec les cadres supérieurs, en organisation et en leadership, avec la capacité de favoriser l'harmonisation entre les intervenants et de communiquer avec clarté le statut, les risques et les compromis.

• Capacité démontrée de gérer les budgets, les prévisions, les engagements des fournisseurs et les plans de ressources dans des environnements complexes et matriciaux.

• Compétence avec les outils de gestion de portefeuille et de projet et les plateformes de rapport, y compris la capacité de suivre la prestation, les dépendances, les risques et le rendement des investissements.

Compétences de base

• Stratégie du portefeuille, hiérarchisation et gouvernance

• Communication et influence des parties prenantes exécutives

• Planification interfonctionnelle et gestion de la dépendance

• Contrôle financier et alignement des investissements

Qui nous sommes

Vous cherchez un environnement de travail stimulant et inspirant où vous pouvez faire une différence? À Zurich, des millions de particuliers et d'entreprises font confiance à nos produits et services chaque jour. Nos 53 000 employés dans le monde entier forment la base de notre succès, permettant aux entreprises et aux communautés de faire face avec confiance à un monde de risque. Imaginez si vous pouviez aider les gens à faire ça partout dans le monde. Vous leur donneriez confiance et assurance en protégeant ce qu'ils aiment le plus. C'est un grand défi, mais vous serez soutenu par une équipe de classe mondiale qui croit en vous aider à atteindre votre plein potentiel et à tenir nos promesses. Alors soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Aidez-nous à faire la différence. À Zurich, nous sommes un employeur à égalité des chances. Nous attirons et conservons les personnes les plus qualifiées disponibles, sans égard à la race/ethnicité, à la religion, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'âge ou au handicap.

jobs.title: RCIS Crop Claims Specialist Iowa
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS is one of the leading crop insurance providers in the U.S. RCIS offers insurance protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 3,600 licensed agents. RCIS offers a wide range of private product coverages, including a diverse selection of named-peril options, supplemental and stand-alone insurance products as well as federal crop insurance plans through the United States Department of Agriculture’s Risk Management Agency. Together with RCIS agents, we protect America’s farmers and ranchers.

Zurich North America is hiring an RCIS Crop Claims Specialist or Claims Crop Field Adjuster I to join our team!

We are open to hiring talent in one of the following locations within- Tama, ,Marshall, Hardin, Hamilton, Webster, Boone counties in Iowa. You must live within 50 miles of these locations to be successful.

If you are ready for a career move, consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers terrific benefits including a bonus plan, 401K match and a second 401K company contribution, flexible work options, summer hours, an excellent work/life balance and a great culture.

Additional responsibilities will include:

- Exercise judgement to determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts, utilizing applicable procedures.

- Exercise judgment to determine policy verification and coverage determination by analyzing applicable coverage for claims and determining whether the loss falls within the coverage.

- Participates in Risk Management Agency initiated reviews and referrals for sake of operations integrity and quality assurance.

- Protect Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential.

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks. And participating in professional societies.

This role will be filled at either the Crop Claims Specialist or Crop Claims Specialist II Level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Crop Claims Specialist Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more months of experience in the agricultural area

- Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date.

- Reliable personal transportation and travel within territory

- RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements: walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs to 50 lbs, work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions.

OR

Crop Claims Specialist II:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the agricultural or the crop insurance industry
AND

- Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program (CAPP) Certification must be obtained within 180 days of hire date

- Personal transportation and travel within assigned territory and travel outside of assigned are to assist with workload(s) , participate on CAT team and/or provide remote assistance for the CROP Claims Care Center calls and/or CCP Claims

Preferred Qualifications for both levels:

- Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills.

- Strong organization, multi-tasking and prioritization skills.

- Intermediate Microsoft office skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $47,000.00 - $77,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Zurigo sta attualmente cercando di aderire al nostro team di Servizi di Assicurazione della Comunità Rurale (RCIS). RCIS è uno dei principali fornitori di assicurazione coltura negli Stati Uniti RCIS offre protezione assicurativa in tutti i 50 stati attraverso una rete nazionale di circa 3.600 agenti autorizzati. RCIS offre una vasta gamma di coperture di prodotti privati, tra cui una vasta selezione di opzioni denominate-peril, prodotti assicurativi complementari e stand-alone e piani di assicurazione colture federali attraverso la United States Department of Agriculture’s Risk Management Agency. Insieme agli agenti della RCIS, proteggiamo gli agricoltori e gli allevatori americani.

Zurigo Nord America sta assumendo un RCIS Crop Claims Specialist o Claims Crop Field Adjuster I per aderire al nostro team!

Siamo aperti all'assunzione di talenti in una delle seguenti sedi all'interno- Tama, Marshall, Hardin, Hamilton, Webster, Boone contee in Iowa. È necessario vivere entro 50 miglia di questi luoghi per avere successo.

Se siete pronti per una mossa di carriera, considerare di lavorare per un'azienda con un'impronta globale che offre grandi benefici, tra cui un piano bonus, 401K match e un secondo 401K contributo aziendale, opzioni di lavoro flessibili, ore estive, un ottimo equilibrio lavoro / vita e una grande cultura.

Ulteriori responsabilità includono:

- Giudizio di esercizio per determinare la responsabilità raccogliendo e analizzando fatti pertinenti, utilizzando procedure applicabili.

- Giudizio di esercizio per determinare la verifica della politica e la determinazione della copertura analizzando la copertura applicabile per i reclami e determinare se la perdita rientra nella copertura.

- I partecipanti a Risk Management Agency hanno avviato recensioni e referral per l'integrità delle operazioni e l'assicurazione della qualità.

- Proteggere la reputazione di Zurigo mantenendo le informazioni riservate.

- Mantenere le conoscenze professionali e tecniche partecipando alle opportunità educative, rimanendo attuali con le tendenze del settore, stabilendo reti personali. E partecipare a società professionali.

Questo ruolo sarà riempito sia al Crop Claims Specialist o Crop Claims Specialist II Level. Il gestore di assunzione determinerà il livello appropriato in base all’esperienza e alle competenze del richiedente selezionato rispetto alle qualifiche elencate per questa posizione.

Rivendicazioni di base specialistiche:

- Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 6 o più mesi di esperienza nell'area agricola

- La certificazione del programma di competenza dell'Aggiustatore di Crop (CAPP) deve essere ottenuta con 180 giorni di data di noleggio.

- Trasporto personale affidabile e viaggi all'interno del territorio

- RCIS Aggiustatore di Crop Requisiti fisici: camminare in campi agricoli fino a 3 miglia, scalare contenitori di stoccaggio agricoli fino a 25 piedi, sollevare 25 lbs a 50 lbs, lavorare all'aperto in diverse temperature / condizioni di acqua.

O

Crop Claims Specialist II:

- Diploma di High School o Equivalent e 4 o più anni di esperienza nell'industria agricola o dell'assicurazione coltura
E

- Programma di Proficienza dell'Aggiustatore di Crop (CAPP) La certificazione deve essere ottenuta entro 180 giorni dalla data di noleggio

- I trasporti e i viaggi personali all'interno del territorio assegnato e i viaggi al di fuori degli assegnati sono di assistere con carico di lavoro, partecipare al team CAT e/o fornire assistenza remota per le chiamate CROP Claims Care Center e/o CCP Claims

Preferite qualifiche per entrambi i livelli:

- Forte capacità verbali, scritte e interpersonali.

- Forte organizzazione, multi-tasking e competenze di priorità.

- Intermedio competenze di ufficio Microsoft

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi. L'intervallo di pagamento indicato è una media nazionale e può variare in base alla posizione. La gamma Salary proposta per questa posizione è $47,000.00 - $77,000.00, con l'ammissibilità bonus di breve termine fissato al 10%.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo in Nord America non discrimina in base a razza, etnia, colore, religione, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, identità di genere, informazioni genetiche, età, disabilità, stato veterano protetto, stato civile, orientamento sessuale, gravidanza o altre caratteristiche protette dalla legge applicabile. Pari opportunità Disabilità del datore di lavoro/vet.

Zurigo è conforme al codice 18 degli Stati Uniti § 1033.

Nota bene: Zurigo non accetta CV non richiesti dalle agenzie. I fornitori preferiti dovrebbero utilizzare il nostro Recruiting Agency Portal.

- RCIS Crop Adjuster Physische Anforderungen: Gehen Sie auf landwirtschaftlichen Feldern bis zu 3 Meilen, klettern Sie auf landwirtschaftliche Lagerbehälter bis zu 25 Fuß, heben Sie 25 lbs bis 50 lbs, arbeiten Sie im Freien unter unterschiedlichen Temperaturen / Wetterbedingungen.

ODER

- High School Diplom oder Äquivalent und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in der Landwirtschaft oder der Ernteversicherung
UND

- Starke verbale, schriftliche und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.

- Starke Organisation, Multitasking und Priorisierungskompetenzen.

jobs.title: Claims Specialist II, Workers Compensation
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is seeking a skilled and experienced Claims Specialist II to join our dynamic Workers Compensation team. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact by delivering exceptional claims service and applying your expertise within a respected, industry leading organization.

We are seeking someone who can collaborate in person at our Maitland, FL office on a hybrid work schedule. If you’re looking to grow your career with a company that values excellence, innovation, and flexibility, we’d love to hear from you.

The Workers Compensation Claims Specialist will handle multi-party commercial line Workman’s Compensation claims of moderate to high exposure and complexity within specific authority limits, to ensure that claims are handled in the most efficient, effective way while delivering a customer-centric claims service.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Document claims file by accurately capturing and updating claims data/information in compliance with best practices for commercial line claims of moderate to high exposure and complexity.

- Exercise judgment to determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts; utilizing applicable law; establishing basic principles of negligence.

- Exercise judgment to determine policy verification and coverage determination by analyzing applicable coverage for claims and determining whether the loss falls within the coverage.

- Work to have a timely resolution to claims by developing case strategy; developing a case evaluation; escalating issues as appropriate.

- Establish timely reserves and perform ongoing review throughout claims cycle within authority limit by estimating and validating value of claims.

- Assess damages by calculating applicable damages or range of damages allowed by law.

- Negotiate settlement of claim by establishing appropriate negotiation strategy and utilizing available tools and resources within authority limits.

- Meet quality standards by following best practices

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree with 3 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.
OR

- Completion of Zurich Claims Training Program and 3 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.
OR

- High School Diploma Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.
AND

- Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s)

- Microsoft Office experience

- Knowledge of insurance regulations, markets and products

Preferred Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience handling claims with medium to high severity and exposure

- 3+ years of Litigation Management experience

- Jurisdictional expertise handling claims in FL

- Valid adjuster license in FL

- Claims handling experience working for a carrier

- Effective verbal and written communication skills

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem solving skills

- Solid time management, prioritization and multi-tasking skills

- Experience collaborating in a team environment and building cross functional working relationships

- Adept in identifying and explaining complex financial and/or actuarial concepts.

- Ability to determine the scope and exposure for moderately complex claims

- Demonstrates understanding of the reserving process for indemnity and expense in analyzing the potential exposure of moderately complex claims

- Ability to develop and execute a negotiation strategy and plan for resolution

- Ability to identify subtleties in customer/client and/or business partner interactions

- Ability to present information necessary to propose a claim resolution to stakeholders

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $59,900.00 - $98,200.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Der Workers Compensation Claims Specialist wird Workmans Compensationsansprüche von mäßiger bis hoher Exposition und Komplexität innerhalb spezifischer Behördengrenzen behandeln, um sicherzustellen, dass Ansprüche auf die effizienteste und effektivste Weise behandelt werden, während ein kundenorientierter Schadensdienst bereitgestellt wird.

- Beurteilen Sie den Schaden, indem Sie den anwendbaren Schaden oder die gesetzlich zulässige Schadensspanne berechnen.

- Verhandeln Sie die Beilegung von Ansprüchen, indem Sie eine angemessene Verhandlungsstrategie festlegen und verfügbare Werkzeuge und Ressourcen innerhalb der Zuständigkeitsgrenzen nutzen.

jobs.title: Senior Liability Trial Attorney
jobs.description:
Zurich is looking for a Sr. Liability Trial Attorney to join our in-house Staff Legal team. This Trial Attorney will be responsible for representing the commercial insureds of a prestigious and financially stable commercial insurance carrier, by preparing and trying high complexity, high exposure General Liability and Commercial Auto personal injury cases.

At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report out of Zurich’s Maitland Florida office in the Orlando area or work from home in the Tampa Florida area and will handle cases in central Florida, Jacksonville and the Florida panhandle.

Ready for a career move? Consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers an incentive plan, terrific benefits including a dollar -for- dollar 401K Match and a second 401K contribution, flexible work options, a hybrid work schedule and a great culture.

The selected candidate will perform duties encompassing all aspects of insurance defense, including initial investigation and legal analysis and advice, preparing and filing legal pleadings and documents, performing legal research, preparing for and conducting pre-trial discovery, preparing for and aggressively handling hearings and trials, and conducting post-trial activities where appropriate. We look for demonstrated case analysis ability and a track record of proven trial and negotiation skills, along with the ability to work independently and without substantial supervision. The successful candidate must have strong computer skills and be able to handle remote team based work which requires them to use video conferencing, task assignments and other computer based systems.

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 7 or more years of experience in the Litigation area

AND

- Member of the Bar in good standing in jurisdiction(s) in which practice is located.

- Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe

- Experience working with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience handling insurance industry claims and general commercial litigation, including but not limited to wrongful death, commercial motor vehicle torts, products and premises liability, and personal injury, from inception through trial.

- Must be well organized with good analytical skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, proactive approach to file handling and caseloads, and able to work independently as well as within a team environment.

Non stai cercando il caso semplice, ma la profondità professionale? In questo ruolo, si assume la responsabilità di esigere i casi di prestazioni nelle pensioni professionali – dove i principi normativi, le norme legali, le valutazioni mediche e i temi di coordinamento si uniscono ad altri regimi di assicurazione sociale. Vuoi davvero capire i casi, identificare le connessioni e prendere decisioni informate che sono notevolmente importanti per i nostri clienti.

Il nostro servizio BVG garantisce la gestione professionale dei benefici nel settore della disabilità e della morte in tutta la Svizzera. In qualità di esperto nei servizi BVG, siete strettamente connessi alla questione della pensione – dall'esame di un possibile diritto pensionistico alla cura continua dei pensionati. Assicurarsi che le richieste di prestazioni siano elaborate correttamente, tracciabilmente e prontamente. Ciò che conta qui non è solo la vostra competenza e il vostro pensiero analitico, ma anche il vostro senso di diverse situazioni di vita. Comunichi chiaramente, comprensibilmente ed empaticamente – soprattutto quando la questione è difficile per coloro che sono interessati a capire.

Con noi troverete una variegata attività in un ambiente dinamico con molta responsabilità personale. Viviamo Flexwork e vi offriamo un luogo di lavoro ibrido – in modo flessibile nell'ufficio o presso la sede di Zurigo-Oerlikon, coordinato con il vostro team. Se combini qualità, efficienza e collaborazione e vuoi plasmare attivamente i nostri processi di performance, non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come servizi esperti BVG.

Cosa fai

- Elaborerai le prestazioni di invalidità e di morte nel regime pensionistico professionale (BVG) correttamente e tempestivamente e sono responsabili del pagamento.

- Si esamina e valuta aspetti legali e medici, nonché l'attuazione tecnica di ogni caso di beneficio.

- Lavori a stretto contatto con altre compagnie di assicurazione sociale, chiarisci le questioni di coordinamento

- Lei calcola i servizi in base alle disposizioni normative e legali.

- Scrivere e elaborare corrispondenza esigente con i clienti, le istituzioni pensioni, le autorità, i broker e gli avvocati – sia per iscritto che per via orale.

- Formare e migliorare attivamente i processi e portare le proprie idee per un ulteriore sviluppo.

Cosa porti

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel settore del BVG, preferibilmente nella lavorazione dei servizi.

- Una formazione commerciale completa, maturità ginnasio, una tessera di previdenza sociale o personale o una scuola tecnica superiore.

- Gestione sicura di varie applicazioni IT e apertura agli strumenti digitali.

- Tedesco stilistico nella parola e nella scrittura; Ogni altra lingua nazionale è un vantaggio.

- Responsabilità personale, efficienza e divertimento di lavorare insieme in un team.

Il tuo contatto

Consulente per l'acquisizione di talenti senior: Bernd Makasy (044 628 42 14)

Siete invitati a convincerci della vostra motivazione durante un incontro personale.

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere meglio se stessi dai loro rischi. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. Our BVG service ensures the professional handling of benefits in the area of disability and death throughout Switzerland. You ensure that performance claims are processed correctly, traceably and promptly. jobs.title: Casualty Underwriter - Vancouver or Calgary
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in insurance underwriting, customer relationship management, or a related field and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Casualty Underwriter in our Vancouver or Calgary office to analyze and underwrite new and renewal business, regularly interact with the market, and deliver exceptional service to customers.

Reporting to the AVP Liability Manager, Western Region, you will work closely with agents, brokers, and customers to understand their insurance needs, support sales initiatives, and ensure underwriting guidelines and risk assessment standards are met. You will use The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority, supporting both retention and new business growth while gaining hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules, rating manuals, and insurance laws/regulations.

- Build and maintain relationships with distributors (agents and brokers) to support business retention and growth.

- Collaborate with business line representatives to support customer needs.

- Identify and qualify new business and renewal opportunities.

- Analyze exposures, measure risk, and negotiate terms and conditions.

- Calculate and quote target prices using Zurich’s underwriting tools.

- Promote Zurich’s products and services to agents, brokers, and customers.

- Support sales culture as a Help Point for distributors and clients.

- Participate in sales meetings and target account planning.

- Update systems with details of broker/client visits and account statuses.

- Provide technical expertise and clear explanations for underwriting decisions.

- Resolve technical and operational issues by referring to policies and procedures.

- Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory controls governing work practices.

- Travel for business and work extended hours during peak periods, as required.

- Maintain a valid driver’s license.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent, with 1 or more years of experience in Insurance or Market-Facing areas (Claims/Underwriting Support, or relevant experience for specialized lines)

OR

-
High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in Claims or Underwriting Support area

AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal/regulatory environment

- Understanding of underwriting philosophy, techniques, and filing regulations

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Relationship-building, active listening, and negotiation skills

- Microsoft Office proficiency

Preferred:

- Bachelor’s Degree with 1 or more years of underwriting experience

- Financial acumen and analytical skills

- Presentation skills and a solutions/service orientation

Compensation for roles at Zurich varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. The salary range provided is a nationwide market range and has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Compensation may exceed the range listed based on the evaluation of skillset and experience. The starting salary range for this position is $62,500 - $80,000.

Our Culture

-

At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.

We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.

We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.

We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.

We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time, and resources.

We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here. If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here. Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.co

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Remote working:

- Schedule: Full Time

- Closing date:

jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster I to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents.

This is a great opportunity to serve the agricultural community.

Zurich is looking for an RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster to work out of Minnesota state. This incumbent will work from a home-based office. This position is scheduled to work 40 hours per week. Approximately 50% travel is expected to cover the territory.

The ideal candidate will need to live within and service these following counties in Minnesota: Kittson, Marshall, Pennington, Roseau.

As a Crop Adjuster, your primary responsibilities will include:

- With minimal supervision, completes field inspections and related responsibilities such as reading maps and aerial photos, measuring fields, storage bins, and discussing findings of crop loss with farmers on the most complex non-routine, problematic claims including controversial claims.

- Ability to convey complex regulations and interpretations to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.

- Performs fact finding regarding crop damage, records information and transmits loss information to accurately determine potential indemnities.

- Gather relevant facts, utilizing applicable law and establishing basic principles of negligence.

- Complete claim reviews and audits on lower-level adjusters as assigned.

- Ensure legal compliance by maintaining a strong working knowledge of regulatory and company policies and procedures.

- Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more months of experience in the agricultural area

- Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date

- Reliable personal transportation and travel within territory

- Valid Driver’s License

- RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements:walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs. to 50 lbs., work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions

Preferred Qualifications:

- Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

- Strong organization and prioritization skills

- Experience as a Crop Claims Field Adjuster

- Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. For this position, the hourly rate is $22.40-$30.87, plus a short-term incentive bonus of 5%

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. - Capacité de transmettre des règlements et des interprétations complexes aux demandeurs, aux mandataires et aux gens de l'industrie qui ont présenté des demandes.

- Licence de conducteur valide

- Régulateur de culture du RISC Exigences physiques: marcher dans des champs agricoles jusqu'à 3 miles, monter des bacs de stockage agricole jusqu'à 25 pieds, soulever 25 lb à 50 lb, travailler à l'extérieur dans des températures et conditions météorologiques variables

- Excellentes compétences en communication verbale, écrite et interpersonnelle

- Compétences solides en matière d'organisation et de hiérarchisation

- Compétences intermédiaires de Microsoft Office

Job Summary

Provide support in relation to activities to ensure the business areas have accurate data on which to monitor and improve sales performance, meet compliance, governance requirements and support the activities development and operation of wider projects and business as usual activity to ensure the wider sales function is operating effectively and efficiently.

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Accounting, Management, or a related field.

- 3–5+ years of experience in Life Insurance Operations, Policy Administration, Unit Link Operations, Payment Operations, or Policy Services, with supervisory experience preferred.

- Strong understanding of Unit Link products, policy servicing processes, premium/payment operations, insurance regulations, and operational risk controls.

- Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, and insurance core systems, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

- Support, manage, develop, implement and deliver the plan via key strategies to aid the overall success of the business.

- Resolve complex queries-errors and ensure problems are resolved quickly and efficiently.

- Analysis of business performance and results in sales and comparison of results with defined outcomes.

- Coordinate, plan and implement measures as well as assisting in projects.

- Support the implementation of sales initiatives, networks, events and systems, execute the liaison between the field and internal areas on customers issues and maintaining management data in systems.

- Support specific and more complex customer management activities.

- Prepare customer reports and other information for key meetings.

- Investigate research-analysis around potential business development opportunities.

- Carry out tasks, such as the preparation of customer reports, to support the implementation of projects to time and quality standards.

- Work with Sales and Distribution teams to ensure effective on-going sales performance.

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!

Sintesi del lavoro

Fornire supporto in relazione alle attività per garantire che le aree aziendali abbiano dati accurati su cui monitorare e migliorare le prestazioni di vendita, soddisfare la conformità, i requisiti di governance e sostenere lo sviluppo e il funzionamento delle attività di progetti e business più ampi come attività abituale per garantire che la più ampia funzione di vendita sia operativa in modo efficace ed efficiente.

Qualifiche di lavoro

- Laurea in Business Administration, finanza, assicurazione, contabilità, gestione o un campo relativo.

- 3-5 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni di assicurazione sulla vita, amministrazione delle politiche, operazioni di collegamento unità, operazioni di pagamento o servizi politici, con esperienza di supervisione preferita.

- Forte comprensione dei prodotti Unit Link, dei processi di manutenzione delle politiche, delle operazioni di premio/pagamento, delle norme di assicurazione e dei controlli di rischio operativi.

- Ottima leadership, gestione degli stakeholder, gestione del progetto, analitiche e capacità di problem solving.

- Proficiente in Microsoft Excel, strumenti di reporting e sistemi di core di assicurazione, con la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente veloce.

Capacità di lavoro - Capacità di contabilità chiave

- Supporto, gestire, sviluppare, implementare e fornire il piano attraverso strategie chiave per aiutare il successo generale del business.

- Risolvere query-errors complessi e garantire i problemi vengono risolti in modo rapido ed efficiente.

- Analisi delle prestazioni aziendali e dei risultati nelle vendite e confronto dei risultati con risultati definiti.

- Coordinare, pianificare e attuare misure, nonché assistere in progetti.

- Sostenere l'implementazione di iniziative di vendita, reti, eventi e sistemi, eseguire il collegamento tra il campo e le aree interne sulle questioni dei clienti e mantenere i dati di gestione nei sistemi.

- Supporta attività specifiche e più complesse di gestione dei clienti.

- Preparare i rapporti dei clienti e altre informazioni per le riunioni chiave.

- Indagare la ricerca-analisi intorno a potenziali opportunità di sviluppo aziendale.

- Effettuare attività, come la preparazione delle relazioni con i clienti, per sostenere l'attuazione di progetti a standard di tempo e qualità.

- Lavora con i team di vendita e distribuzione per garantire prestazioni di vendita in corso efficaci.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Stellenbeschreibung

Unterstützung in Bezug auf Aktivitäten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Geschäftsbereiche über genaue Daten verfügen, um die Vertriebsleistung zu überwachen und zu verbessern, Compliance- und Governance-Anforderungen zu erfüllen und die Entwicklung und den Betrieb breiterer Projekte und Business as usual-Aktivitäten zu unterstützen, um sicherzustellen, dass die breitere Vertriebsfunktion effektiv und effizient funktioniert.

Berufsqualifikationen

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen, Versicherung, Buchhaltung, Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.

- 3–5+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Life Insurance Operations, Policy Administration, Unit Link Operations, Payment Operations oder Policy Services mit bevorzugter Aufsichtserfahrung.

- Starkes Verständnis von Unit Link-Produkten, Policy-Service-Prozessen, Prämien- / Zahlungsvorgängen, Versicherungsvorschriften und betrieblichen Risikokontrollen.

- Ausgezeichnete Führung, Stakeholder-Management, Projektmanagement, analytische und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Reporting-Tools und Versicherungs-Kernsysteme, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

- Unterstützen, verwalten, entwickeln, implementieren und liefern Sie den Plan über Schlüsselstrategien, um den Gesamterfolg des Unternehmens zu unterstützen.

- Lösen Sie komplexe Abfragefehler und stellen Sie sicher, dass Probleme schnell und effizient gelöst werden.

- Analyse der Geschäftsleistung und der Ergebnisse im Verkauf und Vergleich der Ergebnisse mit definierten Ergebnissen.

- Koordination, Planung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen sowie Unterstützung bei Projekten.

- Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Verkaufsinitiativen, Netzwerken, Veranstaltungen und Systemen, Durchführung der Verbindung zwischen dem Feld und internen Bereichen zu Kundenfragen und Pflege von Managementdaten in Systemen.

- Unterstützen Sie spezifische und komplexere Kundenmanagementaktivitäten.

- Bereiten Sie Kundenberichte und andere Informationen für wichtige Meetings vor.

- Untersuchen Sie Forschungsanalysen zu potenziellen Geschäftsentwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

- Durchführung von Aufgaben, wie die Erstellung von Kundenberichten, um die Umsetzung von Projekten nach Zeit- und Qualitätsstandards zu unterstützen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Vertriebs- und Vertriebsteams zusammen, um eine effektive laufende Verkaufsleistung zu gewährleisten.

jobs.title: Workers Compensation Claims Specialist (NE Region)
jobs.description:
Zurich is looking for an accomplished Workers Compensation Claims Specialist II for our Northeast region. This position offers a hybrid work schedule from our Parsippany or Boston offices, or a fully remote setup based in one of the following states: Connecticut, Delaware, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, or West Virginia.

The Workers Compensation Claims Specialist will handle multi-party commercial line Workman’s Compensation claims of low to high exposure and complexity within specific authority limits, to ensure that claims are handled in the most efficient, effective way while delivering a customer-centric claims service.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Document claims file by accurately capturing and updating claims data/information in compliance with best practices for low to moderate exposure and complexity personal or commercial line claims.

- Exercise judgement to determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts; utilizing applicable law; establishing basic principles of negligence.

- Exercise judgment to determine policy verification and coverage determination by analyzing applicable coverage for claims and determining whether the loss falls within the coverage.

- Work to have a timely resolution to claims by developing case strategy; developing a case evaluation; escalating issues as appropriate.

- Establish timely reserves and perform ongoing review throughout claims cycle within authority limit by estimating and validating value of claims.

- Assess damages by calculating applicable damages or range of damages allowed by law.

- Negotiate settlement of claim by establishing appropriate negotiation strategy and utilizing available tools and resources within authority limits.

- Meet quality standards by following best practices.

- Ensure customer service by proactively communicating information; responding to inquiries; following customer protocols and may participating in customer marketing efforts.

- Manage expenses by working within vendor approved networks and managing scope of work assigned to outside contractors. Departs from approved vendors with manager approval, where in the best interests of the insured.

- Ensure legal compliance by following state and federal laws and regulations and internal control requirements.

- Refer claim to subrogation and fraud teams by identifying potential subrogation and fraud.

- Contribute to profitable growth by providing risk insight, information and trends to Business Unit or customer as needed.

- Protect Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential.

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks. And participating in professional societies.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in Claims or Insurance area
OR

- Completion of Zurich Claims Training Program and 2 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area
AND

- Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s)

- Knowledge of insurance regulations, markets and products

- Microsoft Office experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- 4+ years of experience in the Workers Compensation line of business

- 3+ years of experience handling litigation management

- Specialization in PA jurisdiction with knowledge of NJ and/or VA jurisdictions

- Learn and handle additional jurisdictions as needed

- EDI filing requirements

- MSA/Medicare knowledge

- WCCA, WCCP Designations

- Knowledge and skill of claims handling

- Negotiation experience

- Experience in line of business

- Excellent communication skills

- Analytical skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $59,900.00 - $98,200.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.
