descriptionByLocale.fr:
Spécialiste Support en indemnités journalières maladie DE/FR en assurances de personnes (h/f/d) 80–100%

Es-tu passionné(e) par le système de santé et d’assurance sociale ? Tu travailles déjà dans le domaine de l’assurance indemnités journalières, ou tu souhaites découvrir ce secteur captivant ? Tu as le sens du service client et tu parles couramment l’allemand et le français ?

Au sein de ton équipe, tu garantis des prestations de qualité pour nos entreprises clientes et nos assurés. En tant que premier point de contact pour les dossiers d’indemnités journalières en Suisse, l’équipe support veille à ce que les cas soient rapidement enregistrés dans le système et traités efficacement dans des segments définis. Tu évolues dans un environnement dynamique, entouré(e) de collègues motivé(e)s, qui offrent chaque jour un service exceptionnel à nos clientes et clients.

Si tu fais preuve d’une orientation client prononcée, d’une grande rapidité d’apprentissage, et si l’esprit d’équipe et l’autonomie sont tes atouts, alors nous avons besoin de toi !

Découvre ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse fait partie du "Top 3" du prix du “Meilleur employeur” en Suisse. Deviens-en membre également et postule en tant que Spécialiste Support en indemnités journalières maladie DE/FR en assurances de personnes.

Ce que tu fais

- Tu traites des dossiers d’indemnités journalières en assurance maladie en allemand et en français et tu garantis une gestion correcte des prestations.

- Tu vérifies la couverture d’assurance et tu calcules les indemnités journalières.

- Tu obtiens des informations écrites et téléphoniques auprès de nos clientes et clients dans toute la Suisse, en allemand et en français.

- Tu crées de nouveaux dossiers de prestations dans le système.

Ce que tu apportes

- Tu as terminé une formation commerciale ou médicale, ou tu possèdes une qualification équivalente.

- Tu es motivé(e), autonome et tu sais transmettre ton enthousiasme.

- Tu es un(e) véritable joueur(se) d’équipe et tu apprends rapidement.

- Tu fais preuve d’un comportement professionnel et d’un sens prononcé du service.

- Tu maîtrises parfaitement l’allemand (B2) et le français (niveau C1/C2).

Ton contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Informations complémentaires

Ce poste est disponible à temps partiel ou à temps plein: 80 - 100%.

Lieu: Lausanne, Crissier

Travail hybride: jusqu’ à 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Nous attendons avec impatience de recevoir ta candidature en ligne - même sans lettre de motivation. Tu pourras nous convaincre de ta motivation lors d'un entretien personnel.

Qui nous sommes

Zurich est une marque forte – plus de 1,4 million de clientes et clients en Suisse font confiance à nos produits et services. Notre succès, nous le devons principalement à nos 53'000 employés qui, répartis dans 210 pays et territoires, aident nos clients à comprendre les risques et à s’en prémunir. Pour être le plus performant possible, nous offrons à nos collaborateurs un modèle de travail flexible et de nombreuses opportunités de formations continues. En tant qu’employé de Zurich tu profites de nombreux avantages et d’une culture d’entreprise très positive basée sur l’acceptation, la diversité et l’esprit d’équipe.

Chez Zurich, nous favorisons une culture basée sur la diversité et l’inclusion. Nos objectifs et nos valeurs sont conçus pour protéger, inspirer confiance et aider nos employés à atteindre leur potentiel. Nous valorisons et défendons ce qui est juste et mettons en avant l’équité pour tous, sans distinction de genre, handicap, identité sexuelle, race, appartenance ethnique, génération, croyances, etc. Nos processus respectent cet engagement au quotidien, aussi bien dans la recherche de talents qu’au niveau du recrutement. Fais partie de cette culture en rejoignant Zurich.

Pourquoi Zurich connaît-elle le succès depuis plus de 150 ans ? Découvre notre histoire et rejoins-la.

Information aux agences de recrutement

Zurich n'accepte aucune candidature soumise de leur propre chef par les agences de recrutement pour ce poste. Nous demandons aux agences de recrutement de ne transmettre aucun document de candidature que ce soit à nos collaborateurs/trices ou par le biais de notre portail carrière online. Nous déclinons toute responsabilité concernant des candidatures non sollicitées ainsi que d'éventuels honoraires qui en découleraient. Nous te remercions de ta compréhension.

Postuler »
descriptionByLocale.it:
Specialista Assistenza giornaliera di malattia DE/FR in assicurazione personale (h/f/d) 80–100%

Sei appassionato del sistema di assicurazione sanitaria e sociale? Lavori già nell'ambito dell'assicurazione giornaliera, o vuoi scoprire questo settore emozionante? Hai un senso del servizio clienti e parli fluentemente tedesco e francese?

All'interno del vostro team, garantite servizi di qualità per le nostre aziende clienti e le nostre assicurazioni. Come primo punto di contatto per i file di indennità giornaliera in Svizzera, il team di supporto assicura che i casi siano rapidamente registrati nel sistema e gestiti efficacemente in segmenti definiti. Lei opera in un ambiente dinamico, circondato da colleghi motivati, che offrono un servizio eccezionale ai nostri clienti ogni giorno.

Se si mostra un forte orientamento del cliente, una grande velocità di apprendimento, e se lo spirito di squadra e l'autonomia sono i vostri beni, allora abbiamo bisogno di voi!

Scopri perché Zurigo Svizzera fa parte del prezzo "Top 3" del miglior datore di lavoro in Svizzera. Diventa membro anche e si applica come supporto specialistico nelle prestazioni di malattia giornaliere DE/FR in assicurazione personale.

Che cosa fai

- Elabori le prestazioni di assicurazione sanitaria giornaliere in tedesco e francese e garantisci una corretta gestione delle prestazioni.

- Controlla la copertura assicurativa e calcola le indennità giornaliere.

- Lei ottiene informazioni scritte e telefoniche dai nostri clienti in tutta la Svizzera, in tedesco e in francese.

- Stai creando nuovi file di benefici nel sistema.

Cosa porti

- Hai completato la formazione commerciale o medica, o hai una qualifica equivalente.

- Siete motivati, autonomi, e sapete come trasmettere il vostro entusiasmo.

- Sei un vero giocatore e impari velocemente.

- Hai un atteggiamento professionale e un forte senso di servizio.

- Ha il comando perfetto di tedesco (B2) e francese (livello C1/C2).

Il tuo contatto

Consulente per l'acquisizione di talenti senior: Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Ulteriori informazioni

Questa posizione è disponibile a tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%.

Ubicazione: Losanna, Crissier

Lavoro ibrido: fino al 40%

#LI-Hybrid #

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda online - anche senza una lettera di copertura. Potete convincerci della vostra motivazione in un colloquio personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti in Svizzera si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. Il nostro successo è dovuto principalmente ai nostri 53.000 dipendenti, che, in 210 paesi e territori, aiutano i nostri clienti a comprendere i rischi e proteggerli. Per essere il più efficiente possibile, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un modello di lavoro flessibile e molte opportunità di formazione continua. Come dipendente di Zurigo si godono molti vantaggi e una cultura aziendale molto positiva basata su accettazione, diversità e lavoro di squadra.

A Zurigo, promuoviamo una cultura basata sulla diversità e l'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere, ispirare la fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro potenziale. Valoriamo e difendiamo ciò che è giusto e promuoviamo l'equità per tutti, indipendentemente dal sesso, dalla disabilità, dall'identità di genere, dalla razza, dall'etnia, dalla generazione, dalle convinzioni, ecc. I nostri processi rispettano questo impegno ogni giorno, sia nella ricerca del talento che nel reclutamento. Partecipa a questa cultura unendo Zurigo.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Scopri la nostra storia e unisciti.

Informazioni alle agenzie di reclutamento

Zurigo non accetta alcuna domanda presentata di propria iniziativa dalle agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Chiediamo alle agenzie di reclutamento di non inviare documenti applicativi ai nostri dipendenti o tramite il nostro portale di carriera online. Rifiutiamo ogni responsabilità per le applicazioni non richieste e qualsiasi costo derivante da loro. Vi ringraziamo per la vostra comprensione.

Richiedi »
descriptionByLocale.en:
Specialist Daily sickness allowance support DE/FR in personal insurance (h/f/d) 80–100%

Are you passionate about the health and social insurance system? Do you already work in the area of daily allowances insurance, or do you want to discover this exciting sector? Do you have a sense of customer service and speak fluently German and French?

Within your team, you guarantee quality services for our client companies and our insureds. As the first point of contact for daily allowance files in Switzerland, the support team ensures that cases are quickly recorded in the system and handled effectively in defined segments. You operate in a dynamic environment, surrounded by motivated colleagues, who offer exceptional service to our clients every day.

If you show a strong customer orientation, a great speed of learning, and if team spirit and autonomy are your assets, then we need you!

Find out why Zurich Switzerland is part of the "Top 3" price of the best employer in Switzerland. Become a member also and apply as a Specialist Support in daily sickness benefits DE/FR in personal insurance.

What You Do

- You process daily health insurance benefits in German and French and guarantee proper management of benefits.

- You check the insurance coverage and calculate the daily allowances.

- You obtain written and telephone information from our clients throughout Switzerland, in German and French.

- You're creating new benefit files in the system.

What you bring

- You have completed commercial or medical training, or you have an equivalent qualification.

- You are motivated, autonomous, and you know how to convey your enthusiasm.

- You are a real player and you learn quickly.

- You have a professional attitude and a strong sense of service.

- You have perfect command of German (B2) and French (level C1/C2).

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Further information

This position is available part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%.

Location: Lausanne, Crissier

Hybrid work: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to receiving your application online - even without a cover letter. You can convince us of your motivation in a personal interview.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million customers in Switzerland trust our products and services. Our success is due mainly to our 53,000 employees, who, in 210 countries and territories, help our clients understand the risks and protect them. To be as efficient as possible, we offer our employees a flexible work model and many opportunities for continuous training. As an employee of Zurich you enjoy many advantages and a very positive corporate culture based on acceptance, diversity and teamwork.

At Zurich, we promote a culture based on diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees reach their potential. We value and defend what is right and promote equity for all, regardless of gender, disability, gender identity, race, ethnicity, generation, beliefs, etc. Our processes respect this commitment on a daily basis, both in the search for talent and in recruitment. Be part of this culture by joining Zurich.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? Discover our story and join it.

Information to recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications submitted on its own initiative by the recruitment agencies for this position. We ask recruitment agencies not to submit any application documents to our employees or through our online career portal. We disclaim any liability for unsolicited applications and any fees resulting from them. We thank you for your understanding.

Apply »

Spezialisierte tägliche Krankengeldunterstützung DE / FR in der persönlichen Versicherung (h / f / d) 80-100%

Sie interessieren sich für das Gesundheits- und Sozialversicherungssystem? Arbeiten Sie bereits im Bereich der Tagegeldversicherung oder möchten Sie diese spannende Branche entdecken? Haben Sie einen Sinn für Kundenservice und sprechen fließend Deutsch und Französisch?

Innerhalb Ihres Teams garantieren Sie qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen für unsere Kundenunternehmen und unsere Versicherten. Als erster Ansprechpartner für Tagesgeldakten in der Schweiz sorgt das Supportteam dafür, dass Fälle schnell im System erfasst und in definierten Segmenten effektiv bearbeitet werden. Sie arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld, umgeben von motivierten Kollegen, die unseren Kunden jeden Tag einen außergewöhnlichen Service bieten.

Wenn Sie eine starke Kundenorientierung, eine hohe Lerngeschwindigkeit zeigen und wenn Teamgeist und Autonomie Ihr Kapital sind, dann brauchen wir Sie!

Erfahren Sie, warum Zürich Schweiz Teil des „Top 3 Preises des besten Arbeitgebers der Schweiz ist. Werden Sie auch Mitglied und bewerben Sie sich als Spezialist für tägliche Krankengeld DE / FR in der Personenversicherung.

Was Sie tun

- Sie verarbeiten die täglichen Krankenversicherungsleistungen in deutscher und französischer Sprache und garantieren eine ordnungsgemäße Verwaltung der Leistungen.

- Sie überprüfen den Versicherungsschutz und berechnen die Tagesgelder.

- Sie erhalten schriftliche und telefonische Informationen von unseren Kunden in der ganzen Schweiz, auf Deutsch und Französisch.

- Sie erstellen neue Benefit-Dateien im System.

Was du mitbringst

- Sie haben eine kaufmännische oder medizinische Ausbildung abgeschlossen oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.

- Sie sind motiviert, autonom und wissen, wie Sie Ihre Begeisterung vermitteln können.

- Du bist ein echter Spieler und lernst schnell.

- Sie haben eine professionelle Einstellung und einen starken Sinn für Service.

- Sie beherrschen perfekt Deutsch (B2) und Französisch (Level C1/C2).

Ihr Kontakt

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Manuela Trezzini (+41 44 628 32 25)

Weitere Informationen

Diese Position ist in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit verfügbar: 80 - 100%.

Standort: Lausanne, Crissier

Hybridarbeit: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung online – auch ohne Anschreiben. Sie können uns in einem persönlichen Interview von Ihrer Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zürich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Kunden in der Schweiz vertrauen unseren Produkten und Dienstleistungen. Unser Erfolg ist vor allem unseren 53.000 Mitarbeitern zu verdanken, die in 210 Ländern und Territorien unseren Kunden helfen, die Risiken zu verstehen und sie zu schützen. Um so effizient wie möglich zu sein, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitern ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell und viele Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung. Als Mitarbeiter von Zurich genießen Sie viele Vorteile und eine sehr positive Unternehmenskultur, die auf Akzeptanz, Vielfalt und Teamwork basiert.

Bei Zurich fördern wir eine Kultur, die auf Vielfalt und Inklusion basiert. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind darauf ausgerichtet, zu schützen, Vertrauen zu schaffen und unseren Mitarbeitern zu helfen, ihr Potenzial zu erreichen. Wir schätzen und verteidigen, was richtig ist und fördern Gerechtigkeit für alle, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Behinderung, Geschlechtsidentität, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Generation, Überzeugungen usw. Unsere Prozesse respektieren dieses Engagement täglich, sowohl bei der Suche nach Talenten als auch bei der Rekrutierung. Werden Sie Teil dieser Kultur, indem Sie Zürich beitreten.

Warum ist Zürich seit mehr als 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Entdecken Sie unsere Geschichte und schließen Sie sich ihr an.

Est-ce tu parles français? Parli inglese? Parli Itailano? Sei un talento linguistico e affascinato dall'interazione tra regolamentazione dei casi di performance e comunicazione con una vasta gamma di stakeholder e partner? Ti piace assumerti la responsabilità e vuoi essere la persona di contatto diretta per i nostri clienti?

Nell'ambito di un team di 11 membri, insieme ai vostri colleghi, valuterete i casi di performance nel settore dei bagagli, dei costi di cancellazione e della protezione dei viaggi e fornire così un eccellente servizio di richiesta ai nostri clienti.

Se ti spinge anche a essere in grado di aiutare le persone in un'emergenza, sei un tipo di doer e fai attivamente tutto il possibile con il team, allora questa è la tua prossima opportunità di carriera.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e si applica come un aiuto di danno esperto.

Cosa fai

- Lei è responsabile del trattamento dei crediti di viaggio privato

- Lavori su casi di danno in diverse lingue

- Hai un contatto telefonico e scritto regolarmente

- Si comunica con interfacce come partner e agenzie di viaggio

- Supporti i servizi di sottoscrizione e di assistenza sul campo

Cosa porti

- Assicurazione o servizio istruzione e formazione

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel settore assicurativo, viaggi, turismo o auto

jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS is one of the leading crop insurance providers in the U.S. RCIS offers insurance protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 3,600 licensed agents. RCIS offers a wide range of private product coverages, including a diverse selection of named-peril options, supplemental and stand-alone insurance products as well as federal crop insurance plans through the United States Department of Agriculture’s Risk Management Agency. Together with RCIS agents, we protect America’s farmers and ranchers.

Zurich is currently looking for an RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster II to work out of the state of Kansas. This incumbent will work from a home-based office. This position is scheduled to work 40 hours per week. Approximately 50% travel is expected to cover the territory.

The ideal candidate will need to live and service within a 100-mile area of the following Kansas counties: Cheyenne, Decatur, Graham, Greeley, Logan, Rawlins, Scott, Sheridan, Sherman, Thomas, Wallace, and/or Wichita.

RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents. This is a great opportunity to serve the agricultural community.

As a Crop Adjuster II, your primary responsibilities will include:

-

With minimal supervision, completes field inspections and related responsibilities such as reading maps and aerial photos, measuring fields, storage bins, and discussing findings of crop loss with farmers on the most complex non-routine, problematic claims including controversial claims.

Ability to convey complex regulations and interpretations to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.

Performs fact finding regarding crop damage, records information and transmits loss information to accurately determine potential indemnities.

Gather relevant facts, utilizing applicable law and establishing basic principles of negligence.

Complete claim reviews and audits on lower-level adjusters as assigned.

Ensure legal compliance by maintaining a strong working knowledge of regulatory and company policies and procedures.

Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the crop insurance and claims adjusting area

Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date

Reliable personal transportation and travel within territory

RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements: walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs. to 50 lbs., work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions

Preferred Qualifications:

Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

Strong organization and prioritization skills

Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

Experience providing technical training to other crop professionals

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed hourly rate for this position is $23.66 - $33.89, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Remote Working: Yes
Schedule: Full Time
Employment Sponsorship Offered: No

RCIS offre una vasta gamma di coperture di prodotti privati, tra cui una vasta selezione di opzioni denominate-peril, prodotti assicurativi complementari e stand-alone e piani di assicurazione colture federali attraverso la United States Department of Agriculture’s Risk Management Agency. Insieme agli agenti della RCIS, proteggiamo gli agricoltori e gli allevatori americani.

Zurigo sta attualmente cercando un RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster II per lavorare fuori dallo stato del Kansas. Questo incumbent funzionerà da un ufficio a casa. Questa posizione è prevista per lavorare 40 ore alla settimana. Circa il 50% di viaggio dovrebbe coprire il territorio.

Il candidato ideale dovrà vivere e servire in una zona di 100 miglia delle seguenti contee del Kansas: Cheyenne, Decatur, Graham, Greeley, Logan, Rawlins, Scott, Sheridan, Sherman, Thomas, Wallace e/o Wichita.

RCIS fornisce assicurazioni e servizi superiori attraverso agenti leader per proteggere gli agricoltori e gli allevatori americani. È stato un innovatore nell’assicurazione delle colture dal momento che il commercio di assicurazione delle colture è stato privatizzato dal governo federale nel 1980. Oggi è uno dei più grandi fornitori di assicurazione coltura della nazione, offrendo protezione di gestione del rischio in tutti i 50 stati attraverso una rete nazionale di circa 4.000 agenti professionalmente addestrati e licenziati. Questa è una grande opportunità per servire la comunità agricola.

Come Aggiustatore di Crop II, le vostre responsabilità principali includono:

-

Con una supervisione minima, completa le ispezioni sul campo e le relative responsabilità, come la lettura di mappe e foto aeree, campi di misura, contenitori di stoccaggio, e discutendo i risultati della perdita di colture con gli agricoltori sulle affermazioni non-routine più complesse, problematiche comprese affermazioni controverse.

Capacità di trasmettere regolamenti e interpretazioni complesse ai richiedenti, agli agenti e alle persone del settore sulle situazioni di reclamo.

Esegue infatti la ricerca per quanto riguarda i danni alle colture, registra le informazioni e trasmette le informazioni sulla perdita per determinare con precisione le potenziali indennitÃ .

Raccogliere fatti pertinenti, utilizzando la legge applicabile e stabilire principi fondamentali di negligenza.

Completo recensioni di reclamo e audit su regolatori di livello inferiore come assegnato.

Assicurare la conformità legale mantenendo una forte conoscenza di lavoro delle politiche e delle procedure regolamentari e aziendali.

Contribuisci allo sforzo del team realizzando risultati correlati e partecipando a progetti come necessario.

Qualifiche di base:

High School Diploma o Equivalent e 2 o più anni di esperienza nell'assicurazione coltura e rivendicazioni zona di regolazione

La certificazione del Programma di Proficienza dell'Aggiustatore di Crop (CAPP) deve essere ottenuta con 180 giorni di noleggio

Trasporto personale affidabile e viaggi all'interno del territorio

RCIS Aggiustatore di Crop Requisiti fisici: camminare in campi agricoli fino a 3 miglia, scalare i contenitori di stoccaggio agricoli fino a 25 piedi, sollevare 25 lbs. a 50 lbs., lavorare all'aperto in diverse temperature/tempo

Preferiti:

Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale, scritta e interpersonale

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zürich ist derzeit auf der Suche nach einem Mitglied unseres Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) Teams. RCIS ist einer der führenden Anbieter von Ernteversicherungen in den USA RCIS bietet Versicherungsschutz in allen 50 Staaten durch ein nationales Netzwerk von etwa 3.600 lizenzierten Agenten. RCIS bietet eine breite Palette von privaten Produktabdeckungen, einschließlich einer vielfältigen Auswahl an namensgefährdeten Optionen, ergänzenden und eigenständigen Versicherungsprodukten sowie Bundespflanzenversicherungen durch die Risikomanagement-Agentur des US-Landwirtschaftsministeriums. Zusammen mit RCIS-Agenten schützen wir Amerikas Landwirte und Viehzüchter.

Zürich ist derzeit auf der Suche nach einem RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster II, um aus dem Bundesstaat Kansas zu arbeiten. Dieser Amtsinhaber wird von einem Heimbüro aus arbeiten. Diese Position soll 40 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten. Es wird erwartet, dass etwa 50% der Reisen das Territorium abdecken.

Der ideale Kandidat muss in einem 100-Meilen-Gebiet der folgenden Bezirke von Kansas leben und dienen: Cheyenne, Decatur, Graham, Greeley, Logan, Rawlins, Scott, Sheridan, Sherman, Thomas, Wallace und / oder Wichita.

RCIS bietet Versicherungen und erstklassige Dienstleistungen durch führende Agenten an, um Amerikas Landwirte und Viehzüchter zu schützen. Es ist ein Innovator in der Ernteversicherung, seit das Ernteversicherungsgeschäft 1980 von der Bundesregierung privatisiert wurde. Heute ist es einer der größten Ernteversicherungsanbieter des Landes und bietet Risikomanagementschutz in allen 50 Staaten durch ein nationales Netzwerk von etwa 4.000 professionell ausgebildeten und lizenzierten Agenten. Dies ist eine großartige Gelegenheit, der landwirtschaftlichen Gemeinschaft zu dienen.

Als Crop Adjuster II umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

-

Mit minimaler Aufsicht führt Feldinspektionen und damit verbundene Verantwortlichkeiten durch, wie das Lesen von Karten und Luftbildern, das Messen von Feldern, Lagerbehältern und das Besprechen von Ergebnissen des Ernteverlusts mit Landwirten zu den komplexesten nicht routinemäßigen, problematischen Ansprüchen, einschließlich umstrittener Ansprüche.

Fähigkeit, komplexe Vorschriften und Interpretationen an Antragsteller, Agenten und Industrieleute in Anspruchssituationen zu übermitteln.

Führt Faktenfindung in Bezug auf Ernteschäden durch, zeichnet Informationen auf und übermittelt Verlustinformationen, um mögliche Entschädigungen genau zu bestimmen.

Sammeln Sie relevante Fakten, unter Verwendung des geltenden Rechts und die Festlegung der Grundprinzipien der Fahrlässigkeit.

Vervollständigen Sie die Antragsprüfungen und Audits bei niedrigeren Einstellern wie zugewiesen.

Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Rechtsvorschriften durch Aufrechterhaltung eines fundierten Kenntnisstands der Regulierungs- und Unternehmenspolitik und -verfahren.

Tragen Sie zur Teamarbeit bei, indem Sie die damit verbundenen Ergebnisse erzielen und bei Bedarf an Projekten teilnehmen.

Grundqualifikationen:

High School Diplom oder Äquivalent und 2 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in der Ernteversicherung und Schadensanpassung Bereich

Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) muss mit 180 Tagen Mietdatum erhalten werden

Zuverlässige persönliche Beförderung und Reisen innerhalb des Territoriums

RCIS Crop Adjuster Physikalische Anforderungen: Gehen Sie auf landwirtschaftlichen Feldern bis zu 3 Meilen, klettern Sie auf landwirtschaftliche Lagerbehälter bis zu 25 Fuß, heben Sie 25 lbs. bis 50 lbs., Arbeiten Sie im Freien unter unterschiedlichen Temperaturen / Wetterbedingungen

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

Hervorragende verbale, schriftliche und zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Starke Organisation und Priorisierung Fähigkeiten

Mittlere Microsoft Office Fähigkeiten

Erfahrung in der technischen Ausbildung anderer Anbaufachleute

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS is one of the leading crop insurance providers in the U.S. RCIS offers insurance protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 3,600 licensed agents. RCIS offers a wide range of private product coverages, including a diverse selection of named-peril options, supplemental and stand-alone insurance products as well as federal crop insurance plans through the United States Department of Agriculture’s Risk Management Agency. Together with RCIS agents, we protect America’s farmers and ranchers.

Zurich is currently looking for an RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster II to work out of the state of South Dakota. This incumbent will work from a home-based office. This position is scheduled to work 40 hours per week. Approximately 50% of travel is expected to cover the territory.

The ideal candidate will need to live and service within a 100-mile area of the following South Dakota counties: Lake, McCook, Miner, Minnehaha, and/or Moody.

RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents. This is a great opportunity to serve the agricultural community.

As a Crop Adjuster II, your primary responsibilities will include:

- With minimal supervision, completes field inspections and related responsibilities such as reading maps and aerial photos, measuring fields, storage bins, and discussing findings of crop loss with farmers on the most complex non-routine, problematic claims including controversial claims.

- Ability to convey complex regulations and interpretations to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.

- Performs fact finding regarding crop damage, records information and transmits loss information to accurately determine potential indemnities.

- Gather relevant facts, utilizing applicable law and establishing basic principles of negligence.

- Complete claim reviews and audits on lower-level adjusters as assigned.

- Ensure legal compliance by maintaining a strong working knowledge of regulatory and company policies and procedures.

- Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the crop insurance and claims adjusting area

- Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date

- Reliable personal transportation and travel within territory

- RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements: walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs. to 50 lbs., work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions

Preferred Qualifications:

- Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

- Strong organization and prioritization skills

- Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

- Experience providing technical training to other crop professionals

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed hourly rate for this position is $23.43 - $32.20, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Zurich est actuellement à la recherche d'un pour rejoindre notre équipe Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS). Le RCIS est l'un des principaux fournisseurs d'assurance-récolte aux États-Unis. Le RCIS offre une large gamme de couvertures de produits privés, y compris une sélection variée d'options nommées de péril, des produits d'assurance supplémentaires et autonomes ainsi que des régimes fédéraux d'assurance-récolte par l'intermédiaire de l'Agence de gestion des risques du ministère de l'Agriculture des États-Unis. Avec les agents du RISC, nous protégeons les agriculteurs et les éleveurs américains.

Zurich est actuellement à la recherche d'un Ajusteur de champ II du RISC pour les revendications de cultures afin de travailler à partir de l'État du Dakota du Sud. Ce titulaire travaillera dans un bureau à domicile. Ce poste est prévu pour 40 heures par semaine. Environ 50 % des déplacements devraient couvrir le territoire.

Le candidat idéal devra vivre et servir dans une zone de 100 milles des comtés suivants du Dakota du Sud : Lake, McCook, Miner, Minnehaha et/ou Moody.

Le RCIS fournit des services d'assurance et des services supérieurs par l'intermédiaire d'agents de premier plan pour protéger les agriculteurs et les éleveurs américains. Il a été un innovateur en assurance-récolte depuis que l'entreprise d'assurance-récolte a été privatisée par le gouvernement fédéral en 1980. Aujourd'hui, il est l'un des plus grands fournisseurs d'assurance-récolte, offrant une protection de gestion des risques dans les 50 États grâce à un réseau national d'environ 4000 agents formés et agréés. C'est une excellente occasion de servir la communauté agricole.

En tant qu'Ajusteur de culture II, vos responsabilités principales comprendront :

- Avec une supervision minimale, effectue les inspections sur le terrain et les responsabilités connexes, comme la lecture de cartes et de photos aériennes, la mesure des champs, les bacs de stockage, et discute des conclusions de la perte de cultures avec les agriculteurs sur les revendications non courantes les plus complexes, qui posent problème, y compris les revendications controversées.

- Capacité de transmettre des règlements et des interprétations complexes aux demandeurs, aux mandataires et aux gens de l'industrie qui ont présenté des demandes.

- Effectuer des recherches sur les dommages causés aux cultures, consigner l'information et transmettre l'information sur les pertes afin de déterminer avec précision les indemnités potentielles.

- Recueillir les faits pertinents, en utilisant la loi applicable et en établissant les principes fondamentaux de la négligence.

- Effectuer des examens et des vérifications des demandes de règlement de niveau inférieur.

- Assurer la conformité juridique en maintenant une solide connaissance pratique des politiques et des procédures réglementaires et d'entreprise.

- Contribuer à l'effort de l'équipe en obtenant des résultats connexes et en participant aux projets au besoin.

Qualifications de base :

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 2 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'assurance-récolte et de l'ajustement des sinistres

- La certification du Programme de compétences des ajusteurs de cultures (PCPA) doit être obtenue avec une date de location de 180 jours.

- Transports et déplacements personnels fiables sur le territoire

- RCIS Ajusteur de culture Exigences physiques: marcher dans des champs agricoles jusqu'à 3 miles, monter des bacs de stockage agricole jusqu'à 25 pieds, soulever 25 lbs à 50 lbs, travailler à l'extérieur dans des températures et conditions météorologiques variables

Qualifications préférées :

- Excellentes compétences en communication verbale, écrite et interpersonnelle

- Compétences solides en matière d'organisation et de hiérarchisation

- Compétences intermédiaires de Microsoft Office

- Expérience en matière de formation technique pour d'autres professionnels de la culture

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous.

L'échelle de rémunération indiquée est une moyenne nationale et peut varier selon le lieu. Le taux horaire proposé pour ce poste est de 23,43 $ - 32,20 $, et la prime incitative à court terme est fixée à 5 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est un chef de file en gestion des risques, avec plus de 150 ans d'expertise et de couverture dans plus de 25 industries, dont 90% du Fortune 500®.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

Égalité des chances Invalidité/veuves de l'employeur.

jobs.description:
Zurich gives you the tools and support to construct a rewarding career in the Insurance industry. We are looking for a Underwriter, Construction Casualty or Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty to join our Specialities Construction Casualty team out of our Dallas office. While this position will be based out of our Dallas office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers and be in the office/market three days per week.

As a Underwriter, Constrcution Casualty or Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty you will have a chance to use your marketing and analytical skills along with your knowledge of buildings to analyze and underwrite new and renewal Constrcution business both in the US. This is a market facing position and we are seeking someone with a strong sales execution mindset and knowledge of commercial Property policies. There will be 15%-20% travel for this position.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriter, Construction Casualty or Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Key Accountabilities of this role:

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules and guidelines, rating manual rules, and insurance laws and regulations.

- Develop, maintain & collaborate with Line of Business representatives and other business-related needs, as appropriate.

- Develop and maintain relationships with distributors (agents & brokers) in support of business retention and acquisition and works with customers and distributors (agents & brokers) to determine their insurance related needs and provide solutions.

- Support the organization's sales culture by being a Help Point for agents, brokers and customers.

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

Basic Qualifications Underwriter, Construction Casualty:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 1 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Banking, Mortgage, Finance, Construction or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal and regulatory environment

- Knowledge of underwriting philosophy, techniques, national/local filing regulations and guidelines

OR

Basic Qualifications: Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Construction underwriting experience and broker relationships in the South region

- Ability to effectively assess risk

- Strong negotiation skills

- Superior skills in relationship building, active listening, needs analysis, and win-win negotiating
Possess knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Excellent oral and written communication skills

- Strong knowledge of underwriting philosophy, techniques, national/local filing regulations and guidelines

- Demonstrated technical knowledge and skills reflective of progression of positions of increasing responsibility

- PC and related software skills

- CPCU and ARM a plus

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $62,900.00 - $130,300.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriter is $62,900.00 - $103,100.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $79,600.00 - $130,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zürich bietet Ihnen die Werkzeuge und Unterstützung, um eine lohnende Karriere in der Versicherungsbranche aufzubauen. Wir suchen nach einem Underwriter, Construction Casualty oder Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty, um unserem Specialities Construction Casualty Team aus unserem Büro in Dallas beizutreten. Während diese Position von unserem Büro in Dallas aus basiert, haben Sie die Flexibilität, auf einer hybriden Basis zu arbeiten. Sie arbeiten mit Ihrem Manager zusammen, um einen flexiblen Arbeitsplan festzulegen, der Sie, unsere Kunden und unsere Makler und Agenten unterstützt. Diese Rolle erfordert, dass Sie auf dem Markt sichtbar sind, um sich mit unseren Agenten und Brokern zu treffen und drei Tage pro Woche im Büro / Markt zu sein.

Als Underwriter, Constrcution Casualty oder Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Marketing- und Analysefähigkeiten zusammen mit Ihrem Wissen über Gebäude zu nutzen, um neue und erneuerte Constrcution-Geschäfte in den USA zu analysieren und zu unterzeichnen. Dies ist eine Marktposition, und wir suchen jemanden mit einer starken Verkaufsausführung und Wissen über kommerzielle Immobilienpolitik. Es wird 15%-20% Reisen für diese Position geben.

Diese Rolle wird entweder beim Underwriter, Construction Casualty oder Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty besetzt. Der Einstellungsmanager bestimmt das geeignete Niveau basierend auf der Erfahrung und den Fähigkeiten des ausgewählten Bewerbers in Bezug auf die für diese Position aufgeführten Qualifikationen.

Key Accountabilities dieser Rolle:

- Verwalten und überwachen Sie Underwriting-Regeln und Richtlinien, Rating-Handbuchregeln und Versicherungsgesetze und -vorschriften.

- Entwickeln, pflegen und arbeiten Sie mit Vertretern von Line of Business und anderen geschäftsbezogenen Bedürfnissen zusammen.

- Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Distributoren (Agenten & Brokern) zur Unterstützung der Unternehmensbindung und -akquisition und arbeitet mit Kunden und Distributoren (Agenten & Brokern) zusammen, um ihre versicherungsbezogenen Bedürfnisse zu ermitteln und Lösungen anzubieten.

- Unterstützen Sie die Verkaufskultur des Unternehmens, indem Sie ein Help Point für Agenten, Broker und Kunden sind.

- Proaktiv suchen Erneuerung und neue Konto Möglichkeiten.

jobs.description:
Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen?

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

- Als Property Underwriter:in steuerst du in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb das dir zugeordnete Property- (Sach-) Versicherungsportfolio eigenverantwortlich

- Du unterstützt den Vertrieb im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft durch selektive Aufnahme und Bewertung von Risiken vor Ort sowie bei der Akquisition von Portfoliotransfers und Sondervereinbarungen im Bereich Property (Sach) für das kleine und mittlere Gewerbegeschäft

- Bei uns bringst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrungen aktiv ein und arbeitest an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Transformationen mit

- Du beobachtest laufend den Markt in der verantworteten Sparte, erkennst neue Trends und Möglichkeiten frühzeitig und unterstützt bei Bedarf das Product Underwriting aktiv bei der Produktentwicklung

- Deine Expertise setzt du auch gerne im Rahmen von internen und externen Schulungs- und Vertriebsveranstaltungen ein

Das bringst du mit

- Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Vertriebsorientierung sowie Teamfähigkeit

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Versicherungsgeschäft, insbesondere im Underwriting in der Sparte Sachversicherung für Gewerbe- und Firmenkunden

- Sehr gutes Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Durchsetzungsstärke

- Ausbildung zum Versicherungskaufmann/-frau, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Versicherungsfachwirt oder ein abgeschlossenes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Bachelor/Master)

- Vertrauter Umgang mit MS-Office-Produkten (insbesondere Excel mit Pivot-Tabellen und PowerPoint) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Diese Stelle ist IDD-relevant. Die Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD) richtet sich als Vertriebsrichtlinie an alle Personen, die am Vertrieb von Versicherungen beteiligt sind. Bei Einstellung benötigen wir gem. § 48 VAG deine Erklärung zu deiner Zuverlässigkeit und deinen Vermögensverhältnissen sowie den Nachweis deiner angemessenen Qualifikation.

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexible Arbeitsformen, um eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten im Büro und von zu Hause zu gestalten

- Zahlreiche Trainings- und Lernangebote, um fit für den Arbeitsalltag zu bleiben und eine individuelle Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen

- Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner Karriereplanung von der Potenzialanalyse bis hin zur individuellen Förderung

- Eine moderne, offene und transparente Arbeitsumgebung, die Kreativität und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördert

- Ob Fitness in der Gruppe vor Ort oder virtuelles Achtsamkeitstraining von zu Hause: unser vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot unterstützt eine gesunde Work-Life Balance

- Bikeleasing, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket und weitere tolle Benefits

Z usätzliche Informationen

ZGD unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll- und Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns ( frederick.kortmann@zurich.com ), um die Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

- Arbeitsort: Köln oder Frankfurt

- Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Vollzeit

Frederick Kortmann freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen und des möglichen Starttermins über das Karriereportal (“Jetzt Bewerben”-Button). Leider können wir Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigen.

Willkommen in deiner Zukunft

55.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in 215 Ländern und Gebieten. Gemeinsam auf dem Weg, Versicherung jeden Tag neu zu denken – und die Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Willkommen in einer starken Gemeinschaft, in der du von Anfang an etwas bewegst. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns weiter!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo riviviamo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Come sottoscrittore di proprietà: in collaborazione con il reparto vendite, si controlla la proprietà (proprietà) portafoglio assicurativo assegnato a voi indipendentemente

- Supporti le vendite nel nuovo e esistente assumendo selettivamente e valutando i rischi sul sito, nonché l'acquisizione di trasferimenti di portafoglio e accordi speciali nel settore della proprietà per le piccole e medie imprese commerciali

- Con noi contribuisci attivamente alla tua conoscenza e esperienza e lavori al continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi e trasformazioni

- Si sta costantemente osservando il mercato nella divisione responsabile, identificare nuove tendenze e opportunità in una fase iniziale e sostenere attivamente la sottoscrizione del prodotto nello sviluppo del prodotto, se necessario

- Ti piace anche utilizzare la tua esperienza in eventi di formazione e vendita interni ed esterni

Lo porti con te.

- Forte orientamento al cliente e alle vendite e lavoro di squadra

- Diversi anni di esperienza nel settore assicurativo, in particolare nella sottoscrizione nel settore assicurativo per clienti commerciali e aziendali

- Molto buone capacità di negoziazione e forti capacità di comunicazione e l'applicazione

- Formazione come impiegato di assicurazione, idealmente con ulteriore istruzione come specialista di assicurazione o un diploma di economia completa (Bachelor/Master)

- Gestione familiare dei prodotti MS-Office (specialmente Excel con le tabelle pivot e PowerPoint) così come buone abilità inglesi in parola e scrittura

Questo corpo e' iDD-relevant. La direttiva sulla distribuzione delle assicurazioni (IDD) è una linea guida di distribuzione per tutte le persone coinvolte nella distribuzione dell'assicurazione. Quando è stato assunto, abbiamo bisogno secondo § 48 VAG la vostra dichiarazione sulla vostra affidabilità e la vostra situazione finanziaria e la prova della vostra qualifica appropriata.

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per creare un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro in ufficio e da casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Ti sosteniamo nella pianificazione della tua carriera da analisi potenziali a promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Sia che il fitness nel gruppo sul sito o la formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: la nostra gamma diversificata di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio di vita-lavoro

- Leasing bici, biglietto scontato Germania e altri grandi vantaggi

Z informazioni aggiuntive

A seconda del requisito di lavoro individuale e dell'idoneità personale, ZGD supporta generalmente forme di lavoro flessibili e part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (frederick.kortmann@zurich.com) per discutere le possibilità.

- Luogo di lavoro: Colonia o Francoforte

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: a tempo pieno

Frederick Kortmann non vede l'ora di presentare i documenti delle vostre applicazioni con l'indicazione delle vostre aspettative di stipendio e la data di inizio possibile tramite il portale di carriera (“Applica ora” pulsante). Purtroppo non possiamo considerare le applicazioni via e-mail.

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 2515 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- As a property underwriter: in cooperation with the sales department, you control the property (property) insurance portfolio assigned to you independently

- You support sales in the new and existing business by selectively taking up and evaluating risks on site as well as in the acquisition of portfolio transfers and special agreements in the area of property for small and medium-sized commercial business

- With us you actively contribute your knowledge and experience and work on the continuous improvement of our processes and transformations

- You are constantly observing the market in the responsible division, identify new trends and opportunities at an early stage and actively support product underwriting in product development if necessary

- You also like to use your expertise in internal and external training and sales events

You bring that with you

- Strong customer and sales orientation as well as teamwork

- Several years of experience in the insurance business, in particular in underwriting in the property insurance sector for commercial and corporate customers

- Very good negotiation skills as well as strong communication skills and enforcement

- Training as an insurance clerk, ideally with further education as an insurance specialist or a completed economics degree (Bachelor/Master)

- Familiar handling of MS-Office products (especially Excel with pivot tables and PowerPoint) as well as good English skills in word and writing

This body is IDD-relevant. The Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD) is a distribution guideline for all persons involved in the distribution of insurance. When recruited, we require according to § 48 VAG your statement on your reliability and your financial situation as well as proof of your appropriate qualification.

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work to create an optimal balance between work in the office and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- We support you in your career planning from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket and other great benefits

Z additional information

Depending on the individual job requirement and personal suitability, ZGD generally supports both flexible and part-time forms of work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (frederick.kortmann@zurich.com) to discuss the possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne or Frankfurt

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

Frederick Kortmann is looking forward to your application documents with indication of your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

jobs.description:
Our opportunity

Junior AI Engineer #LI-Hybrid

We are looking for a highly motivated AI Use Case Engineer to join our Global Specialties organization, focusing on the Credit Lines / Underwriting domain. In this role, you will design, prototype and rollout AI use cases that streamline underwriting and credit processes. You will work closely with underwriters, data engineers and BI teams to turn ideas into working AI applications, primarily using modern Python based AI and analytics tooling. This role is ideal for early career to mid level AI engineers who enjoy building practical solutions end to end rather than doing research or pure software engineering.

Start date: earliest September / October 2026

Your role

As a Junior AI Engineer, your main responsibilities will involve:

- Designing and delivering end to end AI use cases to support underwriting and credit processes

- Rapidly prototyping AI solutions (POCs) and iterating based on business feedback

- Implementing AI applications using Python and large language models (LLMs)

- Structuring, validating and transforming data for AI workflows

- Creating simple APIs and services to expose AI logic to users or systems

- Working with internal Data Lake, BI and analytics platforms (e.g. Databricks)

- Supporting testing and validation to ensure AI outputs are fit for business use

- Contributing to the rollout of AI solutions into production environments

- Continuously improving solutions based on monitoring and user feedback

Your Skills and Experience

As a Junior AI Engineer your skills and experience will ideally include:

- 2+ years h ands‑on experience with:

- LLMs or modern AI tooling

- Data processing and validation

- Strong Python foundations and interest in applied AI / analytics

- Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions

- Willingness to work closely with underwriters and business users

- Pragmatic mindset: delivery, iteration, learning fast

- Independence and proactive approach

Nice to have

- Prior experience in insurance, finance or risk domains

- Databricks or similar analytics platforms

- Basic API development (e.g. FastAPI)

- Containers (Docker) and cloud environment

- Hackathon, internship or university AI project experience

We offer

Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. The starting base salary range for this position is 1930 EUR to 2300 EUR.

Working time benefits
Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workcation

Monetary benefits
Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus

Other benefits
Electronic cafeteria, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office

Learning/Development
Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP)

- Location: Bratislava

- Schedule: full-time

- Form: hybrid - occasional home office possible

About us

At Zurich Insurance, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted and respected at all times.

In questo ruolo, si progetta, prototipo e rollout AI utilizzano casi che semplificano i processi di sottoscrizione e di credito. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con sottoscrittori, ingegneri di dati e team BI per trasformare le idee in applicazioni AI di lavoro, principalmente utilizzando moderni strumenti basati su Python AI e analytics. Questo ruolo è ideale per la prima carriera a ingegneri AI di livello medio che amano la costruzione di soluzioni pratiche finiscono per finire, piuttosto che fare ricerca o pura ingegneria del software.

Il tuo ruolo

In qualità di Junior AI Engineer, le tue principali responsabilità coinvolgeranno:

- Progettazione e fornitura di casi di uso dell'intelligenza artificiale per supportare i processi di sottoscrizione e di credito

- Rapidamente prototipando soluzioni AI (POCs) e iterating in base al feedback aziendale

- Implementazione delle applicazioni AI utilizzando Python e grandi modelli di lingua (LLMs)

- Structuring, validazione e trasformazione dei dati per i flussi di lavoro AI

- Creazione di semplici API e servizi per esporre la logica AI agli utenti o ai sistemi

- Lavorare con piattaforme interne Data Lake, BI e analytics (ad esempio Databricks)

- Supporto di test e validazione per garantire che le uscite AI siano adatte per l'uso aziendale

- Contribuire all'implementazione di soluzioni AI in ambienti produttivi

- Migliorare costantemente le soluzioni in base al monitoraggio e al feedback degli utenti

Le tue abilità ed esperienza

Come Junior AI Ingegnere le tue competenze e esperienza saranno idealmente includere:

- 2+ anni di esperienza con:

- LLM o moderni strumenti AI

- Trattamento e convalida dei dati

- Forte fondazione Python e interesse per l'applicazione AI / analytics

- Capacità di tradurre i problemi aziendali in soluzioni tecniche

- Volontà di lavorare a stretto contatto con i sottoscrittori e gli utenti aziendali

- Pragmatic mindset: consegna, iterazione, apprendimento veloce

- Indipendenza e approccio proattivo

- Esperienza prioritaria nei settori assicurativo, finanziario o di rischio

- Databricks o piattaforme di analisi simili

- Sviluppo API di base (ad esempio FastAPI)

- Contenitori (Docker) e ambiente cloud

- Hackathon, stage o università AI esperienza di progetto

La gamma di stipendio base di partenza per questa posizione è di 30 EUR a 2300 EUR.

Benefici del tempo di lavoro
Giorni liberi personali, settimana di lavoro concentrata, Vacanza aggiuntiva, Ufficio domestico, Giorni extra in occasione di parto, congedo sabatico, Workcation

Benefici monetari
Assicurazione sulla vita da Zurigo Austria, Compensazione per la perdita di stipendio durante il congedo di malattia, 3° contributo pilastro pensione, Risk Life Insurance, Contributo in cima al minimo legale richiesto, Anni di bonus di servizio, Bonus di nozze, Baby bonus

Caffetteria elettronica, Prestazioni di congedo di maternità, Massaggi in ufficio

Certificazioni professionali, Portali di formazione online, programma di onboarding esteso, cultura basata sui punti di forza (GALLUP)

- Posizione: Bratislava

- Orari: a tempo pieno

- Rapidly Prototyping AI-Lösungen (POCs) und Iteration basierend auf Business-Feedback

- Datenverarbeitung und -validierung

Nel nostro team clienti KTG diversificato e multilingue, si lavora a stretto contatto con partner interni ed esterni e contribuire a garantire che i nostri clienti sono rapidamente e con competenza sostenuti in caso di un servizio. Ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro flessibile in cui si può assumere la responsabilità, approfondire la vostra esperienza e sviluppare professionalmente.

Ottimo servizio è buono solo come il team motivato che si trova dietro i nostri clienti e offre un servizio clienti eccezionale. Siamo alla ricerca di specialisti appassionati che vogliono far progredire la loro carriera a Zurigo Svizzera e iniziare nelle nostre squadre clienti.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come team clienti specializzato KTG.

- Corrispondete e tenete discussioni con le varie parti coinvolte nel regolamento di reclamo (assicurato, datore di lavoro, servizio medico, altri assicuratori, avvocati)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you excited about claims processing and want to play a key role in delivering services to our customers’ employees? Do you have a talent for managing multiple claims processes in a dynamic environment and continuously improving the experience of our insured?

In our diverse and multilingual customer team KTG, you work closely with internal and external partners and help ensure that our customers are quickly and competently supported in the event of a service. You can expect a flexible working environment in which you can take on responsibility, deepen your expertise and develop professionally.

Excellent service is only as good as the motivated team that stands behind our customers and offers outstanding customer service. We are looking for passionate specialists who want to advance their career at Zurich Switzerland and start in our customer teams.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a specialist customer team KTG.

What you do

- You regulate the services for illnesses of our customers' employees in accordance with the legal and contractual provisions

- You correspond and hold discussions with the various parties involved in the claims settlement (insured, employer, medical service, other insurers, lawyers)

- You clarify medical matters and make payments based on legal requirements and insurance contracts

- You manage recourse claims against third parties and other insurers

What you bring

- Commercial basic education in the insurance sector or a VBV education, a diploma in the social insurance sector beneficial

- Min. 3 years of experience in processing KTG, medical experience of benefit

- Excellent communication and negotiation skills

- You perform professionally and bring a high service mentality

- Very good knowledge of German in words and writing, further language skills are advantageous

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Silke Nachtigall (+41 44 628 20 59)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Kriens, Lucerne

Hybrid work: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to your online application - even without an application letter. You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: Finance and Insurance Executive - Direct Markets
jobs.description:
Zurich is seeking a Finance & Insurance Executive to support sales efforts in Oklahoma area. As part of our F&I sales team, this role offers an opportunity to leverage and refine your sales and marketing expertise within the automotive sector! We are looking for high performers that are goal driven and able to take us to the next level of achieving financial targets. You will be responsible for driving growth and profitability by acquiring, developing, and maintaining strong relationships with new and existing customers.

Immediate benefits include work from home flexibility, travel, a competitive base salary with uncapped incentives, excellent benefits (Medical, Dental, 401k, PTO), and a company car (subject to a driving record check) provided.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Sales area or Automotive area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Sales area or Automotive area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Sales area or Automotive area

Preferred Qualifications:

- Ideal candidates have outside sales experience and advanced knowledge of the automotive industry, market trends, and competitors.

- Extensive experience in retail automotive finance or senior sales management (e.g. GM, GSM, Finance Director, Finance Manager).

- Experience in dealership training (1:1, classroom, virtual).

- Proficiency in automotive and traditional software/technology.

- Knowledge of insurance, reinsurance, and warranty claims processes and F&I products.

- Ability to analyze financial statements.

- Excellent presentation skills for both small and large groups.

Background:

Zurich Direct Markets specializes in offering Finance & Insurance (F&I) products to the automotive industry, supported by a dedicated team of F&I sales professionals who maintain close relationships with Dealership customers.

The Finance & Insurance Executive (FIE) role involves driving growth and profitability by:

• Prospecting:

Identifying and developing new business prospects, focusing on providing Finance & Insurance products to large automotive dealers, while also supporting P&C product marketing within the assigned territory.

Attending Automotive industry events to promote Zurich’s sales and marketing initiatives.

• Relationship Management:

Building and maintaining strong relationships with both new and existing customers.

Effectively communicating with internal and external stakeholders via various channels (in-person and virtual) to maintain solid relationships.

• Closing:

Managing and growing your assigned territory to achieve profitability and exceed sales targets.

• Direct Sales:

Conducting sales presentations either in-person or via Microsoft Teams.

• Consulting:

Collaborating with field team members to ensure seamless implementation of programs and products, while strengthening customer relationships.

• Building market share:

Working remotely in an entrepreneurial environment

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The annual variable compensation range, based on performance under the sales incentive plan for this role is $59,300.00 - $97,100.00.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.
