The individual life fascinates you and you already bring expertise? Then you are exactly right with us!

In the Customer Service Individual Life team, you are part of a dedicated team, which is responsible for handling all requests and inquiries from our customers throughout Switzerland and provides them with advice and support. As an individual specialist, you actively support the individual life division within the customer service and act as a competent contact person for our customer advisors from Zurich agencies and external brokers – especially in the processing of all new applications.

If you are service-oriented, enjoy dealing with customers in sales and work together as a team to find the best possible solution to create a positive experience for our customers, this is your next career step.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a professional specialist for new business.

What you do

- You independently process all requests of demanding customers from the application to the policy in telephone and written contact

- You are responsible for the technical recording and administrative handling of complex business transactions

- You work closely with internal and external interfaces (e.g. compliance)

- You support your teammates with technical questions and difficult processing of customer policies

- You actively build up your network, act confidently and take on additional tasks such as working in specialist groups and projects

What you bring

- Commercial or comparable training completed

- Individual experience and expertise and at least two years of experience in a customer-oriented environment

- Enjoyment in dealing with customers in telephone and written contact

- Stylistic German in word and writing as well as very good knowledge of French absolutely necessary; Knowledge of Italian is an advantage

- Very good knowledge of MS-Office programs

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Eleni Bourtzakis +41 44 628 20 51

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

We look forward to your online application - even without an application letter.

You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: AVP, Underwriting Director or VP, Senior Underwriting Director - E&S Excess Casualty
jobs.description:
Zurich is seeking an experienced AVP, Underwriting Director OR VP, Senior Underwriting Director – E&S Excess Casualty to join our team in our Atlanta, GA, Dallas, TX or Houston, TX office. While this position will be based out of our Atlanta, GA, Dallas, TX or Houston, TX office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers. In this role you will be working with national wholesalers to drive growth with a focus on profitability.

Zurich E&S is dedicated 100% to a wholesale distribution model and a product and technology strategy designed to make Zurich a market leader in E&S as measured by gross written premium, profitability, and employee satisfaction!

As an AVP, Underwriting Director or VP, Senior Underwriting Director – Zurich E&S you will have the opportunity to grow and develop your career as a member of seasoned and dynamic team. You will be underwriting new and renewal business, under limited direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority levels on a variety of accounts. We focus strongly on our customers and are seeking someone with the ability to develop exceptional relationships and a strong market facing presence.

This role will be responsible for:

- Proactively seeking new account opportunities and managing existing renewal accounts.

- Demonstrating specialized knowledge and expertise in underwriting excess casualty lines of business.

- Completing detailed opportunity assessments with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Contributing to the development and completion of proposals.

- Qualifying accounts that meet the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Making agent/broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiating Terms & Conditions and closing deals.

- Cross-Selling other lines of business to increase product density with the account.

- Participating in Sales Team meetings as related to assigned brokers and / or territory.

- Proactively engaging in the target account process, managing a qualified list of opportunities 90 to 120 days prior to effective date.

- Developing strong broker and client networks as related to industries underwritten by Business Unit.

AVP, Underwriting Director – Zurich E&S Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

OR

VP, Senior Underwriting Director – Zurich E&S

- Bachelor’s Degree and 9 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- Bachelor’s Degree and 18 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Experience in Excess & Surplus Property Underwriting

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of E&S Commercial insurance industry experience

- Technical knowledge of Excess Underwriting with E&S

- Established wholesale broker relationships (E&S brokers)

- Creative problem-solving skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is$131,500.00 - $287,000.00. The proposed salary range for the AVP, Underwriting Director is $131,500.00 - $217,000.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 40%. The proposed salary range for the VP, Senior Underwriting Director is $175,200.00 - $287,000.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 50%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for an experienced Trial Attorney to join our Staff Legal Team in Houston with the flexibility of working from home while having access to a local office with support staff. This litigator will be responsible for representing the commercial insureds of a prestigious and financially stable commercial insurance carrier, by preparing and trying moderate to high exposure General Liability cases from a challenging and varied caseload.

If you are ready for a career move, consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers terrific benefits including an incentive plan, 401K match and a second 401K company contribution, flexible work options and a great culture.

This is an exciting opportunity to work for a well-respected Company and represent its insureds in all phases of litigation, while being part of a high-performing law office. The ideal candidate will engage in the practice of law at all times in compliance with the ethical standards established by the Federal Courts and Texas State Bar.

Duties of this position encompass all aspects of insurance defense, including initial investigation, legal analysis and advice, evaluating damages, preparing and filing legal pleadings and documents, performing legal research, preparing for and conducting pre-trial discovery, preparing for and aggressively handling hearings and trials, and conducting post-trial activities where appropriate.

The candidate will demonstrate strong case analysis ability and have a track record of effective settlement and trial skills, as well as the ability to work independently without substantial supervision. In addition, they will be expected to mentor less experienced attorneys and provide leadership and training across the organization.

Basic Qualifications for the Sr. Liability Trial Attorney:

- Juris Doctor and 7 or more years of experience in the Litigation area
AND

- Member of the Texas State Bar in good standing

- Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe

- Experience working with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience handling insurance industry claims and general commercial litigation, including but not limited to wrongful death, commercial motor vehicle torts, products and premises liability, and personal injury, from inception through trial.

- Must be well organized with good analytical skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, proactive approach to file handling and caseloads, and able to work independently as well as within a team environment.

- Relevant first chair jury trial experience

- Ability to budget costs and calculate exposure for clients.

- Efficient work habits, knowledge of billables and diary review with substantive and procedural legal knowledge.

- Understands the staff counsel function and role in overall business.

- A functional and extensive knowledge of the law and procedure

- Prior experience in an insurance defense environment

- Strong negotiation skills

- Effective problem solving skills

- Experience working in a team-based environment

Zurich is currently seeking an Executive Underwriter or AVP, Underwriting Director – Construction Casualty to join our team in our Boston, MA or New York, NY office! While this position will be based out of Boston or New York, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers and be in the office/market three days per week.

Zurich is one of the leading insurance providers in the construction industry, our mission is to provide creative solutions for the risks our customers face today and in the future.

As a Construction Casualty Underwriter, you will handle complex new and renewal accounts across Auto, GL, and Worker’s Compensation as well as the potential to handle large project/wrap-up insurance programs. As a member of Zurich's Underwriting Team, you will enjoy the opportunity to fully apply and hone your underwriting and marketing skills while building relationships with our Preferred Distribution Partners in the Northeast. While candidates with construction casualty experience are ideal, we will consider Senior Underwriter candidates who have a desire to expand their skillsets in the construction risk management space.

This is an exciting time to join Construction at Zurich!

The Construction Casualty Underwriter is responsible for:

- Serving as a customer industry advocate with a focus on improving the customer experience by understanding their risk and offering the best end to end solution for their insurance needs.

- Using a disciplined approach to exposure evaluation, risk assessment and pricing

- Using risk insights, data and models to drive informed decisions at point of sale

- Market facing and production within the growing Construction division

- Administering and monitoring underwriting rules and guidelines, insurance laws and regulations and rating manual rules

- Working within broad limits and authority on complex assignments

This role will be filled at either the Executive Underwriter or AVP, Underwriting Director – Construction Casualty level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Executive Underwriter – Construction Casualty Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

AVP, Underwriting Director – Construction Casualty Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting, Market Facing area or Banking, Mortgage, Finance or Construction
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area or Banking, Mortgage, Finance, Construction
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Advanced knowledge and practice of line/s of business

- Strong knowledge of underwriting philosophy, techniques, national/local filing regulations and guidelines

- Ability to effectively assess risk

- Ability to work in a team-based environment

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The combined salary range for this position is $100,000.00 - $215,000.00. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $100,000.00 - $165,000.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 30%. The proposed salary range for the AVP, Underwriting Director is $130,000.00 - $215,000.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 40%.

jobs.description:
The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

The Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation plays a key role in the technology stream, ensuring that Group Finance leverages the right platforms for the right processes – across planning, consolidation, reporting and analytics.

This senior role will translate business needs into an integrated solution architecture, guide platform choices and help ensure that tools such as SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan and Databricks are used effectively and consistently across the Group.

What you will do

- Define and evolve the end to end solution architecture for Group Finance processes (planning, consolidation, reporting, analytics and performance management).

- Ensure each process is supported by the most suitable platform (e.g. SAP Group Reporting for consolidation, Anaplan for planning, Databricks for data and analytics), avoiding duplication and custom “shadow IT”.

- Translate requirements into solution designs, integration patterns and implementation options, balancing standardisation, flexibility and cost.

- Challenge and refine business requirements to fit platform capabilities and long term architecture principles.

- Define how Finance platforms integrate (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, reporting/BI tools) to deliver consistent, governed data for planning and reporting.

- Contribute to the Finance data architecture (data domains, models, flows, lineage) and ensure that key data (actuals, plans, scenarios, KPIs) is managed as a single source of truth.

- Support solution review and design authority processes, ensuring new initiatives adhere to agreed architecture.

- Act as lead Business Solution Architect across key Finance Transformation projects and technology initiatives.

- Provide guidance to project teams on solution options, trade offs and technical risks.

- Review key design artefacts (solution designs, interface specs, data models) and support issue resolution.

- Collaborate closely with Group Finance leadership, BU Finance, Group IT, data/analytics teams and platform owners

- Explain complex architecture topics in clear business language and build consensus around design decisions.

- Contribute to communication and education on the target Finance technology landscape

- Propose improvements to the Finance architecture, including better use of Anaplan and Databricks, standardisation of data and simplification of the system landscape.

What you bring

- Strong experience in Finance / Group Finance processes, such as planning and forecasting, consolidation, reporting, performance management or capital management.

- Proven track record in solution architecture or senior business/IT design roles within Finance transformation programmes.

- Experience with SAP finance platforms (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) and their role in Group reporting.

- Knowledge of Anaplan and Databricks is a strong advantage.

- Solid understanding of data and integration architecture

- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.

- Ability to lead solution design across multiple projects, balancing strategic direction and pragmatic delivery.

- Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable working with senior Finance and IT stakeholders, platform owners and external partners.

- Structured, analytical and solution oriented mindset.

- Ability to simplify complexity and communicate clearly to non technical audiences.

- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

- Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

You b elong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

descriptionByLocale.it:
La Trasformazione delle Finanze sta costruendo una funzione di finanza collegata e collaborativa che è più veloce e più orientata agli insight. Lo faremo trasformando tutto ciò che facciamo, ogni processo, dati e strumento e iniettando nuovi modi di lavoro e AI per amplificare il nostro talento Finance.

Il Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation svolge un ruolo chiave nel flusso tecnologico, assicurando che Group Finance sfrutta le piattaforme giuste per i processi giusti – attraverso la pianificazione, il consolidamento, il reporting e l'analisi.

Questo ruolo senior tradurrà le esigenze aziendali in un'architettura integrata delle soluzioni, guiderà le scelte della piattaforma e aiuterà a garantire che strumenti come SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan e Databricks vengano utilizzati in modo efficace e coerente in tutto il Gruppo.

Cosa farai

- Definire ed evolvere l'architettura di soluzioni end to end per i processi di Group Finance (pianificazione, consolidamento, reporting, analisi e gestione delle prestazioni).

- Assicurarsi che ogni processo sia supportato dalla piattaforma più adatta (ad esempio SAP Group Reporting per il consolidamento, Anaplan per la pianificazione, Databricks per i dati e analisi), evitando duplicazioni e custom “shadow IT”.

- Traduci i requisiti in progetti di soluzione, modelli di integrazione e opzioni di implementazione, bilanciamento della standardizzazione, flessibilità e costi.

- Sfida e affina i requisiti aziendali per adattarsi alle funzionalità della piattaforma e ai principi di architettura a lungo termine.

- Definire come le piattaforme Finance integrano (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, report/BI strumenti) per fornire dati coerenti e regolamentati per la pianificazione e la reportistica.

- Contribuire all'architettura dei dati Finance (domini dati, modelli, flussi, lineage) e garantire che i dati chiave (attuali, piani, scenari, KPI) siano gestiti come un'unica fonte di verità.

- Sostenere i processi di revisione e autorità di progettazione, assicurando nuove iniziative attenersi all'architettura concordata.

- Agire come lead Business Solution Architetto tra i principali progetti di trasformazione delle finanze e iniziative tecnologiche.

- Fornire una guida ai team di progetto sulle opzioni di soluzione, gli sconti e i rischi tecnici.

- Review key design artefatti (progetti di risoluzione, specifiche di interfaccia, modelli di dati) e risoluzione di problemi di supporto.

- Collabora a stretto contatto con la leadership Group Finance, BU Finance, Group IT, team di dati/analytics e proprietari di piattaforme

- Spiegare argomenti di architettura complessi in linguaggio aziendale chiaro e costruire il consenso sulle decisioni di progettazione.

- Contribuire alla comunicazione e all'istruzione sull'obiettivo

- Proporre miglioramenti all'architettura Finance, tra cui un migliore utilizzo di Anaplan e Databricks, standardizzazione dei dati e semplificazione del panorama del sistema.

Cosa porti

- Forte esperienza nei processi Finance / Group Finance, come pianificazione e previsione, consolidamento, reporting, gestione delle prestazioni o gestione dei capitali.

- Provato record di traccia in architettura di soluzione o ruoli senior business/IT design all'interno dei programmi di trasformazione Finance.

- Esperienza con piattaforme di finanza SAP (ad esempio S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) e il loro ruolo nel reporting di Gruppo.

- La conoscenza di Anaplan e Databricks è un forte vantaggio.

- Solida comprensione dei dati e dell'architettura di integrazione

- Esperienza di lavoro in programmi complessi e globali, preferibilmente nel settore assicurativo o dei servizi finanziari.

- Capacità di condurre la progettazione della soluzione in più progetti, bilanciando la direzione strategica e la consegna pragmatica.

- Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder; lavoro confortevole con senior Finance e stakeholder IT, proprietari di piattaforme e partner esterni.

- Mindset strutturato, analitico e orientato alla soluzione.

- Capacità di semplificare la complessità e comunicare chiaramente al pubblico non tecnico.

- Forte capacità di collaborazione e un atteggiamento “un team”, sostenendo sia i colleghi Finance che IT.

- Fluente in inglese (scritto e parlato); lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

Voi siete qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.
Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.

Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Finanztransformation baut eine führende vernetzte, kollaborative Finanzfunktion auf, die schneller und aufschlussreicher ist. Wir werden dies tun, indem wir alles, was wir tun, jeden Prozess, Daten und Werkzeug transformieren und neue Arbeitsweisen und KI einführen, um unsere Finanztalente zu verstärken.

Der Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation spielt eine Schlüsselrolle im Technologie-Stream und stellt sicher, dass Group Finance die richtigen Plattformen für die richtigen Prozesse nutzt – für Planung, Konsolidierung, Reporting und Analyse.

Diese Führungsrolle wird Geschäftsanforderungen in eine integrierte Lösungsarchitektur umwandeln, die Auswahl der Plattform steuern und dazu beitragen, dass Tools wie SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan und Databricks konzernweit effektiv und konsistent eingesetzt werden.

Was du tun wirst

- Definieren und Entwickeln der End-to-End-Lösungsarchitektur für Group Finance-Prozesse (Planung, Konsolidierung, Reporting, Analyse und Performance Management).

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass jeder Prozess von der am besten geeigneten Plattform unterstützt wird (z. B. SAP Group Reporting für die Konsolidierung, Anaplan für die Planung, Databricks für Daten und Analysen), vermeiden Sie Doppelarbeit und benutzerdefinierte „Schatten-IT.

- Übersetzen Sie Anforderungen in Lösungsdesigns, Integrationsmuster und Implementierungsoptionen, wobei Standardisierung, Flexibilität und Kosten ausgeglichen werden.

- Herausforderung und Verfeinerung der Geschäftsanforderungen, um die Plattformfähigkeiten und langfristigen Architekturprinzipien zu erfüllen.

- Definieren Sie, wie Finanzplattformen (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, Reporting/BI-Tools) integriert werden, um konsistente, geregelte Daten für die Planung und Berichterstattung zu liefern.

- Tragen Sie zur Finanzdatenarchitektur bei (Datendomänen, Modelle, Flüsse, Abstammung) und stellen Sie sicher, dass Schlüsseldaten (Ist, Pläne, Szenarien, KPIs) als eine einzige Quelle der Wahrheit verwaltet werden.

- Unterstützen Sie die Überprüfung von Lösungen und Designautoritätsprozesse, um sicherzustellen, dass neue Initiativen der vereinbarten Architektur entsprechen.

- Handeln Sie als führender Business Solution Architect bei wichtigen Finanztransformationsprojekten und Technologieinitiativen.

- Bereitstellung von Anleitungen für Projektteams zu Lösungsoptionen, Kompromissen und technischen Risiken.

- Überprüfen Sie die wichtigsten Design-Artefakte (Lösungsdesigns, Schnittstellenspezifikationen, Datenmodelle) und unterstützen Sie die Problemlösung.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Group Finance, BU Finance, Group IT, Daten-/Analyseteams und Plattformbesitzern

- Erklären Sie komplexe Architekturthemen in klarer Geschäftssprache und schaffen Sie einen Konsens über Designentscheidungen.

- Beitrag zur Kommunikation und Bildung in der Ziel-Technologielandschaft Finanzen

- Verbesserung der Finanzarchitektur, einschließlich einer besseren Nutzung von Anaplan und Databricks, Standardisierung der Daten und Vereinfachung der Systemlandschaft.

Was du mitbringst

- Starke Erfahrung in Finance / Group Finance Prozessen, wie Planung und Prognose, Konsolidierung, Reporting, Performance Management oder Kapitalmanagement.

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Lösungsarchitektur oder Senior Business / IT-Design-Rollen innerhalb der Finanztransformationsprogramme.

- Erfahrung mit SAP-Finanzplattformen (z.B. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) und deren Rolle im Group Reporting.

- Kenntnisse von Anaplan und Databricks sind ein großer Vorteil.

- Solides Verständnis von Daten und Integrationsarchitektur

- Erfahrung in komplexen, globalen Programmen, vorzugsweise im Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungssektor.

- Fähigkeit, das Lösungsdesign in mehreren Projekten zu führen, die strategische Ausrichtung und die pragmatische Umsetzung auszugleichen.

- Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management; komfortables Arbeiten mit leitenden Finanz- und IT-Stakeholdern, Plattformbesitzern und externen Partnern.

- Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise.

- Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu vereinfachen und klar mit nicht-technischen Zielgruppen zu kommunizieren.

- Starke Collaboration-Fähigkeiten und eine "One Team" -Haltung, die sowohl Finanz- als auch IT-Kollegen unterstützt.

- fließend Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen); zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Du b elong hier.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.
Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.
Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.
Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La transformation financière est en train d'établir une fonction de financement connectée et collaborative de premier plan, qui est plus rapide et davantage axée sur les idées. Nous le ferons en transformant tout ce que nous faisons, chaque processus, chaque donnée et chaque outil et en injectant de nouvelles façons de travailler et d'IA pour amplifier nos talents financiers.

L'Architecte des solutions d'affaires – Transformation financière joue un rôle clé dans le volet technologique, assurant que Group Finance exploite les bonnes plateformes pour les bons processus – dans la planification, la consolidation, l'établissement de rapports et l'analyse.

Ce rôle de premier plan permettra de traduire les besoins des entreprises en une architecture de solution intégrée, de guider les choix des plates-formes et de veiller à ce que des outils tels que SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan et Databricks soient utilisés de façon efficace et cohérente dans l'ensemble du Groupe.

Ce que vous ferez

- Définir et développer l'architecture de la solution de bout en bout pour les processus du Groupe Finance (planification, consolidation, reporting, analyse et gestion des performances).

- Assurez-vous que chaque processus est supporté par la plate-forme la plus appropriée (par exemple SAP Group Reporting pour la consolidation, Anaplan pour la planification, Databricks pour les données et l'analyse), en évitant la duplication et l'ombre personnalisée de l'IT.

- Traduire les exigences en conception de solutions, modèles d'intégration et options de mise en œuvre, équilibrer la normalisation, la flexibilité et les coûts.

- Définer et affiner les exigences opérationnelles pour adapter les capacités des plateformes et les principes d'architecture à long terme.

- Définir comment les plates-formes financières s'intègrent (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, reporting/BI tools) pour fournir des données cohérentes et régies aux fins de planification et de reporting.

- Contribuer à l'architecture des données financières (domaines de données, modèles, flux, lignée) et veiller à ce que les données clés (réelles, plans, scénarios, ICR) soient gérées comme une seule source de vérité.

- Appuyer les processus d'examen des solutions et d'autorisation de conception, en veillant à ce que les nouvelles initiatives respectent l'architecture convenue.

- Agir à titre de chef de file en matière de solutions d'affaires dans le cadre de projets clés de transformation financière et d'initiatives technologiques.

- Fournir des conseils aux équipes de projet sur les options de solution, les compromis et les risques techniques.

jobs.description:
Personal Lines Direct Sales Agent

Zurich Insurance in our Wexford Centre of Excellence is looking for a Personal Lines Direct Sales Agent to join the Direct New Business Team who manage all Direct new business across our home, motor, and van products.

If you have a flair for sales, and are a target focused individual you will enjoy working in our sales team.

Your role

As a Direct Sales Agent your main responsibilities will include, but not necessarily be limited to, the following:

-Working in the sales team the Direct Sales Agent will be responsible for following up on quotations and completing sales of our Zurich products (home, motor & van) over the phone – direct with our customers.
• -You will work in a target driven environment and will be rewarded with a competitive sales bonus on a monthly basis for meeting or exceeding your monthly targets.
• -Identify and develop calls likely to result in new business.
• -Identify cross-selling prospects for additional products and arrange follow-up calls with customers for future sales opportunities.
• -Convert quotations into sales in order to exceed team targets.
• -Retain current customers in line with challenging business targets.
• -Identify upsell opportunities for additional policy benefits.
• -Contacting targeted renewals to drive retention targets.
• -Build rapport & relationship with our potential and existing customers.
• -Experience in the insurance industry would be desirable.

Your skills and experience

As a Direct Sales Agent your skills and qualifications will include:

• -Excellent phone manner & communication skills.
• -Good IT Skills (use of MS Office Products).
• -Minimum of 2 H5's or higher level C3's in the Leaving Certificate (or equivalent) Third Level Qualification (minimum level 6 standard).
• -Completed or be in the process of completing CIP as a minimum and / or ACII qualification – more desirable state rather than required.
• -Previous experience of working in a sales & target driven environment.
• -Have good negotiation skills to close the new business or renewal offer & be target focused.
• -Enthusiastic, professional, positive and flexible approach that includes the ability to self-motivate.
• -Have attention to details, ability to interpret data and ability to follow work through.

Additional Information

Position is Wexford-based but occasional travel may be required to other Zurich locations.

If you value an exciting and varied working environment and meet the above requirements, then our recruiter is looking forward to receiving your application by clicking on the button “Apply online”.

Who we are

Zurich is one of Ireland's leading insurance companies providing a wide range of general insurance and life insurance products and services. The company employs over 1,000 people across its locations in Dublin and Wexford.

Zurich is a strong brand – with our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, helping our customers in 210 countries and territories to understand and protect themselves from risk. In order to deliver our services, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting opportunities for further training & development. As a Zurich employee you benefit from a multitude of advantages as well as a strong culture, characterized by acceptance, diversity and team spirit.

At Zurich, we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our purpose and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees reach their full potential. We value and defend what is right and promote opportunities for equity among our professionals, regardless of gender, disability, LGBTQ +, race, ethnicity, generations, belief, etc. Join Zurich and be part of this culture. Together we are committed to delivering on our purpose - Let’s Create a Brighter Future Together!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Personal Lines Agente di vendita diretto

L'assicurazione di Zurigo nel nostro Wexford Centre of Excellence è alla ricerca di un agente di vendita diretto di linee personali per aderire al nuovo team di affari diretto che gestisce tutti i nuovi business diretti attraverso la nostra casa, motore e prodotti van.

Se si dispone di un vantaggio per le vendite, e sono un target focalizzato individuo vi piacerà lavorare nel nostro team di vendita.

Il tuo ruolo

Come agente di vendita diretto le vostre responsabilità principali includono, ma non necessariamente essere limitato a, i seguenti:

-Lavorare nel team di vendita l'agente di vendita diretto sarà responsabile di seguire le quotazioni e completare le vendite dei nostri prodotti di Zurigo (casa, camper) al telefono – direttamente con i nostri clienti.
• -Lavorerai in un ambiente mirato e sarai ricompensato con un bonus di vendita competitivo su base mensile per soddisfare o superare i tuoi obiettivi mensili.
• -Identificare e sviluppare chiamate che possono portare a nuovi affari.
• -Identificare prospettive cross-selling per prodotti aggiuntivi e organizzare chiamate di follow-up con i clienti per future opportunità di vendita.
• -Convertire le quotazioni nelle vendite per superare gli obiettivi del team.
• -Ritenere clienti attuali in linea con obiettivi di business impegnativi.
• -Identificare opportunità di aumento per ulteriori benefici politici.
• -Contattazione di rinnovi mirati per guidare obiettivi di ritenzione.
• -Build rapporto & rapporto con i nostri potenziali e clienti esistenti.
• -L'esperienza nel settore assicurativo sarebbe auspicabile.

Le tue competenze ed esperienza

In qualità di agente di vendita diretto le tue competenze e qualifiche includono:

• -Ottimo modo di telefono e capacità di comunicazione.
• - Buone competenze IT (uso dei prodotti MS Office).
• -Minimo di 2 H5 o C3 di livello superiore nel certificato di abbandono (o equivalente) di terzo livello (livello minimo 6 standard).
• -Completato o essere nel processo di completamento CIP come una qualifica minima e / o ACII – stato più desiderabile piuttosto che richiesto.
• - Esperienza precoce di lavorare in un ambiente di vendita e obiettivo guidato.
• - Avere buone capacità di negoziazione per chiudere la nuova offerta di business o rinnovo & essere mirato.
• -Procedimento coinvolgente, professionale, positivo e flessibile che include la capacità di auto-motivare.
• - Avere attenzione ai dettagli, la capacità di interpretare i dati e la capacità di seguire il lavoro attraverso.

Informazioni aggiuntive

La posizione è basata su Wexford, ma i viaggi occasionali possono essere richiesti in altre località di Zurigo.

Se si apprezza un ambiente di lavoro emozionante e vario e soddisfare i requisiti di cui sopra, allora il nostro recruiter è impaziente di ricevere la vostra applicazione facendo clic sul pulsante “Applicare online”.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è una delle principali compagnie di assicurazione irlandese che fornisce una vasta gamma di assicurazioni generali e prodotti e servizi di assicurazione vita. L'azienda impiega oltre 1.000 persone nelle sue sedi a Dublino e Wexford.

Zurigo è un marchio forte – con i nostri 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo formano la base del nostro successo, aiutando i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere se stessi dal rischio. Al fine di fornire i nostri servizi, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di ulteriore formazione e sviluppo. Come dipendente di Zurigo beneficiate di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una cultura forte, caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e spirito di squadra.

A Zurigo, adottiamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. Il nostro scopo e i nostri valori sono progettati per proteggere, ispirare la fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Apprezziamo e difendiamo ciò che è giusto e promuoviamo opportunità di equità tra i nostri professionisti, indipendentemente dal sesso, dalla disabilità, LGBTQ +, dalla razza, dall'etnia, dalle generazioni, dalla fede, ecc. Unisciti a Zurigo e partecipiamo a questa cultura. Insieme siamo impegnati a fornire sul nostro scopo - Creare un futuro più luminoso insieme!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Personal Lines Direktvertrieb Agent

Zurich Insurance in unserem Wexford Center of Excellence sucht einen Personal Lines Direct Sales Agent, der sich dem Direct New Business Team anschließt, das alle direkten Neugeschäfte in unseren Heim-, Motor- und Van-Produkten verwaltet.

Wenn Sie ein Gespür für den Verkauf haben und eine zielgerichtete Person sind, werden Sie es genießen, in unserem Verkaufsteam zu arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Direktvertriebsagent umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben, sind aber nicht unbedingt auf Folgendes beschränkt:

-In der Arbeit im Verkaufsteam ist der Direktvertriebsmitarbeiter dafür verantwortlich, die Angebote zu verfolgen und den Verkauf unserer Zürich-Produkte (Haus, Motor & Van) telefonisch abzuschließen - direkt bei unseren Kunden.
• Sie arbeiten in einer zielgerichteten Umgebung und werden monatlich mit einem wettbewerbsfähigen Verkaufsbonus belohnt, wenn Sie Ihre monatlichen Ziele erreichen oder übertreffen.
• Identifizieren und entwickeln Sie Anrufe, die wahrscheinlich zu neuen Geschäften führen.
• Identifizieren Sie Cross-Selling-Perspektiven für zusätzliche Produkte und vereinbaren Sie Folgegespräche mit Kunden für zukünftige Verkaufschancen.
• Konvertieren Sie Angebote in Verkäufe, um die Teamziele zu übertreffen.
• Halten Sie aktuelle Kunden im Einklang mit herausfordernden Geschäftszielen.
• -Identifizieren Sie Upsell-Möglichkeiten für zusätzliche politische Vorteile.
• Kontaktaufnahme mit gezielten Erneuerungen, um Retentionsziele zu erreichen.
• Aufbau einer Beziehung und Beziehung zu unseren potenziellen und bestehenden Kunden.
• Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche wäre wünschenswert.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Als Direct Sales Agent umfassen Ihre Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen:

• Ausgezeichnete telefonische art und kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Gute IT-Fähigkeiten (Nutzung von MS Office-Produkten).
• Mindestens 2 H5 oder höheres Niveau C3 im Verlassen Zertifikat (oder gleichwertig) Third Level Qualification (Mindestniveau 6 Standard).
• Abgeschlossen oder dabei sein, CIP als Minimum und / oder ACII-Qualifikation abzuschließen - eher wünschenswerter Zustand als erforderlich.
• -Vorherige Erfahrung in einer verkaufs- und zielorientierten Umgebung.
• Haben Sie gute Verhandlungsfähigkeiten, um das neue Geschäft oder Erneuerungsangebot zu schließen und zielgerichtet zu sein.
• -Enthusiastischer, professioneller, positiver und flexibler Ansatz, der die Fähigkeit zur Selbstmotivation beinhaltet.
• Achten Sie auf Details, die Fähigkeit, Daten zu interpretieren und die Arbeit zu verfolgen.

Zusätzliche Informationen

Position ist Wexford-basierte, aber gelegentliche Reisen zu anderen Zürich Standorten erforderlich sein.

Wenn Sie Wert auf ein spannendes und abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld legen und die oben genannten Anforderungen erfüllen, dann freut sich unser Recruiter auf Ihre Bewerbung per Klick auf den Button „Online bewerben.

Wer wir sind

Zürich ist eines der führenden Versicherungsunternehmen Irlands, das eine breite Palette von allgemeinen Versicherungs- und Lebensversicherungsprodukten und -dienstleistungen anbietet. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt über 1.000 Mitarbeiter an seinen Standorten in Dublin und Wexford.

Zürich ist eine starke Marke – mit unseren 53.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit bilden wir die Basis unseres Erfolgs und helfen unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Territorien, sich selbst zu verstehen und vor Risiken zu schützen. Um unsere Leistungen erbringen zu können, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitern flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Als Mitarbeiter von Zurich profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl von Vorteilen sowie einer starken Kultur, die sich durch Akzeptanz, Vielfalt und Teamgeist auszeichnet.

Bei Zurich fördern wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind darauf ausgerichtet, zu schützen, Vertrauen zu schaffen und unseren Mitarbeitern zu helfen, ihr volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir schätzen und verteidigen, was richtig ist und fördern Chancen für Gerechtigkeit unter unseren Fachleuten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Behinderung, LGBTQ +, Rasse, Ethnizität, Generationen, Überzeugung usw. Schließen Sie sich Zürich an und werden Sie Teil dieser Kultur. Gemeinsam sind wir entschlossen, unseren Zweck zu erfüllen - Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Personal Lines Agent de vente direct

Zurich Assurance dans notre Centre d'excellence Wexford est à la recherche d'un agent de vente direct Personal Lines pour rejoindre le Direct New Business Team qui gère toutes les nouvelles affaires Direct dans notre maison, moteur et van produits.

Si vous avez un style pour les ventes, et sont une personne ciblée cible, vous apprécierez travailler dans notre équipe de ventes.

Votre rôle

En tant qu'agent de vente direct, vos principales responsabilités comprennent, mais pas nécessairement, les suivantes :

-Travailler dans l'équipe de vente, l'Agent de Vente Direct sera chargé de suivre les devis et d'achever les ventes de nos produits Zurich (maison, moteur et van) par téléphone – directement avec nos clients.
• -Vous travaillerez dans un environnement axé sur les cibles et serez récompensé par un bonus de vente compétitif sur une base mensuelle pour atteindre ou dépasser vos cibles mensuelles.
• -Identifiez et développez les appels susceptibles de créer de nouvelles affaires.
• -Identifiez les perspectives de vente croisée pour des produits supplémentaires et organisez des appels de suivi avec les clients pour les futures opportunités de vente.
• -Convertissez les prix en ventes afin de dépasser les objectifs de l'équipe.
• -Conserver les clients actuels en ligne avec des objectifs commerciaux difficiles.
• -Identifiez les possibilités de vente à plus forte valeur ajoutée.
• -Contacter les renouvellements ciblés pour obtenir des objectifs de rétention.
• -Construire un rapport et une relation avec nos clients potentiels et existants.
• - Une expérience dans le secteur des assurances serait souhaitable.

Vos compétences et votre expérience

En tant qu'agent de vente direct, vos compétences et qualifications comprendront :

• - Excellent mode de téléphone et compétences en communication.
• - Bonnes compétences en TI (utilisation des produits MS Office).
• - Minimum de 2 H5 ou plus de niveau C3 dans le certificat de départ (ou l'équivalent) Troisième niveau de qualification (niveau minimum 6 standard).
• -Remplir ou être en train de remplir le CIP comme qualification minimale et / ou ACII – état plus souhaitable plutôt que requis.
• - Expérience antérieure de travail dans un environnement axé sur les ventes et les objectifs.
• - Avoir de bonnes compétences en négociation pour fermer la nouvelle offre d'affaires ou de renouvellement et être ciblé.
• -Une approche enthousiaste, professionnelle, positive et flexible qui inclut la capacité à se motiver.
• -Attention aux détails, à la capacité d'interpréter les données et à suivre les travaux.

Informations complémentaires

La position est basée sur Wexford, mais des voyages occasionnels peuvent être nécessaires à d'autres endroits de Zurich.

Si vous appréciez un environnement de travail passionnant et varié et que vous répondez aux exigences ci-dessus, notre recruteur est impatient de recevoir votre candidature en cliquant sur le bouton « Appliquer en ligne ».

Qui nous sommes

Zurich est l'une des principales compagnies d'assurance irlandaises fournissant une large gamme de produits et services d'assurance générale et d'assurance-vie. L'entreprise emploie plus de 1 000 personnes sur ses sites de Dublin et Wexford.

Zurich est une marque forte – avec ses 53 000 employés dans le monde entier, elle constitue la base de notre succès, aidant nos clients dans 210 pays et territoires à se comprendre et à se protéger des risques. Afin de fournir nos services, nous offrons à nos employés des modèles de travail flexibles et des possibilités intéressantes de formation et de développement. En tant qu'employé de Zurich, vous bénéficiez d'une multitude d'avantages ainsi que d'une culture forte, caractérisée par l'acceptation, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe.

À Zurich, nous favorisons une culture de diversité et d'inclusion. Notre but et nos valeurs sont conçus pour protéger, inspirer confiance et aider nos employés à réaliser leur plein potentiel. Nous apprécions et défendons ce qui est juste et promouvons les opportunités d'équité parmi nos professionnels, indépendamment du sexe, du handicap, LGBTQ +, la race, l'ethnicité, les générations, les croyances, etc. Rejoignez Zurich et faites partie de cette culture. Ensemble, nous nous engageons à réaliser notre objectif - Laissez-nous créer un avenir meilleur ensemble!

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Programs
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is hiring a Senior Program Manager to join our Middle Markets Programs team! We are open to hiring strong Underwriting talent in a hybrid (or fully remote) work environment & will consider talent in the following cities: Chicago IL, Schaumburg IL, Omaha NE, or Atlanta GA and open to others.

As a member of Zurich’s Programs underwriting team, you will enjoy the opportunity to develop your portfolio management skills and collaborate with many stakeholders.

This Senior Program Manager will be responsible for:

- Working with stakeholders to resolve issues and concerns for various Programs within Middle Markets

- Assisting with Dashboard completion and Game Plan updates

- Supporting the Underwriting and product development process

- Executing on referrals from Program Administrators

- Project work as necessary

- Participate in underwriting, sales, claims meetings

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are

Preferred Qualifications:

- Good problem-solving skills

- Strong verbal, listening and written communication skills

- Ability to handle multiple and varied assignments

- Eager to learn

- Networking ability

- Embraces change

- Self-starter

- Ownership minded

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The compensation indicated represents a nationwide market range and has not been adjusted for geographic differentials pertaining to the location where the position may be filled. The proposed salary range for this position is $130,000.00 - $190,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.description:
【Job Responsibility】

1)AIソリューションエンジニアとして、部内関係者および IT 部門と連携し、LLM／生成AIを活用したオペレーション高度化・自動化を推進する。
2)オペレーション領域の課題を把握し、LLM／生成AIを活用した業務プロセスの改善・自動化を企画・実行する。
3)LLM／生成AIアプリケーションのアーキテクチャ・標準・ガバナンスの整備に寄与する。

【Key Tasks & Accountabilities】

1)LLM／生成AIを活用した業務自動化・業務支援ソリューションの設計・実装（ハンズオン中心）。
2)LLMアプリケーション（RAG構成、プロンプト管理、API連携、ログ・監査基盤など）の開発・標準化への寄与。
3)プロジェクト／プロダクトのデリバリー（PoC〜本番展開）：要件整理、開発、進捗管理。
4)LLM出力の品質・安全性・コンプライアンスチェックの実装・運用。
5)データサイエンスチーム、IT部門、業務部門と連携したユースケースの実装支援。
6)ジュニアメンバーへの技術的ガイドおよびナレッジ共有。

【
• Qualifications / Experience】

1)AIソリューション開発、データサイエンス、またはソフトウェア／クラウドエンジニアリングのいずれかの分野での実務経験（3年以上が望ましい）。
2)オペレーションの自動化やAI活用に関する実装経験。
3)AzureまたはAWS上でのアプリケーションもしくはデータ基盤の構築・運用経験。
4)RAG、プロンプトエンジニアリング、API連携等に関する基礎的な理解。
5)PythonおよびSQLの実務経験。
6)統計解析や機械学習などのデータ分析経験があれば尚可。
7)保険業界、特に損害保険業界での業務経験があれば尚可。
8)日本語：ビジネスレベル 英語：ビジネスレベル

【募集要項】

・勤務地：東京本社オフィス（東京都中野区東中野3-14-20）または在宅勤務のハイブリッド勤務

・雇用形態：正社員

・勤務時間：フレックスタイム制；始業および終業の時刻は社員の決定に委ねる（標準となる１日の労働時間：7時間）

フレキシブルタイム6時00分から22時00分、コアタイム なし、1日における最低勤務時間 4時間

休憩時間60分（1日の実労働時間が4時間を超える場合）

・給与：当社規程により決定

※ 前職の経験・スキルを考慮

・休日休暇：年末年始休暇、ペアレンタル・リーブ（6週間の特別有給休暇。社員の性別を問わず取得できる制度）、慶弔休暇、産前産後休暇、ボランティア休暇、Re-Creation休暇

各種社会保険（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災、他）、団体生命保険、会員制福利厚生クラブ加入、EAP: Employee Assistance Program（従業員支援プログラム）、育児休職制度、育児時間制度、介護休職制度、フレックスタイム制度、短時間勤務制度、時差勤務制度、育児休職者の早期復職支援手当、シフト勤務に対する育児支援手当、社内クラブ活動、ドレスコードフリー(服装自由)、オンライン自己啓発プログラム、副業、兼業（届出制）

jobs.description:
【Job Responsibility 】

1)AI Platform & Engineering チームのリードとして、部内関係者および IT 部門と連携し、LLM／生成AI・エージェンティックAIを活用したオペレーション高度化・自動化を推進する。
2)オペレーション領域（引受、保全、損害サービス、バックオフィス等）の課題を把握し、LLM／生成AIを活用した業務プロセスの改善・自動化を企画・実行する。
3)LLM／生成AIアプリケーションのアーキテクチャ・標準・ガバナンスを整備し、安全かつ効率的に展開・運用できる仕組みを構築する。
4)Japan P&C の Data & AI 戦略を理解した上で、業績目標およびオペレーショナル・エクセレンス目標の達成に貢献する。

【Key Tasks & Accountabilities】

1)LLM／生成AIを活用した業務自動化・業務支援ソリューションのロードマップ策定および優先順位付け。
2)LLMアプリケーションのリファレンスアーキテクチャ設計（RAG構成、プロンプト管理、API連携、ログ・監査基盤など）および標準化。
3)プロジェクト／プロダクトのデリバリー統括（PoC〜本番展開）：要件整理、スコープ定義、進捗管理、リスク管理。
4)LLM出力の品質・安全性・コンプライアンスに関するガバナンス枠組みの設計・運用。
5)データサイエンスチーム、IT部門、業務部門との連携によるユースケース創出と実装支援（例：Agentic AI Telephony、Image STP、Citizen Development、LINE & digital tools、AI-assisted coding）。
6)チーム内外でのリーダーシップ発揮（役割分担の明確化、ナレッジ共有の促進）。
7)業務部門長および経営層への状況報告・提案（成果の可視化、次年度以降の投資テーマの整理等）。

【
• Qualifications / Experience】

1)AIソリューション開発、データサイエンス、またはソフトウェア／クラウドエンジニアリングのいずれかの分野における実務経験（5年以上が望ましい）。
2)オペレーションの自動化やAI活用に関する企画立案および実装の実務経験。
3)AzureまたはAWS上でのアプリケーションまたはデータ基盤の設計・構築・運用のいずれかに関する実務経験 （3年以上が望ましい）。
4)プロジェクトまたはチームのリード／マネジメント経験（複数ステークホルダーとの調整・推進を含む）。
5)RAG、プロンプトエンジニアリング、API連携などに関する基礎的な理解。
6)統計解析や機械学習などのデータ分析経験があれば尚可。
7)保険業界、特に損害保険業界、または類似する規制業界での経験があれば尚可。
8)AIガバナンスおよびデータガバナンスに関するプロセス設計・運用の経験があれば尚可。
9)日本語：ビジネスレベル 英語：ビジネスレベル

【募集要項】

・勤務地：東京本社オフィス（東京都中野区東中野3-14-20）または在宅勤務のハイブリッド勤務

・雇用形態：正社員

・勤務時間： 9時00分から17時00分迄

休憩時間60分

・給与：当社規程により決定

・休日休暇：年末年始休暇、ペアレンタル・リーブ（6週間の特別有給休暇。社員の性別を問わず取得できる制度）、慶弔休暇、産前産後休暇、ボランティア休暇、Re-Creation休暇

各種社会保険（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災、他）、団体生命保険、会員制福利厚生クラブ加入、EAP: Employee Assistance Program（従業員支援プログラム）、育児休職制度、育児時間制度、介護休職制度、フレックスタイム制度、短時間勤務制度、時差勤務制度、育児休職者の早期復職支援手当、シフト勤務に対する育児支援手当、社内クラブ活動、ドレスコードフリー(服装自由)、オンライン自己啓発プログラム、副業、兼業（届出制）

jobs.title: SUBDIRECCION DE RECURSOS HUMANOS
jobs.description:
Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo:

SUBDIRECTOR (A) DE RECURSOS HUMANOS

Buscamos un líder capaz de construir e integrar la estrategia de Capital Humano de una alianza entre una institución financiera y una aseguradora, impulsando el crecimiento, la rentabilidad y la transformación organizacional mediante una gestión estratégica del talento y una toma de decisiones basada en resultados.

Objetivo de la posición

Liderar la estrategia integral de Capital Humano de una alianza entre una institución financiera y una aseguradora, definiendo la visión, estructura, cultura y modelo organizacional que impulse el crecimiento, la rentabilidad y la consolidación del negocio.

Será responsable de integrar equipos, procesos y culturas organizacionales, alineando la estrategia de talento con los objetivos del negocio y facilitando la toma de decisiones basada en resultados.

Habilidades y experiencia:

Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Recursos Humanos, Psicología, Administración o afín. Deseable Posgrado.

Experiencia:

- Más de 10 años en posiciones de liderazgo de Recursos Humanos.

- Experiencia en sectores financiero, bancario, asegurador, fintech o empresas reguladas.

- Participación en procesos de integración organizacional, alianzas estratégicas, fusiones o transformación de negocios.

- Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y gestionando culturas organizacionales diversas.

- Conocimientos en nómina, compensaciones, relaciones laborales, cumplimiento laboral y estructuras organizacionales.

- Experiencia generando estrategias de talento orientadas al crecimiento, rentabilidad y resultados del negocio.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Definir e implementar la estrategia de Capital Humano de la alianza.

- Integrar equipos, estructuras y culturas organizacionales.

- Alinear la estrategia de personas con los objetivos del negocio.

- Liderar atracción, desarrollo, sucesión y retención del talento.

- Supervisar los procesos de nómina, compensaciones y cumplimiento laboral.

- Impulsar una cultura de alto desempeño y orientación a resultados.

- Generar indicadores y análisis para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

- Actuar como socio estratégico de la Alta Dirección en iniciativas de crecimiento y transformación.

Competencias clave:

- Visión estratégica y orientación al negocio.

- Toma de decisiones bajo incertidumbre.

- Liderazgo e influencia.

- Pensamiento analítico y gestión por indicadores.

- Gestión del cambio e integración cultural.

- Adaptabilidad, resiliencia e inteligencia emocional.

- Orientación a resultados y rentabilidad.

- Capacidad para integrar perfiles y equipos diversos.

Ofertamos:

- Atractivo esquema de compensación.

- Prestaciones superiores a ley.

- Trabajo Flexible

- Zona de empleo: Toreo de cuatro caminos / Montes Urales

Zurich reconoce la diversidad de nuestra fuerza laboral como una fortaleza, por lo que contamos con políticas y programas de diversidad e inclusión, donde buscamos igualdad de oportunidades sin importar la edad, etnia, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, discapacidades, etc. Como empleador inclusivo, queremos asegurarnos de que todos los candidatos se sientan cómodos y puedan rendir al máximo durante la entrevista.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.title: Plan de Carrera para Agentes Profesionales
jobs.description:
Tu Negocio con Zurich | Programa de Desarrollo de Nuevos Agentes

¿Buscas algo más que un empleo? ¿Y si tu próximo paso profesional fuera construir tu propio negocio con el respaldo de Zurich?

Si buscas algo más que un trabajo tradicional, quieres tener más autonomía y te atrae la idea de desarrollar tu propio proyecto profesional, estás en el lugar correcto.

En Zurich lanzamos nuestro Programa de Desarrollo para Agentes Exclusivos en [Málaga / Valencia / Sevilla / Tenerife / Alicante / Mallorca / Castellón].

Se trata de una oportunidad para desarrollar tu propio negocio como autónomo siendo agente exclusivo para Zurich, creando así tu propia agencia, con el respaldo, la formación, las herramientas y el acompañamiento de una compañía sólida, reconocida y con una apuesta clara por el crecimiento de su red de agentes.

Esta oportunidad no va solo de vender seguros.

Va de crear tu propia actividad profesional, desarrollar una cartera de clientes y crecer acompañado desde el primer día.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Asesoramiento de alto valor: Asesorarás a personas, familias y empresas para ayudarles a proteger lo que más les importa, ofreciendo soluciones aseguradoras adaptadas a sus necesidades.

Desarrollo de tu propio negocio
Construirás tu propia cartera de clientes y desarrollarás una actividad profesional con recorrido, apoyándote en una marca reconocida y en un modelo pensado para crecer.

Una propuesta de valor pensada para ayudarte a crecer
Tendrás una propuesta de valor sólida y servicios de apoyo pensados para que puedas centrarte en lo importante: generar confianza, asesorar bien a tus clientes y hacer crecer tu negocio.

Gestión comercial con herramientas digitales
Contarás con herramientas, datos y recursos comerciales que te ayudarán a gestionar oportunidades, hacer seguimiento de clientes y dedicar más tiempo a generar negocio.

Autonomía con acompañamiento
Organizarás tu actividad con autonomía, pero no estarás solo. Tendrás el apoyo de profesionales expertos que te acompañarán en tu arranque, planificación comercial y evolución como agente.

¿Encajas en esta propuesta?

No buscamos la perfección, ¡buscamos actitud, iniciativa y ganas reales de construir algo propio!

Este plan es ideal si tienes estudios mínimos (Bachillerato, FP o Grado), aptitudes comunicativas y en servicio al cliente y tienes vocación comercial.

Valoramos la experiencia previa en el sector asegurador o en posiciones comerciales, pero no es imprescindible.
Lo importante es que tengas ambición, compromiso y ganas de aprender.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Zurich?

Un programa para ayudarte a construir tu propio negocio
No se trata solo de empezar como agente. Se trata de hacerlo acompañado, con un programa diseñado para ayudarte a arrancar, aprender, ganar confianza comercial y crecer paso a paso.

Formación y certificación oficial
Financiamos tu curso homologado de mediación (Nivel 2 DGSFP) y te acompañaremos para que puedas iniciar tu actividad profesional con una base sólida.

Acompañamiento desde el primer día
Contarás con apoyo experto para orientarte en tus primeros pasos, ayudarte a planificar tu actividad comercial y acompañarte en el desarrollo de tu negocio

Tranquilidad Financiera Inicial y elevado potencial de crecimiento: modelo de comisiones e incentivos altamente competitivo, complementado con un esquema de apoyo económico durante el arranque

Una carrera con futuro
Queremos acompañarte para que puedas construir una cartera, consolidar tu actividad profesional y desarrollar una agencia con recorrido.

¿Por qué Zurich?

Porque no queremos que seas un agente más.

Queremos acompañarte en la construcción de tu propio negocio, con formación, herramientas, apoyo comercial y una marca que apuesta por el desarrollo de nuevos agentes como una palanca clave de crecimiento.

Estamos construyendo la nueva generación de agentes Zurich.

Y queremos contar con personas que quieran formar parte de este proyecto desde el inicio.

¿Sientes que esto es para ti?

Si te ves construyendo tu propio negocio, no lo pienses más, haz clic en inscribirte. Estaré encantada de conocerte, tomar un café (virtual o real) y contarte cómo puedes empezar a construir tu carrera como agente profesional independiente con el respaldo de Zurich.

Empieza a construir tu propio negocio con Zurich.

Enviar candidatura ahora »

Soy Maschio, recuit from este proyecto

Me encanta la música, ir a la playa y conocer a gente nueva. Y hoy estoy aquí para contarte algo que, si estás empezando tu camino profesional (o replanteándotelo), puede interesarte mucho.

Antes de nada, gracias por leer esta oferta . Verdad.

A Zurigo estamos lanzando a Plan de Carrera para Agents Profesionales en Málaga y Valencia (aunque si no estás en alguna de estas Provinces, sigue leyendo que a lo mejor te interesa) , pensado para personas jóvenes con ganas de aprender, crecer y construir un proyecto profesional con futuro. Nessun hablamos solo de un trabajo, sino de una oportunidad para desarrollarte paso a paso, con acompañamiento real y el respaldo de una compañía sólida y cercana.

Un proyecto parabuilder tu futuro

Este plan no es un puesto comercial al uso. Es un itinerario desarrollo profesional , diseñado para que puedas aprender el negocio desde dentro, ganar experiencia, confianza y autonomía, y construir tu propia cartera de clients de forma sostenible.

A Zurigo creemos que nadie nace sabiendo y que el crecimiento se logra con formación, apoyo y tiempo. Por eso, este plan combina aprendizaje costante, acompañamiento cerca y la libertad necesaria para que vayas creando tu propio camino.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Misión será acompañar a personas y empresas en epocas importantes de su vida, ayudándoles a proteger lo que más import. Aprenderás a rilevaar sus necessides, a asesorarles de forma cercana y profesional y a ofrecer soluciones aseguradoras adattaadas a cada situazioneción.

Tu día a día combinará actividad comercial, aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de tu propio proyecto. Irás construyendo relaciones de confianza, haciendo crecer tu cartera de clientelas y trabajando con objetivos claros, siempre con el apoyo de formación, herramientas digitales y un equipo que estará ahí para acompañarte.

Qual e' il problema?

No si vede pedir che cumblas el 100% los requisitis o vienes del settore asegurador. Lo que buscamos es actitud, curiosità y ganas de crecer . Aunque estamos Ethicisme principalmente a personas en Málaga y Valencia, siempre estamos abiertos a encontrar el Talento más TOP, independientemente de dónde esté ubicado.

Este plan es para ti si te motiva el trato con personas, si te organizas bien, te responsibilizas de tus objetivos y atrae un proyecto con visión a largo plazo. Valoraremos experiencia previa en ventas o atención al cliente, pero no es imprescindibile. Davvero importante sei potencial y tus ganas da prendere.

¿Qué te ofrecemos desde Zurich?

Te ofrecemos un plan de carrera estructurado, con una evolución clara y real. Desde el primer día contarás con formación incial y continua, acompañamiento cerca y soporte comercial, tecnico y de marketing para que nunca te sientas solo/a.

Además, disfrutarás de un modelo económico competitivo orientaledo al crecimiento progresivo, flexibilidad para organizar tu actividad y el respaldo de una compañía líder, sólida y con una clara visión de futuro.

Se ha llegado hasta aquí... Gracias por leerme hasta el finale.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Account Engineer-HPR Property
jobs.description:
Zurich’s Property Risk Engineering team seeking a Senior Property Account Engineering consultant with highly protected risk (HPR) experience. This role will include account engineering responsibilities, depending on level of experience and workload. This is a work from home/remote role preferably located in the North East Region, This position may require travel into a local Zurich Office once a month.

Our Senior Property Risk Account Engineer is responsible for:

- Management of account risk portfolio and providing account level engineering to meet underwriting requirements.

- Developing and implementing customer service strategies that reduce loss and improve customer operations.

- Performing plan reviews and supporting change management

- Management of account risk portfolio and providing account level risk engineering to meet underwriting requirements and/or customer requirements where unattached from risk transfer

- Providing engineering support to underwriting team by attending client broker meetings

- Monitoring property account engineering services to ensure that delivery is proper, on-time, and cost effective

- Providing advanced property consultative services to customers, including identifying exposures with significant loss potential, investigation of cause/effect of major losses, and property management programs

- Assist in marketing Zurich risk transfer insurance products in conjunction with underwriting professionals and agents across company business segments

- Assist in marketing of Zurich Resilience Solutions risk engineering services

Senior Risk Engineering Consultant Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 6 or more years of experience within the Risk Engineering area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience within the Risk Engineering area
AND

- Experience with Microsoft Office

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Fire Science, or related degree

- Large account HPR property experience

- Account Executive & Loss Control/Risk Engineering experience within the insurance industry

- Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS)

- Strong communication and consultative skills

- Outstanding collaborative skills

- History of working successfully in a team environment

- High degree of proficiency related to PC and Software or systems

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $100,000.00 - $164,100.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

jobs.description:
Zurich Insurance group is looking for a senior SAM specialist who specializes in SAP enterprise software to join global Software Asset Management function with an objective to optimize software contract spend, manage compliance, analyses data, draw the relevant conclusions and then work with others to implement opportunities or remediate risks. This is a challenging senior role, requiring a broad understanding of IT technology, service management processes and the ability to collaborate with many different stakeholder groups within Zurich Group.

As a SAM Specialist your main responsibilities will be:

• Subject matter expertise, in-depth and proven knowledge of SAM operations and competencies, with ability to apply and advise on complex software licensing topics and produce ELPs specifically for SAP.

• Understands SAP licensing concepts, indirect usage rules and product use rights.

• Navigating and leveraging the SAP4Me, SAP System Measurement Tools - LAW, USSM, self-declaration metrics

• Provide transparency of costs for SW contracts and assure fair allocation of charges to BUs and Service owners based on software usage.

• Negotiate successfully across the organization and with external suppliers/vendors in a constructive and collaborative manner.

• Maintains stakeholder community and enables information sharing environment.

• Proactively identify and drive initiatives to achieve SW related savings, mitigate compliance risks, develop best practices and processes, to continuously improve software asset management service and to ensure compliance with budget and contractual requirements.

• Identify necessary changes and play key role in the complex software contract negotiations, manage demand and contract updates, liaise with external vendors, legal, contract and sourcing teams.

• Support day-to-day activities of the global SAM team

Proven Personal Traits:

• analytical skills, financial and commercial acumen, attention to detail, ability to process data in a complex global organizational environment,

• organizational, productivity, time and project management skills,

• ability to interface, influence and network with managers, staff and stakeholders inside and outside of the organization,

• communication and negotiation skills with vendors as well as with internal stakeholders.

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability

• Proaktive Identifizierung und Förderung von Initiativen zur Erreichung von SW-bezogenen Einsparungen, zur Minderung von Compliance-Risiken, zur Entwicklung von Best Practices und Prozessen, zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Software-Asset-Management-Services und zur Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Budget- und Vertragsanforderungen.
