Job Title: Ejecutivo de Servicio Veracruz

Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Ejecutivo de servicio Veracruz #ZAM”

Objetivo de la posición:

Asegurar una atención postventa oportuna y de calidad a los intermediarios, dando seguimiento puntual a sus trámites y necesidades, coordinando con las áreas internas involucradas, para contribuir a la retención y crecimiento de la cartera.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Negocios, Finanzas, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o afín.

- Experiencia: 2–3 años de experiencia en gestión y seguimiento de trámites administrativos o postventa y atención y servicio a clientes o intermediarios

- Competencias clave: Excelente atención y actitud de servicio. Trabajo en equipo. Comunicación, enfoque al detalle y resultados. Proactividad y sentido de urgencia.

Responsabilidades:

- Dar atención postventa a intermediarios

- Revisión y corrección de facturas

- Reportería de renovaciones

- Actuar como enlace entre el área de cobranza y los agentes/intermediarios para aclarar saldos, pagos, cancelaciones y regularización de cuentas

- Capacitación a agentes de herramientas digitales

- Coordinación con áreas internas.

Ofertamos:

- Programa de bienestar

- Esquema de trabajo flexible

- Desarrollo y Crecimiento

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.description:
Wir verstärken ab sofort unser Vertriebsteam Außendienst in Salzburg, Tirol und Vorarlberg. Du sprichst gerne mit Menschen und bringst ein gewisses Verkaufstalent mit? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! In dieser Position betreust du unsere Kundinnen und Kunden - mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Flexibilität.

Was macht dich zum perfekten Match für diese Rolle?

- Deine Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und am Verkauf sorgt für gute Stimmung und Erfolg im Team.

- Empathie und Kommunikationsstärke zeichnen deine Persönlichkeit aus. Du verstehst es, auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden einzugehen und ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu begegnen.

- Deine Einsatzbereitschaft und deine Überzeugungskraft bilden die Grundlage für eine erfolgreiche Karriere im Vertrieb. Du setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für deine Ziele ein und überzeugst durch dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.

- Du bringst Interesse an Finanzthemen und Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge mit. Diese Eigenschaften helfen dir, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln.

- Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für diese Position erforderlich

Welche abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben erwarten dich?

- Nach der Ausbildung bei uns übernimmst du verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben und betreust dein eigenes Kundennetzwerk

- Individuelle Betreuung wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Deshalb erarbeitest du maßgeschneiderte Versicherungskonzepte, die perfekt auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zugeschnitten sind.

- Durch kontinuierliches Netzwerken wirst du zur ersten Ansprechperson rund um das Thema Versicherung und Vorsorge. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und pflegst diese nachhaltig.

- Du begleitest und unterstützt deine Kundinnen und Kunden im Schadensfall und bei sämtlichen Anliegen. Mit deinem Fachwissen stehst du ihnen in schwierigen Situationen zur Seite und findest gemeinsam die beste Lösung.

- Du bildest dich regelmäßig weiter und kennst unsere Versicherungsprodukte und Services in- und auswendig. So stellst du sicher, dass du immer auf dem neuesten Stand bist und deine Kundinnen und Kunden optimal beraten kannst.

Warum ist es großartig bei Zurich zu arbeiten?

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und einen flexiblen Arbeitsort, der die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie unterstützt

- Einarbeitung und Begleitung durch erfahrene und erfolgreiche Kolleginnen und Kollegen - auch für Quereinsteigende bestens geeignet

- Attraktive und leistungsabhängige Entlohnung

- Eine solide und zertifizierte Grundausbildung und umfassende, laufende Aus- und Weiterbildung

- Perspektive für eigene Entwicklung in verschiedenen Bereichen

- Fixanstellung mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln inklusive Laptop und Handy

- Angebote für deine Gesundheit: Gesundheitsberatung, Betriebsarzt, etc.

- Attraktive Konditionen für Versicherungsprodukte

- Gelebte Diversity und soziales Engagement – PrideZ-Initiative, Eltern-Buddy-Netzwerk, Sozialprojekte

- Mitgestalten unserer Zukunft – digital, innovativ und nachhaltig

- …und das ist nicht alles!

Das zu erwartende Jahresbruttogehalt beträgt zwischen EUR 32.294,97 und EUR 35.000. Dein Gehalt wird als zusätzliche variable Komponente auch Provisionen enthalten. Abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation machen wir dir ein passendes Angebot. Dabei orientieren wir uns an aktuellen Marktgehältern.
Dieser Position liegt der Kollektivvertrag Versicherungsunternehmen Außendienst zugrunde.

Was macht Zurich besonders?
Unsere rund 1.300 engagierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen setzen sich miteinander dafür ein, für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bestmöglich da zu sein. Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe und gehen dabei auch unkonventionelle Wege, um herausragende Lösungen zu bieten. Das bleibt nicht unbemerkt: Unsere innovativen Produkte und Services wurden mehrfach ausgezeichnet und wir zählen zu den Top Ten der Versicherungen Österreichs. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine neue, aufregende Zukunft der Versicherungsbranche.

Du findest dich in unseren Werten wieder und die Rolle wäre ein passender Karriereschritt für dich? Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung (Lebenslauf; optional Bewerbungsschreiben) über den Button Jetzt bewerben .

Bei Fragen sind wir gerne für dich da:
Zürich Versicherungs-Aktiengesellschaft
Doris Leherbauer
Karolingerstraße 3a
5020 Salzburg
Tel.: (0662) 842516 - 5012
https://www.zurich.at/ueber-zurich/zurich-karriere

*) Wir betonen besonders, dass du – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Identität, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Nationalität, Religion, Beeinträchtigung sowie Herkunft – bei ZURICH Österreich willkommen bist.

descriptionByLocale.it:
D'ora in poi, stiamo rafforzando il nostro team di vendita a Salisburgo, Tirolo e Vorarlberg. Ti piace parlare con le persone e portare un certo talento di vendita? Allora hai proprio ragione con noi! In questa posizione, supporta i nostri clienti - con un sacco di responsabilità personale e flessibilità.

Cosa ti rende la partita perfetta per questo ruolo?

- Il vostro piacere in cooperazione e vendite assicura un buon umore e il successo nel team.

- Empatia e comunicazione caratterizzano la tua personalità. Capisci come rispondere alle esigenze dei nostri clienti e soddisfarli a livello degli occhi.

- Il vostro impegno e la persuasione costituiscono la base per una carriera di successo nelle vendite. Sei appassionato dei tuoi obiettivi e convinci attraverso il tuo aspetto sicuro.

- Hai un interesse per gli argomenti finanziari e una comprensione dei contesti economici. Queste qualità ti aiutano a prendere decisioni informate e a sviluppare soluzioni innovative.

- La buona conoscenza del tedesco è necessaria per questa posizione

Quali compiti diversi vi aspettano?

- Dopo la formazione con noi, si assume compiti responsabili e gestire la propria rete clienti

- La cura individuale è molto importante per noi. Ecco perché si sviluppano concetti di assicurazione su misura che sono perfettamente adattati alle esigenze dei nostri clienti.

- Attraverso una rete continua, si diventa la prima persona di contatto intorno al tema dell'assicurazione e della fornitura. Costruisci relazioni di fiducia e li mantieni in modo sostenibile.

- Accompagnate e sostenete i vostri clienti in caso di danni e in tutte le preoccupazioni. Con la vostra esperienza, si sta accanto a loro in situazioni difficili e trovare la soluzione migliore insieme.

- Impara regolarmente e conosci i nostri prodotti e servizi assicurativi all'interno e all'esterno. Questo garantisce che sei sempre aggiornato e in grado di consigliare i tuoi clienti in modo ottimale.

Perché è bello lavorare a Zurigo?

- Ore lavorative flessibili e un luogo di lavoro flessibile che supporta l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa

- Formazione e supporto da parte di colleghi esperti e di successo - adatti anche per i partecipanti laterali

- Remunerazione attraente e basata sulle prestazioni

- Formazione di base solida e certificata e formazione continua e completa

- Prospettiva di sviluppo proprio in vari settori

- Lavoro fisso con attrezzature di lavoro moderne tra cui laptop e telefono cellulare

- Offerte per la salute: consulenza sanitaria, medico aziendale, ecc.

- Condizioni interessanti per i prodotti assicurativi

- La diversità vivente e l'impegno sociale – Iniziativa PrideZ, rete padre, progetti sociali

- plasmare il nostro futuro – digitale, innovativo e sostenibile

- ...e non è tutto!

Lo stipendio lordo annuo previsto è compreso tra 32.294.97 euro e 35.000 euro. Il tuo stipendio includerà anche commissioni come componente variabile aggiuntivo. A seconda della tua esperienza e delle tue qualifiche, ti faremo un'offerta adatta. Ci concentriamo sugli attuali stipendi di mercato.
Questo articolo si basa sul contratto collettivo di assicurazione servizio sul campo società.

Cosa rende speciale Zurigo?
I nostri circa 1.300 colleghi impegnati lavorano insieme per essere lì per i nostri clienti nel modo migliore possibile. Ci incontriamo a livello degli occhi e andiamo anche modi non convenzionali per offrire soluzioni eccezionali. Questo non va inosservato: I nostri prodotti e servizi innovativi sono stati premiati più volte e siamo tra le prime dieci compagnie di assicurazione in Austria. Insieme, stiamo plasmando un nuovo, emozionante futuro per l'industria dell'assicurazione.

Ti trovi nei nostri valori e il ruolo sarebbe un passo di carriera adatto per te? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online (CV; lettera di applicazione opzionale) tramite il pulsante Applica Ora.

Se avete domande, siamo lieti di aiutarvi:
Società di assicurazione di Zurigo

Karolingerstraße 3a
5020 Salisburgo
Tel. (0662) 842516 - 5012
https://www.zurich.at/ueber-zurich/zurich carriera

*) Sottolineiamo in particolare che voi – indipendentemente dal sesso, dall'identità, dall'età, dall'orientamento sessuale, dalla nazionalità, dalla religione, dalla disabilità e dall'origine – siete i benvenuti a ZURICH Austria.
descriptionByLocale.en:
From now on, we are strengthening our sales team in Salzburg, Tyrol and Vorarlberg. Do you like to talk to people and bring a certain sales talent? Then you are exactly right with us! In this position, you support our customers - with a lot of personal responsibility and flexibility.

What makes you the perfect match for this role?

- Your pleasure in cooperation and sales ensures a good mood and success in the team.

- Empathy and communication characterize your personality. You understand how to respond to the needs of our customers and meet them at eye level.

- Your commitment and persuasion form the basis for a successful career in sales. You are passionate about your goals and convince through your self-confident appearance.

- You have an interest in financial topics and an understanding of economic contexts. These qualities help you make informed decisions and develop innovative solutions.

- Good knowledge of German is required for this position

What varied tasks await you?

- After training with us, you take on responsible tasks and manage your own customer network

- Individual care is very important to us. This is why you develop tailor-made insurance concepts that are perfectly tailored to the needs of our customers.

- Through continuous networking, you become the first contact person around the topic of insurance and provision. You build trusting relationships and maintain them sustainably.

- You accompany and support your customers in the event of damage and in all concerns. With your expertise, you stand by them in difficult situations and find the best solution together.

- You learn regularly and know our insurance products and services inside and out. This ensures that you are always up-to-date and can advise your customers optimally.

Why is it great to work at Zurich?

- Flexible working hours and a flexible place of work that supports work-life balance

- Training and support by experienced and successful colleagues - also suitable for lateral entrants

- Attractive and performance-based remuneration

- Solid and certified basic training and comprehensive, ongoing education and training

- Perspective for own development in various areas

- Fixed employment with modern work equipment including laptop and mobile phone

- Offers for your health: health advice, company doctor, etc.

- Attractive conditions for insurance products

- Living diversity and social commitment – PrideZ initiative, parent-buddy network, social projects

- Shaping our future – digital, innovative and sustainable

- ...and that is not all!

The expected annual gross salary is between EUR 32,294.97 and EUR 35,000. Your salary will also include commissions as an additional variable component. Depending on your experience and qualifications, we will make you a suitable offer. We focus on current market salaries.
This item is based on the collective agreement insurance company field service.

What makes Zurich special?
Our approximately 1,300 committed colleagues work together to be there for our customers in the best possible way. We meet each other at eye level and also go unconventional ways to offer outstanding solutions. This does not go unnoticed: Our innovative products and services have been awarded several times and we are among the top ten insurance companies in Austria. Together, we are shaping a new, exciting future for the insurance industry.

You find yourself in our values and the role would be a suitable career step for you? We look forward to your online application (CV; optional application letter) via the Apply Now button.

If you have any questions, we are happy to help you:
Zurich Insurance Company
Doris Leherbauer
Karolingerstraße 3a
5020 Salzburg
Tel: (0662) 842516 - 5012
https://www.zurich.at/ueber-zurich/zurich career

*) We emphasize in particular that you – regardless of gender, identity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, religion, impairment and origin – are welcome at ZURICH Austria.

Qu'est-ce qui vous fait le meilleur match pour ce rôle ?

- Votre plaisir dans la coopération et les ventes assure une bonne humeur et le succès dans l'équipe.

- L'empathie et la communication caractérisent votre personnalité. Vous comprenez comment répondre aux besoins de nos clients et les satisfaire au niveau des yeux.

- Votre engagement et votre persuasion constituent la base d'une carrière réussie dans les ventes. Vous êtes passionné par vos objectifs et convainquez par votre apparence de confiance.

- Vous avez un intérêt pour les sujets financiers et une compréhension des contextes économiques. Ces qualités vous aident à prendre des décisions éclairées et à développer des solutions innovantes.

Quelles tâches variées vous attendent ?

Zurich North America is hiring a Sr. Corporate Counsel – Corp Governance to join our Legal team! We are open to hiring talent in our Schaumburg, IL Corporate Headquarters.

In this role you will be responsible to:

- Identify, manage and mitigate legal, regulatory and corporate governance risks, to enable the business to achieve its strategic and commercial goals in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and to protect and preserve Zurich’s tangible and intangible assets.

- The role holder provides in-house legal, regulatory and governance advice on Governance, , Communications, Investor Relations, IT, Data Protection, Group Operations, Mergers & Acquisitions, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs.

Key Accountabilities:

- Corporate Legal – Regulatory, Governance and Company Secretariat

- Ensure legal advice accurately reflects applicable laws and regulations.

- Promote the practice of the organizational values, ethical and responsible business conduct.

- Provide a full range of legal advice and services on corporate legal issues relevant to objectives set by the Corporate Legal Team Lead/General Counsel which may include concerning Governance, Communications, Investor Relation, Regulatory Affairs, Finance and Capital Market transactions, Sourcing, IT, Data Protection.

- Proactively detect and resolve material legal and regulatory issues.

- Report on and escalate material legal and regulatory risks and issues.

- Address potential conflicts between management and legal entity view by either aligning the two views or by actively identifying and managing the divergences.

- Business Travel, as required

- Extended Hours during Peak Periods, as required

- Regular Predictable Attendance

- Visibility in the Office, as required

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 6 or more years of experience in the Legal area
AND

- Member of the Bar

- Knowledge of NILS, Lexis or Westlaw

Preferred Qualifications :

- Insurance Industry experience

- Strong organizational and analytical skills

- Excellent communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
#ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is currently hiring a:

Business Analyst

Zurich Capability Center is looking for Business Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the design, configuration and optimization of their business processes, leveraging our advanced INSIS platform. Your expertise will help organizations maximize value and enhance stakeholder satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

- Facilitate face-to-face workshops with clients to design and map out optimized business processes aligned with the platform's capabilities.

- Identify and define innovative solutions that enhance the value delivered to stakeholders.

- Design and configure solutions utilizing INSIS and related systems.

- Support clients in understanding business processes as they relate to the INSIS platform.

- Conduct product demonstrations and training sessions for clients on the effective use of INSIS.

- Lead strategic planning for functional analysis and prioritize business requirements based on client needs.

- Execute functional team tasks, ensuring thorough follow-up on requirements gathering, analysis, and configuration.

- Provide support in clarifying tasks for the technical team and assist in planning the testing strategy.

- Map business processes and create SIPOC diagrams collaboratively with clients.

- Participate in proof-of-concept initiatives across various business lines.

Qualifications:

- Proven experience in business process consulting within the insurance sector (Life, P&C).

- Strong understanding of business process mapping and requirements gathering.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a knack for training and mentorship.

- Ability to analyze complex business requirements and translate them into actionable plans.

- Experience in product configuration with INSIS (PAS, BLC, Commissions)

- Experience in complex implementations.

- A proactive approach to problem-solving and client engagement.

- Advanced English level.

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability

Are you fascinated by the design and further development of the IT architecture in a dynamic and innovative environment? Do you want to actively shape the technological orientation of a leading company and ensure that the IT strategy is optimally aligned with business objectives?

In your role as Lead Enterprise IT Architect, you are part of Enterprise Architecture & Planning, which is responsible for the strategic planning and development of the IT architecture. You will work in an environment that promotes innovation and strategic thinking and have the opportunity to actively shape the technological future of Zurich Switzerland.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as Lead Enterprise IT Architect.

What you do

- Develop and maintain the IT architecture strategy to ensure it is optimally aligned with business objectives

- You lead architecture projects and ensure that architecture standards and guidelines are adhered to

- You work closely with different stakeholders to identify technological requirements and develop innovative solutions

- You will analyze existing IT systems and processes to identify and implement optimization potential

- You will monitor technological trends and evaluate their relevance for the strategic orientation of Zurich Switzerland

What you bring

- Higher education in computer science or a related field as well as in-depth knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF

- Several years of experience in the development and implementation of IT architecture strategies in a complex corporate environment, preferably in insurance or banking

- Tool responsibility for the architecture tool AdoIT as well as its further development as well as expertise in current technological trends and their application in corporate architecture

- Strong ability to think strategically and analyze complex relationships as well as strong communication and implementation skills to convince different stakeholders and successfully advance projects

- Flowing knowledge of German and English

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Hybrids working: up to 40%

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

To handle single and multi-party personal or commercial line claims of moderate to high exposure and complexity within specific authority limits, to ensure that claims are handled in the most efficient, effective way while delivering a customer-centric claims service.

Job Qualifications

Required:

- Minimun 3 years of experience as Claim Handler or Claim Analyst handling Property or Machinery claims.

Preferred:

- Having engineering education background

- Document claims file by accurately capturing and updating claims data/information.

- To determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts.Analyze and determine policy coverage.

- Work to have a timely resolution to claims by developing case strategy, developing a case evaluation, escalating issues as appropriate.

- Establish timely reserves and perform ongoing review throughout teh claims cycle within authority limits.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del lavoro

Per gestire le richieste di linea personali o commerciali di singole e multiparti di esposizione da moderata a elevata e complessità entro limiti di autorità specifici, al fine di garantire che i reclami siano gestiti in modo più efficiente, efficace durante la fornitura di un servizio di reclami incentrati sul cliente.

Qualifiche di lavoro

Richiesto:

- Minimo 3 anni di esperienza come Claim Handler o Claim Analyst gestione proprietà o macchinari reclami.

Preferito:

- Sfondo di istruzione ingegneristica

- Essendo stato in Loss Adjuster prima

Capacità di lavoro - Capacità di contabilità chiave

- Documento sostiene file catturando e aggiornando con precisione i dati / informazioni richieste.

- Per determinare la responsabilità raccogliendo e analizzando i fatti rilevanti. Analizzare e determinare la copertura politica.

- Lavorare per avere una risoluzione tempestiva ai reclami sviluppando la strategia dei casi, sviluppando una valutazione dei casi, aumentando i problemi come appropriato.

- Stabilire le riserve tempestive e eseguire la revisione in corso durante il ciclo di rivendicazioni teh entro limiti di autorità.

- Valutare i danni e negoziare la liquidazione del reclamo stabilendo una strategia di negoziazione appropriata.

- Soddisfare gli standard di qualità seguendo le migliori pratiche.

- Assicurare il servizio clienti comunicando in modo proattivo le informazioni, rispondendo alle richieste, seguendo i protocolli del cliente.

- Allineato alla strategia di gestione del venditore Claims dell'organizzazione.

- Assicurare la conformità legale con le seguenti leggi e regolamenti e requisiti di controllo interno.

- Fare riferimento alla sottoroga e alle squadre di frode.

- Contribuisci alla crescita redditizia fornendo informazioni, informazioni e tendenze di rischio a Business Unit o al cliente come necessario.

- Proteggi una reputazione dell'organizzazione mantenendo le informazioni riservate.

- Comprendere l'attuale con le tendenze del settore e stabilire reti personali e partecipare a società professionali.

- Gestisci il contenzioso assegnando il consulente all'interno del pannello approvato, ove applicabile.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Unisciti a noi come esploriamo costantemente nuovi modi per proteggere i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

Stellenbeschreibung

Behandlung von Einzel- und Mehrparteienforderungen von mittlerer bis hoher Exposition und Komplexität innerhalb spezifischer Behördengrenzen, um sicherzustellen, dass Forderungen auf die effizienteste und effektivste Weise behandelt werden, während ein kundenorientierter Schadensdienst bereitgestellt wird.

Berufsqualifikationen

Vorgeschrieben:

- Minimun 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Claim Handler oder Claim Analyst beim Umgang mit Immobilien- oder Maschinenforderungen.

Bevorzugt:

- Ingenieurausbildung Hintergrund

- Vorher schon im Loss Adjuster gewesen

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

- Dokument Ansprüche Datei durch genaue Erfassung und Aktualisierung der Ansprüche Daten / Informationen.

- Um die Haftung zu bestimmen, indem Sie relevante Fakten sammeln und analysieren. Analysieren und bestimmen Sie die Versicherungsdeckung.

- Arbeiten Sie daran, eine rechtzeitige Lösung für Ansprüche zu finden, indem Sie eine Fallstrategie entwickeln, eine Fallbewertung entwickeln und gegebenenfalls Probleme eskalieren.

- Richten Sie rechtzeitige Reserven ein und führen Sie eine laufende Überprüfung während des gesamten Schadenzyklus innerhalb der Autoritätsgrenzen durch.

- Beurteilen Sie Schadensersatz und verhandeln Sie die Schadensregulierung durch Festlegung einer angemessenen Verhandlungsstrategie.

- Erfüllen Sie Qualitätsstandards, indem Sie Best Practices befolgen.

- Stellen Sie den Kundenservice sicher, indem Sie proaktiv Informationen kommunizieren, Anfragen beantworten und Kundenprotokolle befolgen.

- Ausrichtung auf die Claims Vendor Management Strategie des Unternehmens.

- Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Rechtsvorschriften durch Einhaltung von Gesetzen und Vorschriften sowie internen Kontrollanforderungen.

- Verweisen Sie auf Subrogation und Betrug Teams.

- Tragen Sie zum profitablen Wachstum bei, indem Sie der Business Unit oder dem Kunden bei Bedarf Informationen, Risiken und Trends zur Verfügung stellen.

- Schützen Sie die Reputation einer Organisation, indem Sie die Schadensinformationen vertraulich behandeln.

- Verstehen Sie den Strom mit Branchentrends und etablieren Sie persönliche Netzwerke und beteiligen Sie sich an Fachgesellschaften.

- Verwalten Sie Rechtsstreitigkeiten, indem Sie gegebenenfalls einen Anwalt innerhalb des genehmigten Gremiums zuweisen.

Warum Zürich

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der weiß, dass jeder Mitarbeiter einzigartig ist - das macht unser Team so großartig!
Begleiten Sie uns, während wir ständig neue Wege erkunden, um unsere Kunden und den Planeten zu schützen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé de l'emploi

Traiter les réclamations individuelles ou commerciales d'exposition modérée à élevée et de complexité dans les limites des pouvoirs spécifiques, afin de s'assurer que les réclamations sont traitées de la manière la plus efficace et la plus efficiente tout en offrant un service de réclamations axé sur la clientèle.

Qualifications professionnelles

Requis :

- Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant qu'analyste ou analyste de revendications traitant les réclamations de biens ou de machines.

Préféré:

- Avoir une formation en ingénierie

- Ayant été dans le régulateur de perte avant

Responsabilités au travail - Principales responsabilités

- Documenter le dossier des réclamations en saisissant et en mettant à jour avec précision les données et les renseignements sur les réclamations.

- Déterminer la responsabilité en recueillant et en analysant les faits pertinents. Analyser et déterminer la couverture de la police.

- S'efforcer de régler rapidement les revendications en élaborant une stratégie de cas, en établissant une évaluation de cas et en accroissant les problèmes au besoin.

- Établir des réserves en temps opportun et effectuer un examen continu tout au long du cycle des demandes dans les limites des pouvoirs.

- Évaluer les dommages et négocier le règlement de la réclamation en établissant une stratégie de négociation appropriée.

- Respecter les normes de qualité en suivant les pratiques exemplaires.

- Assurer le service à la clientèle en communiquant de façon proactive de l'information, en répondant aux demandes de renseignements, en suivant les protocoles clients.

- Harmonisation avec la stratégie de gestion des fournisseurs de réclamations de l'organisation.

- Assurer le respect de la législation en respectant les lois et règlements et les exigences en matière de contrôle interne.

- Se référer aux équipes de subrogation et de fraude.

- Contribuer à une croissance rentable en fournissant des renseignements, des renseignements et des tendances sur les risques à l'unité d'affaires ou au client au besoin.

- Protéger la réputation d'une organisation en maintenant les renseignements sur les réclamations confidentiels.

- Comprendre l'actualité avec les tendances de l'industrie, établir des réseaux personnels et participer à des sociétés professionnelles.

- Gérer les litiges en attribuant des avocats au sein du comité approuvé, le cas échéant.

Pourquoi Zurich

À Zurich, nous aimons penser en dehors de la boîte et défier le statu quo. Nous adoptons une approche optimiste en nous concentrant sur les positifs et nous demandons constamment ce qui peut aller bien?

Nous sommes un employeur à chances égales qui sait que chaque employé est unique - c'est ce qui rend notre équipe si géniale!
Rejoignez-nous en explorant constamment de nouvelles façons de protéger nos clients et la planète.

jobs.description:
Du stellst gern Schadenfälle auf den Prüfstand und suchst nach intelligenten Wegen, Regresspotenziale konsequent und fair zu nutzen? In dieser Rolle fokussierst du dich auf die gezielte Durchsetzung von Regressen in der Sach- und Haftpflichtversicherung und trägst damit wesentlich zur Ergebnisqualität und Professionalität unseres Schadenbereichs bei. Du kombinierst juristisches und versicherungstechnisches Know-how und setzt deine Verhandlungskompetenz ein, um tragfähige Lösungen mit unterschiedlichsten Anspruchsgruppen zu erzielen.

Als Regressspezialist beurteilst Du Regresspotenziale, führst Aktivregresse nach Rechtslage eigenständig durch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Fachspezialisten unsere systematische Regesserkennung weiter. Gleichzeitig sorgst du mit Partnerfirmen für eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Regressen im Ausland und stellst das Inkasso sicher. Du gibst dein Wissen in Schulungen und Coachings an Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter und trägst so dazu bei, Regressprozesse zu professionalisieren und für Zurich wie auch für unsere Kundschaft einen nachhaltigen Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Du hast Freude an analytischer Arbeit, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest die Schadenwelt mit modernen Methoden und datenbasiertem Arbeiten voranbringen? Dann erwartet dich bei uns eine abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, in der du deine Fachkompetenz, deine Verhandlungssicherheit und deinen Teamgeist voll einbringen kannst.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Regressspezialist Sach- und Haft.

Was du tust

- Du prüfst und tätigst Aktivregresse nach Rechtslage– mit Fokus auf Sach- und technische Versicherungen.

- Du verhandelst zielorientiert mit anderen Versicherungsgesellschaften sowie Regressschuldnern aus dem Privat- und Unternehmensbereich.

- Du arbeitest eng mit internen Partnern und externen Partnerfirmen zusammen, insbesondere bei Auslandregressen, und stellst das Inkasso von Forderungen sicher.

- Du erarbeitest die Grundlagen für Rechtsöffnungsklagen und unterstützt damit eine effiziente rechtliche Durchsetzung.

- Du trägst zur Weiterentwicklung einer modernen,System-gestützten Regresserkennung bei und bringst dein Know-how in Projekte und Arbeitsgruppen ein.

Was du mitbringst

- Ein schweizerisches Rechtsstudium oder eine Versicherungslaufbahn mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Komplexschaden

- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Haftpflicht- und Regressrecht im Sachschadenbereich.

- Freude am Verhandeln mit Versicherern und weiteren Parteien sowie ausgeprägtes Durchsetzungsvermögen.

- Deutsch als Muttersprache und gute Französischkenntnisse; Englisch und Italienisch sind von Vorteil.

- Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Teamfähigkeit sowie Bereitschaft, Wissen zu teilen – z.B. durch Schulungen und fachlichen Support zu Regressthemen.

Dein Kontakt

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Bernd Makasy (044 628 42 14)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Information für Personalvermittler

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

Ti piace mettere casi di danno alla prova e cercare modi intelligenti per utilizzare il potenziale di regressione in modo coerente e corretto? In questo ruolo, si concentra sull'applicazione mirata dei ricorsi nell'assicurazione di proprietà e responsabilità e quindi contribuire in modo significativo alla qualità dei risultati e la professionalità del nostro settore crediti. Unisci il know-how legale e assicurativo e utilizzi le tue capacità di negoziazione per raggiungere soluzioni valide con una vasta gamma di stakeholder.

In qualità di specialista del ricorso, si valutano i potenziali ricorsi, indipendentemente effettuare i ricorsi attivi secondo la situazione legale e sviluppare il nostro sistematico riconoscimento di ricorso insieme a specialisti. Allo stesso tempo, si lavora con le aziende partner per garantire una riuscita implementazione del ricorso all'estero e garantire la raccolta del debito. Trasferisci la tua conoscenza ai colleghi nelle sessioni di formazione e nelle sessioni di coaching e contribuisci così alla professionalizzazione dei processi di regressione e alla creazione di valore aggiunto sostenibile per Zurigo e i nostri clienti.

Ti piace il lavoro analitico, come assumerti la responsabilità e vuoi far avanzare il mondo dei danni con metodi moderni e lavoro basato sui dati? Poi un variegato compito vi aspetta con noi, in cui potete contribuire pienamente alla vostra esperienza, alla vostra fiducia di negoziazione e al vostro spirito di squadra.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come specialista di ricorso per proprietà e detenzione.

Cosa fai

- Controllare e attivare i ricorsi attivi secondo la situazione legale – con un focus sull'assicurazione materiale e tecnica.

- Si negoziano obiettivi orientati con altre compagnie di assicurazione e debitori di ricorso dai settori privato e societario.

- Si lavora a stretto contatto con partner interni e società partner esterne, soprattutto nei rapporti esteri, e garantire la raccolta del debito.

- Si svilupperà la base per i procedimenti legali e quindi sostenere l'applicazione legale efficiente.

- Contribuisci all'ulteriore sviluppo di un moderno riconoscimento di un ricorso basato sul sistema e porta il tuo know-how a progetti e gruppi di lavoro.

Cosa porti

- Una laurea in diritto svizzero o una carriera assicurativa con diversi anni di esperienza in danni complessi

- Conoscenza approfondita della responsabilità e del diritto di ricorso nel campo dei danni di proprietà.

- Goditi di negoziare con gli assicuratori e altre parti, così come forte assertività.

- Tedesco come lingua madre e buona conoscenza del francese; inglese e italiano sono benefiche.

- Alto livello di competenza sociale, lavoro di squadra e disponibilità a condividere la conoscenza – ad esempio attraverso la formazione e il supporto professionale su argomenti di regresso.

Il tuo contatto

Do you like to put damage cases to the test and look for intelligent ways to use regression potential consistently and fairly? In this role, you focus on the targeted enforcement of recourses in property and liability insurance and thus contribute significantly to the quality of results and professionalism of our claims area. You combine legal and insurance know-how and use your negotiating skills to achieve viable solutions with a wide range of stakeholders.

As a recourse specialist, you assess potential recourses, independently carry out active recourses according to the legal situation and develop our systematic recourse recognition together with specialists. At the same time, you work with partner companies to ensure a successful implementation of recourse abroad and ensure debt collection. You pass on your knowledge to colleagues in training sessions and coaching sessions and thus contribute to professionalizing processes of regression and creating sustainable added value for Zurich and our customers.

You enjoy analytical work, like to take on responsibility and want to advance the damage world with modern methods and data-based work? Then a varied task awaits you with us, in which you can fully contribute your expertise, your negotiating confidence and your team spirit.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as a recourse specialist for property and detention.

What you do

- You check and activate active recourses according to the legal situation – with a focus on material and technical insurance.

- You negotiate goal-oriented with other insurance companies and recourse debtors from the private and corporate sectors.

- You work closely with internal partners and external partner companies, especially in foreign recourses, and ensure debt collection.

- You will develop the basis for legal proceedings and thus support efficient legal enforcement.

- You contribute to the further development of a modern, system-based recourse recognition and bring your know-how to projects and working groups.

What you bring

- A Swiss law degree or an insurance career with several years of experience in complex damage

- In-depth knowledge of liability and recourse law in the field of property damage.

- Enjoy negotiating with insurers and other parties as well as strong assertiveness.

- German as a mother tongue and good knowledge of French; English and Italian are beneficial.

- High level of social competence, teamwork and willingness to share knowledge – e.g. through training and professional support on regress topics.

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Bernd Makasy (044 628 42 14)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. Vous transmettez vos connaissances à vos collègues lors de sessions de formation et de coaching et contribuez ainsi à professionnaliser les processus de régression et à créer une valeur ajoutée durable pour Zurich et nos clients.

Ensuite, une tâche variée vous attend avec nous, dans laquelle vous pouvez apporter pleinement votre expertise, votre confiance en négociation et votre esprit d'équipe.

Ce que tu fais

- Vous contrôlez et activez les recours actifs selon la situation juridique – en mettant l'accent sur l'assurance matérielle et technique.

- Vous négociez avec d'autres compagnies d'assurance et des débiteurs de recours du secteur privé et des entreprises.

- Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires internes et des entreprises partenaires externes, en particulier dans les recours étrangers, et vous assurez le recouvrement de la dette.

- Vous développerez la base des procédures judiciaires et favoriserez ainsi une application efficace de la loi.

- Vous contribuez au développement d'une reconnaissance moderne et systémique des recours et apportez votre savoir-faire aux projets et aux groupes de travail.

Ce que vous apportez

- Diplôme de droit suisse ou carrière d'assurance avec plusieurs années d'expérience en dommages complexes

- Connaissance approfondie du droit de la responsabilité et des recours dans le domaine des dommages matériels.

- Profitez des négociations avec les assureurs et d'autres parties ainsi que d'une solide assurance.

- L'allemand comme langue maternelle et la bonne connaissance du français; l'anglais et l'italien sont bénéfiques.

- Un niveau élevé de compétence sociale, de travail d'équipe et de volonté de partager des connaissances – par exemple par la formation et le soutien professionnel sur des sujets de régression.

Impulsar el crecimiento de ventas de productos y soluciones aseguradoras, dentro del ramo daños. Fortalecer relaciones con clientes clave, gestionar activamente agentes y generar valor a través de asesoría experta, para contribuir al desarrollo y posicionamiento de la compañía en el mercado.

What can happen when you grow your career?

Now’s the time to take the next step and make a difference. At Zurich, we want your ideas and experiences to help us grow and create lasting change.

Know someone who would be a great fit for this role? Zurich North America has two talent referral programs in the US. Scroll down to learn more and submit your referral.

Zurich North America is currently hiring a Underwriting Analyst - E&S Financial Lines in our Scottsdale, AZ; Chicago, IL; and Atlanta, GA office! While this role is based out of our Scottsdale, AZ office, the position will provide you the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis, requiring to be in office 3 days a week. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you and our E&S Financial Lines team members.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Reviews, evaluates and analyzes risk exposures, controls, loss history, financial condition and recommends or executes, underwriting decisions around submission acceptance or declination within established risk appetite.

- Anticipates underwriting exposure information needs, and proactively seeks out alternative, relevant data sources using underwriting tools to improve understanding of risks.

- Analyze and recommends input in areas of policy rating, subjective pricing, policy construction, coverages and exclusions, mandatory forms, etc. that are needed to accurately quote and/or renew policies (bonds).

- Develops and executes account servicing solutions independently and in collaboration with Underwriter, with responsibility for end-to-end servicing processes for new business, renewals, and endorsements for more complex business accounts.

- Drives broker/agent/distributor/customer interactions and on-site calls related to account servicing matters with a planned and well-prepared purpose. Builds strong working relationships outside the team and with broker counterparts.

- Develops new team members and provides support and coaching to peers, based on quality results. Provides coaching and problem solving for complex transactions / issues while educating peers on the context behind the solution.

- Supports special projects as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associate Degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting or Market Facing area.
AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal and regulatory environment.

- Experience with data collection and analysis

- Experience with processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry.

- Customer service experience

- Problem solving experience

- Experience servicing product portfolios for multiple lines of business for insurance.

- Microsoft Office experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Knowledge of underwriting philosophy and techniques

- Knowledge of national and local insurance filing regulations and guidelines

- Knowledge of international insurance programs

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $54,500.00 - $89,200.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

jobs.description:
L’opportunité

Vous recherchez un environnement de travail bienveillant, collaboratif et axé sur des valeurs, avec des collègues et des leaders inspirants? Vous avez l’ambition et le désir d’exceller et de vous épanouir chez le plus influent assureur mondial? Ne cherchez pas plus loin que Zurich Canada.

Si vous possédez une expérience en actuariat et recherchez un nouveau défi, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

Zurich Canada recherche actuellement un analyste actuariel senior, Tarification automobile – Particuliers, pour soutenir le processus de tarification des assurances automobiles de particuliers et fournir des analyses et des perspectives à l'équipe de tarification automobile et à nos partenaires commerciaux.

Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez également aux modifications tarifaires, aux déclarations et à la communication de ces modifications auprès des partenaires internes. Vous participerez à l'amélioration continue de la sophistication de la tarification et de la segmentation des risques, en mettant en œuvre des changements dans la plateforme de tarification et en effectuant les validations requises.

Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de développer vos connaissances et votre expérience pour l'avenir, dans un environnement stimulant où votre avis compte. Ce poste est nouvellement vacant.

Zurich Canada utilise des outils intégrant l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certains aspects du processus de recrutement, notamment l’examen initial et le présélection des candidatures. L’intelligence artificielle ne constitue pas l’unique fondement de la présélection ou de la sélection des candidats. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont examinées et prises par des professionnels qualifiés en recrutement.

Zurich adopte un modèle de travail hybride qui exige une présence en personne trois jours par semaine, comprenant du temps au bureau ou des rencontres avec le marché.

Ce que vous ferez

• Sous supervision modérée, soutenir la tarification des nouvelles affaires et des portefeuilles de renouvellement.
• Aider à la préparation d’analyses de taux, d’indications, d’analyses de tendances et d’impacts de taux.
• Contribuer aux activités liées aux dépôts réglementaires, à la gouvernance et aux revues internes, avec l’appui de membres seniors.
• Participer au développement, à la maintenance et à la documentation des modèles, outils et rapports de tarification.
• Développer une compréhension des principaux facteurs influençant les coûts de sinistres, les primes et la performance du portefeuille.
• Aider à la surveillance de la rentabilité et de la performance du portefeuille pour les nouvelles affaires et les renouvellements.
• Soutenir les équipes de produits et de souscription en fournissant des analyses et des observations basées sur les données.
• Participer aux activités de validation, de mise en œuvre et de maintenance des algorithmes et plateformes de tarification.
• Se tenir informé des évolutions réglementaires et du marché en tarification automobile.
• Travailler conformément aux lignes directrices et procédures de souscription et de tarification de Zurich.

Qualifications personnelles - Ce que vous apportez

Obligatoires :

• Apprenti certifié en assurance Zurich, incluant un diplôme d’associé

OU

• Baccalauréat

ET

• 3 à 4 ans d’expérience dans un rôle actuariel ou analytique, idéalement en assurance de dommages – lignes personnelles
• Progression vers un titre actuariel (ACAS ou certification internationale équivalente)

Souhaitées :

• Exposition à la tarification automobile dans une ou plusieurs provinces
• Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à interpréter les résultats
• Bonnes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite en développement
• Capacité à vulgariser des résultats analytiques pour des parties prenantes non techniques, avec accompagnement

Chez Zurich Canada, nous nous engageons envers l’équité salariale. Nous déterminons la rémunération selon des critères objectifs tels que les compétences, l’expérience et l’équité interne. L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 81,000 à 131 000. Cette plage reflète la rémunération prévue pour ce poste partout au Canada et peut varier selon des facteurs comme l’emplacement, les responsabilités spécifiques et les qualifications individuelles. Conformément à la loi locale, Zurich fournit de bonne foi une fourchette de rémunération raisonnable, mais le salaire de départ peut dépasser cette plage selon les compétences et l’expérience du candidat.

La maîtrise de l’anglais parlé et écrit est requise afin de faciliter la communication avec des parties prenantes internes et externes hors Québec.

Notre culture

• Chez Zurich, nous sommes fiers de notre culture. Nous sommes passionnés par la Diversité, l’Inclusion, l’Équité et l’Appartenance (DIEB). Nous voulons que vous soyez vous-même au travail et que nos employés reflètent les communautés dans lesquelles nous vivons et travaillons. Nos initiatives DIEB créent un environnement où chacun se sent le bienvenu.

• Nous valorisons la collaboration et la diversité de pensée. Votre avis compte et nous offrons à nos employés les outils nécessaires pour avoir un impact.

• Le bien-être de nos employés nous tient à cœur. Nous proposons un régime complet d’avantages sociaux et de santé avec différents niveaux de couverture pour répondre à vos besoins, ainsi qu’un ensemble concurrentiel de rémunération globale.

• Nous savons qu’il est important de se reposer, de se ressourcer et de pratiquer ses passions. Chez Zurich, tous les employés bénéficient d’un minimum de quatre semaines de vacances par an pour le faire.

• Nous comprenons aussi que les employés ont besoin de congés personnels. Que ce soit pour un rendez-vous, une fête culturelle ou religieuse, ou pour se concentrer sur votre santé mentale, les employés de Zurich bénéficient de quatre jours personnels par an à utiliser à leur discrétion.

• Nous nous engageons à l’amélioration continue et offrons un accès à une gamme complète de formations et d’opportunités de développement.

• Nous avons à cœur nos communautés. Nos communautés sont là où nos clients, nos employés et nos actionnaires vivent et travaillent. Bien que nous puissions être fiers de notre contribution à la société par notre activité principale d’assurance, nous devons aussi redonner à nos communautés grâce à notre talent, notre temps et nos ressources.

• Nous avons remporté de nombreux prix pour notre culture d’entreprise. Nous sommes fiers d’être l’un des meilleurs employeurs du Grand Toronto et d’avoir reçu le prix Insurance Business Canada 5-Star pour la Diversité, l’Équité et l’Inclusion.

Faites la différence. Relevez des défis. Soyez inspiré(e). Soyez soutenu(e). Aimez ce que vous faites. Travaillez avec nous.

À propos de nous

Zurich Canada fait partie du Groupe Zurich Insurance, un assureur multibranches comptant environ 55 000 employés dans le monde, au service des clients sur les marchés mondiaux et locaux. Zurich Canada est un chef de file qui dessert les entreprises de taille moyenne et grande, y compris les multinationales, sur le marché commercial canadien depuis 100 ans. Avec plus de 650 employés dans des bureaux partout au pays, Zurich offre la force mondiale d’un assureur de premier plan, alliée à une connaissance approfondie des secteurs et des marchés locaux. Zurich Canada aspire à être le premier choix des professionnels de la gestion des risques comme partenaire privilégié pour relever les défis d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Pour en savoir plus, consultez www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here . If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here . Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
Opportunità

Alla ricerca di un ambiente di lavoro attento, collaborativo e basato sui valori con colleghi e leader ispiranti? Avete ambizione e desiderio di eccellere e fiorire nell'insurretore più influente del mondo? Non guardare oltre Zurigo Canada.

Se avete un'esperienza nel lavoro attuariale e siete alla ricerca di una nuova sfida, saremo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Zurigo Canada è attualmente alla ricerca di un Senior Actuarial Analyst, Automotive Pricing – Individuals, per sostenere il processo di valutazione dell'assicurazione auto privata e fornire analisi e prospettive al team di prezzi dell'automobile e ai nostri partner commerciali.

In questo ruolo, contribuirai anche a cambiamenti tariffari, reporting e comunicazione di questi cambiamenti ai partner interni. Parteciperai al continuo miglioramento della sofisticazione dei prezzi e della segmentazione dei rischi, implementando i cambiamenti nella piattaforma dei prezzi ed eseguendo le validazioni richieste.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per sviluppare la vostra conoscenza e la vostra esperienza per il futuro, in un ambiente stimolante in cui la vostra opinione conta. Questo posto è appena vacante.

Zurigo Canada utilizza strumenti che integrano l'intelligenza artificiale per sostenere alcuni aspetti del processo di reclutamento, tra cui l'esame iniziale e la screening delle applicazioni. L'intelligenza artificiale non è la sola base per la proiezione o la selezione dei candidati. Tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono esaminate e prese da professionisti qualificati di reclutamento.

Zurigo adotta un modello ibrido di lavoro che richiede una presenza persona a persona tre giorni alla settimana, tra cui l'orario di ufficio o gli incontri con il mercato.

Cosa farai

• Sotto una moderata supervisione, supporta i prezzi dei nuovi portafogli di business e rinnovo.
• Assistere nella preparazione di analisi dei tassi, indicazioni, analisi di tendenza e impatti dei tassi.
• Contribuisci alle attività legate ai licenziamenti normativi, alla governance e alle recensioni interne, con il supporto dei membri senior.
• Partecipa allo sviluppo, alla manutenzione e alla documentazione dei modelli, degli strumenti e dei report dei prezzi.
• Sviluppare una comprensione dei principali fattori che influenzano i costi dei crediti, i premi e le prestazioni del portafoglio.
• Assistere nel monitoraggio della redditività e delle prestazioni del portafoglio per nuove imprese e rinnovi.
• Supporta i team di prodotti e abbonamenti fornendo analisi e osservazioni basate sui dati.
• Partecipa alla validazione, implementazione e manutenzione di algoritmi e piattaforme di prezzi.
• Tenere informato degli sviluppi normativi e di mercato nei prezzi delle auto.
• Lavoro in conformità con le linee guida e le procedure di abbonamento e prezzi di Zurigo.

Qualifiche personali - Che cosa porti

Mandatory:

• Imparare certificato in assicurazione Zurigo, compreso il grado associato

O

• Baccalaureato

E

• da 3 a 4 anni di esperienza in un ruolo attuariale o analitico, idealmente in assicurazione danni – linee personali
• Progressi verso il titolo attuariale (ACAS o certificazione internazionale equivalente)

Desideri:

• Esposizione ai prezzi delle auto in una o più province
• Forte capacità analitiche e capacità di interpretare i risultati
• Buone capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta nello sviluppo
• Capacità di divulgare i risultati analitici per gli stakeholder non tecnici, con il supporto

A Zurigo Canada, siamo impegnati a pagare l'equità. Determinamo la compensazione in base a criteri oggettivi quali competenze, esperienza e correttezza interna. La fascia salariale per questa posizione è 81.000 a 131.000. Questa gamma riflette la paga prevista per questa posizione in tutto il Canada e può variare a seconda di fattori come la posizione, responsabilità specifiche e qualifiche individuali. Secondo la legge locale, Zurigo fornisce in buona fede un range di pagamento ragionevole, ma lo stipendio iniziale può superare questa gamma a seconda delle competenze e dell'esperienza del candidato.

La competenza in inglese parlato e scritto è necessaria per facilitare la comunicazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni al di fuori del Quebec.

La nostra cultura

• A Zurigo siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura. Siamo appassionati di Diversità, Inclusione, Equità e Membership (DIEB). Vogliamo che siate al lavoro voi stessi e i nostri dipendenti a riflettere le comunità in cui viviamo e lavoriamo. Le nostre iniziative DIEB creano un ambiente in cui tutti si sentono benvenuti.

• Apprezziamo la collaborazione e la diversità del pensiero. La tua opinione conta e offriamo ai nostri dipendenti gli strumenti per avere un impatto.

• Ci preoccupiamo del benessere dei nostri dipendenti. Offriamo un piano completo di benefici sociali e sanitari con diversi livelli di copertura per soddisfare le vostre esigenze, così come un pacchetto di compensazione globale competitivo.

• Sappiamo che è importante riposare, rilassarsi e praticare le vostre passioni. A Zurigo, tutti i dipendenti hanno un minimo di quattro settimane di vacanza all'anno per farlo.

• Sappiamo anche che i dipendenti hanno bisogno di un congedo personale. Che si tratti di un appuntamento, di una celebrazione culturale o religiosa, o di concentrarsi sulla vostra salute mentale, i dipendenti di Zurigo beneficiano di quattro giorni personali all'anno da utilizzare a loro discrezione.

• Siamo impegnati a un miglioramento continuo e offriamo l'accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.

• Abbiamo a cuore le nostre comunità. Le nostre comunità sono dove vivono e lavorano i nostri clienti, dipendenti e azionisti. Mentre possiamo essere orgogliosi del nostro contributo alla società attraverso la nostra attività di assicurazione primaria, dobbiamo anche restituire alle nostre comunità attraverso il nostro talento, il tempo e le risorse.

• Abbiamo vinto molti premi per la nostra cultura aziendale. Siamo orgogliosi di essere uno dei migliori datori di lavoro in Greater Toronto e di aver ricevuto il Insurance Business Canada 5-Star Award per la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione.

Fai la differenza. Alza le sfide. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora con noi.

Informazioni su di noi

Opportunity

Looking for a caring, collaborative and values-based work environment with inspiring colleagues and leaders? Do you have ambition and desire to excel and flourish in the world's most influential insurer? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have an experience in actuarial work and are looking for a new challenge, we would be happy to receive your application.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Senior Actuarial Analyst, Automotive Pricing – Individuals, to support the private car insurance pricing process and provide analysis and perspectives to the automobile pricing team and our business partners.

In this role, you will also contribute to tariff changes, reporting and communicating these changes to internal partners. You will participate in the continuous improvement of pricing sophistication and risk segmentation, implementing changes in the pricing platform and performing the required validations.

This is a unique opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience for the future, in a stimulating environment where your opinion counts. This post is newly vacant.

Zurich Canada uses tools that integrate artificial intelligence to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including initial examination and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for the screening or selection of candidates. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified recruitment professionals.

Zurich adopts a hybrid model of work that requires a person-to-person presence three days a week, including office time or meetings with the market.

What You Will Do

• Under moderate supervision, support the pricing of new business and renewal portfolios.
• Assist in the preparation of rate analyses, indications, trend analyses and rate impacts.
• Contribute to activities related to regulatory filings, governance and internal reviews, with support from senior members.
• Participate in the development, maintenance and documentation of pricing models, tools and reports.
• Develop an understanding of the main factors influencing claims costs, premiums and portfolio performance.
• Assist in monitoring the profitability and performance of the portfolio for new business and renewals.
• Support product and subscription teams by providing data-based analysis and observations.
• Participate in the validation, implementation and maintenance of algorithms and pricing platforms.
• Keep informed of regulatory and market developments in car pricing.
• Work in accordance with the Zurich subscription and pricing guidelines and procedures.

Personal qualifications - What you bring

Mandatory:

• Learned certified in insurance Zurich, including associate degree

OR

• Baccalaureate

AND

• 3 to 4 years of experience in an actuarial or analytical role, ideally in damage insurance – personal lines
• Progress towards actuarial title (ACAS or equivalent international certification)

Wishes:

• Exposure to car pricing in one or more provinces
• Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret results
• Good oral and written communication skills in development
• Ability to popularize analytical results for non-technical stakeholders, with support

At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation according to objective criteria such as skills, experience and internal fairness. The salary range for this position is 81,000 to 131,000. This range reflects the expected pay for this position across Canada and may vary depending on factors such as location, specific responsibilities and individual qualifications. According to local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable pay range, but the starting salary may exceed this range depending on the candidate's skills and experience.

Proficiency in spoken and written English is required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

Our culture

• At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Membership (DIEB). We want you to be at work yourself and our employees to reflect the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives create an environment where everyone feels welcome.

• We value collaboration and diversity of thought. Your opinion counts and we offer our employees the tools to make an impact.

• We care about the well-being of our employees. We offer a comprehensive social and health benefits plan with different levels of coverage to meet your needs, as well as a competitive overall compensation package.

• We know that it is important to rest, to relax and practice your passions. At Zurich, all employees have a minimum of four weeks' vacation per year to do so.

• We also understand that employees need personal leave. Whether it's for an appointment, a cultural or religious celebration, or to focus on your mental health, Zurich employees benefit from four personal days a year to use at their discretion.

• We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a full range of training and development opportunities.

• We have our communities at heart. Our communities are where our clients, employees and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of our contribution to society through our primary assurance activity, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.

• We have won many awards for our corporate culture. We are proud to be one of the best employers in Greater Toronto and to have received the Insurance Business Canada 5-Star Award for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

Make a difference. Raise challenges. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work with us.

About us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-branch insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide, serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leader in serving medium and large businesses, including multinationals, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a leading insurer, combined with a thorough knowledge of local sectors and markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be the first choice of risk management professionals as a preferred partner to meet the challenges of today and tomorrow. For more information, visit www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich leads to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We welcome talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion brig us closer to our common goal: exeeding our customers Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on need of, Zurich.
